findings.reasoning: Laravel's validator skips non-implicit rules for an empty string (Validator::presentOrRuleIsImplicit returns isImplicit($rule) when trim($value) === ''), so '' never reaches integer or exists; UploadPostForm.php:114 maps '' to null. Pinned by tests/Feature/Livewire/UploadPostFormImportIntegrationTest.php:56-79, which submits without choosing a category and asserts no errors.
findings.resolution_ru: categoryId по умолчанию '', nullable это не пропускает, и integer отклонит отправку без категории. Итог: бот ошибся, валидатор Laravel пропускает неимплицитные правила для пустой строки, UploadPostForm превращает '' в null, и это закреплено тестом UploadPostFormImportIntegrationTest.

findings.claim: After a failed moderation action the cached post is not reloaded, so the Hide/Restore button for the old status stays visible.
findings.reasoning: $cachedPost is a private property (InlinePostModeration.php:29) and Livewire does not persist private properties, so every request reads the post afresh the first time post() runs — inside hide()/restore(), immediately before the action — and canHide/canRestore then render from that same current row. A status changed by another moderator before the click is therefore already reflected; only a change in the milliseconds between that read and the action's lock could differ, and the next request corrects it.
findings.resolution_ru: После неудачной модерации кэшированный пост не перечитывается, и остаётся кнопка для старого статуса. Итог: бот ошибся, $cachedPost приватный и не сохраняется Livewire, пост читается заново прямо перед действием; расхождение возможно лишь в миллисекунды, и следующий запрос его исправит.

findings.claim: Rating filters can match answers from inactive groups or archived options.
findings.reasoning: FeedPage normalizes the ratings filter against active groups and their active options at mount, on every update and on every toggle (FeedPage.php:55-60, 72-75, 87-105, 204-224), and PostFeed is FeedQuery's only caller (PostFeed.php:50-57). A configuration change while a page is open only leaves the visitor's own chosen filter in effect until their next interaction; a forged PostFeed prop only narrows the forger's own list of published posts.
findings.resolution_ru: Фильтры рейтинга могут совпадать с ответами неактивных групп или архивных опций. Итог: бот ошибся, FeedPage нормализует фильтр по активным группам и опциям при каждом изменении, PostFeed единственный вызывающий FeedQuery, а поддельный prop сужает лишь свой список.

findings.claim: Once a user has voted, the rating UI switches permanently to results, so the answer cannot be changed.
findings.reasoning: Showing the results panel instead of the option buttons after voting is the documented component design: docs/design/design-contract.md:47 specifies the option chips 'until the visitor has voted' followed by the Results panel, implemented in components/voting/rating-options.blade.php:20-27. Replacement in VoteRatingOptionAction (docs/rating/configurable-voting.md:39) serves other callers such as Content Studio; it does not imply a public change-vote control.
findings.resolution_ru: После голосования UI рейтинга навсегда показывает результаты, и ответ не сменить. Итог: бот ошибся, это задокументированный дизайн компонента; замена голоса в VoteRatingOptionAction служит другим вызывающим, например Content Studio, а не публичной кнопке смены.

findings.claim: Repeated-vote handling should move into VotePostAction so clicking the active vote withdraws it.
findings.reasoning: The current behaviour is deliberate and pinned: tests/Feature/Livewire/PostVotingTest.php:25-42 ('keeps upvote active when clicked again in the UI') and :60-108 (opposite click clears first, second click casts) assert exactly what PostVoting.php:62-66 does, and VotePostAction's toggle contract is documented in its docblock (VotePostAction.php:31-33) for its other callers (Content Studio). The finding asks for a product behaviour change, not a fix.
findings.resolution_ru: Обработку повторного голоса надо перенести в VotePostAction, чтобы клик снимал активный голос. Итог: бот ошибся, текущее поведение намеренное и закреплено в PostVotingTest, контракт VotePostAction описан для других вызывающих; это смена продуктового поведения, а не исправление.

findings.claim: The moderation list admits a live row with status Deleted, and Recently Deleted lists rows whose deleted_from_status is null or not author-deletable.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause and verdict as 02-51: the only writer of status Deleted and deleted_from_status is DeletePostAction, which sets both together with the soft delete and only from an author-deletable status (DeletePostAction.php:63-70), so neither malformed shape is produced by any code path. In listed() a live row is admitted by whereNull(deleted_at) whatever its status, and the 'deleted' tab already requires both conditions (ModerationPostsQuery.php:160-187); RecentlyDeletedPostsQuery.php:15-26 documents its well-formed shape as soft-deleted + status Deleted.
findings.resolution_ru: Список модерации пропускает живую строку со статусом Deleted, а Recently Deleted строки с неверным deleted_from_status. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 02-51: оба поля пишет только DeletePostAction вместе с soft delete, такие кривые строки не создаёт ни один путь.

findings.claim: randomActive/choices/activeChoices turn a zero limit into one row; they should return an empty collection.
findings.reasoning: No caller passes 0: StudioPlanDiscussionEditor bounds randomCount to at least 1 before calling randomActive (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1202, 1576), CreateStudioPlan asks for 1 (CreateStudioPlan.php:64), and choices/activeChoices receive class constants (EditsStudioPlan.php:1116, StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1305, 1344, 1475, StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:1242, StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:1846).
findings.resolution_ru: randomActive, choices и activeChoices превращают нулевой лимит в одну строку. Итог: бот ошибся, никто не передаёт 0: StudioPlanDiscussionEditor ограничивает randomCount минимум единицей, CreateStudioPlan просит 1, а choices и activeChoices получают константы.

findings.claim: ImportUrlForm is never mounted, so the page-import preview flow is unreachable.
findings.reasoning: True: no view mounts livewire:import.import-url-form since commit 4e335e3b, which replaced the upload modal's import tab with an image-URL tab bound directly to UploadPostForm::$importedImageUrl (upload-post-form.blade.php:148-163); ImportFromUrlAction is still used by the Studio plan editor (EditsStudioPlan.php:704). The removal looks deliberate, so this is dead code plus a stale guide (docs/import/url-import.md:5-7, 316, 343 still describe the page-import flow) — a cleanup, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: ImportUrlForm нигде не монтируется, и превью импорта страницы недостижимо. Итог: верно, вкладку импорта, похоже, намеренно заменили вкладкой URL картинки в UploadPostForm; это мёртвый код и устаревший url-import.md, то есть уборка, а не дефект.

findings.claim: ImportUrlForm succeeds silently on an empty preview and reports unexpected failures as 'unsupported'.
findings.reasoning: Both concern ImportUrlForm, which no production view mounts (see 04-37), so neither message can reach a user; fix or delete together with the component.
findings.resolution_ru: ImportUrlForm молча успешен на пустом превью и выдаёт неожиданные сбои как unsupported. Итог: оба пункта касаются ImportUrlForm, который не монтирует ни один продакшен-view (см. 04-37), так что пользователь их не увидит; чинить или удалять вместе с компонентом.

findings.claim: $tags holds the whole tags table as a public property and is serialized on every round-trip.
findings.reasoning: True (UploadPostForm.php:55, 281-293), but tags are an administrator-curated list, so the snapshot is a few KB; moving to a computed, server-filtered list is a refactor with little measurable gain.
findings.resolution_ru: $tags хранит всю таблицу тегов в публичном свойстве и сериализуется на каждом запросе. Итог: верно, но теги это список, который ведут администраторы, снимок весит несколько КБ; переход на вычисляемый список с фильтром на сервере это рефакторинг с малой измеримой пользой.

findings.claim: matchedUsers() runs an unindexed leading-wildcard LIKE over users on every FeedPage request while a search is active.
findings.reasoning: True (FeedPage.php:267-278, MatchedUsersQuery.php:14-30, limit 5), but literal LIKE search is the accepted, documented approach (http-and-database-boundaries.md:64-79) and the posts search on the same request does the same; caching per term is speculative optimization.
findings.resolution_ru: matchedUsers() при активном поиске делает LIKE с ведущим wildcard по users без индекса на каждом запросе FeedPage. Итог: верно, но буквальный LIKE это принятый и задокументированный подход, поиск постов в том же запросе работает так же, а кэш по запросу это спекулятивная оптимизация.

findings.claim: users.role and users.status are unindexed, so every Persona query scans users.
findings.reasoning: True that no index covers role/status (add_role/add_status migrations), but these queries serve only the administrator Content Studio screens; an index is a schema change to justify with measurements, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: users.role и users.status без индекса, и каждый запрос Persona сканирует users. Итог: верно, но эти запросы обслуживают только админские экраны Content Studio; индекс это изменение схемы, которое надо обосновать замерами, а не дефект.

findings.claim: The published-post filter also applies to the owner, although the privacy doc says the owner sees full history.
findings.reasoning: docs/profile/profile-privacy-rules.md:39 ('Owner sees full history') is about the visibility setting, and :82 states the published-only rule; the code applies it to everyone (UserRatingActivityQuery.php:25). Showing owners their votes on hidden or rejected posts would resurface titles of moderated content, so changing this is a product decision, not a fix.
findings.resolution_ru: Фильтр опубликованных постов применяется и к владельцу, хотя документ обещает ему всю историю. Итог: та фраза о настройке видимости, а правило только опубликованных задокументировано; показ голосов по скрытым постам вернул бы заголовки модерированного контента, это продуктовое решение.

findings.claim: activeRatingGroups is loaded even when no post is selected.
findings.reasoning: True (PostDrawer.php:120-122): two small configuration queries per render of the layout overlay; negligible.
findings.resolution_ru: activeRatingGroups загружается, даже когда пост не выбран. Итог: верно, но это два маленьких запроса конфигурации на рендер оверлея, нагрузка пренебрежимая.

findings.claim: The locale save can write onto a tombstone because UpdateUserLocaleAction does not lock, re-read and check canAuthenticate().
findings.reasoning: Same finding as 02-56 and 03-06 (SKIP): UpdateUserLocaleAction writes only the dirty locale column through the caller's instance, so the worst outcome is a language code on a tombstone that never signs in or receives mail. 03-06's note still applies: docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:402-409 overstates the barrier.
findings.resolution_ru: Сохранение локали может попасть на tombstone, так как UpdateUserLocaleAction не блокирует и не проверяет canAuthenticate(). Итог: та же находка, что 02-56 и 03-06, худший исход это код языка у tombstone; замечание 03-06 о преувеличении в user-lifecycle.md в силе.

findings.claim: A person's moderation history loses logs about posts and comments that were physically purged.
findings.reasoning: True (UserModerationProfileQuery.php:43-46 resolves authorship through live/trashed rows), but logs are kept as audit history with null-safe rendering of missing targets (docs/architecture/post-lifecycle.md:152-153); attributing them after purge needs a schema change to the moderation log.
findings.resolution_ru: История модерации человека теряет логи о физически удалённых постах и комментариях. Итог: верно, но логи хранятся как аудит с безопасной отрисовкой отсутствующих целей, а привязка их к автору после очистки требует изменения схемы лога модерации.

findings.claim: ToggleSavedPostAction checks post_saves before the locked save/unsave, so concurrent toggles can act on stale state.
findings.reasoning: Same finding as 02-53 (SKIP): Livewire queues one component's requests and SavePostAction/UnsavePostAction are idempotent, so racing tabs end in a consistent state the user can toggle again. The stale-button problem is tracked separately in 04-14.
findings.resolution_ru: ToggleSavedPostAction проверяет post_saves до заблокированного save/unsave. Итог: та же находка, что 02-53, Livewire выстраивает запросы в очередь, действия идемпотентны, состояние согласовано; устаревшая кнопка отслеживается отдельно в 04-14.

findings.claim: $canVote ignores the post lifecycle, so controls can render enabled for a non-public post.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 01-33 (SKIP): the post-state rule is enforced by VoteRatingOptionAction on the locked post with a clear message the component shows (RatingVoting.php:92-97); the component is mounted only for published posts and re-reads published() on rating-voted (:41-50), so only a post that changes state while open shows enabled controls.
findings.resolution_ru: $canVote игнорирует жизненный цикл поста, и элементы могут быть активны для непубличного поста. Итог: как в 01-33, правило проверяет VoteRatingOptionAction под блокировкой с понятным сообщением, компонент монтируется только для опубликованных постов, и активны они лишь при смене статуса на открытой странице.

findings.claim: randomActive() random-sorts the whole active Persona set before applying its small limit.
findings.reasoning: True (PersonasQuery.php:87-95), but the role filter restricts the sort to administrator-created Personas, a small set, on an admin-only action.
findings.resolution_ru: randomActive() случайно сортирует весь набор активных Persona до применения маленького лимита. Итог: верно, но фильтр по роли ограничивает сортировку небольшим набором Persona, созданных администраторами, в админском действии.

findings.claim: activeIds() materializes every active Persona id for operations that need only a count or a small set.
findings.reasoning: True (PersonasQuery.php:103-111, called repeatedly by the Studio vote editors), but the set is small and admin-only; replacing it with bounded queries is an optimization without a demonstrated cost.
findings.resolution_ru: activeIds() выгружает все id активных Persona там, где нужен лишь счётчик или маленький набор. Итог: верно, но набор маленький и только для админов; замена ограниченными запросами это оптимизация без доказанной стоимости.

findings.claim: counts() runs one COUNT query per SocialProvider case.
findings.reasoning: True, but SocialProvider has two cases (Google, Facebook); two queries on an admin settings page.
findings.resolution_ru: counts() делает по одному COUNT на каждый случай SocialProvider. Итог: верно, но случаев два, Google и Facebook, то есть два запроса на странице настроек админа.

findings.claim: The moderation reason is length-limited only in the browser, at 1000 instead of the Filament forms' 500.
findings.reasoning: Only moderators can submit it, the reason is normalized by CreateModerationLogAction and stored in a text column (create_moderation_logs migration: text('reason')), so a long reason cannot fail or harm anything; aligning the limit is cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: Причина модерации ограничена только в браузере, 1000 символов вместо 500, как в формах Filament. Итог: отправить её могут только модераторы, CreateModerationLogAction её нормализует, хранится она в text-колонке, так что длинная причина ничего не ломает; выравнивание лимита косметика.

findings.claim: A search of just '@' binds '%%' for the author/Persona name and matches every plan or action.
findings.reasoning: True (StudioPlansQuery.php:73, StudioActionsQuery.php:146; PersonasQuery.php:176 behaves the same), but an administrator typing '@' simply sees the unfiltered list, the same as an empty search; no wrong data is shown.
findings.resolution_ru: Поиск по одному «@» подставляет '%%' и находит все планы и действия. Итог: верно, но администратор просто видит нефильтрованный список, как при пустом поиске; неверных данных не показывается.

findings.claim: The onTab() docblock says Hidden holds every hidden comment although author-deleted ones appear under Deleted.
findings.reasoning: Docblock wording only (ModerationCommentsQuery.php:102-117); behaviour is as tested.
findings.resolution_ru: Docblock onTab() говорит, что во вкладке Hidden все скрытые комментарии, хотя удалённые автором попадают в Deleted. Итог: это только формулировка docblock, поведение соответствует тестам.

findings.claim: The @return type hides the nested post_id → rating_group_id map.
findings.reasoning: PHPDoc precision only.
findings.resolution_ru: Тип @return скрывает вложенную карту post_id → rating_group_id. Итог: это только точность PHPDoc, на поведение не влияет.

findings.claim: vote() computes $currentVote and never uses it.
findings.reasoning: True (CommentVoting.php:42-44): dead code costing one indexed query per vote click; a cleanup.
findings.resolution_ru: vote() вычисляет $currentVote и не использует его. Итог: верно, это мёртвый код ценой одного индексного запроса на клик; это уборка, а не исправление дефекта.

findings.claim: variant="compact" passed by post-show and post-drawer-content has no effect.
findings.reasoning: True (FollowButton has no variant property), but an unused attribute changes no behaviour; cleanup.
findings.resolution_ru: variant="compact", который передают post-show и post-drawer-content, ни на что не влияет. Итог: верно, у FollowButton нет свойства variant, но лишний атрибут не меняет поведения; это уборка.

findings.claim: toggle() does not send the shown state, so a stale page can invert the user's intent.
findings.reasoning: On one page FollowButton instances stay in sync through follow-state-changed (FollowButton.php:60, 68-75), so only a second tab can be stale, and the button then shows the real state for the next click; consistent with 02-39 (SKIP).
findings.resolution_ru: toggle() не передаёт показанное состояние, и устаревшая страница может инвертировать намерение. Итог: на одной странице кнопки синхронизируются через follow-state-changed, устареть может только вторая вкладка, и после клика кнопка покажет реальное состояние; как в 02-39.

findings.claim: The failure scan's 'constant memory' claim is wrong for drivers that buffer cursor() results; use chunking or an unbuffered read.
findings.reasoning: Partly true: cursor() (TranslationAiUsageQuery.php:228-238) hydrates one model at a time but pdo_mysql and pdo_pgsql buffer the result client-side. The rows are three small columns of failed calls in one period on an admin page, so memory is not a practical concern; at most the docblock should be qualified.
findings.resolution_ru: Обещание «постоянной памяти» при cursor() неверно для драйверов с буферизацией. Итог: частично верно, pdo_mysql и pdo_pgsql буферизуют результат, но это три небольших колонки неудачных вызовов за период на админ-странице; максимум стоит уточнить docblock.

findings.claim: The p95 docblock claims an indexed-order read but no index covers latency_ms.
findings.reasoning: True (indexes are on completed_at and composites, not latency_ms); the sort covers one period's calls on an admin page. Docblock accuracy only.
findings.resolution_ru: Docblock p95 обещает чтение в порядке индекса, но индекса на latency_ms нет. Итог: верно, но сортируются вызовы одного периода на админ-странице; вопрос только к точности docblock.

findings.claim: NotificationBell should delegate markAsRead() to an Action.
findings.reasoning: Layering convention only: the component already scopes the lookup to the authenticated user's notifications (NotificationBell.php:40-56); no behavioural defect.
findings.resolution_ru: NotificationBell должен делегировать markAsRead() в Action. Итог: это только соглашение о слоях; компонент уже ограничивает поиск уведомлениями текущего пользователя, дефекта поведения нет.

findings.claim: PostShow and PostDrawer should navigate away or close when the displayed post is hidden via post-moderated.
findings.reasoning: Only PostFeed is specified to consume post-moderated (docs/design/phase-22-inline-moderation-ui-review.md 'Card refresh'). Keeping the page/drawer lets the moderator use the inline Restore that InlinePostModeration offers right after hiding; a re-render of PostShow would instead hit findOrFail on a now-hidden post. A behaviour change to decide, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: PostShow и PostDrawer должны закрываться, когда пост скрыт через post-moderated. Итог: по спецификации post-moderated обрабатывает только PostFeed; открытая страница даёт модератору сразу нажать Restore, а перерисовка PostShow упала бы на findOrFail. Это решение о поведении, не дефект.

findings.claim: MediaAuditIssuesQuery, PersonasQuery and ModerationUsersQuery raw-SQL boundaries are missing from the reviewed-boundaries list.
findings.reasoning: The executable registry already lists all three with behaviour tests (tools/phpstan/architecture.neon rawSqlExceptions; tests/Feature/Queries/MediaAuditIssuesQueryTest.php, PersonasQueryTest.php, ModerationUsersQueryTest.php); only the prose list at http-and-database-boundaries.md:64-79 lags (it also omits ModerationPosts/Comments/ReportsQuery). Documentation sync, no code issue.
findings.resolution_ru: В списке проверенных raw-SQL границ нет MediaAuditIssuesQuery, PersonasQuery и ModerationUsersQuery. Итог: исполняемый реестр в architecture.neon уже содержит все три с тестами; отстаёт только текст в http-and-database-boundaries.md, это синхронизация документации.

findings.claim: idIn() strips all leading '#', so '##12' still finds id 12.
findings.reasoning: True (StudioPlansQuery.php:92-96, StudioActionsQuery.php:164-169), but an admin search for '##12' finding #12 is harmless.
findings.resolution_ru: idIn() срезает все ведущие '#', поэтому '##12' находит id 12. Итог: верно, но то, что админский поиск '##12' находит #12, безвредно.

findings.claim: CommentsSection should refresh its lists on comment-voted for its post.
findings.reasoning: Nothing the section renders goes stale on a vote: scores live in the CommentVoting children, which update themselves, and counts are unaffected. Refreshing would re-sort a 'top'/'hot' thread under the reader on every vote.
findings.resolution_ru: CommentsSection должна обновлять списки по comment-voted для своего поста. Итог: от голоса ничего не устаревает: счёт живёт в дочерних CommentVoting, которые обновляются сами, счётчики не меняются, а обновление пересортировало бы ветку top/hot под читателем.

findings.claim: Replies are eager-loaded without a per-root bound.
findings.reasoning: True (CommentListQuery.php:18-31), but threads are two levels deep and showing every surviving reply of a shown root is the current design; bounding replies needs a 'more replies' UI. The forged-limit amplification is handled in 04-07.
findings.resolution_ru: Ответы подгружаются без лимита на корневой комментарий. Итог: верно, но ветки двухуровневые, и показ всех ответов показанного корня это текущий дизайн; лимит требует UI «ещё ответы». Усиление через подделанный limit закрыто в 04-07.

findings.claim: openTargets() reaches the Query Builder through getQuery()/toBase() instead of the Eloquent API.
findings.reasoning: Style/layering point; the distinct-target count is correct and covered by ModerationReportsQueryTest.
findings.resolution_ru: openTargets() обращается к Query Builder через getQuery()/toBase(), а не через Eloquent. Итог: это вопрос стиля и слоёв; подсчёт уникальных целей корректен и покрыт ModerationReportsQueryTest.

findings.claim: Add a tied-sort cross-page test for StudioActionsQuery::forPlan.
findings.reasoning: The ordering already ends on id (StudioActionsQuery.php:56-64) and the existing test covers ties on one page (StudioActionsQueryTest.php:77-89); a cross-page test, as http-and-database-boundaries.md:120-125 asks for registered boundaries, is test hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: Нужен межстраничный тест сортировки с равными значениями для StudioActionsQuery::forPlan. Итог: сортировка уже заканчивается на id, а существующий тест покрывает равенства на одной странице; межстраничный тест это лишь усиление тестов.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks the template's verification, architecture, visual and mobile sections.
findings.reasoning: Audit-PR bookkeeping, not a property of the code (same as 01-37/02-88/03-35).
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов шаблона о проверке, архитектуре, визуале и мобильной версии. Итог: это оформление аудиторского PR, а не свойство кода (как 01-37, 02-88, 03-35).

findings.claim: Docstring coverage is below the configured threshold.
findings.reasoning: Documentation-coverage metric; no behavioural defect (same as 01-38).
findings.resolution_ru: Покрытие docstring ниже настроенного порога. Итог: это метрика покрытия документацией, дефекта поведения нет (как 01-38).

findings.claim: normalizeHost() only lowercases and strips a trailing dot, with no hostname-character check, so hosts containing %, \ or spaces reach DNS and the transport.
findings.reasoning: normalizeHost (UrlImportValidator.php:106-141) accepts whatever parse_url() returns, including a percent-encoded host such as 'a%2eb.attacker.example'. resolveAndValidate resolves that literal string with dns_get_record (DnsHostResolver.php:20), and the transport pins '{host}:{port}:{ip}' under the same literal string (PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:134); Guzzle's Uri keeps the encoded host (checked with psr7 2.13.2). libcurl percent-decodes the URL host (the decoding behind CVE-2022-27780, present since 7.80, so also in the Ubuntu 22.04 baseline's 7.81), connects as 'a.b.attacker.example', finds no matching CURLOPT_RESOLVE entry and does its own DNS lookup. Verified locally with libcurl 8.23 and 8.6: a pin for 'a%2eb.invalid' was ignored and curl tried to resolve 'a.b.invalid'. This breaks the documented core invariant (docs/import/url-import.md:100-133, 'the transport never performs its own DNS lookup'). Backslashes and spaces are rejected by curl's own hostname check (fail closed), so '%' is the bypass; raw non-ASCII hosts are a probable second one with an IDN-enabled libcurl (not verifiable on this machine). UrlImportValidatorTest has no case for either.
findings.scenario: A signed-in member submits the upload form with importedImageUrl = https://x%2ei.attacker.example/a.jpg. UploadPostForm downloads it even when imports are switched off (04-02). The attacker's nameserver answers the literal label 'x%2ei' with a public IP, so validation passes and the pin targets that IP. curl then resolves x.i.attacker.example itself, the attacker answers 10.0.0.5, 127.0.0.1 or 169.254.169.254, and the server opens TCP and TLS connections to internal addresses on ports 80/443, with no security.unsafe_url_blocked log. Only https is allowed and TLS verification is on, so no internal response is read: this is blind connection probing (reachability and timing). It becomes full SSRF to metadata or internal HTTP the moment allowed_schemes gains http.

findings.claim: redactException only rewrites the 'Key (...)=(...)' / 'Duplicate entry' fragments, but a QueryException message also carries ' (Connection: ..., SQL: ...)' with the bindings substituted, so emails, names and password hashes still reach Nightwatch.
findings.reasoning: Laravel builds every QueryException message as previous message + ' (Connection: pgsql, Host/Port/Database..., SQL: <sql with Str::replaceArray bindings>)' unless the connection sets mask_bindings_in_exception_messages (vendor QueryException::formatMessage; Connection.php:871), and config/database.php does not set it. Nightwatch's ExceptionSensor sends getMessage() as the record message, and redactException (NightwatchPrivacy.php:233-246) only replaces the DETAIL 'Key (col)=(value)' and MySQL 'Duplicate entry' values, so the SQL tail with all inserted values survives; the class docblock (:21-24) promises 'no SQL bindings'. NightwatchPrivacyTest.php:336-357 only feeds bare driver messages, never a real QueryException message. The same unmasked message also reaches Sentry (sentry.php only disables sql_bindings in breadcrumbs/spans) and laravel.log, and Nightwatch's request/command 'exception_preview' (first 255 chars of the raw message, ExceptionSensor.php:77) bypasses redactException entirely, so the DETAIL value leaks there too.
findings.scenario: With Nightwatch enabled on staging, two concurrent registrations with the same address (the unique-violation 500 of 02-08) produce a UniqueConstraintViolationException whose message ends '... SQL: insert into "users" ("name", "email", "password", ...) values (Ada, ada@example.com, $2y$12$...)'; redactException leaves that tail intact and Nightwatch stores the name, email and bcrypt hash.

findings.claim: The Hot feed orders by a stored hot_score computed at the last activity, so scores never decay for posts without new votes/comments.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-64 (BUG medium): HotScoreCalculator divides by (age+2)^1.5 at calculation time (HotScoreCalculator.php:31-34), RecalculatePostScoreAction stores it only on a vote or new comment, FeedQuery.php:85 orders by the stored value, and routes/console.php schedules no posts:recalculate-hot-scores run. Keep one fix for both ids.
findings.scenario: See 02-64: a post that peaked a month ago keeps its early score and stays above today's posts in Hot indefinitely.

findings.claim: The Key/Duplicate-entry redaction patterns stop at the first ')' or "'" inside the value, so part of an email or username can still leak.
findings.reasoning: The PostgreSQL pattern '/(Key \([^)]*\)=\()[^)]*(\))/' (NightwatchPrivacy.php:236) stops at the first ')' in the value; verified with php: 'Key (email)=(a)b@x.com) already exists' becomes 'Key (email)=([redacted])b@x.com) already exists'. The MySQL pattern stops at the first apostrophe, which is common in addresses (o'brien@...). Usernames are /\A[a-z0-9_]+\z/ (ProfileUpdateRequest.php:24) so only emails are affected; on PostgreSQL (the primary DB, .env.example:23) a ')' needs an RFC-quoted or commented local part that Laravel's 'email' rule accepts but users rarely type. Independent of 05-02: stripping the SQL tail does not fix the DETAIL part.
findings.scenario: A user registers "x)y"@example.com twice concurrently; the Nightwatch exception record keeps 'y@example.com' after the redaction marker.

findings.claim: build() calls LogContext::base(), which resolves the authenticated user from the database, so during a database failure the context callback throws while the original error is being reported.
findings.reasoning: bootstrap/app.php:48-50 registers build() as an exception context callback; Handler::exceptionContext runs those callbacks unguarded inside reportThrowable (vendor Handler.php:471-476, 652-662), whereas Laravel's own context() wraps Auth::id() in try/catch for exactly this case (Handler.php:672-681). LogContext::base() calls auth()->id() and auth()->user() (LogContext.php:22-29); if the guard has not resolved the user yet, SessionGuard re-queries the users table, which throws again while the DB is down. Sentry's reportable callback runs before the logger (Handler.php:453-457), so Sentry still gets the error, but the log write never happens and the second exception escapes report().
findings.scenario: PostgreSQL goes down; every signed-in visitor's request fails in EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned with a QueryException; reporting it re-runs the user lookup in the context callback, which throws, so not one line about the outage lands in laravel.log (and Sentry receives duplicate events as the escaped exceptions are reported again by the kernel and HandleExceptions).

findings.claim: build() merges base() after the caller's context, so the signed-in administrator's user_id overwrites the persona id the persona events pass as user_id.
findings.reasoning: DomainLogger::build does array_merge($context, $this->logContext->base()) (DomainLogger.php:48), and base() sets user_id = auth()->id() when signed in (LogContext.php:22-25). The admin-driven persona events pass the persona as user_id: persona.created (CreatePersonaAction.php:80-83), persona.updated (UpdatePersonaAction.php:107-110), persona.avatar.updated (SetPersonaAvatarAction.php:131-134), each with admin_id too. In the admin panel the result is user_id = admin_id and the persona id is gone. DomainLoggerTest has no case for a caller-supplied user_id.
findings.scenario: An administrator edits Persona #57 in Filament; the log shows persona.updated {user_id: 3, admin_id: 3}, so nobody can tell from the logs which Persona was changed.

findings.claim: user_id and theme_preference never reach request logs because AttachStructuredLogContext evaluates LogContext::base() before the session starts.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 01-08 (AttachStructuredLogContext is prepended to the web group in bootstrap/app.php:22-25, before StartSession, so auth()->id() is null and the locale is the default when Log::withContext is set); DomainLogger and the exception context re-evaluate base() per call, so only plain Log:: calls and framework logs lack user_id. Verdict kept consistent with 01-08.
findings.scenario: A signed-in user triggers a plain Log::error in CreatePostAction; the line carries request_id but no user_id or theme_preference.

findings.claim: forUserAndPost runs a separate post_saves query for every save button mounted in the feed (N+1); load the states once with forUserAndPosts.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 04-10 (MINOR): forUserAndPost (SavedPostState.php:39-49) is called only from SavePostButton::mount (SavePostButton.php:36), once per card, while the batched forUserAndPosts (:15-37) has no caller. The fix in 04-10 resolves this finding too.
findings.scenario: A signed-in member's 12-card feed issues 12 separate post_saves EXISTS queries (plus 12 Post::find) per render.

findings.claim: The owner's saved count includes saves of posts that are no longer public, while the Saved tab (SavedPostsQuery) lists only published, non-deleted posts.
findings.reasoning: ProfileStats counts every post_saves row for the owner (ProfileStats.php:23-25), shown as the Saved stat (profile-page.blade.php:94-97). The Saved tab and /saved use SavedPostsQuery, which requires posts.status = Published and deleted_at IS NULL (SavedPostsQuery.php:15-24; ProfilePage.php:87-93). Nothing removes post_saves when a post is hidden, rejected or author-deleted (only Unsave/Toggle actions delete rows), so the two diverge whenever a saved post leaves the public state.
findings.scenario: A member saved 5 posts; a moderator hides one and its author deletes another. The profile header says 'Saved 5' but the Saved tab lists 3.

findings.claim: When no provider is listed, the Connected accounts card is not rendered, so a connected-accounts status or error flashed by ConnectedAccountsResponse is never shown.
findings.reasoning: ConnectedAccountsResponse puts its message only in the 'connected_accounts_status' flash or the 'connectedAccounts' error bag (ConnectedAccountsResponse.php:20-28), rendered solely inside the card partial (connected-accounts.blade.php:23-33). profile/edit.blade.php:28-34 renders the card only when providers() is non-empty, and providers() lists available providers plus still-connected ones (ConnectedAccounts.php:30-35). So when every provider is unavailable and the account has none connected after the action, the message disappears; SignInProviderSwitchesTest.php:290-296 pins hiding the card only without a pending message.
findings.scenario: Google is the only configured provider and an admin switches it off; a member with a password disconnects Google (allowed by SignInMethods). The redirect lands on /profile#connected-accounts, the card is gone and the 'Google disconnected' confirmation never appears; likewise a connect refused because the provider was just switched off shows no error.

findings.claim: hitOrFail() checks tooManyAttempts and then hits in two separate cache operations, so concurrent requests can all pass the check and exceed the limit (plus: add a concurrent-admission test).
findings.reasoning: True: ActionRateLimiter.php:16-23 reads the counter (tooManyAttempts) and increments it later (hit), so N requests in flight for the same key all see the old count. It guards per-user keys (RateLimitKey::userAction) for upload 5/600 s, comment 10/60 s, report 10/600 s and vote 60/60 s (config/rate_limits.php) in CreatePostAction.php:63, AddCommentAction.php:60, ReportContentAction.php:71, VotePostAction.php:57, VoteCommentAction.php:54 and VoteRatingOptionAction.php:55. Same check-then-hit root cause and same weight as 02-01 (login lockout): a burst amplifier of an anti-spam limit, not a bypass of an authorization control. ActionRateLimiterTest only covers sequential calls; the requested concurrency test is the regression test for this fix, not a separate finding.
findings.scenario: A member scripts 20 parallel Livewire upload submissions: all 20 pass tooManyAttempts while the counter is still below 5, so 20 posts are created inside a window that should allow 5.

findings.claim: drawn() compares xxh3 hex strings with <=>, which compares numerically when a hash looks numeric, so the comparator is not a total order and the draw can depend on input order.
findings.reasoning: Verified: [hash, id] <=> [hash, id] uses PHP loose string comparison, and an xxh3 hex string can be numeric (all digits, or digits with one "e" such as "9e00000000000000"; ~0.13% of hashes in a 200k sample). With A="9e00…", B="1234567890123456", C="5abc…" PHP gives A<B (numeric), B<C and C<A (string) — a cycle, so usort output then depends on input order. The trait promises "the same seed draws the same order, whatever order they came in" (DrawsPersonaVotes.php:144-147). The random pool is id-ordered (PersonasQuery::activeIds()), so only hand-chosen lists (chosenVoters, ordered as the admin picked) and timeOrder() inputs vary; a cycle needs two numeric hashes in one pool, so it is rare.
findings.scenario: An admin picks the same 150 Personas in a different order with the same seed; two of their hashes happen to be numeric with mismatched numeric/string order, so the rebuilt plan assigns some votes to different Personas although nothing changed.

findings.claim: openGraphFromMaster() passes the asset's nullable width/height into OpenGraphImage's non-nullable int parameters, so a dimensionless image makes the post page throw a TypeError.
findings.reasoning: True: media_assets.width/height are nullable (2026_07_29_100000_create_media_assets_table.php:27-28), openGraphFromMaster() passes them straight through (PostImagePresenter.php:279-286) into OpenGraphImage(int $width, int $height) (OpenGraphImage.php:11-16), and null to a non-nullable userland int is a TypeError in any mode; the downstream OpenGraphImageData already takes ?int. The project fixed exactly this for ResponsiveImage and calls dimensionless assets real ("stored before dimensions were recorded — or one whose probe failed", tests/Feature/Media/ResponsiveImageWithoutDimensionsTest.php:10-18; MediaAssetFactory::dimensionless()), but missed this DTO. Low because current ingest always records int dimensions (NormalizedImage int width/height; MediaAssetCreator.php:39-40), so only legacy rows reach it.
findings.scenario: A post whose image asset predates dimension probing (width/height NULL) and has no open_graph/post_detail_1920 variant on disk is opened: PostOpenGraph::image() -> openGraph() -> openGraphFromMaster() throws TypeError and the post page returns 500.

findings.claim: The IPv6 blocklist misses 6to4 (2002::/16), Teredo (2001::/32), local-use NAT64 (64:ff9b:1::/48) and deprecated site-local (fec0::/10), so addresses embedding or reaching private space are classified public.
findings.reasoning: IPV6_BLOCKED_CIDRS (PublicIpClassifier.php:37-44) holds only ::, ::1, fc00::/7, fe80::/10, ff00::/8 and 2001:db8::/32. extractEmbeddedIpv4 (:150-169) unwraps only IPv4-mapped, IPv4-compatible and 64:ff9b::/96, so 2002:7f00:1::, 2001::1, 64:ff9b:1::a00:5 and fec0::1 all return public. docs/import/url-import.md:185-193 lists the blocked set without these ranges, so the omission is not a recorded decision. Reaching an internal host through them needs a 6to4/Teredo tunnel, a local NAT64 on that prefix, or site-local routing on the server, which a standard VPS does not have. Exposure is therefore low and this is hardening.
findings.scenario: On a host whose network runs a local NAT64 on 64:ff9b:1::/48 (or routes fec0::/10), a hostname with AAAA 64:ff9b:1::a00:5 (embedding 10.0.0.5) passes validation, and the pinned connection reaches the internal 10.0.0.5.

findings.claim: The transport catches only ConnectionException, so a size-cap abort that Laravel surfaces as RequestException escapes instead of becoming ImportFetchException.
findings.reasoning: When on_headers throws or the XFERINFO callback aborts (errno 42), Guzzle rejects with a RequestException that carries the received response (vendor CurlFactory::createRejection). Laravel's PendingRequest::marshalTransportExceptionWithResponse rethrows it as Illuminate RequestException whenever that response is 4xx/5xx (Response::toException); only 1xx-3xx responses become the ConnectionException that PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:141 catches. So an oversized or mid-body-failed error response breaks the interface's @throws ImportFetchException contract (ImportHttpTransport.php:20-23). It skips the adapters' fallbacks, which catch only ImportFetchException|UnsafeImportUrlException (XPostImportAdapter.php:46, InstagramPostImportAdapter.php:75, ImportFromUrlAction.php:80). The outermost callers catch Throwable (EditsStudioPlan.php:356-366 and 704-717, UploadPostForm.php:90-97), so the user sees a generic error rather than a 500.
findings.scenario: Instagram's embed endpoint answers 429/404 with an HTML page over the 1 MB cap, or any server answers 500 with Content-Length: 50000000. Instead of keeping the og:image crop (Instagram) or falling back to the page's Open Graph tags (X), the Studio editor shows 'This post couldn't be read'. Sentry also gets an unclassified Illuminate RequestException instead of responseTooLarge.

findings.claim: The direct-image preview caps at import.max_image_bytes (8 MB) while the download caps at min(that, uploads.images.max_kilobytes*1024) (5 MB), so 5-8 MB images pass preview and then fail.
findings.reasoning: DirectImageImportAdapter.php:16-19 fetches with import.max_image_bytes (8 MB, config/import.php:25). StoreImportedImageAction::download() caps at min(8 MB, ImageIngestPolicy maxBytes) (StoreImportedImageAction.php:33-36), which is 5 MB by default (config/uploads.php:5). In the Studio editor, a direct image link pasted as a post link goes ImportFromUrlAction -> preview (EditsStudioPlan.php:704) -> download (:356). A 5-8 MB image is therefore fetched in full twice and ends in a generic 'couldn't be downloaded. Try again' message instead of a size message. The final outcome, rejection, is still correct, which is why this is minor.
findings.scenario: An admin pastes a direct link to a 6 MB JPEG as the post link in the Studio editor. The preview downloads 6 MB and accepts it, the download stops at 5 MB with responseTooLarge, and the editor says 'The post's image couldn't be downloaded. Try again, or upload the file.' Retrying cannot help.

findings.claim: extractMeta() returns content untrimmed, so whitespace around an og:image value makes resolveUrl() produce a wrong URL.
findings.reasoning: extractMeta (OpenGraphParser.php:59-61) returns the raw attribute, unlike extractTitle (:72). Checked with psr7 2.13.2: UriResolver turns "\nhttps://cdn.example/a.jpg" into 'https://page.example/post/%0Ahttps://cdn.example/a.jpg' and a trailing space into '...a.jpg%20', and a leading space hits a Guzzle deprecation path. Browsers and social scrapers strip that whitespace. The broken URL then 404s, and the Studio post-link import reports no image for a page that has one. Title and description are affected too, but no live path consumes them (only imageUrl is used, EditsStudioPlan.php:704-724).
findings.scenario: A CMS template emits <meta property="og:image" content="\n  https://cdn.site/p.jpg">. The admin pastes the article link into the Studio editor, and the download of the mis-resolved URL fails with 'The post's image couldn't be downloaded'.

findings.claim: A non-empty http og:image masks og:image:secure_url, and the https-only policy then rejects the http URL, so the page yields no image.
findings.reasoning: parse() takes og:image first and only falls back to og:image:secure_url and twitter:image when og:image is absent (OpenGraphParser.php:30-32). OpenGraphImportAdapter validates that single candidate and drops it on UnsafeImportUrlException (OpenGraphImportAdapter.php:28-35); http is not an allowed scheme (config/import.php:6). Pages that publish an http og:image next to an https secure_url, the pattern og:image:secure_url exists for, therefore lose their image.
findings.scenario: A page carries og:image=http://cdn.site/p.jpg and og:image:secure_url=https://cdn.site/p.jpg. The Studio post-link import says 'No image was found in this post' although a valid https image is declared.

findings.claim: The Serbian date-locale override does not reach Laravel's Date facade, so Date-facade relative dates stay in plain 'sr'.
findings.reasoning: The listener sets Illuminate\Support\Carbon::setLocale($dateLocale) along with the Carbon classes (LanguageRulesServiceProvider.php:42-46). With no Date::use()/factory/callable configured (no Date:: usage in app/), DateFactory::__call forwards setLocale to Illuminate\Support\Carbon (vendor DateFactory.php:217-236), and Carbon's locale is global, so Date-created instances already use sr_Cyrl. tests/Feature/I18n/LanguageRulesTest.php:31-41 pins the Cyrillic output.
findings.resolution_ru: Сербская локаль дат якобы не доходит до фасада Date. Итог: бот ошибся: слушатель ставит локаль и для Illuminate\Support\Carbon, DateFactory пересылает setLocale туда же, а локаль Carbon глобальна; кириллический вывод закреплён в LanguageRulesTest.

findings.claim: profile_website_url accepts any URL scheme, so a javascript: link can be saved and rendered as a clickable href on public profiles.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's 'url' rule (Str::isUrl, vendor Support/Str.php:631-675) requires '<scheme>://host' from a fixed IANA scheme list that does not contain javascript or vbscript; checked directly: 'javascript:alert(1)', 'javascript://example.com/%0Aalert(1)' and mixed-case variants all fail. The only write path is EditProfileForm::save -> ProfileValidationRules -> UpdateUserProfileAction (EditProfileForm.php:44-55, UpdateUserProfileAction.php:33), and the link is Blade-escaped with rel=noopener noreferrer (profile-page.blade.php:28-37, components/profile/header.blade.php:22-30). Other schemes (data://, ftp://) do pass, but browsers block top-level navigation to data:/file: from web content, so restricting to 'url:http,https' is optional hardening, not a fix for an XSS.
findings.resolution_ru: profile_website_url якобы принимает javascript: ссылки. Итог: бот ошибся: правило url в Laravel требует scheme://host из списка IANA без javascript и vbscript, это проверено, а ссылка экранируется в Blade. Ограничение до http,https это необязательное усиление, а не исправление XSS.

findings.claim: Every Facebook-returned email is treated as verified and can claim existing accounts; Facebook email presence is not mailbox proof.
findings.reasoning: Treating every address Facebook reports as vouched is the recorded design: docs/dev/social-login.md:99-102 ('Facebook for every address it reports, because it only completes a registration after the address is confirmed') and the claim table at :104-114, implemented at SocialIdentityNormalizer.php:70-72 and consumed by ResolveSocialLoginAction.php:97-106 / ClaimAccountWithVerifiedEmailAction.php:50. tests/Feature/Auth/SocialAccountClaimTest.php:37-63 and :87-126 pin the Facebook claim/takeover with a non-Gmail address. Changing it is a product/security policy decision, not a code defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Любой email от Facebook считается подтверждённым и может присвоить существующий аккаунт. Итог: это записанное решение в docs/dev/social-login.md, оно реализовано и закреплено в SocialAccountClaimTest; менять его это вопрос продуктовой политики безопасности, а не дефект кода.

findings.claim: Google non-Gmail addresses should count as provider-verified only when email_verified is true AND a hosted-domain (hd) claim is present.
findings.reasoning: The current rule (Gmail/Googlemail, or email_verified === true) is exactly what docs/dev/social-login.md:99-101 records ('Google for any @gmail.com address and for any address it reports with email_verified: true'), and SocialAccountClaimTest.php:329-356 pins a non-Gmail email_verified=true identity as vouched. Caveat for the owner: Google's own guidance treats email_verified without hd as verified once at account creation, not authoritative, so a former owner of a recycled non-Workspace address could use this to sign in to (or take over) the account now registered with it; tightening to require hd is a deliberate policy change to the documented rule, not a bug fix.
findings.resolution_ru: Не-Gmail адрес Google надо считать подтверждённым только при email_verified и claim hd. Итог: текущее правило совпадает с social-login.md и закреплено тестом. Но без hd прежний владелец переиспользованного адреса может войти в аккаунт; требовать hd это осознанная смена политики.

findings.claim: Only InvalidStateException is translated; a token-endpoint rejection of an expired or already-used code throws a Guzzle ClientException that escapes as a 500.
findings.reasoning: Socialite pulls the session state before the token exchange (vendor socialite Two/AbstractProvider.php:236-240, 288-290), so a replayed callback or one from an expired session already fails as InvalidStateException and is translated (SocialProviderGateway.php:73-77); the realistic replays the @throws promises are covered. Letting token-endpoint failures reach the handler is the documented split ('expected OAuth failures (cancelled, refused, invalid state)... Anything unexpected still reaches the normal exception handler and Sentry', docs/dev/social-login.md:207-210), pinned by SocialLoginTest.php:347-355. What remains is two concurrent callbacks both reading the state before either saves the session, which is narrow.
findings.resolution_ru: Отказ token endpoint по старому коду якобы даёт 500. Итог: бот ошибся: Socialite забирает state до обмена, поэтому повтор и истёкшая сессия дают InvalidStateException и обрабатываются; прочие сбои по документу идут в обработчик и Sentry. Остаётся узкий случай двух одновременных callback.

findings.claim: A present-but-null link context is treated as absent (has() is false for null), so the callback falls through to ordinary sign-in instead of failing closed as StaleConnect.
findings.reasoning: Nothing writes null under auth.social_link_context: remember() always stores an array (SocialLinkContext.php:44-51) and forget() removes the key. Even if it were null, SignIn grants nothing Connect would: a signed-in session is refused by the already_signed_in branch (SocialAuthController.php:90-100), and a guest gets the ordinary sign-in any guest callback gets; Connect still requires a well-formed, fresh context for the same user (:72-83).
findings.resolution_ru: Контекст привязки со значением null считается отсутствующим, и callback идёт в обычный вход вместо StaleConnect. Итог: бот ошибся: null туда никто не пишет, а даже с null SignIn не даёт ничего сверх Connect: вошедшая сессия отклоняется, гость получает обычный вход.

findings.claim: In automatic (Random) mode a Persona restricted since its vote was saved is not kept as a keeper, so its saved vote is dropped.
findings.reasoning: Documented and tested intent: Random mode draws "as many as asked for ... from the active ones" (BuildStudioPostVotesData.php:136-144; docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:819-823), and BuildStudioPostVotesDataTest "draws the voters from the active Personas" excludes a Limited Persona. Keeping restricted Personas is the hand-chosen case (chosenVoters). A restricted Persona's vote could not be cast anyway: readinessErrors() requires every voting Persona Active and able to vote before approval (studio-plans.md:678-682), so replacing it in a fresh draw is the useful outcome.
findings.resolution_ru: В режиме Random персона, ограниченная после сохранения голоса, не остаётся, и её голос теряется. Итог: это задокументированное и протестированное поведение: Random берёт только активных персон, а голос ограниченной всё равно нельзя подать, readinessErrors() требует активных голосующих.

findings.claim: An extreme spreadSeconds overflows $place * spreadSeconds to float and makes intdiv() throw before timingErrors() can refuse it.
findings.reasoning: Unreachable: the only callers build the settings from Livewire properties marked #[Locked] (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:158-161; StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:180-191) that setTiming() changes only to one of the offered SPREAD_CHOICES or a value already held (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:425-437; StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:368-386), and the values read back from saved votes are bounded by the 30-day offset rule. No input path reaches an overflowing spread.
findings.resolution_ru: Огромный spreadSeconds переполняет $place * spreadSeconds до float, и intdiv() бросает исключение. Итог: бот ошибся: настройки берутся из #[Locked] свойств Livewire, setTiming() допускает только SPREAD_CHOICES или уже сохранённое значение, а сохранённые ограничены правилом 30 дней.

findings.claim: normalize() returns malformed UTF-8 unchanged, so an invalid reason passes the empty check and reaches the moderation-log write.
findings.reasoning: Documented deliberate choice (ModerationReason.php:37-43): returning the input keeps a real reason with one bad byte from being silently discarded as "empty", and leaves rejection to whatever rejects malformed text. In practice the reason arrives through Filament/Livewire JSON payloads, which cannot carry invalid UTF-8, and PostgreSQL rejects it inside the action's transaction, so nothing invalid is stored.
findings.resolution_ru: normalize() возвращает битый UTF-8 как есть, и такая причина доходит до записи в журнал модерации. Итог: это задокументированный выбор, чтобы не терять причину из-за одного байта; JSON Filament/Livewire не может нести битый UTF-8, а PostgreSQL отклонит его в транзакции.

findings.claim: responsive() picks avatar variants without checking their files exist on disk, so a missing variant file breaks the srcset.
findings.reasoning: Documented design: presentation reads the loaded variants only, with "no query, no storage I/O — a stale row whose file is gone still renders an pointing at it"; only openGraph() is the exception (docs/architecture/media.md:470-477, 512-516). Missing variant files are recovered by the variant-regeneration command and reported by media:audit, not by per-render existence checks.
findings.resolution_ru: responsive() выбирает варианты аватара без проверки файлов на диске. Итог: бот ошибся: по документированному дизайну отрисовка не делает запросов и I/O к хранилищу, исключение только openGraph(); пропавшие файлы восстанавливает команда регенерации, а media:audit о них сообщает.

findings.claim: responsive() selects src and srcset variants without the on-disk existence check that firstExistingOnDisk() does.
findings.reasoning: Deliberate and documented: responsive() does no storage I/O so a feed render does not stat (or, on S3, request) every variant (docs/architecture/media.md:470-477, 512-516; PostImagePresenter.php:225-237 "Unlike responsive(), every candidate here is also checked"). Lost variant files are a recovery case for the regeneration command and media:audit.
findings.resolution_ru: responsive() выбирает src и srcset без проверки на диске, как в firstExistingOnDisk(). Итог: это намеренно и задокументировано, чтобы рендер ленты не опрашивал хранилище (на S3 запросами) по каждому варианту; потерянные файлы восстанавливает команда регенерации и показывает media:audit.

findings.claim: Truncating the DNS answer set to dns_max_answers means a private record after the first N is never classified, so the hostname is accepted.
findings.reasoning: DnsHostResolver keeps the first dns_max_answers records (DnsHostResolver.php:28). The validator classifies every returned IP and pins the first validated one (UrlImportValidator.php:219-235), and the transport connects only to that pinned IP (PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:134). A record beyond the 16th is never connected to, so dropping it cannot steer the connection; the mixed-set rejection is defence in depth. The bound is documented behaviour (docs/import/url-import.md:198-206; config/import.php:18-22), and UrlImportValidatorTest pins the deterministic first pick for large answer sets.
findings.resolution_ru: Обрезка DNS-ответа до dns_max_answers якобы пропускает приватную запись после первых N. Итог: бот ошибся: транспорт подключается только к первому проверенному и закреплённому IP, запись дальше 16-й никогда не используется. Лимит задокументирован и закреплён тестом.

findings.claim: An allowed Content-Type alone lets non-image bytes be previewed; the body should be validated as an image first.
findings.reasoning: The network layer deliberately judges only where bytes come from, and ImageIngestor judges what they are. This is documented as two separate trust boundaries (docs/import/url-import.md:237-256, 'A URL ending in .jpg whose body is actually HTML fetches successfully at the network layer and is only rejected once ImageIngestor tries to decode it'). The preview stores nothing. Its imageUrl is only handed to StoreImportedImageAction::download() and then the normal ImageUploadStorer/ImageIngestor pipeline (EditsStudioPlan.php:356-372), which rejects non-image bytes.
findings.resolution_ru: Разрешённого Content-Type якобы достаточно для превью не-изображения. Итог: бот ошибся: сеть судит только об источнике, а ImageIngestor о содержимом, это две задокументированные границы. Превью ничего не хранит, а при сохранении ImageIngestor отклонит не-картинку.

findings.claim: mediaDetails.indices are UTF-16 offsets, but mb_substr() counts code points, so emoji before the media link break the stripping.
findings.reasoning: X/Twitter entity indices are counted in Unicode code points, not UTF-16 units. That is why twitter-text's JavaScript port converts them (modifyIndicesFromUnicodeToUTF16), and why clients of this syndication endpoint slice Array.from(text). mb_substr() (XPostImportAdapter.php:152) also counts code points, so the ranges line up. The resulting description is not consumed by any live path anyway: the Studio editor uses only imageUrl, and ImportUrlForm is unmounted (04-37).
findings.resolution_ru: mediaDetails.indices якобы в UTF-16, а mb_substr() считает кодовые точки. Итог: бот ошибся: индексы X/Twitter в кодовых точках Unicode, как и у mb_substr(), диапазоны совпадают. К тому же description не используется: Studio берёт только imageUrl, а ImportUrlForm не смонтирован.

findings.claim: redactCommand's '.' does not match newlines, so a multi-line option value is only partly redacted.
findings.reasoning: True in isolation: without the s modifier the pattern at NightwatchPrivacy.php:217 stops at a newline (verified with php). But the only command with these options is rateguru:admin:create, run by hand by an operator (no script in infrastructure/ or .github invokes it), and a literal newline inside --name/--email requires deliberately typed $'...\n...' quoting; validation of an email would reject it anyway. Practically unreachable; adding /s is harmless if someone touches the regex.
findings.resolution_ru: В redactCommand точка не ловит перевод строки, и многострочное значение маскируется частично. Итог: верно, но это только ручная rateguru:admin:create, перевод строки в --name/--email надо вводить нарочно, а email его отклонит. Добавить /s безвредно при правке regex.

findings.claim: The '$' anchor lets isValid("posts.created\n") pass.
findings.reasoning: Technically true (php confirms preg_match returns 1), but LogEventName is only used by DomainLogger::validate (DomainLogger.php:41) and every event name passed to DomainLogger is a string literal or class constant in app code — no request data ever reaches it. It is a developer guard, not an input filter, so the trailing-newline case cannot occur (same reasoning as the '$' part of 01-09).
findings.resolution_ru: Якорь '$' пропускает isValid("posts.created\n"). Итог: технически верно, но LogEventName используется только в DomainLogger::validate, а имена событий там всегда литералы или константы кода; это защита от ошибки разработчика, а не фильтр ввода (как в 01-09).

findings.claim: measure() ignores observability.slow_actions.enabled, so disabling it does not stop slow-action logging although the health command reports it disabled.
findings.reasoning: True that measure() (SlowActionLogger.php:11-32) never reads the flag and ObservabilityHealthCommand.php:56-60 prints it. But config/observability.php:14-18 hard-codes 'enabled' => true with no env() hook, so no environment can switch it off without a code change and the health line is always accurate in practice. Dead config; the cheap cleanup is to either honour it or delete it together with the health line, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: measure() игнорирует observability.slow_actions.enabled, хотя health его показывает. Итог: верно, но в config 'enabled' => true зашит без env(), отключить без правки кода нельзя, и строка health всегда верна. Это мёртвый конфиг: учесть флаг или удалить его со строкой, не дефект.

findings.claim: redact() never reads observability.redaction.enabled, so the flag is dead and the health command can report redaction 'disabled' while it still runs.
findings.reasoning: The flag is indeed unread (SensitiveDataRedactor.php:10-26), but config/observability.php:20-21 hard-codes 'enabled' => true with no env() override, so the health command (ObservabilityHealthCommand.php:45-51) always prints 'enabled', which is true. Implementing the suggested gate would add a switch that turns off password/token redaction in logs — a weaker system for no benefit. If anything, remove the flag and the health wording; not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: redact() не читает observability.redaction.enabled, флаг мёртвый. Итог: верно, но 'enabled' => true зашит без env(), и health честно пишет 'enabled'. Предложенный переключатель позволил бы выключить маскировку паролей и токенов в логах; можно лишь удалить флаг и строку health.

findings.claim: A throwing Log::warning() in the finally block replaces the callback's result or exception (e.g. the import's unsupported-preview fallback).
findings.reasoning: PHP semantics make the claim true, but the only caller, ImportFromUrlAction::handle, already writes url_import.preview.started through the same log stack before measure() (ImportFromUrlAction.php:44, 58-62) and url_import.preview.failed in its catch (:80-84); a log channel that fails would fail those calls too, so the outcome is already an exception regardless of the finally block. A logging backend that fails only for the slow-path line is speculative.
findings.resolution_ru: Исключение Log::warning() в finally подменяет результат или исключение callback. Итог: по семантике PHP верно, но ImportFromUrlAction пишет в тот же лог до measure() и в catch, так что сломанный канал и так дал бы исключение; сбой только для строки slow-path умозрителен.

findings.claim: RELEASE_PATTERN and COMMIT_PATTERN end in '$', so a value with a trailing newline is accepted.
findings.reasoning: Correct regex reading, but the input is release.json written by the project's own build action into a sealed artifact (DeploymentMetadata.php:11-17) and read once at config load (config/deployment.php:5, sentry.php:67, nightwatch.php:90); a JSON string with an escaped trailing \n is not something the pipeline can produce, and the deploy/rollback actions validate the same release shape in bash. No untrusted input reaches it.
findings.resolution_ru: RELEASE_PATTERN и COMMIT_PATTERN с '$' пропускают завершающий перевод строки. Итог: regex прочитан верно, но вход это release.json из запечатанного артефакта нашей сборки, такой строки пайплайн не создаёт, а deploy и rollback проверяют формат в bash. Недоверенного ввода тут нет.

findings.claim: COMMIT_PATTERN accepts abbreviated 7-character hashes although release.json stores a full SHA.
findings.reasoning: The reader is deliberately lenient and matches the pipeline's own tooling: the rollback action accepts an active SHA of '^[0-9a-f]{7,40}$' (.github/actions/rollback-rateguru/action.yml:330), and the release ID embeds a 7-40 char SHA. The value comes only from the trusted build artifact, so an abbreviated SHA would still identify the commit; tightening it changes nothing observable.
findings.resolution_ru: COMMIT_PATTERN принимает сокращённый хеш из 7 символов, хотя release.json хранит полный SHA. Итог: читатель намеренно мягкий и совпадает с инструментами пайплайна (rollback принимает 7-40 символов); значение только из доверенного артефакта, ужесточение ничего наблюдаемого не меняет.

findings.claim: A non-regular release.json (directory, FIFO) is reported as 'missing' instead of 'malformed' because of is_file().
findings.reasoning: True (DeploymentMetadata.php:62-64), but release.json is a file the build action writes into an immutable artifact; a directory or special file at that path is not a state any deploy produces, and the consequence is only the health command's wording (missing vs malformed) — Sentry/Nightwatch get no release either way.
findings.resolution_ru: Если release.json не обычный файл (каталог, FIFO), is_file() даёт 'missing' вместо 'malformed'. Итог: верно, но сборка всегда пишет туда файл в неизменяемый артефакт, такого состояния deploy не создаёт, а разница лишь в формулировке health; Sentry и Nightwatch в обоих случаях без релиза.

findings.claim: A scalar JSON value in feature_flags crashes every settings read because array_merge() receives a non-array.
findings.reasoning: feature_flags is cast 'array' on ProjectSettings and only written by the app's own actions (SaveProjectSettingsAction, ApplyProjectPresetAction, SwitchStudioExecutionAction), all of which store arrays; a scalar can only appear through manual database edits. Defensive hardening against hand-corrupted rows, not a reachable defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Скалярное значение JSON в feature_flags роняет чтение настроек в array_merge(). Итог: feature_flags приводится к array, а пишут его только наши Action, всегда массивом; скаляр возможен только при ручной правке БД. Это защита от испорченных вручную строк, а не достижимый дефект.

findings.claim: Tags with a script subtag after the region (zh-CN-hant, sr-RS-latn) are not rejected, so they fall back to the installed variant.
findings.reasoning: True that compatible() only reads a 4-letter subtag as a script before any region (LanguageRules.php:118-124), so 'zh-cn-hant' is treated as region cn and reaches 'zh'. But such tags are not well-formed BCP 47 (script must precede region) and browsers do not send them in Accept-Language; well-formed zh-Hant-TW / sr-Latn-RS are handled correctly. No realistic visitor is affected.
findings.resolution_ru: Теги со script после региона (zh-CN-hant, sr-RS-latn) не отклоняются. Итог: верно, но такие теги не соответствуют BCP 47 и браузеры их не шлют в Accept-Language; корректные zh-Hant-TW и sr-Latn-RS обрабатываются правильно. Реальных посетителей это не задевает.

findings.claim: The /up probe only reads the cache, so a cache store that accepts reads but rejects writes still reports healthy.
findings.reasoning: The probe is documented as a reachability check (class docblock DiagnoseHealthDependencies.php:11-20) and HealthEndpointTest.php pins that contract (DB select 1 + cache get). A write-failing-but-readable store (Redis OOM with noeviction, read-only replica) is a narrow failure mode, and writing on every /up poll adds churn; this is a health-check enhancement, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Проба /up только читает кеш, поэтому хранилище, отвергающее запись, выглядит здоровым. Итог: проба задокументирована как проверка доступности и закреплена HealthEndpointTest; такой отказ узкий, а запись на каждый опрос /up добавляет нагрузку. Это улучшение health-check, а не дефект.

findings.claim: The staticPage() docblock says config/static-pages.php is not read here, although with no settings row the defaults seed static_pages from it.
findings.reasoning: Docblock wording only; behaviour is as ProjectSettingsManager documents (ProjectSettingsManager.php:7-14, 93-98: config seeds a project without a row). No code change needed.
findings.resolution_ru: Docblock staticPage() говорит, что config/static-pages.php здесь не читается, хотя без строки настроек он задаёт значения по умолчанию. Итог: это только формулировка docblock; поведение соответствует описанию в ProjectSettingsManager, менять код не нужно.

findings.claim: Controlled callback failures (provider unavailable, error param, missing code) leave Socialite's state and code_verifier in the session because they return before Socialite consumes them and abandon() is not called.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true: identityFromCallback throws at :55, :59-63 and :67-71 before driver()->user() pulls 'state'/'code_verifier', and SocialAuthController.php:102-107 does not call abandon(). But the leftover state only matches a callback from this browser's own round trip, the next redirect() overwrites it, and a later replay of the same callback can at most finish that person's own consented sign-in (the code is single-use and short-lived). docs/dev/social-login.md:165-168 promises the discard only for the link_expired/already_signed_in refusals. Same class of leftover-session-state hardening as 01-24/01-26 (SKIP).
findings.resolution_ru: При контролируемых сбоях callback state и code_verifier Socialite остаются в сессии, abandon() не вызывается. Итог: верно, но остаток совпадает лишь с callback этого же браузера, следующий redirect() его перезапишет, а повтор максимум завершит свой же вход. Как 01-24/01-26: усиление, SKIP.

findings.claim: A callback that does not match the current connection attempt consumes that attempt's context and OAuth state; it should return StaleConnect without consuming them.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 01-25 (SKIP): consume() pulls the context (SocialLinkContext.php:70) and the StaleConnect branch calls abandon() (SocialAuthController.php:79-88), so an unsolicited callback for another provider can cancel an in-progress Connect. The only effect is that the account holder clicks Connect again; nothing is linked or signed in, and one-time consumption 'by the first callback, whatever the outcome' is documented (docs/dev/social-login.md:155-157).
findings.resolution_ru: Чужой callback расходует контекст и OAuth state текущей попытки Connect. Итог: та же причина, что в 01-25: незапрошенный callback может отменить Connect, но владелец просто нажмёт Connect снова, ничего не привязывается и вход не выполняется; одноразовое расходование задокументировано.

findings.claim: unavailable() also includes providers switched on but missing keys, so the login notice says 'Sign-in with Google is turned off' when the admin left it on.
findings.reasoning: True that unavailable() is !isAvailable (on AND configured) (SocialProviderAvailability.php:24-56) and feeds the notice (AppServiceProvider.php:128-134, lang/en/auth.php:62). For the person reading the notice, 'turned off' and 'not configured' have the same meaning and the same remedy (set a password); this is copy wording, not behaviour.
findings.resolution_ru: unavailable() включает провайдеров, включённых без ключей, и уведомление пишет, что вход через Google выключен. Итог: верно, но для читателя «выключен» и «не настроен» значат одно и то же и решаются одинаково (задать пароль); это формулировка текста, а не поведение.

findings.claim: The SignInMethods docblock overstates what is shared: each caller counts the other available providers itself, from different sources.
findings.reasoning: Docblock wording only; UnlinkSocialAccountAction.php:61 (locked row) enforces and ConnectedAccounts.php:52-64 only decides whether to show the button.
findings.resolution_ru: Docblock SignInMethods преувеличивает общую логику: каждый вызывающий сам считает доступных провайдеров. Итог: это только формулировка docblock; проверку выполняет UnlinkSocialAccountAction по заблокированной строке, а ConnectedAccounts лишь решает, показывать ли кнопку.

findings.claim: parse_url() returns false for a path like /times/12:30, so sanitize() rejects a valid local path and the user lands on /.
findings.reasoning: Reproduced: parse_url('/times/12:30') and '/x/y:1' return false, while colons in the query or fragment parse fine. No RateGuru route produces such a path (routes/web.php: numeric post ids, usernames limited to [a-z0-9_] by ProfileUpdateRequest.php:24, fixed static pages), and the failure is the safe fallback to '/'. Dropping the parse_url block from the single open-redirect guard to accommodate paths the app never generates is not worth it.
findings.resolution_ru: parse_url() возвращает false для пути вроде /times/12:30, и sanitize() ведёт на /. Итог: воспроизведено, но таких путей в маршрутах RateGuru нет, а отказ безопасно ведёт на '/'. Убирать parse_url из единственной защиты от open redirect ради несуществующих путей не стоит.

findings.claim: After a failed modal form post the reopened mode comes from the client-submitted _auth_mode old input, not from the endpoint's fixed mode, so an omitted or mismatched value reopens the wrong panel.
findings.reasoning: True mechanically: decorate() only sets the error bag and redirect (AuthSurfaceContext.php:131-136) and AuthModalState reads old('_auth_mode') (AuthModalState.php:41-43). But each modal form posts a hidden _auth_mode matching its endpoint (login-form.blade.php:31, register-form.blade.php:27, forgot-password-form.blade.php:28), so only a hand-crafted request can mismatch, and the effect is cosmetic for that requester. Consistent with 01-16.
findings.resolution_ru: После неудачной отправки формы модалки режим берётся из присланного _auth_mode, а не из endpoint. Итог: верно, но каждая форма отправляет скрытый _auth_mode под свой endpoint, несовпадение возможно только в подделанном запросе, и эффект косметический для его автора; как 01-16.

findings.claim: Rounding the hot score to 6 decimals collapses old low-vote posts to 0, so the Hot feed orders them by published_at alone.
findings.reasoning: Arithmetic is right but the effect is negligible: with no votes the score drops below 5e-7 only after ~661 days ((h+2)^1.5 > 2e6), with one net vote after ~1050 days, and FeedQuery.php:85 then breaks ties by published_at desc, which is the order decay would give equal-vote posts anyway. It only reorders the far tail of the Hot feed among posts years old; the substantive Hot-feed defect is the missing periodic recalculation (02-64).
findings.resolution_ru: Округление hot score до 6 знаков обнуляет старые посты с малым числом голосов. Итог: арифметика верна, но без голосов это наступает через ~661 день, а равенства FeedQuery и так разбивает по published_at; меняется лишь хвост Hot из постов многолетней давности. Реальный дефект Hot в 02-64.

findings.claim: Add a regression assertion that one downvote lowers the score for a fixed positive upvote count.
findings.reasoning: Test-coverage suggestion only; the behaviour is correct: netVotes = max(0, up - down) (HotScoreCalculator.php:28), so with up > down a downvote lowers the raw score. HotScoreCalculatorTest.php:31-43 only asserts non-negativity, which is a coverage gap, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Добавить тест, что один downvote снижает счёт при фиксированных upvote. Итог: это лишь предложение по покрытию; поведение верное, netVotes = max(0, up - down), а тест пока проверяет только неотрицательность, это пробел в покрытии, не дефект.

findings.claim: assign() offers a kept choice to active voters before restricted keepers, so when slots are short a keeper loses its saved vote to an active voter.
findings.reasoning: True ordering ([...$voters, ...$keepers], DrawsPersonaVotes.php:94), but either order keeps the same number of saved votes on that choice; the difference is only which one survives. A keeper is a Limited/Shadowbanned/Banned Persona whose vote readinessErrors() refuses before approval (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:678-682: every Persona must be Active and able to vote), so preferring the castable vote of an active Persona is the more useful outcome, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: assign() отдаёт сохранённый выбор активным голосующим раньше ограниченных keeper. Итог: верно, но при любом порядке число сохранённых голосов то же; keeper это ограниченная персона, чей голос readinessErrors() не пропустит, так что голос активной персоны полезнее.

findings.claim: timeOrder() breaks ties between equal saved moments by Persona id instead of the saved sort_order, so a rebuild can reorder simultaneous votes.
findings.reasoning: True (DrawsPersonaVotes.php:139 sorts by [$previous, id]), but it only changes the order of votes that share one moment: with the spread unchanged they keep the same offsets, and the result is still deterministic (BuildStudioPostVotesDataTest "keeps the votes of one moment in one order, the same every time"). Reordering votes cast at the same second has no observable effect on the published post.
findings.resolution_ru: timeOrder() разбивает равенства по id персоны, а не по sort_order. Итог: верно, но меняется лишь порядок голосов одного момента: смещения те же, результат детерминирован и закреплён тестом. На опубликованном посте это никак не видно.

findings.claim: allActiveOptionIds($groups) trusts that the passed groups' options are already filtered to active ones.
findings.reasoning: Speculative misuse: the only caller that passes groups passes activeGroups() output, whose options relation is constrained to is_active (UploadPostForm.php:163, 188, 206; RatingConfigurationManager.php:15-23, 59-65); the other callers pass nothing. CreatePostAction re-checks the group/option pairing anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: allActiveOptionIds($groups) верит, что опции переданных групп уже отфильтрованы по активности. Итог: это умозрительное неправильное использование: единственный вызов с группами передаёт вывод activeGroups(), а CreatePostAction всё равно перепроверяет пару группа/опция.

findings.claim: validateGroupHasAllowedOptionCount() is never called outside tests although docs/rating/configurable-voting.md says the manager validates each active group's option count.
