findings.reasoning: The doc sentence is stale, but the invariant is enforced where it can be broken — on writes: UpdateRatingGroupAction.php:51-58 checks holdsActiveOptions() under lock, and ValidateRatingOptionTransitionAction/ActivateRatingOptionRaisingMaximumAction guard option transitions. The real gaps in those write paths are already tracked as 02-67 and 02-68; validating on every read would add nothing. Doc wording fix only.
findings.resolution_ru: validateGroupHasAllowedOptionCount() вызывается только в тестах, хотя документ обещает проверку. Итог: устарела фраза в документе; инвариант соблюдается при записи в UpdateRatingGroupAction и Action переходов опций, пробелы там уже в 02-67 и 02-68. Нужна только правка текста.

findings.claim: forPosts() divides by a total that includes votes for archived options, so the emitted percentages understate the active options' shares.
findings.reasoning: True for the "percent"/"label" fields (RatingVotingStateLoader.php:52-61), but nothing renders them: the rating view recomputes every percentage from the counts of the options it displays (resources/views/components/voting/rating-options.blade.php:54-59 binary, 76-81 multi), and no other consumer reads percent or label. No user-visible effect.
findings.resolution_ru: forPosts() делит на сумму с голосами за архивные опции, и проценты занижены. Итог: верно для полей percent и label, но их никто не выводит: шаблон рейтинга сам пересчитывает проценты из счётчиков показанных опций. Видимого эффекта нет.

findings.claim: The label rounds an already one-decimal percent to a whole number, so e.g. 0.45% is shown as 1%.
findings.reasoning: Double rounding is real (RatingVoteDistribution.php:42-45, 52-55; same in RatingVotingStateLoader.php:57-61), but the label string is never rendered: the voting view builds its own "N% · votes" text from raw counts (rating-options.blade.php:58-59, 81, 91). Dead output with no visible effect.
findings.resolution_ru: label повторно округляет процент с одним знаком, и 0.45% показывается как 1%. Итог: двойное округление есть, но строка label нигде не выводится: шаблон голосования строит свой текст «N% · votes» из исходных счётчиков. Мёртвый вывод без видимого эффекта.

findings.claim: MOST_BYTES is checked with filesize() before a separate unbounded file_get_contents(), so a file grown or swapped in between is read in full.
findings.reasoning: A TOCTOU only against the operator's own input: the reader is used only by the studio:personas:import console command (ImportStudioPersonasCommand.php:42) on a path the operator passes. Whoever can grow or swap that file between the stat and the read already controls the import; the 4 MB cap is a sanity guard against a wrong file, which it still is.
findings.resolution_ru: MOST_BYTES проверяется через filesize() до file_get_contents(), и подменённый файл прочитается целиком. Итог: это TOCTOU лишь против ввода самого оператора studio:personas:import; кто может подменить файл, и так управляет импортом, а лимит 4 МБ защищает от не того файла.

findings.claim: A top-level JSON object with keys "0","1",… decodes to a list-shaped array and is accepted although the file must be a JSON list.
findings.reasoning: True (json_decode(..., true) at PersonaFileReader.php:67 and the array_is_list check at :72), but harmless: such an object carries exactly the same entries in the same order, each entry is still validated field by field, and the file comes from the operator of a console command. Strictness without a failure mode.
findings.resolution_ru: Объект JSON с ключами "0","1"… декодируется как список и принимается. Итог: верно, но безвредно: такой объект несёт те же записи в том же порядке, каждая проверяется по полям, а файл даёт оператор консольной команды. Строгость без сценария сбоя.

findings.claim: Visually blank characters outside Z/Cc/Cf — combining marks such as U+034F or the Braille blank U+2800 — pass normalize(), so a blank-looking reason is accepted by both finalizers.
findings.reasoning: True: the strip class is [\s\p{Z}\p{Cc}\p{Cf}] (ModerationReason.php:47); U+034F (Mn) and U+2800 (So) are outside it. But reasons are typed by staff in admin forms (FinalizePostRemovalAction.php:35, FinalizeCommentRemovalAction.php:32), and unlike the no-break space the class targets — which pastes produce by accident (cf. 02-19 for member comments) — these characters only arrive on purpose; a moderator who wants to skip the reason can type "." just as well. Extending the blank test does not add a control.
findings.resolution_ru: Невидимые символы вне Z/Cc/Cf (U+034F, U+2800) проходят normalize(), и пустая на вид причина принимается. Итог: верно, но причины пишет персонал в админ-формах, такие символы не попадают туда случайно, а модератор может так же ввести «.». Расширение проверки контроля не добавит.

findings.claim: The fullscreen srcset adds the master even when a variant with the same width is already present, producing duplicate width descriptors.
findings.reasoning: True and common: Contain variants never upscale (MediaVariantSpecification.php:33), so for any master up to 1920 px wide post_detail_1920 has the master's width and PostImagePresenter.php:194-196 adds "master W w" next to "detail W w". The HTML source-selection algorithm drops a later candidate with the same density, so the browser always uses the detail variant; the effect is redundant markup, not a wrong image.
findings.resolution_ru: Fullscreen srcset добавляет master рядом с вариантом той же ширины, дублируя дескрипторы. Итог: верно и часто, но алгоритм выбора источника в HTML отбрасывает более поздний кандидат с той же плотностью, браузер всегда берёт detail; это лишняя разметка, а не неверная картинка.

findings.claim: The DNS lookup has no bound of its own, so a slow resolver can hold an import worker indefinitely.
findings.reasoning: dns_get_record() (DnsHostResolver.php:20) takes no timeout and is not covered by the HTTP connect/read timeouts (config/import.php:14-15). It is not indefinite, though: the system resolver's own timeout and attempts (resolv.conf) bound it to seconds per query. Bounding it further needs a different resolver library or per-process resolver options, which costs more than a few extra seconds on an attacker-chosen import is worth.
findings.resolution_ru: DNS-запрос без своего лимита может держать воркер импорта бесконечно. Итог: dns_get_record() без таймаута, но не бесконечен: системный резолвер ограничивает его секундами на запрос. Лимит строже требует другой библиотеки резолвера, что дороже нескольких секунд на импорт.

findings.claim: IPv6 targets cannot be pinned because the CURLOPT_RESOLVE entry leaves the IPv6 address (and an IPv6-literal host) unbracketed.
findings.reasoning: For a hostname, the entry 'host:443:2606:4700::1' parses correctly: curl reads the address field up to ',' and accepts an unbracketed IPv6 address. Verified locally: a pin 'v6host.invalid:443:::1' was used. So the claim is false for the normal case. Only an IPv6-literal URL (https://[2606::1]/) produces a host part containing colons. libcurl 8.x still connects (verified); an older libcurl may reject the entry as malformed, and the fetch then fails closed to an address that was validated anyway. An IP-literal https image URL with a valid certificate is not a realistic import.
findings.resolution_ru: IPv6 нельзя закрепить, так как запись CURLOPT_RESOLVE не берёт адрес в скобки. Итог: для имени хоста бот ошибся, curl принимает адрес без скобок, проверено. Только URL с IPv6-литералом может не пройти на старом libcurl, тогда запрос безопасно падает; такой импорт нереалистичен.

findings.claim: With decode_content disabled, a gzip-encoded response reaches the HTML parser as compressed bytes and yields an empty preview.
findings.reasoning: With decode_content=false, Guzzle sets no CURLOPT_ENCODING (vendor CurlFactory.php:2170), so no Accept-Encoding is sent and compliant servers and CDNs answer uncompressed. Disabling decompression is a documented decision against decompression bombs (docs/import/url-import.md:232-235). A server that gzips anyway produces no metadata, or bytes ImageIngestor rejects, which fails safe. Only non-compliant servers are affected, on a best-effort import.
findings.resolution_ru: При отключённом decode_content gzip-ответ попадает в HTML-парсер сжатым. Итог: Guzzle тогда не шлёт Accept-Encoding, и корректные серверы отвечают без сжатия; отключение задокументировано как защита от бомб распаковки. Нарушающий сервер даст пустое превью, это безопасный отказ.

findings.claim: The transport interface's contract should state that get() must enforce the byte cap and timeouts.
findings.reasoning: Docblock suggestion only. The single implementation enforces the cap three ways and applies both timeouts (PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:98-138, 167-171), PinnedImportHttpTransportTest covers the caps and the timeout mapping, and ImportFetchPolicy's own docblock says it carries the byte cap and timeouts.
findings.resolution_ru: Контракт интерфейса транспорта должен требовать лимит байт и таймауты в get(). Итог: это лишь предложение к docblock; единственная реализация применяет лимит и оба таймаута, PinnedImportHttpTransportTest их покрывает, а docblock ImportFetchPolicy это уже описывает.

findings.claim: preview() downloads the entire image only to read Content-Type, and confirmation then downloads it again.
findings.reasoning: True (DirectImageImportAdapter.php:19 and StoreImportedImageAction.php:38), but the only live path is the admin-only Studio post-link import of a direct image link (EditsStudioPlan.php:704, 356), and each fetch is capped. A metadata-only request (HEAD or Range) is not reliably supported by image hosts and would add a second code path. 05-16 already shrinks the wasted transfer, so the restructuring costs more than it saves.
findings.resolution_ru: preview() скачивает всю картинку ради Content-Type, а подтверждение качает её снова. Итог: верно, но это только админский импорт ссылки в Studio, каждый запрос ограничен; HEAD или Range хосты поддерживают ненадёжно, а 05-16 уже сокращает лишний трафик. Переделка дороже выгоды.

findings.claim: Forcing UTF-8 decoding garbles og:title/og:description of pages served in another charset.
findings.reasoning: True for non-UTF-8 pages (OpenGraphParser.php:18), but no live path consumes the parsed title or description. The Studio editor uses only imageUrl (EditsStudioPlan.php:704-724), and ImportUrlForm, which displayed them, is mounted nowhere (04-37). Image URLs are ASCII and unaffected, so there is no user-visible defect today.
findings.resolution_ru: Принудительное UTF-8 портит og:title/og:description страниц в другой кодировке. Итог: верно для не-UTF-8 страниц, но title и description никто не использует: редактор Studio берёт только imageUrl, ImportUrlForm не смонтирован (04-37), а URL картинок в ASCII. Видимого дефекта нет.

findings.claim: The silent return null on an embed-fetch failure leaves no log signal; add a DomainLogger warning.
findings.reasoning: Observability nice-to-have. The fallback to the og:image crop is the documented behaviour (InstagramPostImportAdapter.php:14-23), and the transport already logs url_import.connection_failed with the host for connection failures (PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:158-162).
findings.resolution_ru: Молчаливый return null при сбое embed-запроса не оставляет следа в логах. Итог: это пожелание к наблюдаемости; откат к кропу og:image задокументирован, а транспорт уже пишет url_import.connection_failed с хостом при сбоях соединения.

findings.claim: When the post page's Open Graph fetch fails, the embed page should still be tried for the image instead of failing the preview.
findings.reasoning: The design treats the post page's Open Graph tags as the primary source and the embed page as an upgrade of its image (InstagramPostImportAdapter.php:14-23, 32-45), and Instagram is configured best_effort (config/import.php:37). A failed page fetch already degrades to the unsupported preview with a manual-upload hint (ImportFromUrlAction.php:80-91). Adding a second path is a feature enhancement, not a defect fix.
findings.resolution_ru: При сбое загрузки Open Graph поста стоит пробовать embed-страницу. Итог: по дизайну Open Graph поста основной источник, а embed лишь улучшает картинку; Instagram настроен как best_effort, и сбой уже даёт unsupported-превью с подсказкой загрузить вручную. Это новая функция.

findings.claim: Provider detection does not strip a trailing dot from the host, so 'x.com.' is not recognised as X.
findings.reasoning: True (ImportProviderDetector.php:18-24), but provider choice is not a security boundary: every fetch still goes through UrlImportValidator, which does normalise the dot. A link typed with a trailing FQDN dot merely takes the generic Open Graph path, an input nobody pastes in practice.
findings.resolution_ru: Определение провайдера не срезает точку в конце хоста, и 'x.com.' не считается X. Итог: верно, но выбор провайдера не граница безопасности: каждый запрос проходит UrlImportValidator, который точку нормализует. Такая ссылка идёт общим путём Open Graph, и так никто не вставляет.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review and Mobile QA sections.
findings.reasoning: Audit-PR bookkeeping, not a property of the code (same as 01-37/02-88/03-35/04-68).
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review и Mobile QA. Итог: это оформление аудиторского PR, а не свойство кода (как 01-37, 02-88, 03-35, 04-68).

findings.claim: Any warning raised by exif_read_data() is turned into an exception and treated as 'no EXIF', so a JPEG whose EXIF still yields a valid Orientation is stored unrotated (cubic's line 116 points at readImageSize, but its text describes the same EXIF catch).
findings.reasoning: readExifOrientation() runs exif_read_data() inside withNativeErrorsAsExceptions() (GdImageIngestor.php:247-250, 395-406), whose handler throws on ANY E_WARNING; the catch sets $exif = false and :255-256 returns orientation 1. exif_read_data emits non-fatal warnings for many recoverable EXIF quirks while still returning the parsed tags. Verified by running the tree's GdImageIngestor class directly on PHP 8.5: a 40x20 JPEG with Orientation=6 normalizes to 20x40, but the same file plus one IFD entry with an illegal format code ('Process tag(x010D=DocumentName): Illegal format code 0x0000') normalizes to 40x20 (unrotated); a non-Exif APP1 (XMP) placed before the Exif APP1 ('Incorrect APP1 Exif Identifier Code') has the same effect. docs/architecture/media.md:290-296 only sanctions the default for absent EXIF/absent tag, and no GdImageIngestorTest case covers a warning-carrying EXIF block. Cubic's proposed fix (reject such images) would be wrong; the returned Orientation is valid.
findings.scenario: A member uploads a portrait phone photo whose camera writes Orientation=6 together with a maker-note/IFD entry PHP warns about; the ingestor drops the tag, re-encodes the pixels without EXIF, and the post (and every variant) shows the photo permanently on its side, with no way to recover the intent short of re-uploading an edited file.

findings.claim: The purges' open-report hold is a plain read that ReopenReportAction is not serialized with, so a report reopened between the hold check and the deletion is either orphaned (comment leaf purge) or deleted along with the post graph.
findings.reasoning: The hold checks are unlocked exists() reads (CommentRetentionPurgeService.php:113-117, ModerationContentPurgeService.php:153-157 and 184-200, PostRetentionPurgeService.php:104-120). ReopenReportAction locks only Actor -> Report and runs a guarded UPDATE (ReopenReportAction.php:33-48), never the target's Post/Comment rows that the purge holds; docs/architecture/post-lifecycle.md:114-119 and moderation-content-lifecycle.md:120-123 describe serialization only for NEW reports (ReportContentAction locks the post first). On PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED, a reopen committed after the exists() is seen by the later statements: CommentPhysicalDeletionService.php:32-38 skips the now-open report and force-deletes the comment, while PostGraphDeletionService.php:61-64 and 77-80 delete reports unconditionally, so the reopened report vanishes. The window is the milliseconds between check and delete inside a daily purge, and ListReports renders a missing target null-safely ('Target unavailable', ListReports.php:457), hence low impact.
findings.scenario: The nightly comments:purge-deleted run reaches an expired author-deleted comment whose last report a moderator resolved; in the same instant the moderator clicks Undo (ReopenReportAction). The purge's exists() saw no open report, the reopen commits, deleteLeaf() leaves the open report and force-deletes the comment: the moderation queue now holds an open report on 'Target unavailable'. For a post purge the reopened report is silently deleted instead.

findings.claim: The pre-lookup Post::query()->find() excludes soft-deleted posts, so deleting a stale card of an already-deleted post returns skipped and the card stays.
findings.reasoning: FeedPostDeletionService.php:22-26 returns skipped() for a trashed post, and FeedPage::deletePost (FeedPage.php:131-153) then returns silently without dispatching post-deleted. DeletePostAction already handles that case idempotently: it re-reads withTrashed under lock, authorizes the owner (PostPolicy::deleteFromFeed, PostPolicy.php:50-54) and returns without error for an author-deleted post (DeletePostAction.php:37-55), which would make the service return deleted() and remove the card. The stale card is reachable in the normal UI: deleting from the drawer leaves the card in the feed (04-05).
findings.scenario: The author deletes a post from the drawer (the card stays, 04-05) or in another tab, then clicks Delete on the card still shown: nothing happens, no message, and the card remains until a full reload.

findings.claim: The notifier serializes on the two user rows but does not re-check for an existing notification, so overlapping follower jobs can both insert one.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-35 (MINOR): the duplicate check in NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction is a pre-read outside this transaction, and send() (LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier.php:40-57) writes unconditionally once both users are living; overlap is possible because the job's 120s timeout exceeds the queues' 90s retry_after. Kept consistent with 02-35, whose fix already includes re-checking (notifiable, post_id) inside this locked transaction.
findings.scenario: As 02-35: a long follower send is re-delivered to a second worker while the first still runs, and followers in the remaining chunks get two identical notifications.

findings.claim: generateAll() passes nullable media_assets.width/height into wouldUpscale(int, int), so a dimensionless Ready asset throws a TypeError before any variant is generated.
findings.reasoning: Same class of defect as 05-13 (MINOR): media_assets.width/height are nullable (2026_07_29_100000_create_media_assets_table.php:27-28) and the project treats dimensionless assets as real (ResponsiveImageWithoutDimensionsTest.php:10-18, MediaAssetFactory::dimensionless()), but MediaVariantGenerator.php:65 passes them to MediaVariantSpecification::wouldUpscale(int $sourceWidth, int $sourceHeight) (MediaVariantSpecification.php:30); null to a non-nullable userland int is a TypeError regardless of strict_types, even for Contain specs that would never upscale. Current ingest always records dimensions, so only legacy/probe-failed rows are affected; GenerateMediaVariantsCommand catches per asset (:78-90) and the job logs and rethrows.
findings.scenario: An older post image stored without dimensions has no variants; media:generate-variants (or Regenerate in Media diagnostics) fails for it every time with a TypeError, so it keeps serving the full master in the feed.

findings.claim: A file that disappears between allFiles() and lastModified() makes lastModified() throw and aborts the whole orphan scan.
findings.reasoning: scan() calls $this->storage->lastModified() for every unknown listed path without a catch (MediaOrphanScanner.php:41-50); FilesystemMediaStorage::lastModified throws MediaStorageException::notFound when the file is gone, and its own comment calls that 'a clean, expected notFound()' race (FilesystemMediaStorage.php:123-147) — but nothing treats it as expected. Unknown-but-listed files that vanish are produced by normal operation: StoredMediaCleaner deleting a just-written upload after a failed transaction, MediaVariantWriter::deleteQuietly() removing a moved/compensated variant, or a concurrent --orphans --force run. RunMediaAuditJob then records the whole audit as Failed (RunMediaAuditJob.php:89-100).
findings.scenario: While an admin-triggered full audit is listing media/post-images, an upload's DB transaction fails and StoredMediaCleaner deletes its fresh file; the scanner reaches that path, lastModified() throws notFound, and the hour-long audit run ends as Failed with no snapshot.

findings.claim: A soft-deleted asset that is still referenced is counted as soft_deleted_within_grace (no issue), even after its grace expired, so the audit reports a broken state as normal.
findings.reasoning: MediaAuditService.php:67-78 sends every trashed asset that is not (grace-expired AND unreferenced) to $softDeletedWithinGrace++, including trashed assets that are still referenced, whatever their age. A trashed-but-referenced asset is a gap state the design never produces (releaseUnreferenced checks references first, MediaLifecycleService.php:241-249), exactly like active-but-unreferenced, which the docs call 'a gap-state alarm ... worth surfacing if it ever does' (media.md:762-763). But unlike that one it is silently folded into a normal bucket, although it is user-visible: Post::imageAsset() applies SoftDeletes' scope (Post.php:152-155), so the post renders without its image.
findings.scenario: An asset is soft-deleted while a post still points at it (manual SQL, a future code path, a restore); media:audit and the diagnostics page report it as 'soft-deleted within grace' and the health stays healthy, while the post shows no image and media:purge correctly never removes it.

findings.claim: couldNotReadUploadedFile() embeds the client-supplied original filename in the exception message, which is reported to observability.
findings.reasoning: ImageInput::fromUploadedFile throws ImageDecodeException::couldNotReadUploadedFile($file->getClientOriginalName(), ...) when the uploaded temp file cannot be stat'ed/read (ImageInput.php:44-46); the message is 'Could not read uploaded file [<client filename>]' (ImageDecodeException.php:9-12). Every caller reports ImageIngestException (UploadPostForm.php:131-133, EditProfileForm.php:59-61, EditsPersona.php:181-182, EditsStudioPlan.php:650-651), and NightwatchPrivacy::redactException only rewrites driver unique-violation fragments (NightwatchPrivacy.php:233-247), whose docblock states the project's premise that exception messages are static text. Client filenames routinely carry names. The path is rare (temp upload unreadable), hence low.
findings.scenario: A member's avatar upload whose Livewire temp file was already cleaned up fails to read; the reported exception carries 'Could not read uploaded file [anna-petrova-passport.jpg]' into Nightwatch/the error log.

findings.claim: comments.status defaults to 'published', which CommentStatus (visible|hidden) cannot hydrate.
findings.reasoning: The column is string('status')->default('published') (2026_05_14_183711_create_comments_table.php:16) while the enum has only Visible/Hidden (CommentStatus.php) and the model casts to it (Comment.php:26-31). Every current writer sets status explicitly (AddCommentAction.php:131-136, DemoFillSeeder's inserts, CommentFactory), and no migration changed the default since the enum was introduced (git log), so no defaulted rows exist today; but any insert that omits status creates a row whose ->status access throws ValueError and which no Visible/Hidden query ever counts.
findings.scenario: A future import, maintenance script or raw insert that relies on the default creates comments with status 'published': rendering them throws ValueError (500 on the post page), and they are excluded from every visible-comment count and purge query.

findings.claim: Member votes/comments lock Actor -> Post and then implicitly take a KEY SHARE lock on the post author's row, out of the documented order, so they can deadlock with two-user operations that lock the author first.
findings.reasoning: VotePostAction and AddCommentAction lock the actor FOR UPDATE, then the post (VotePostAction.php:67-109, AddCommentAction.php:89-143), and update the post twice in that transaction (counters/comments_count, then hot score). On PostgreSQL the second update re-checks posts' FKs and takes FOR KEY SHARE on the author's users row while the post is held — the project documents this exact behaviour in ExecuteStudioAction.php:646-668 and works around it for Personas only (lockActorAndPostAuthor, FOR NO KEY UPDATE). That violates the order in docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:294-312 (other User rows before Post). Two-user operations (FollowAuthorAction.php:48-55, user reports, sanctions, LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier) lock both users FOR UPDATE in ascending id order. If the author's id is lower, such an operation holds the author and waits for the actor while the vote holds the actor and waits for the author: PostgreSQL aborts one with a deadlock error. Needs the same member (or the author acting on that member) to act within milliseconds, hence low.
findings.scenario: Member #7 upvotes author #3's post and, in another tab, follows author #3 at the same moment: the vote holds #7 and the post and waits for KEY SHARE on #3, the follow holds #3 and waits for #7; PostgreSQL kills one transaction with SQLSTATE 40P01 and that click fails with an error.

findings.claim: Variant generation/writing and asset purge use unrelated locks, so a purge can run while a variant is being written and leave an orphaned file.
findings.reasoning: Documented decision: docs/architecture/media.md (Media lifecycle, 'Locking') states that no coordination with MediaVariantWriter's lock is needed because generateAll() refuses trashed assets (MediaVariantGenerator.php:41) and purge eligibility requires the asset to be soft-deleted for the grace period (default 7 days, config/media.php:81; MediaLifecycleService.php:47-79). GenerateMediaVariantsJob re-reads the asset at start (GenerateMediaVariantsJob.php:36) and times out after 120s, so a write cannot still be running when its asset becomes purgeable; only an operator override of 0 grace days could approach it, and the residue would be an orphan file that media:audit reports.
findings.resolution_ru: Генерация вариантов и purge используют разные блокировки, и может остаться файл-сирота. Итог: бот ошибся: по media.md координация не нужна: generateAll() отказывает удалённым ассетам, purge ждёт 7 дней, job живёт 120 с. Риск лишь при grace 0 дней, и сироту покажет media:audit.

findings.claim: The orphan scan uses a stale snapshot and purgeOrphanFile() deletes without re-checking ownership, so a concurrent upload or variant write can be deleted by orphan force mode.
findings.reasoning: A file is a candidate only if its lastModified is older than orphan_grace_hours (default 24h, MediaOrphanScanner.php:36,48; config/media.php:82), so an upload or variant written during or shortly before the scan is never a candidate; docs/architecture/media.md ('Physical orphan detection') records this as the guard for in-flight uploads. Deletion happens only on an explicit, human-run media:purge --orphans --force (MediaPurgeCommand.php:132-170; not scheduled, routes/console.php:16). The residual case — regenerating a variant onto an already-orphaned >24h path during a manual force run — is contrived and self-healing (the next generate-variants run rewrites a missing file).
findings.resolution_ru: Скан сирот идёт по устаревшему снимку, и force-режим может удалить свежую загрузку. Итог: бот ошибся: кандидат только файл старше orphan_grace_hours (24 ч), а удаление лишь при ручном media:purge --orphans --force. Оставшийся случай надуман и исправится следующей генерацией.

findings.claim: Concurrent detach transactions on a shared asset can each see the other's reference and both leave the asset active.
findings.reasoning: Same as 03-21 (INVALID): the only shared asset is a Studio plan's photo taken over by the post the executor publishes from it, and only Drafts can drop their reference (DeleteStudioPlanDraftAction/RemoveStudioPlanImageAction/SetStudioPlanImageAction), while a published plan is no longer a Draft; avatars and member post images are always fresh assets (02-59). Two post purges of the same post serialize on the post row lock. So no two detaches of one asset can run concurrently.
findings.resolution_ru: Параллельные отвязки общего ассета видят ссылки друг друга и оставляют его активным. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 03-21: общий ассет бывает только у фото плана Studio, отвязать его может лишь Draft, а опубликованный план уже не Draft; purge одного поста сериализуется блокировкой строки.

findings.claim: The 500-row scan limit is applied before filtering by media job class, so unrelated failures can hide recent media failures from the list.
findings.reasoning: Deliberate and documented: SCAN_LIMIT is described as 'a defensive bound' over all failed jobs, with the reason for not filtering in SQL (FailedMediaJobReader.php:29-44), the list is 'a diagnostics panel, not a queue browser' (:54-61), and the authoritative count that drives health status is exact across all rows (countMediaJobFailures, :67-88; MediaAuditService.php:124-128 acknowledges the difference).
findings.resolution_ru: Лимит в 500 строк применяется до фильтра по классу job, и чужие сбои скрывают медийные. Итог: бот ошибся: SCAN_LIMIT задокументирован как защитная граница, список это диагностическая панель, а точное число сбоев для health считается по всем строкам.

findings.claim: A failed updateOrCreate() after overwriting an existing variant leaves new bytes with a stale row, and a non-forced run never repairs it.
findings.reasoning: Documented intent: MediaVariantWriter.php:41-47 states that on a regeneration a DB failure keeps the overwritten file and accepts transiently stale row metadata 'until a successful retry, which is preferred over destroying a working variant'. Same-path overwrites only happen on forced regeneration; the exception propagates (MediaVariantGenerator.php:86-97), GenerateMediaVariantsJob retries with the same force flag (tries=4), and the command reports the failure for a re-run.
findings.resolution_ru: Сбой updateOrCreate() после перезаписи варианта оставляет новые байты со старой строкой. Итог: это задокументированное намерение: временно устаревшие метаданные лучше удаления рабочего варианта; исключение пробрасывается, job повторяет с тем же force, команда сообщает о сбое.

findings.claim: Variant paths are derived from the master path without the asset id, so two assets with the same base path would share variant keys.
findings.reasoning: Two assets can only share a base path if their paths differ only by extension; MediaPathGenerator always mints a fresh UUID filename (MediaPathGenerator.php:24-40) and the explicitPath branch has no caller in app code (all four store calls use forPostImage/forAvatar without it). (disk, path) is unique per asset (create_media_assets_table.php:50). No collision is producible.
findings.resolution_ru: Пути вариантов строятся из пути master без id ассета и могут совпасть. Итог: бот ошибся: MediaPathGenerator всегда даёт новое UUID-имя, ветку explicitPath никто не вызывает, а (disk, path) уникален для ассета. Коллизию получить нельзя.

findings.claim: An extensionless master path makes variants land beneath the master path itself.
findings.reasoning: No master is ever extensionless: the ingestor always yields jpg/png/webp (GdImageIngestor.php:24-28, 375-382) and MediaPathGenerator appends it (MediaPathGenerator.php:24-29); the only extensionless branch would be an explicitPath, which no app code passes. Demo seeders write .jpg/.svg paths.
findings.resolution_ru: Master без расширения заставляет варианты ложиться внутрь пути master. Итог: бот ошибся: master всегда с расширением, ingestor даёт jpg/png/webp, а MediaPathGenerator его добавляет; путь без расширения возможен лишь через explicitPath, который никто не передаёт.

findings.claim: The scanner omits application-created media under posts/ and demo/posts/.
findings.reasoning: Those roots are written only by demo seeders (DemoFillSeeder 'posts/{userId}/...', DemoPublishedPostsSeeder 'demo/posts/*.svg'), which refuse to run outside local/testing (DemoFillSeeder.php:150-151, DemoDatabaseSeeder.php:11) and clean their own files (DemoFillSeeder.php:883-893). Every production upload path writes under config('media.directories') (MediaStoreRequest::forPostImage/forAvatar), which is what the scanner walks.
findings.resolution_ru: Сканер не обходит медиа приложения в posts/ и demo/posts/. Итог: бот ошибся: туда пишут только демо-сидеры, которые не запускаются вне local/testing и сами чистят файлы; все продакшн-загрузки идут в config('media.directories'), которые сканер и обходит.

findings.claim: delete() leaks filesystem-driver exceptions instead of wrapping them in MediaStorageException.
findings.reasoning: Every configured disk has 'throw' => false (config/filesystems.php:37,46,59), and Laravel's FilesystemAdapter::delete catches UnableToDeleteFile, reports it and returns false in that mode (vendor FilesystemAdapter.php:602-623), so a driver failure reaches the `! delete()` branch and becomes MediaStorageException::couldNotDelete (FilesystemMediaStorage.php:102-107). No caller distinguishes the type anyway: all catch Throwable.
findings.resolution_ru: delete() пропускает исключения драйвера, не оборачивая их в MediaStorageException. Итог: бот ошибся: у всех дисков 'throw' => false, FilesystemAdapter::delete тогда ловит ошибку и возвращает false, что даёт MediaStorageException::couldNotDelete; к тому же все вызывающие ловят Throwable.

findings.claim: postCandidates()/commentCandidates() bypass cutoff(), so a negative day override would select with a future cutoff.
findings.reasoning: The candidates are documented as prefilters only; the sole caller rejects non-digit --older-than values (ModerationPurgeContentCommand.php:162-177) and ModerationContentRetention::days() is strict, and every candidate is re-validated by purgePost()/purgeComment(), whose cutoff() throws on a negative value before touching anything (ModerationContentPurgeService.php:207-220).
findings.resolution_ru: postCandidates()/commentCandidates() обходят cutoff(), и отрицательное число дней даст будущую дату. Итог: бот ошибся: кандидаты лишь предфильтр, команда отклоняет не-цифры в --older-than, а purgePost()/purgeComment() перепроверяют, и cutoff() бросает исключение на минусе.

findings.claim: A guest social callback can pass canSignIn() on a stale user and log in after the account was anonymized.
findings.reasoning: Same reasoning as 02-02 (INVALID): if anonymization commits in the milliseconds between ResolveSocialLoginAction's canSignIn() check and Auth::login (ResolveSocialLoginAction.php:62-79), the very next request is ended by EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned, which runs on the whole web group and checks the freshly loaded user (bootstrap/app.php:34, EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned.php:25-36). Anonymization deletes the social links (AnonymizeUserAccountAction.php:108), so no later sign-in can succeed; the save on the deleted row updates nothing.
findings.resolution_ru: Гостевой social callback может пройти canSignIn() на устаревшем пользователе и войти после анонимизации. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 02-02: следующий же запрос завершит EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned, а анонимизация удаляет social-привязки, так что дальнейший вход невозможен.

findings.claim: targetKeyFor() accepts a null/non-positive rating group id and builds a key like 'rating:0'.
findings.reasoning: StudioPlanVote is fully guarded and written only by SaveStudioVotesAction under the plan lock (StudioPlanVote.php:36-37, 58; SaveStudioVotesAction.php:182-191), which takes rating_group_id from the validated option (StudioVoteValidationRules.php:466-477). No 'direct model save' path exists in the application.
findings.resolution_ru: targetKeyFor() принимает null или неположительный id группы и строит 'rating:0'. Итог: бот ошибся: StudioPlanVote защищён и пишется только SaveStudioVotesAction под блокировкой плана, rating_group_id берётся из проверенной опции; прямого сохранения модели в приложении нет.

findings.claim: The while(true) leaves-first loop recounts and rescans Comment rows for each leaf.
findings.reasoning: The loop runs once per tree level, not per leaf: each pass bulk-deletes every current leaf in 500-row chunks (PostGraphDeletionService.php:114-153), so the supported one-reply-level shape needs two passes; this is documented in the method's docblock (:98-113) and in post-lifecycle.md ('depth-agnostic').
findings.resolution_ru: Цикл while(true) пересчитывает и пересканирует комментарии для каждого листа. Итог: бот ошибся: цикл идёт по уровням дерева, а не по листьям, каждый проход пачками по 500 удаляет все текущие листья; для одного уровня ответов это два прохода, что описано в docblock и post-lifecycle.md.

findings.claim: countMediaJobFailures() scans and JSON-decodes the whole failed_jobs table on every audit.
findings.reasoning: True (FailedMediaJobReader.php:77-88, nothing prunes failed_jobs in routes/console.php), but it is a deliberate exactness trade-off documented at :67-76, the audit runs only on demand (RunMediaAuditJob/media:audit, 3600s budget, not scheduled), and failed_jobs is normally small. Not worth a queryable discriminator now.
findings.resolution_ru: countMediaJobFailures() при каждом аудите сканирует и декодирует всю failed_jobs. Итог: верно, но это задокументированный компромисс ради точности, аудит запускается только вручную, а failed_jobs обычно мала. Отдельный дискриминатор для запроса сейчас не стоит усилий.

findings.claim: knownLocations() and allFiles() keep every location and listing in memory; batch them.
findings.reasoning: True in shape (MediaOrphanScanner.php:32-90), but it runs only in the on-demand audit and the manual --orphans mode, and at roughly 7 locations per asset the sets stay in the tens of MB until hundreds of thousands of assets; a correct batched design across disk listings is a sizeable rewrite for a hypothetical scale.
findings.resolution_ru: knownLocations() и allFiles() держат все пути и листинги в памяти, надо пакетами. Итог: верно по форме, но это только ручной аудит и режим --orphans, и до сотен тысяч ассетов это десятки МБ; правильный пакетный обход листингов дисков это большая переделка под гипотетический масштаб.

findings.claim: A referenced asset with a missing master is still counted as healthy.
findings.reasoning: The lifecycle bucket is documented and labelled 'Healthy, referenced' (media.md:762; MediaAuditCommand.php:37) and is orthogonal to the file checks: the missing master is still reported as a critical issue and drives the overall status to critical (MediaHealthResolver; media.md:917-925). Only the bucket's wording overlaps.
findings.resolution_ru: Ассет со ссылками, но без master, считается здоровым. Итог: группа 'Healthy, referenced' задокументирована и не связана с проверкой файлов: пропавший master всё равно отражается как критическая проблема и делает общий статус critical. Пересекается только название группы.

findings.claim: A failing putContents() bypasses the cleanup, so a partial first-time write can leave an orphan file.
findings.reasoning: True that the try starts after putContents (MediaVariantWriter.php:82-103), but the path is deterministic, so the next generation overwrites it, and a leftover unknown file is exactly what media:audit's orphan scan reports and --orphans --force removes. Low value.
findings.resolution_ru: Сбой putContents() обходит очистку, и частичная первая запись оставит файл-сироту. Итог: верно, но путь детерминирован, и следующая генерация его перезапишет, а лишний файл покажет скан сирот media:audit и удалит --orphans --force. Польза низкая.

findings.claim: storeNormalized() can write a private file but MediaAssetCreator records every asset as public.
findings.reasoning: Latent only: the only MediaStoreRequest constructors in use are forPostImage/forAvatar, both Public (MediaStoreRequest.php:23-45; no other `new MediaStoreRequest`), and docs/architecture/media.md ('MediaStorage and MediaUrlResolver') states nothing uploads private media. Worth aligning only when a private flow is introduced.
findings.resolution_ru: storeNormalized() может записать приватный файл, а MediaAssetCreator помечает все ассеты публичными. Итог: это лишь латентно: используются только forPostImage/forAvatar, оба Public, и media.md фиксирует, что приватные медиа не загружаются. Выравнивать стоит, когда появится приватный поток.

findings.claim: Leading whitespace bypasses the URL/'/storage' path checks.
findings.reasoning: No user input reaches a MediaLocation path: paths come from MediaPathGenerator (UUID under a config directory), DB rows the app wrote, the deterministic variant generator and disk listings. Even a whitespace-prefixed value would be resolved through disk->url() (FilesystemMediaUrlResolver.php resolveUrl), which always prefixes the disk URL, so no external link can result. Hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: Пробел в начале пути обходит проверки URL и '/storage'. Итог: пользовательский ввод в пути MediaLocation не попадает: они из MediaPathGenerator, наших строк БД, генератора вариантов и листингов, а disk->url() всегда добавляет URL диска. Это только усиление.

findings.claim: MediaAuditIssue::asset() hides soft-deleted assets; add withTrashed().
findings.reasoning: The relation has no production consumer: the diagnostics page uses media_asset_id and loads MediaAsset::withTrashed()->find() itself (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:405-414, 529-544). Harmless as is.
findings.resolution_ru: MediaAuditIssue::asset() скрывает soft-deleted ассеты, нужен withTrashed(). Итог: у связи нет потребителя в продакшне: страница диагностики сама загружает MediaAsset::withTrashed()->find() по media_asset_id. В текущем виде безвредно.

findings.claim: comment() treats hidden comments as available, so a mounted voting widget still shows score and controls after a hide.
findings.reasoning: Same pattern as 04-47/01-33 (SKIP): VoteCommentAction refuses the write on the locked rows and CommentVoting shows its message (CommentVoting.php:46-52); the widget is mounted only for comments the list rendered, so only a comment hidden while the page is open keeps stale controls, and the score shown is what the viewer already saw.
findings.resolution_ru: comment() считает скрытые комментарии доступными, и виджет голосования остаётся после скрытия. Итог: тот же случай, что 04-47/01-33: VoteCommentAction отклоняет запись и CommentVoting показывает сообщение; устаревают лишь контролы комментария, скрытого при открытой странице.

findings.claim: canStartReply() does not require the post to be published, so the reply composer opens for an unavailable post and submit is then refused.
findings.reasoning: Same pattern as 04-47 (SKIP): createReply() re-checks the published post and the action locks and re-validates (CommentReplyService.php:26-44, AddCommentAction.php:101-107); the section is mounted only for published posts, so only a post that changes state while open (or the 04-01 tampering case, fixed there) shows a composer whose submit fails with a message.
findings.resolution_ru: canStartReply() не требует опубликованности поста, и форма ответа открывается для недоступного поста. Итог: как 04-47: createReply() и Action перепроверяют пост под блокировкой, секция есть только у опубликованных постов, а при смене статуса отправка падает с сообщением.

findings.claim: The race guarantee relies on row locks that SQLite does not provide.
findings.reasoning: SQLite is a compatibility target whose matrix explicitly does not claim identical locking behaviour (docs/architecture/database-support.md 'This matrix ... does not claim ... locking throughput'). SQLite transactions are serializable with a single writer, so the no-stale-PII guarantee still holds; the worst case is a 'database is locked' failure, not a third outcome. Production is PostgreSQL.
findings.resolution_ru: Гарантия от гонок опирается на блокировки строк, которых нет в SQLite. Итог: SQLite это цель совместимости без обещания одинаковых блокировок; там транзакции сериализуемы с одним писателем, так что гарантия держится, худший случай 'database is locked'. Продакшн на PostgreSQL.

findings.claim: The synchronizer reads groups/options without the group mutation lock, so a concurrent option change can leave active options under a group it deactivates.
findings.reasoning: Its only caller is DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder (DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder.php:14), run via db:seed, which no deploy step runs (DatabaseSeeder also seeds demo data). Racing an admin's option edit against a manual seeder run is not a realistic production path.
findings.resolution_ru: Синхронизатор читает группы и опции без блокировки, и параллельная правка может оставить активные опции в выключенной группе. Итог: его вызывает только DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder через db:seed, который не запускается при deploy; гонка с правкой администратора нереалистична.

findings.claim: The bulk update overwrites archived_at of options that were already archived.
findings.reasoning: Same as 02-77 (SKIP): true (:35-38), but it only runs from the seeder and only changes a display timestamp on already-archived options; nothing depends on the original value.
findings.resolution_ru: Массовое обновление перезаписывает archived_at уже архивных опций. Итог: как 02-77: верно, но это работает только из сидера и меняет лишь отображаемую дату у уже архивных опций; от исходного значения ничего не зависит.

findings.claim: The default seeder's group/option writes bypass RatingGroupMutationLock and the group range check.
findings.reasoning: DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder writes via updateOrCreate without the lock (DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder.php:20-35), but it is a setup seeder skipped once a preset is applied (:16-18) and not part of deploys; its shipped data (2-3 options, range 2..10) is within range. Operator tooling, not a runtime path.
findings.resolution_ru: Сидер по умолчанию пишет группы и опции в обход RatingGroupMutationLock и проверки диапазона. Итог: верно, но это сидер установки, он пропускается после применения пресета и не входит в deploy, а его данные (2-3 опции, диапазон 2..10) в пределах. Это инструмент оператора, не runtime.

findings.claim: config("project_presets.{$presetKey}.label") misreads preset keys containing dots.
findings.reasoning: Preset keys are the fixed config keys (generic, nature, ai_images, breasts; config/project_presets.php) written by ApplyProjectPresetAction (:56); none contains a dot, and a dotted key would break config() lookups elsewhere in the preset flow too. Cosmetic hardening.
findings.resolution_ru: config("project_presets.{$presetKey}.label") неверно читает ключи пресетов с точкой. Итог: ключи пресетов фиксированы (generic, nature, ai_images, breasts), точки ни в одном нет, а ключ с точкой сломал бы config() и в других местах. Это косметическое усиление.

findings.claim: afterCommit forget does not make the sidebar cache atomic: a request that read pre-commit rows can write them back after the forget.
findings.reasoning: True: the classic cache-aside race remains between the composer's SELECT and Cache::remember's put (AppServiceProvider.php:151-162). The window is milliseconds on a rare admin edit and the cost is a stale sidebar for at most the 300s TTL; a generation-aware cache is out of proportion.
findings.resolution_ru: forget через afterCommit не делает кеш сайдбара атомарным: запрос со старыми строками может записать их обратно. Итог: верно, классическая гонка cache-aside остаётся, но окно в миллисекунды при редкой правке админа, а цена это устаревший сайдбар максимум на 300 с TTL.

findings.claim: recordProviderEmail() saves only the dirty column(s), so concurrent callbacks can combine provider_email from one sign-in with provider_email_verified from another.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true (SocialAccount.php:60-68, Eloquent writes only dirty columns, and the guest path has no lock, ResolveSocialLoginAction.php:62-79). But a mixed pair needs two concurrent callbacks for the same provider subject in which the provider reports different email/verification data at the same instant; two tabs signing in concurrently receive identical identity data and write identical values.
findings.resolution_ru: recordProviderEmail() сохраняет только изменённые колонки, и два callback могут смешать email и признак проверки. Итог: механически верно, но для этого провайдер должен в один момент отдать разные данные для одного subject; две вкладки получают одинаковые данные и пишут одно и то же.

findings.claim: HasFactory without a PostAuthorAnswerFactory.
findings.reasoning: No code or test calls PostAuthorAnswer::factory() (grep); an unused trait changes no behaviour.
findings.resolution_ru: HasFactory без PostAuthorAnswerFactory. Итог: PostAuthorAnswer::factory() нигде не вызывается ни в коде, ни в тестах; неиспользуемый трейт поведение не меняет.

findings.claim: lastTreeTakenIn breaks applied_at ties by id, which may not match application order.
findings.reasoning: applied_at is second-precision (create_studio_plan_discussion_generations_table.php:74), so two full trees applied to one plan within the same second, the later one having the lower id, would pick the wrong row. That needs two version-checked applies within a second; the effect is the stale-texts hint and Keep-as-is target (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:919, KeepStudioDiscussionAction.php:43).
findings.resolution_ru: lastTreeTakenIn разбивает равенства applied_at по id, что может не совпасть с порядком применения. Итог: верно при двух применениях в одну секунду с меньшим id у позднего, но это требует двух apply с проверкой версии за секунду, а эффект лишь в подсказке и цели Keep-as-is.

findings.claim: PasswordResetToken and Session hard-code the framework table names instead of the configured broker table / session table and connection.
findings.reasoning: True that config/auth.php:98 and config/session.php:76,89 make them env-overridable, but no environment template sets AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE, SESSION_TABLE or SESSION_CONNECTION (infrastructure/templates/environment/*.env.example), so the models address the real tables. Hardening against a configuration nobody uses.
findings.resolution_ru: PasswordResetToken и Session жёстко задают имена таблиц вместо настроенных. Итог: верно, что их можно сменить через env, но ни один шаблон окружения не задаёт AUTH_PASSWORD_RESET_TOKEN_TABLE, SESSION_TABLE или SESSION_CONNECTION. Это усиление под неиспользуемую конфигурацию.

findings.claim: The tombstone guard lives only in User::notify(), not at notifyNow()/the Notification facade.
findings.reasoning: No code calls notifyNow(), Notification::send() or sendNow() (grep over app/), the database notifications are synchronous and sent through LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier under the user locks, and the only queued notifications are mail-only social-account notices. Hardening for a call path that does not exist.
findings.resolution_ru: Защита tombstone есть только в User::notify(), а не в notifyNow() или фасаде Notification. Итог: notifyNow(), Notification::send() и sendNow() нигде не вызываются, уведомления в БД синхронны и идут через LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier; это усиление для несуществующего пути.

findings.claim: getResolvedDisplayNameAttribute() returns null (TypeError on its string return type) when display_name, name and username are all empty.
findings.reasoning: users.name is NOT NULL (create_users_table.php:16) and required by every writer, and every registration path generates a unique username (RegisterUserAction.php:32-35, RegisterSocialUserAction.php:43-50), so a living account with all three empty is not producible by the application.
findings.resolution_ru: getResolvedDisplayNameAttribute() вернёт null при пустых display_name, name и username. Итог: users.name NOT NULL и обязателен у всех записывающих, а каждая регистрация генерирует уникальный username; живой аккаунт со всеми тремя пустыми приложение создать не может.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review and Mobile QA sections.
findings.reasoning: A PR-description template check on the audit PR, not a property of the code (same as 01-37).
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review и Mobile QA. Итог: это проверка шаблона описания аудиторского PR, а не свойство кода (как 01-37).

findings.claim: UserEditor's save writes name, username, email and role from the draft without checking they are still what the drawer was opened with, so a stale drawer silently overwrites changes made meanwhile.
findings.reasoning: save() always sends every field (UserEditor.php:138-146) and UpdateUserAccountAction forceFills name, username, email and role on the locked row unconditionally (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:58-64); the only stale guard is for trust ('a level set meanwhile is never put back', :24-25, :85-92, pinned by UpdateUserAccountActionTest.php:134). The role-confirmation dialog only fires when the draft role differs from $saved['role'] (UserEditor.php:129), which is the drawer's own stale copy. Members change their own username/email (UpdateUserIdentityAction) and other admins change roles, while PersonaEditor and every Studio editor already refuse such stale saves via a fingerprint; nothing documents last-write-wins here.
findings.scenario: Admin A opens moderator X's drawer; admin B demotes X to user; A fixes a typo in X's name and saves: X is silently a moderator again, with no confirmation dialog. Likewise a member who changed and verified a new email gets the old address back with email_verified_at nulled (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:66-68) when an admin saves a drawer opened before.

findings.claim: The username/email unique checks are only a preflight, so a value claimed concurrently makes the save throw an uncaught unique-constraint exception (500) instead of a field error.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause and verdict as 03-05 (UpdateUserAccountAction) and 01-11: UserEditor validates Rule::unique (UserEditor.php:255-256) before UpdateUserAccountAction locks and saves (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:45-74), and only CannotUpdateUserAccountException is caught (UserEditor.php:147-153). The unique indexes keep data correct; the effect is a 500 instead of 'This username is taken'.
findings.scenario: An admin renames a user to a free username at the same moment another member takes it on their profile; the admin's save ends in a 500.

findings.claim: After Mark trusted from the drawer, the trust selector and its saved baseline still say Not trusted.
findings.reasoning: confirmSanction() runs MarkUserTrustedAction (ModeratesUsers.php:92-99, UserEditor.php:227-231) but never refreshes $saved['trust'] or $trust (UserEditor.php:79, 105, 332); refreshPerson() only resets the error bag (:242-245). The radio cards keep showing 'Not trusted' while the header and history say trusted, and choosing 'Not trusted' to undo it equals the stale baseline, so save sends trusted=null (:144) and nothing changes, yet 'Changes saved' is shown. No data is written wrongly.
findings.scenario: An admin marks a member trusted from the drawer, sees the Trust selector still on Not trusted, decides to revert, leaves it there and saves: the toast says saved but the member stays trusted.

findings.claim: The role confirmation is not bound to the role that was confirmed, so the role can change between asking and confirming.
findings.reasoning: The dialog is modal and its dismiss calls closeRoleConfirmation() (user-editor.blade.php:213, 226), so the role control cannot be changed while it is open through the UI; only a hand-crafted Livewire request from the same administrator, who may set any role anyway (UserPolicy::manage, re-checked in hydrate() and in UpdateUserAccountAction), could skip it. The confirmation is a UX safety net, not an authorization boundary.
findings.resolution_ru: Подтверждение не привязано к подтверждённой роли, и роль можно сменить до подтверждения. Итог: диалог модальный, через UI роль не сменить; обойти можно лишь подделанным запросом того же админа, который и так вправе ставить любую роль. Это UX-страховка, не граница авторизации.

findings.claim: strip_tags() is applied to plain-string search titles, mangling literal text such as '<b>' that Blade would escape anyway.
findings.reasoning: No resource overrides getGlobalSearchResultTitle, so titles are raw attributes: Post title, Comment body, Tag/Category name, username (CommentResource.php:28, PostResource.php:29). GlobalSearch.php:48 strips tags from them although global-search.blade.php:80 escapes {{ $row['title'] }}; strip_tags also drops everything after an unmatched '<' (e.g. 'I <3 this' becomes 'I '). The same applies to the details at :51. Display only, no security impact.
findings.scenario: An admin searches for a comment 'great photo <3 love it'; the result row shows 'great photo ' — or an empty title for a body starting with '<' — so the admin cannot recognise it.

findings.claim: filter() drops a name part '0', so the initials miss it.
findings.reasoning: True (Sidebar.php:68-73, Collection::filter() treats '0' as falsy), but it only affects the two-letter initials of the signed-in staff member's own account block when their name has a standalone '0' word; purely cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: filter() отбрасывает часть имени '0', и в инициалах её нет. Итог: верно, Collection::filter() считает '0' ложным, но это касается только двух букв в блоке своего аккаунта сотрудника, когда в имени есть отдельное слово '0'; чисто косметика.

findings.claim: When the temporary store is unreachable the block stops polling, so it never notices the store recovering.
findings.reasoning: True (TranslationAiGenerations.php:56-57 sets polling false), but it is a defensible choice: polling an unreachable Redis every 5 s from every open admin tab would tie up workers on connection timeouts, the block says 'Temporarily unavailable', and the page's Refresh re-reads it (TranslationAiPage.php:90 dispatches translation-ai-refresh, handled at :44-45). TranslationAiPageTest.php:695-704 pins the unavailable rendering. No data is affected.
findings.resolution_ru: При недоступном временном хранилище блок перестаёт опрашивать и не замечает восстановления. Итог: верно, но это оправданный выбор: опрос недоступного Redis каждые 5 с из всех вкладок занял бы воркеры таймаутами, блок пишет 'Temporarily unavailable', а Refresh страницы его перечитывает.

findings.claim: Two concurrent Save requests from a new-persona editor (personaId still 0) can each create a Persona; creation needs server-side idempotency.
findings.reasoning: Setting personaId after create (PersonaEditor.php:140-142) covers a repeated Save; concurrent duplicates need two requests in flight from one component, which Livewire queues per component and the form's wire:submit disables its button for (same reasoning as 02-39/02-53), or a deliberate replay of the snapshot by the administrator, who may create Personas anyway. The worst case is a duplicate draft Persona the admin can see and delete; nothing is published.
findings.resolution_ru: Два параллельных Save из редактора новой персоны могут создать две Persona. Итог: повторный Save закрыт установкой personaId, Livewire ставит запросы в очередь, а wire:submit блокирует кнопку. Худший случай это видимый дубль-черновик, который админ удалит; ничего не публикуется.

findings.claim: reload() marks a missing persona gone but render() passes persona null, and the view indexes it, causing a 500.
findings.reasoning: A users row is never physically deleted: deletion anonymizes it (DeleteUserAccountAction.php:12, AnonymizeUserAccountAction), so render()'s find() (PersonaEditor.php:109) still returns the row for a deleted or no-longer-Persona account and the view gets details; gone is set only from canEdit() failing (:88-89). personaId is #[Locked] and set from a row found in mount (:75-79). A null persona with personaId !== 0 needs a manual DELETE in the database.
findings.resolution_ru: reload() помечает пропавшую персону, а render() передаёт null, и шаблон падает с 500. Итог: бот ошибся: строки users не удаляются физически, а анонимизируются, так что find() всё равно находит строку; personaId #[Locked]. Null возможен только при ручном DELETE в базе.

findings.claim: A text-only save does not check the avatar the editor was drawn with, so it is not refused after someone else changed only the photo.
findings.reasoning: Accurate, but nothing is overwritten: UpdatePersonaAction writes only account and profile text (UpdatePersonaAction.php:89-94) under the text fingerprint check (:80-82), never avatar_asset_id, so the other admin's photo stays; a photo save is checked against the avatar (SetPersonaAvatarAction.php:105-107, PersonaResourceTest.php:510-535). The editor redraws with the new photo after saving (:198). At most the class docblock's 'a photo alone included' overstates the text path.
findings.resolution_ru: Сохранение только текста не сверяет аватар, с которым открыт редактор. Итог: верно, но ничего не перезаписывается: UpdatePersonaAction пишет только текст и никогда avatar_asset_id, а сохранение фото сверяется с аватаром. Максимум docblock класса преувеличивает текстовый путь.

findings.claim: stop() does not require askToStop() first, so a direct Livewire request cancels actions without confirmation.
findings.reasoning: The confirmation is a UI affordance, not an authorization check: every request passes Gate manage-studio-plans in boot() (StudioPlanActionPlan.php:63-66) and StopStudioPlanAction re-authorizes (ensureAllowed, StopStudioPlanAction.php:51; see 01-17). Only that same authorized administrator, with the session's CSRF token and a signed snapshot, can send the request, and they could equally call askToStop() then stop(). Nothing is gained by skipping the dialog.
findings.resolution_ru: stop() не требует askToStop(), и прямой запрос Livewire отменяет действия без подтверждения. Итог: бот ошибся: подтверждение это элемент UI, а не проверка прав; запрос проходит Gate manage-studio-plans, StopStudioPlanAction перепроверяет, а админ мог бы просто вызвать оба метода.

findings.claim: Polling stops while the executor is off even if an action is still Running, so a run that finishes is not shown until the next interaction.
findings.reasoning: Polling only while the executor is on is the documented design (StudioPlanActionPlan.php:33-35, :154) and pinned by StudioPlanPublicationStepTest.php:185-198. A run claimed just before the switch went off does continue (ExecuteStudioAction checks the switch only before claiming, :157-161), so the premise 'nothing moves' is slightly off, but the effect is a status that is stale for at most one run (<= 75 s job timeout) until the admin interacts or reloads; no data is affected.
findings.resolution_ru: Опрос останавливается при выключенном исполнителе, даже если действие ещё Running. Итог: опрос только при включённом исполнителе это задокументированный дизайн, закреплённый тестом; статус устаревает максимум на один запуск (до 75 с) до действия админа или перезагрузки, данные не страдают.

findings.claim: Move the plan/action status eligibility shared by canStop and StopStudioPlanAction into reusable domain logic.
findings.reasoning: Refactor suggestion; canStop (StudioPlanActionPlan.php:169-189) only decides whether the button shows, and StopStudioPlanAction re-checks everything in its transaction (:54-69).
findings.resolution_ru: Вынести правила допустимости статусов из canStop и StopStudioPlanAction в общую доменную логику. Итог: это предложение рефакторинга; canStop лишь решает, показывать ли кнопку, а StopStudioPlanAction перепроверяет всё в своей транзакции.

findings.claim: When the awaited generation was already taken in by another page, check() reloads the discussion but does not tell the other editors on the page.
findings.reasoning: check() calls load() for an already-applied generation (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:530-535), taking the new lock_version and tree silently, while reload() announces the same kind of redraw with RELOAD_EVENT (:786-793) — the documented contract is 'a Reload of either editor is said to the other' (class docblock, docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:463-465). The comment-votes and post-votes editors keep the old version and the old tree's targets until their next save is refused as stale; the version checks prevent any wrong write.
findings.scenario: Two tabs of the same plan wait for one generation; tab 1 takes it in. Tab 2's discussion shows the new tree, but its Comment votes still list the old comments' votes, and the first vote change there is refused with 'Someone changed this draft'.

findings.claim: Hand writes (save, delete, undo) are allowed while a generation is on its way, making the paid generation stale; writable()/write() should refuse while awaiting.
findings.reasoning: The documented design lets a hand save win and refuses the stale proposal rather than locking the discussion: 'a hand save ... take turns on the plan's row' and 'A discussion edited by hand since ... the proposal can no longer be taken in' (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:1318-1330, :510-515). The UI disables Comment/Reply/Edit/Delete while underway (studio-plan-discussion-editor.blade.php:245, 304-310) and setOffset refuses (:749). A server-side block would not cover another tab or administrator either; the only cost is the admin's own wasted request.
findings.resolution_ru: Ручные правки во время генерации делают платную генерацию устаревшей. Итог: по задокументированному дизайну ручное сохранение побеждает, а устаревшее предложение отклоняется; UI и так блокирует кнопки, а серверный запрет не покрыл бы другую вкладку. Цена лишь лишний запрос админа.

findings.claim: Undoing a comment or branch deletion does not restore the votes prepared on the deleted comments.
findings.reasoning: Documented and tested intent: 'the comments deleted come back as new ones' (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:436-440), 'a comment deleted takes its votes with it' (SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction.php:45-49), and StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditorTest.php:511 'gives a comment Undo brings back none of the votes it had: it is a new comment'. restored() deliberately gives them id null (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1701-1723).
findings.resolution_ru: Undo удаления комментария или ветки не возвращает подготовленные голоса. Итог: бот ошибся: это задокументированное и протестированное поведение: удалённые комментарии возвращаются как новые, удалённый комментарий уносит свои голоса, и restored() намеренно даёт им id null.

findings.claim: After a stale conflict, pending() reports nothing unsaved, so leaving the step no longer asks about the draft.
findings.reasoning: True: pending() returns false when !writable() (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:1259-1263), which includes conflict, so askLeave goes on and beforeunload does not warn. But a draft in conflict can never be saved — the only way on is Reload votes, which discards it (load(), :556-565) — the conflict notice says so (studio-plan-discussion-votes-editor.blade.php:365-371), and the component lives on hidden steps, so leaving the step loses nothing.
findings.resolution_ru: После конфликта pending() сообщает, что несохранённого нет, и уход со шага не спрашивает о черновике. Итог: верно, но черновик в конфликте сохранить нельзя: единственный путь дальше Reload votes, который его отбрасывает, и уведомление об этом говорит. Уход со шага ничего не теряет.

findings.claim: Changing Total up and Total down in one request loses the second change, because adjusting one total re-tallies both.
findings.reasoning: Livewire 4 sets every updated property first and runs the updated hooks afterwards (vendor livewire HandleComponents::updateProperties, 'run updated hooks after all properties have been updated'). updatedTotalUp() -> adjust('up') -> tally() overwrites totalDown with the old sum of the targets (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:302-312, 1031-1035), so updatedTotalDown() then sees no difference and does nothing. Both fields are wire:model.live.debounce.250ms (view :114-115), so they meet in one request when edited in quick succession or while a request is in flight.
findings.scenario: An admin types 10 in Total up and immediately 4 in Total down; both updates go in one request and Total down snaps back to its old value, unsaved and without notice.

findings.claim: settle() re-reads the plan after the save to build heldVotes/treeFingerprint (and the post votes editor its votesFingerprint), which could capture a later concurrent save and let it be overwritten.
findings.reasoning: Every writer of studio_plan_votes and discussion nodes (SaveStudioVotesAction, SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction, ApproveStudioPlanAction) locks the plan and checks/raises lock_version, so a write landing between the commit and the re-read would have to know the new version within milliseconds; even then the plan would be at v+2 while this editor holds v+1, so its next save is refused as stale and holdsAt()/holdsSavedAt() require plan->lock_version === version (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:1044-1050, StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:918-923). No path lets the stale fingerprint delete concurrent votes.
findings.resolution_ru: settle() перечитывает план после сохранения и может захватить чужое сохранение. Итог: бот ошибся: все писатели блокируют план и повышают lock_version, план будет на v+2 при v+1 у редактора, и его сохранение отклонят как устаревшее. Устаревший fingerprint чужие голоса не удалит.

findings.claim: A failed preview is never rebuilt while the settings stay the same, because previewFor is recorded before the build.
findings.reasoning: makePreview() sets previewFor = previewKey() before BuildStudioDiscussionVotesData runs (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:1283-1290); on ValidationException the preview stays null, and sync() rebuilds only when previewFor !== previewKey() (:1241-1244). The key covers settings, seed and tree but not Persona availability, so an error that external state fixed (e.g. too few active Personas) stays marked and askLeave keeps refusing until some setting changes.
findings.scenario: Comment votes ask for more voters than are active; the admin activates a Persona in another tab, returns and clicks Continue: still 'can't be made until what is marked is fixed' until they touch a setting or Reshuffle.

findings.claim: Emptying the discussion forgets the comment-vote totals instead of keeping them for the next tree.
findings.reasoning: Consistent with the documented rules: 'A comment deleted on its own takes its votes, and the totals drop' and the totals are always the comments' votes added up (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:1039-1040; take() at StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:885-911). Carrying totals over applies to a tree written anew with comments (:891-897); emptying it (Total comments 0, or deleting the last comment) is the limiting case, and the admin simply sets the totals again.
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка обсуждения забывает итоги голосов за комментарии вместо переноса в новое дерево. Итог: это соответствует задокументированным правилам: удалённый комментарий уносит голоса, а итоги это сумма голосов комментариев; очистка это предельный случай, и админ просто задаёт итоги снова.

findings.claim: The manual-voter shortfall ignores restricted Personas whose saved votes are retained, so a valid retained vote is marked as short.
findings.reasoning: A retained vote of a restricted Persona is not castable: StudioVoteValidationRules::problemsAgainst flags it with VotePersonaRestricted when ready (StudioVoteValidationRules.php:384-385), so the comment really has fewer votes that can be cast. Counting only active chosen Personas in problemOf (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:1586-1587) therefore describes the comment correctly; the mark is display-only and never blocks a save.
findings.resolution_ru: Нехватка ручных голосующих не учитывает сохранённые голоса ограниченных персон. Итог: бот ошибся: такой голос нельзя подать, StudioVoteValidationRules помечает его VotePersonaRestricted, голосов действительно меньше. Отметка только для отображения и сохранение не блокирует.

findings.claim: Move the incremental allocation in adjust() into BuildStudioDiscussionVotesData or a domain service.
findings.reasoning: Refactor suggestion with no behavioural defect; adjust() (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:982-1012) only moves draft counts, and the builder and SaveStudioVotesAction validate what is saved.
findings.resolution_ru: Вынести инкрементальное распределение из adjust() в BuildStudioDiscussionVotesData или доменный сервис. Итог: это предложение рефакторинга без дефекта поведения; adjust() лишь двигает счётчики черновика, а сохраняемое проверяют builder и SaveStudioVotesAction.

findings.claim: setMoment() resets every moment to the saved offsets before applying the new one, dropping moment edits not saved yet.
findings.reasoning: StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:469-473 rebuilds postMoments and every rating's moments from the saved votes, and the save happens only at render (commit, :751-755). Two setMoment calls bundled into one request keep only the last, and when a commit failed (another setting marked), a later moment edit silently discards the earlier unsaved ones while unsaved counts are kept. The discussion-votes editor's setMoment edits targets in place (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:397-428).
findings.scenario: With an unsaveable change marked, the admin moves persona A's vote to +2 h, then persona B's to +3 h: A's moment snaps back to its saved time without notice.

findings.claim: A rating option or question activated after the editor loaded is shown, but its inputs do nothing.
findings.reasoning: render() lists questions() from the current active groups and options (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:758, 1139-1185), while ratings[group]['counts'] holds only what load() saw (:844-852). setAnswerCount/moveAnswer return early when the option key is missing (:357, :400) and setRatingTotal/evenSplit when the group is (:306, :332), so typed counts on a new option or question are silently ignored until Reload/Discard.
findings.scenario: Another admin adds an option to a rating question while the Post step is open; the admin types 5 answers for it and nothing happens.

findings.claim: Even split on a question with no open options sets every count to zero, erasing the answers kept on closed options.
findings.reasoning: With openOptions() empty, $even is [] and the counts become all zeros (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:337-347), contradicting the rule that closed options 'only give answers up' as far as the total allows (:298-301, :393-395); change() then saves it at once. The button is disabled only when the question itself is closed (view :342), so an active question whose options were all archived, or a page drawn before the question closed, reaches it.
findings.scenario: All options of an active rating question are archived; the admin clicks Even split on it and every prepared answer to it is deleted and saved.

findings.claim: followReload() reloads over an unsaved post-votes draft instead of setting conflict and asking first.
findings.reasoning: The method's documented behaviour is 'otherwise the votes are drawn again from what is saved' (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:673-677). Every change in this editor is saved at once (commit at render), so a draft survives only when it cannot be saved; it is discarded only when another editor's Reload finds the post votes changed by someone else, i.e. a draft built on votes that no longer exist. Low value compared with the comment-votes editor's stricter handling.
findings.resolution_ru: followReload() перезагружает поверх несохранённого черновика голосов без вопроса. Итог: это задокументированное поведение: правки здесь сохраняются сразу, черновик живёт только когда сохранить нельзя, и отбрасывается лишь если голоса уже изменил другой. Польза низкая.

findings.claim: 'Select all' with an empty search chooses only the first 50 active Personas.
findings.reasoning: selectShown() takes personaList(), capped at PERSONA_LIST = 50 (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:508-516, 1240-1243; PersonasQuery::activeChoices limits), while the button reads 'Select all' whenever the search is empty (view :105). The 'N selected of cap' counter shows the shortfall. The comment-votes editor has the same cap and label (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:465-473, view :56); the discussion editor already says 'Select first N'.
findings.scenario: With 80 active Personas the admin clicks Select all, expecting all 80 voters; 50 are chosen and larger vote counts are marked short.

findings.claim: setMoment() returns silently when the plan was deleted instead of marking the editor gone through writablePlan().
findings.reasoning: StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:449-453 finds the plan directly and returns on null without change(), so commit()/writablePlan() never run and gone and its notice are not set (:1550-1561). Every other action reaches writablePlan() through commit, and the comment-votes editor's setMoment calls writablePlan() first (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor.php:399). No write happens; the admin just gets no feedback.
findings.scenario: The draft is deleted in another tab; the admin changes a vote's moment on the Timing tab and nothing happens, with no 'This draft was deleted' notice.

findings.claim: Generate after an author change silently returns the previous author's batch still on its way, so nothing is queued for the new author and nothing is said.
findings.reasoning: RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction returns any underway batch of the plan whatever its source hash (RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction.php:114-125), and generate() ignores the return value (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard.php:117-118). After the author is saved the card filters generations by the new source hash (:193-197), so the old batch is not shown, the button is enabled and nothing polls; each click is a silent no-op until the old batch ends as stale. The discussion editor handles the same case with a toast (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1115-1135).
findings.scenario: The admin generates in author A's voice, switches to author B and clicks Generate (which saves the draft first): nothing appears and nothing is said for up to a minute while A's batch runs out.

findings.claim: Each render/poll loads the plan's whole text-generation history and filters it in PHP.
findings.reasoning: True (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard.php:193-197), but history is per draft plan and each row is an explicit paid request by an administrator, so it stays at tens of rows; the card polls only while a batch or analysis is on its way (:233).
