Pushing isFor() into SQL and splitting the counts is a refactor with no measurable gain on this admin-only screen (same judgement as 04-39/04-40).
findings.resolution_ru: Каждый render и опрос грузит всю историю генераций текста плана и фильтрует в PHP. Итог: верно, но история на черновой план, каждая строка это платный запрос админа, их десятки, а опрос идёт только во время батча или анализа. Перенос в SQL не даст измеримого выигрыша (как 04-39/04-40).

findings.claim: An image analysis whose worker died keeps the suggestions card polling and saying it is waiting, forever.
findings.reasoning: analysisOnItsWay uses status->isInProgress() without isStale() (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard.php:210-212), and polling stays on while state is analysis_pending (:233), every 3 s. Nothing ends a stale analysis but a retry; the Image step's card treats the same attempt as stale/failed and stops polling (StudioPlanImageAnalysisCard.php:140, 148-149, 170). StudioPlanDiscussionEditor's 'analysing' flag has the same gap (render, and its view :194).
findings.scenario: The analysis job dies; on the Post step the card says 'Text suggestions will be available when photo analysis is complete' and polls every 3 s indefinitely instead of pointing to Re-run analysis.

findings.claim: use() should refuse suggestions when the editor's unsaved author differs from the one the batch was written for.
findings.reasoning: By design suggestions belong to the saved author (class docblock :35-46, RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction.php:33-36): the card shows whose voice the batch is in and warns 'Another author is chosen' (view :48-49, 92-93). Using a title only copies text into the draft for the admin to edit; nothing is saved or published, so a stricter check adds little.
findings.resolution_ru: use() должен отклонять подсказки, если несохранённый автор не тот, для кого батч. Итог: по дизайну подсказки принадлежат сохранённому автору, и карточка предупреждает о смене автора. use() лишь копирует текст в черновик и ничего не сохраняет, строгость мало что даст.

findings.claim: Move the persisted-batch eligibility rule in use() into a reusable domain operation.
findings.reasoning: Refactor suggestion; use() (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard.php:241-263) only hands text to the browser draft after checking plan, photo, status and source hash, and has no defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Вынести правило допустимости сохранённого батча из use() в общую доменную операцию. Итог: это предложение рефакторинга; use() лишь передаёт текст в черновик браузера после проверки плана, фото, статуса и хеша источника, дефекта нет.

findings.claim: Project settings are saved as a full snapshot of the draft taken when the page loaded, so a stale tab silently reverts settings another administrator changed since, including switched-off sign-in providers and safety flags.
findings.reasoning: mount() snapshots every shown field into data/saved (ProjectSettingsPage.php:142-170) and save() sends all of them (:273-283); SaveProjectSettingsAction fills them onto the locked row unconditionally (SaveProjectSettingsAction.php:46-60): sign_in_providers is replaced wholesale and the shown feature_flags win the array_merge. The action guards only what the page does not show (translations, other languages' static pages, the executor flag: 'never as the caller last saw them'), and nothing polls or reloads the draft. The switch-off confirmation (updatedData, :189-206) only fires on a change made in this draft, so the revert is silent. Unlike the four-field taxonomy forms (02-18, SKIP), this page holds the site's lock-out and compliance switches, and a tab left open for hours is enough — the same defect class as 07-01 (UserEditor), while Studio and Persona editors already refuse stale saves.
findings.scenario: Admin A leaves Project settings open in a tab. Admin B switches Google sign-in off (or allow_user_uploads off during a spam wave, or content_studio_verified_adults off) and saves. Later A fixes the tagline and saves: the provider / uploads / verified-adults flag is back on, with no confirmation and no notice to either admin.

findings.claim: Status/sort normalization casts the URL value with (string) without checking it is a string, so an array query value breaks the page; same in ListPosts.
findings.reasoning: #[Url] mixed properties take arrays from the query string (Livewire BaseUrl::setPropertyFromQueryString decodes ?status[]=x to ['x']). ListComments::normalize (:395), ListPosts::normalize (:655 status, :658 sort, also order() :638) and ProjectSettingsPage::mount (:134 tab, again :176/:301) run (string) on it, which raises the 'Array to string conversion' warning that Laravel turns into an ErrorException, i.e. a 500. The docblocks promise the opposite ('Whatever a link or a forged update put here, read as something the page offers'), and the sibling pages guard with is_string() and pin it in tests (ListPersonas::normalize :193-194 with PersonaResourceTest.php:165 'a status as a list'; MediaDiagnosticsPageTest.php:305 'type' => ['x']).
findings.scenario: An administrator follows a link such as /admin/comments?status[]=hidden, /admin/posts?sort[]=oldest or /admin/project-settings?tab[]=pages and gets a server error page instead of the default tab.

findings.claim: The URL page number is unbounded, so a huge ?page= reaches paginate() with an enormous offset.
findings.reasoning: normalize() keeps any numeric page (ListPersonas.php:199; identical in ListPosts.php:659, ListComments.php:397, MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:768, StudioActionQueue.php:416; TranslationAiDiagnostics::page() feeds TranslationAiUsageQuery the same way). (int)'9223372036854775807' is PHP_INT_MAX; when the list has rows Eloquent's paginate() calls forPage(), ($page - 1) * 25 overflows to a float, and Query\Builder::offset()'s (int) cast emits PHP 8.5's 'The float ... is not representable as an int' warning (reproduced with the project's PHP 8.5.8 CLI), which Laravel converts to an ErrorException. The past-the-end clamp in ListPersonas/StudioActionQueue runs only after that first paginate(). The bot's 'expensive query' angle is not the issue (PostgreSQL skips at most the filtered rows); the 500 is.
findings.scenario: A link with ?page=9223372036854775807 (or any page above about 3.7e17) on Personas, Posts, Comments, Media diagnostics or the Action queue returns a 500 instead of the last page.

findings.claim: Posts and Comments show an empty 'queue clear' page when the current last page empties, even though earlier pages still have rows; the page number should be clamped to lastPage().
findings.reasoning: ListPosts::getViewData (:358) and ListComments::getViewData (:230) paginate at the stored page without the past-the-end clamp that StudioActionQueue (:229-232) and ListPersonas (:137-140) apply. The views branch on $rows !== [] (posts.blade.php:117-162, comments.blade.php:51-79), so an empty page renders 'The queue is clear' / 'No comments here' with no pagination links. Moderating the rows of the last page (approve, hide, restore — each removes the row from Pending/Visible/Hidden) is the normal way to reach it. Same pattern as 04-25 (MINOR).
findings.scenario: A moderator on page 2 of 2 of the Pending tab approves the three posts there; the list re-renders page 2, now empty, and says 'The queue is clear' although page 1 still has 25 pending posts.

findings.claim: The Persona photo rule accepts image formats the avatar ingest rejects, so a GIF/BMP passes validation and only fails after the rest of the Persona is saved.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause and verdict as 04-21: File::image() accepts gif/bmp/webp/png/jpeg (SVG only with allowSvg, so that part is wrong) while GdImageIngestor rejects anything outside its MIME map (GdImageIngestor.php:83-84; uploads.images.mimes is jpg/jpeg/png/webp). Here the failure is handled: UnsupportedImageFormatException is an ImageIngestException, which savePhoto() catches, reports and turns into a photo field error (:181-185), and the text-first partial save is the documented design (:166-169). The residue is a validation message that already says 'JPEG, PNG or WebP' but a rule that does not enforce it, an exception reported to error tracking for an operator mistake, and a two-step 'Changes saved, but the photo wasn't' instead of an up-front field error.
findings.scenario: An administrator chooses a GIF as a Persona's photo and presses Save: the text is saved, the toast says the photo wasn't, and an UnsupportedImageFormatException is reported, although validation could have refused the file before anything was written.

findings.claim: savePhoto() does not handle a MediaStorageException from SetPersonaAvatarAction, so a storage failure after the text was saved escapes as an error instead of the 'photo wasn't saved' path.
findings.reasoning: SetPersonaAvatarAction stores the file before its transaction (SetPersonaAvatarAction.php:83) through ImageUploadStorer -> FilesystemMediaStorage::storeNormalized, which throws MediaStorageException on a disk/S3 failure (FilesystemMediaStorage.php:35,39); the action cleans up and rethrows (:123-128). savePhoto() catches only ImageIngestException (:181) and PersonaEditor::update/create only CannotManagePersonaException (PersonaEditor.php:146-147, 186-187), so the exception ends the Livewire request with an error after UpdatePersonaAction/CreatePersonaAction already committed. The component keeps its old fingerprint (or still says 'new'), so the next Save is refused as 'changed meanwhile' (or 'username taken' for a create).
findings.scenario: During a storage outage an administrator edits a Persona's bio and picks a new photo: the bio is saved but the drawer shows an error page; pressing Save again says the Persona changed meanwhile, and only a reload shows what was actually saved.

findings.claim: The Action queue's 'late' flag uses an absolute difference and ignores cancelled actions, so an action cancelled long before its planned time is shown as late.
findings.reasoning: late is finished_at->diffInSeconds(occurs_at, true) > 3600 (StudioActionQueue.php:307) and colours the 'runs' cell red (studio-action-queue/row.blade.php:69). Cancelling sets finished_at = now() (CancelStudioActionAction.php:62, CancelsDependentStudioActions.php:55, StopStudioPlanAction.php:77), and a cancelled row reads 'Not run' (StudioActionPlan::runs :308). Cancelling or stopping actions planned more than an hour ahead — the usual case — therefore paints 'Not run' in the overdue colour; only a run finishing more than an hour after occurs_at is meant.
findings.scenario: An administrator stops a plan whose comments were scheduled for tomorrow; every cancelled action in the queue shows 'Not run' in red as if it had run late.

findings.claim: lastAuditRun() and recentRuns() order audit runs by started_at only, so runs started in the same second sort arbitrarily.
findings.reasoning: started_at is a second-precision timestamp (create_media_audit_runs_table.php:14). latestCompletedRun() (:331-332), the navigation badge (:126-127) and RunMediaAuditJob::pruneOldRuns() (RunMediaAuditJob.php:162-172) all add id as a tiebreaker with a comment saying why; lastAuditRun() (:356) and recentRuns() (:423) do not. Two runs can share a second only when an audit finishes in under a second and a queued duplicate starts right after (small libraries, a double-clicked Run full audit), so the effect is rare and cosmetic.
findings.scenario: On a small installation a double-clicked 'Run full audit' queues two jobs that run back to back within one second; the Last audit card may show the older run and the history may order them wrongly.

findings.claim: auditCurrentlyRunning() uses the raw configured lock TTL, while the job enforces max(TTL, timeout + 60), so a short configured TTL makes the page treat a still-locked audit as abandoned.
findings.reasoning: auditCurrentlyRunning() (:379-385) counts a Running row only within config('media.diagnostics.audit_lock.ttl_seconds'); RunMediaAuditJob::lockTtlSeconds() (RunMediaAuditJob.php:205-210) raises the effective TTL to at least 3660 s, and config/media.php:101-107 explicitly anticipates a misconfigured shorter value. With MEDIA_AUDIT_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS below the job timeout, a run older than that value still holds the lock, but the page drops its Running state and dispatches another job that fails at once (filtered as benign by FailedMediaJobReader.php:126). Default config is unaffected.
findings.scenario: With MEDIA_AUDIT_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS=600, 15 minutes into a full audit the page no longer shows it running; Run full audit toasts 'Full audit dispatched' although the new job is rejected by the lock.

findings.claim: The inspector offers Release for an asset that is already released and Purge without checking the inspection's purgeable state.
findings.reasoning: canRelease checks only the issue type and !referenced, canPurge only the issue type (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:606-607), although the comment above them says an issue from an older audit is not offered once it no longer holds, and canRegenerate already checks trashed() (:603). Issues are a snapshot, so after releasing an asset from this page its ActiveUnreferencedAsset issue still shows Release while the inspector's lifecycle line says 'Released'. The service stays safe: releaseUnreferenced() updates through the SoftDeletes scope so a trashed asset is untouched (MediaLifecycleService.php:245), and purge() re-checks eligibility (:142-144); only the offer and the resulting 'released, if it was still unreferenced' / 'not eligible' toast are wrong.
findings.scenario: An administrator releases asset #42 from the inspector, reopens the same issue, and is offered Release again; confirming does nothing but toasts 'Asset #42 released, if it was still unreferenced'.

findings.claim: When no selected post can be moderated, the bulk confirmation and the Undo handlers return silently instead of saying nothing was done.
findings.reasoning: Bulk confirm() runs each attempt quietly when more than one id is confirmed (:257) and returns without any toast when $done is empty (:267-269); restorePosts()/hidePostsAgain() are always quiet and toast only when something changed (:310-315, :330-335). Single-post actions do report the refusal (attempt() not quiet), so the gap is only the all-refused bulk case and Undo. A refusal can be 'not allowed' (CannotModeratePostException::becauseUserIsNotAllowed, HidePostAction.php:24-26), in which case the list keeps showing the posts unchanged with no explanation.
findings.scenario: A moderator selects five published posts and confirms Hide after another moderator already hid them (or after losing the permission): the dialog closes and nothing is said; an Undo whose posts changed meanwhile likewise does nothing silently.

findings.claim: The bulk Undo toasts name the first selected post instead of the one actually restored or re-hidden when only one of several succeeded.
findings.reasoning: restorePosts() and hidePostsAgain() count successes but, for a single success, print self::shortTitle($posts->first()) (:314, :334) — the first post loaded, which may be one that failed. Only reachable with a partial failure in a multi-post Undo, so rare and cosmetic.
findings.scenario: Undo of a two-post hide where post A was already restored by someone else: B is restored, but the toast says '“A” is visible again'.

findings.claim: A required hide/finalize reason accepts whitespace-only input that trim() then turns into null.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's required rule fails a string whose trim() is empty (ValidatesAttributes::validateRequired), and confirm() validates the raw $this->reason before trimming (ListPosts.php:235-248; ListComments.php:148-161), so an ASCII-whitespace reason never reaches the action. Only Unicode blanks such as NBSP pass, which is 05-61 (SKIP: staff can type any three characters anyway).
findings.resolution_ru: Обязательная причина скрытия принимает одни пробелы, которые trim() превращает в null. Итог: бот ошибся: правило required в Laravel не пропускает строку, пустую после trim(), а confirm() проверяет сырой reason до обрезки. Проходят только Unicode-пробелы вроде NBSP, это 05-61 (SKIP).

findings.claim: Audit dispatch is deduplicated only by a screen-level check, not atomically across pending and running audits.
findings.reasoning: The page check is documented as advisory and the job's cache lock as the real guard (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:184-191, RunMediaAuditJob.php:44-48, config/media.php:93-107); a concurrent duplicate fails fast and is filtered as benign (FailedMediaJobReader.php:117-128). The remaining case — a second job queued before the first creates its Running row — only runs one more read-only audit after the first finishes. Not worth a coordination mechanism.
findings.resolution_ru: Запуск аудита дедуплицируется лишь проверкой на экране, не атомарно. Итог: проверка страницы задокументирована как подсказка, защита это cache lock job, дубль падает быстро и считается безвредным. Остаётся лишь ещё один read-only аудит; координация не стоит того.

findings.claim: regenerateVariants() is public with a force flag, so a direct call can force regeneration without the confirmation.
findings.reasoning: Same as 07-11: the confirmation is a UI affordance, not a permission. regenerateVariants() authorizes view-media-diagnostics (:238) and the page re-checks canAccess on every Livewire request (Filament CanAuthorizeAccess::hydrateCanAuthorizeAccess); only that administrator, who may confirm force regeneration anyway (askToForceRegenerate/confirm), can send the call. Force regeneration rewrites variants from the master and loses nothing.
findings.resolution_ru: regenerateVariants() публичный с флагом force, и прямой вызов обходит подтверждение. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 07-11: подтверждение это UI, а не право; метод проверяет view-media-diagnostics, страница перепроверяет canAccess. Регенерация из master ничего не теряет.

findings.claim: Releasing an asset checks references and then soft-deletes without serialization, so a reference added in between is lost.
findings.reasoning: Same as 06-13/03-21: no code path attaches an existing unreferenced asset. Uploads, avatars and Studio plan photos create the asset and its reference in one transaction (CreatePostAction.php:84-124, SetPersonaAvatarAction.php:86-110, SetStudioPlanImageAction.php:85-93), and the only reuse of an existing asset (CreatePostAction::lockStoredPostImage, :208-220) is the executor publishing a plan's photo, which the plan still references, so the release check sees it as referenced.
findings.resolution_ru: Освобождение ассета проверяет ссылки и удаляет без сериализации, теряя новую ссылку. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 06-13/03-21: ассет без ссылок ничто не привязывает; загрузки создают ассет и ссылку в одной транзакции, а переиспользуется лишь фото плана, на которое план ещё ссылается.

findings.claim: A provider or guarded flag switched off with 0, or through an update of the parent array, skips the switch-off confirmation.
findings.reasoning: The switches are the admin.ui.switch component, whose Alpine state toggles a JSON boolean (checked = ! checked, x-modelable; components/admin/ui/switch.blade.php:38-62) bound with wire:model.live per key (project-settings/providers.blade.php:22), so every switch-off from the UI arrives as false on data.sign_in_providers.{p} and is intercepted (pinned by ProjectSettingsPageTest/SignInProviderSwitchesTest). A 0 or whole-array update only comes from a hand-crafted request by the same authorized administrator, who can confirm the switch-off anyway (07-11).
findings.resolution_ru: Флаг, выключенный через 0 или обновление всего массива, обходит подтверждение. Итог: бот ошибся: admin.ui.switch всегда шлёт булев false по ключу, и это перехватывается, что закреплено тестами. 0 или весь массив возможен только в подделанном запросе того же админа (как 07-11).

findings.claim: The model filter is truncated to 128 characters, so a longer configured model id can no longer be matched.
findings.reasoning: Model names come from translation_ai_provider_calls.model, a varchar(128) (create_translation_ai_provider_calls_table.php:25), so every recorded model fits; the only other option is the configured model before its first call (TranslationAiDiagnostics.php:177-178), and a configured id over 128 characters could never be recorded at all. Real provider model ids are a few dozen characters.
findings.resolution_ru: Фильтр модели обрезан до 128 символов, и длинный id модели не найти. Итог: бот ошибся: имена берутся из translation_ai_provider_calls.model типа varchar(128), так что все записанные помещаются, а id длиннее 128 вообще нельзя записать. Реальные id моделей в несколько десятков символов.

findings.claim: delete() does not compare the supplied id with the confirmed $deleting category.
findings.reasoning: Same as 07-11: the dialog is a UI step, not a permission. delete() re-finds the category (:206) and DeleteCategoryAction authorizes the actor before and after locking and refuses a category any post still uses (DeleteCategoryAction.php:17, 46; CannotDeleteCategoryException REASON_USED_BY_POSTS), so skipping askToDelete() gains the same administrator nothing they could not do with two clicks.
findings.resolution_ru: delete() не сравнивает переданный id с подтверждённой категорией $deleting. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 07-11: диалог это шаг UI, а не право; DeleteCategoryAction проверяет права и отказывает для используемой категории. Пропуск askToDelete() ничего админу не даёт.

findings.claim: hide-posts-again lets any published post be hidden without the required reason.
findings.reasoning: The reason is a page rule, not an action contract: HidePostAction takes an optional reason (HidePostAction.php:22) precisely for the Undo re-hide, and it authorizes moderate-content on the locked actor and post (:24-33). Only a moderator who may hide the post anyway can dispatch the event with other ids, and that moderator can satisfy the required rule with any three characters (cf. 05-61). Same reasoning as 07-11.
findings.resolution_ru: hide-posts-again позволяет скрыть опубликованный пост без обязательной причины. Итог: бот ошибся: причина это правило страницы, HidePostAction намеренно принимает её опционально для Undo и проверяет moderate-content; модератор и так может ввести три любых символа (как 07-11).

findings.claim: PersonaResource::getEloquentQuery() does not exclude tombstoned Personas.
findings.reasoning: Nothing consumes the resource query: global search is disabled (:49), ListPersonas reads PersonasQuery, EditPersona looks the record up itself (EditPersona.php:23) and is a plain Page without Filament record binding, and every way into the editor goes through canEdit(), which refuses a Deleted (tombstoned) account (:72-78, isTombstoned() is status Deleted, User.php:195-198).
findings.resolution_ru: PersonaResource::getEloquentQuery() не исключает tombstoned персон. Итог: бот ошибся: запрос ресурса никто не использует: поиск отключён, ListPersonas читает PersonasQuery, EditPersona сам ищет запись, а вход в редактор идёт через canEdit(), который отказывает удалённым аккаунтам.

findings.claim: The rating group editor saves its whole settings draft, so it can overwrite another administrator's changes made after the page was opened.
findings.reasoning: True last-write-wins (draftData() :91-103 into UpdateRatingGroupAction), but this is the taxonomy case of 02-18 (SKIP): label, description, range, sort and active of a rating group, all visible on the list and reversible, and UpdateRatingGroupAction re-checks the range against the active options under the group lock (InvalidRatingGroupConfigurationException, EditRatingGroup.php:129-140), so no invalid state results. Unlike 08-01 it carries no lock-out or compliance switch.
findings.resolution_ru: Редактор группы рейтинга сохраняет весь черновик и может затереть правки другого админа. Итог: верно, last-write-wins, но это случай таксономии как 02-18: поля видны и обратимы, диапазон перепроверяется под блокировкой. В отличие от 08-01, тут нет блокировки входа или compliance.

findings.claim: Category save always writes is_active from the drawer, overwriting an activation change made meanwhile.
findings.reasoning: Same as 02-18 (SKIP): last-write-wins on a four-field taxonomy form. For the same administrator the drawer follows the row menu's activate/deactivate (ManageCategories.php:283-286), so only another administrator's toggle in the same window is overwritten, visibly and reversibly.
findings.resolution_ru: Сохранение категории всегда пишет is_active из drawer, перезаписывая параллельную активацию. Итог: как 02-18: last-write-wins на форме таксономии из четырёх полей; для того же админа drawer следует меню строки, перезаписать можно лишь переключение другого админа, видимо и обратимо.

findings.claim: The group key uniqueness check races with the insert, so concurrent creates with one key end in a 500 instead of a draftKey error.
findings.reasoning: Same race and verdict as 02-65 (option key) and 02-16/03-04 (category/tag slug): Rule::unique (:94) runs before CreateRatingGroupAction inserts, so two administrators creating the same new key within milliseconds get one unhandled unique violation; the unique index keeps the data correct.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка уникальности ключа группы гоняется со вставкой, и параллельное создание даёт 500. Итог: та же гонка и вердикт, что в 02-65 и 02-16/03-04: два админа с одним ключом в те же миллисекунды получат одно необработанное нарушение, а уникальный индекс держит данные корректными.

findings.claim: Category create/update should catch the slug unique-constraint violation and report it on draftSlug.
findings.reasoning: Same as 02-16 (SKIP): the Livewire Rule::unique (:138) only loses to a concurrent save of the same new slug by another administrator within milliseconds; the outcome is an error, not bad data.
findings.resolution_ru: Нет перехвата нарушения уникальности slug при сохранении категории. Итог: верно в теории, но, как в 02-16, Rule::unique проигрывает только одновременному сохранению того же slug другим администратором за миллисекунды, и итогом будет ошибка, а не плохие данные.

findings.claim: A concurrent hide is reported as this moderator's hide with an Undo, because HideCommentAction does not say whether it changed anything.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-25 (SKIP). The page already re-reads the comment and says 'changed meanwhile' when it is no longer visible (ListComments.php:178-184), so only a hide committing in the milliseconds between that read and HideCommentAction's lock yields the misleading toast, whose Undo is a restore the moderator may perform anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: Чужое одновременное скрытие комментария показывается как своё, с Undo. Итог: страница уже перечитывает комментарий и пишет 'changed meanwhile'; остаётся окно в миллисекунды до блокировки в HideCommentAction, а Undo там это восстановление, которое модератор и так может сделать.

findings.claim: Post (and comment) Undo should be bound to the moderation revision it reverses, so a newer decision is not undone.
findings.reasoning: Same family as 02-25 (SKIP): Undo lives in a toast for a few seconds, and RestorePostAction/HidePostAction re-check the status under lock, so overriding a newer decision needs another moderator to reverse and redo the decision inside that window; the Undo is an action the moderator is allowed to take directly anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: Undo для поста и комментария не привязан к ревизии модерации. Итог: Undo живёт в тосте несколько секунд, RestorePostAction и HidePostAction перепроверяют статус под блокировкой, а само Undo модератор и так вправе выполнить напрямую.

findings.claim: enableLanguage/disableLanguage pass a pre-lock snapshot of enabledCodes(), so a concurrent enable or disable can be lost.
findings.reasoning: True, and the same pre-lock read as 02-83 (SKIP) in UpdateProjectLocaleSettingsAction: it needs two administrators changing the offered languages in the same moment, and the lost change is immediately visible on the Languages page and redone with one click.
findings.resolution_ru: enableLanguage/disableLanguage берут enabledCodes() до блокировки, одновременное изменение может потеряться. Итог: верно, как и 02-83, но нужны два администратора в один момент, а потеря сразу видна на странице Languages и исправляется одним кликом.

findings.claim: The Action queue stops polling while the executor is off even if a claimed action is still running.
findings.reasoning: Same as 07-12 (SKIP) for the plan's Action plan: polling only while the executor is on is the documented design (comment at :265, class docblock :46-48); a run claimed before the switch-off finishes within its job timeout and shows on the next interaction or reload.
findings.resolution_ru: Очередь действий перестаёт опрашивать сервер при выключенном executor, даже если действие ещё идёт. Итог: так задумано и задокументировано; действие, начатое до выключения, завершится в пределах таймаута job и появится при следующем действии или перезагрузке.

findings.claim: StudioActionPlan::links() queries the result post or comment per row, an N+1 on every queue render.
findings.reasoning: True for Done CreatePost/CreateComment/CreateReply rows (StudioActionPlan.php:318-334), but bounded to the 25 rows of a page (plan and actor are already eager-loaded, StudioActionsQuery.php:42) as primary-key lookups on an admin-only screen; same cost/benefit as 07-31 (SKIP).
findings.resolution_ru: StudioActionPlan::links() делает запрос на каждую строку очереди (N+1). Итог: верно для выполненных строк CreatePost/CreateComment/CreateReply, но это не больше 25 выборок по первичному ключу на админском экране; как и 07-31, не стоит изменения.

findings.claim: is_numeric() plus (int) accepts non-integral ids such as '1.9' or '5.9', which then target record #1 / #5.
findings.reasoning: True for EditPersona::mount (:23) and StudioActionQueue::operate/askToCancel (:162, :370-375), but the UI only ever sends integer ids, a hand-crafted '1.9' reaches only a record the same administrator may open or act on directly, every Studio operation re-authorizes on locked rows, and EditPersona only redirects to the editor. Compare 01-18.
findings.resolution_ru: is_numeric() плюс (int) пропускает id вроде '1.9', который ведёт на запись 1. Итог: интерфейс шлёт только целые id, подделанный id достаёт лишь запись, доступную тому же администратору, операции Studio перепроверяют права под блокировкой, а EditPersona только редиректит.

findings.claim: rangeProblems() truncates non-integer drafts and ignores the 2..15 bounds, so the live check leaves Save enabled for values Save will reject.
findings.reasoning: True for the live hint (:141-162), but Save always validates settingsRules() first (EditRatingGroup.php:123, CreateRatingGroup.php:92-101), which rejects 2.5 or 16 with the field message. The only effect is that Save is pressable and then shows the error; nothing invalid is written.
findings.resolution_ru: Живая проверка rangeProblems() не ловит дробные значения и границы 2..15, Save остаётся активной. Итог: Save всегда сначала проверяет settingsRules() и отклоняет 2.5 или 16 с сообщением у поля; ничего некорректного не пишется, просто кнопку можно нажать.

findings.claim: The active-option count decision should move from rangeProblems() and UpdateRatingGroupAction into shared domain validation.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion; the editor and the action already agree (RatingGroup::FEWEST/MOST_OPTIONS, the action re-checks under lock).
findings.resolution_ru: Перенести подсчёт активных вариантов в общую доменную валидацию. Итог: это предложение по рефакторингу; редактор и действие уже согласованы через RatingGroup::FEWEST/MOST_OPTIONS, а действие перепроверяет под блокировкой.

findings.claim: The RunMediaAuditJob (and regeneration) dispatch should move from the page into an Action.
findings.reasoning: Layering preference, not a defect: the page authorizes and dispatches a parameterless job that does all the work; nothing is persisted from the page.
findings.resolution_ru: Вынести запуск RunMediaAuditJob со страницы в Action. Итог: это предпочтение по слоям, а не дефект; страница проверяет права и запускает job без параметров, который делает всю работу, сама страница ничего не сохраняет.

findings.claim: PersonaResource::canEdit()'s role and deleted checks should move into a Policy.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion; the checks are correct where they are and the Content Studio actions re-check on locked rows.
findings.resolution_ru: Перенести проверки роли и удаления из PersonaResource::canEdit() в Policy. Итог: предложение по рефакторингу; проверки корректны на своём месте, а действия Content Studio перепроверяют их на заблокированных строках.

findings.claim: approveSelected and the Undo handlers have no limit on the number of ids.
findings.reasoning: The ids come from one page's checkboxes (25) or a toast; a larger list needs a hand-crafted request by a moderator who is authorized for every item, and each item still goes through its own locked, authorized action.
findings.resolution_ru: approveSelected и обработчики Undo не ограничивают число id. Итог: id приходят с одной страницы (25) или из тоста; длинный список требует подделанного запроса модератора с правами на каждый элемент, и каждый элемент всё равно идёт через своё действие с блокировкой и авторизацией.

findings.claim: The publication-eligibility rule in trust() duplicates CreatePostAction and should be centralized.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion; trust() is a display label that documents it mirrors CreatePostAction (:548-561).
findings.resolution_ru: Правило допуска к публикации в trust() дублирует CreatePostAction. Итог: предложение по рефакторингу; trust() только выводит метку и прямо указывает, что повторяет CreatePostAction.

findings.claim: On an installation without the settings row the translation summary is computed from null, so the translation links are missing until the first save.
findings.reasoning: True only for an installation where row 1 does not exist; DatabaseSeeder runs DefaultProjectSettingsSeeder and any save or preset creates it (ProjectSettingsManager lockedRow, ApplyProjectPresetAction.php:63). The effect is a 'Nothing to translate yet' summary until the first save; visitors are unaffected.
findings.resolution_ru: Без строки настроек сводка переводов считается от null, ссылок на переводы нет до первого сохранения. Итог: строку 1 создаёт DefaultProjectSettingsSeeder и любое сохранение или пресет; в худшем случае до сохранения видна сводка 'Nothing to translate yet', посетителей это не задевает.

findings.claim: The purge failure toast says nothing keepable was deleted although files may already be gone when the database delete fails.
findings.reasoning: The wording is accurate in substance: purge() only deletes files of an asset it has just confirmed purgeable (MediaLifecycleService.php:142-191), so nothing that should be kept is lost, and a retry is idempotent. A clearer 'try again' message would be cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: Тост об ошибке purge говорит, что нужное не удалено, хотя файлы могли уже исчезнуть. Итог: по сути текст верен: purge() удаляет файлы только у ассета, который только что признан удаляемым, а повтор идемпотентен; более ясное сообщение было бы косметикой.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks the template's verification and review sections.
findings.reasoning: Audit PR bookkeeping, not code.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов проверки и ревью из шаблона. Итог: это оформление аудиторского PR, а не код, не меняем.

findings.claim: Docstring coverage is below the configured threshold.
findings.reasoning: Style only.
findings.resolution_ru: Покрытие докстрингами ниже порога. Итог: это только стиль, не меняем.

findings.claim: Delete is offered for an option with no votes even when post_author_answers references it, so deleting it hits the restrict foreign key and fails with an uncaught error.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-66 (BUG low), seen from the page: askToDeleteOption chooses between voted / below-min / delete on votes()->exists() only (EditRatingGroup.php:400-404), DeleteRatingOptionAction checks only votes before $locked->delete() (DeleteRatingOptionAction.php:32-42), and deleteOption catches only CannotDeleteVotedRatingOptionException and InvalidRatingGroupConfigurationException (EditRatingGroup.php:418-428), so the QueryException from the restrictOnDelete post_author_answers FK escapes as a 500.
findings.scenario: An administrator deletes an option no visitor ever voted for but that an author picked as their own answer on a post: the dialog says Delete, and confirming it ends in a server error instead of the archive offer.

findings.claim: The Studio editor's direct-image import downloads the link without checking the allow_url_imports switch, while its social-post import honours it.
findings.reasoning: importImage() sends a direct link straight to StoreImportedImageAction::download() (EditsStudioPlan.php:349-358), which never reads the flag (StoreImportedImageAction.php:25-37); only the post branch goes through ImportFromUrlAction, which throws UrlImportDisabledException (EditsStudioPlan.php:701-708, ImportFromUrlAction.php:35), pinned by StudioPlanImageUiTest.php:445-465. Same root cause as 02-41 (BUG low): download() is the one fetch path that bypasses the kill switch. Exposure here is an active administrator only, but the switch exists to stop outbound fetches site-wide.
findings.scenario: Project settings switch Importing from links off (say during an SSRF scare); an administrator pastes https://... into the Studio editor's Direct link field and the server still fetches it and stores the image.

findings.claim: Tag deletion checks only isAdmin(), so a sanctioned administrator still passes TagPolicy::delete.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 01-06 / 03-02 (MINOR): TagPolicy::delete returns isAdmin() (TagPolicy.php:31-34) while create/update require canAccessPrivilegedPanel(); ManageTags uses it for canDelete and askToDelete (ManageTags.php:167, 225) and DeleteTagAction authorizes with it (DeleteTagAction.php:24). Exposure stays small because Filament's persistent Authenticate rejects non-Active staff on every request via User::canAccessPanel (User.php:406-416).
findings.scenario: An administrator is limited while a ManageTags tab is open; any request that still slips past the panel check (or a future non-panel caller) keeps the delete ability the policy should have removed.

findings.claim: Resolving can overwrite a report another moderator ignored meanwhile, because ResolveReportAction accepts every status except resolved after the page's open check.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-74 (MINOR): ListReports::close pre-checks Open (ListReports.php:386-390) but ResolveReportAction updates where status != resolved (ResolveReportAction.php:39-47) while IgnoreReportAction requires open (IgnoreReportAction.php:42-44); a zero-row result is also reported as success with Undo (02-71). Only a race between two moderators reaches it.
findings.scenario: Moderator A ignores report #7 with a note; at the same moment moderator B resolves it from a list loaded before: B's update matches, replacing A's decision, processor and note.

findings.claim: unarchiveOption accepts any option id and the action deactivates it without the range check, so the group can drop below its minimum.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-67 (MINOR): unarchiveOption() calls UnarchiveRatingOptionAction for whatever option findOption returns (EditRatingGroup.php:372-386), and the action writes archived_at = null, is_active = false on any locked row without ValidateRatingOptionTransitionAction (UnarchiveRatingOptionAction.php:26-31). The row menu offers Unarchive only on archived options, so only a direct Livewire call by an administrator gets there.
findings.scenario: An administrator's crafted call unarchiveOption(<id of an active option>) on a group at its minimum deactivates it, leaving fewer active options than min_options and a misleading 'unarchived · inactive' toast.

findings.claim: UpdateRatingOptionAction does not recheck archived_at under the lock, so a save racing an archive can leave an option archived and active.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-68 (MINOR): the action validates only the min/max transition on the locked row (UpdateRatingOptionAction.php:28-37). The page re-reads the option and forces Active off for an archived one (EditRatingGroup.php:213-229, activeLock :487), so only the milliseconds between that read and the lock remain; an archived-and-active row would then be shown and votable (VoteRatingOptionAction checks is_active only).
findings.scenario: Admin A saves an option drawer with Active on at the instant admin B archives the option: the option ends archived_at set and is_active true.

findings.claim: The Reported posts card counts through Post::query(), which hides soft-deleted rows, while the Reported list it opens includes author-deleted posts.
findings.reasoning: The card counts reports_count > 0 OR needs_review over the default SoftDeletes scope (ReportedPostsWidget.php:25-29). The list it links to reads listed(), which drops SoftDeletingScope and keeps soft-deleted rows whose status is Deleted (ModerationPostsQuery.php:160-167), with the same reported predicate (:183-185). The query's docblock says the tab is 'the posts the dashboard counts as reported' (:170-172) and the commit that set the link (4dcc686f) added a test that each card opens on exactly what it counts (ModerationDashboardTest.php:148-174), which has no author-deleted post.
findings.scenario: A reported post is deleted by its author: the list's Reported tab still shows it ('Deleted by author'), but the dashboard card no longer counts it, so the card says 3 and the list it opens shows 4.

findings.claim: The Reported comments card does not match the list it links to: it counts finalized removals the Reported tab excludes and misses author-deleted comments the tab includes.
findings.reasoning: The card counts Comment::query()->where(reports_count > 0) under the SoftDeletes scope (ReportedCommentsWidget.php:24-26). The Reported tab reads every comment without that scope and adds whereNull(moderation_removed_at) (ModerationCommentsQuery.php:97-100, 115). Finalizing a removal sets only moderation_removed_at and keeps the row live (FinalizeCommentRemovalAction.php:19, 67), and reports_count is a count of all reports, never lowered (ReportContentAction.php:245-260), so every finalized reported comment stays in the card forever. The parity intent is the same as 09-07 (commit 4dcc686f, ModerationDashboardTest.php:148-174).
findings.scenario: Moderators hide and finalize five reported comments: the Reported tab drops them, but the dashboard card keeps counting them indefinitely, while an author-deleted reported comment shows in the tab without being counted.

findings.claim: Save with nothing to save re-draws the plan from the database at whatever version it now has, without telling the page's other editors and with a 'Nothing to save' toast; Generate then goes on as if the version were current.
findings.reasoning: When the validated draft equals the fingerprint, save() calls draw($plan) (EditStudioPlan.php:195-203), which takes the plan's current lock_version and values (:521-537) but, unlike reload() and discard() (:147, :168), never calls saidReloaded() (EditsStudioPlan.php:834-839), so the discussion and votes editors keep the old version. The branch is reachable only when the browser counts a change that normalizes away, because Save is disabled without changes (editor/topbar.blade.php:25). Same family as 07-14 (MINOR). The version checks keep it safe: a then=generate request is refused as stale by the discussion editor's expectedLockVersion (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1092-1094, RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction.php:172), so no paid request goes out on an unseen version.
findings.scenario: Admin B saves a new title; admin A, whose only 'change' is a trailing space, presses Save draft: A's page silently shows B's title with 'Nothing to save', and A's next comment-votes save is refused as stale with no hint why.

findings.claim: The first photo's Draft is always made with startAuthorId, so when that Persona has become unavailable the error asks to choose another author, but choosing one cannot help and every photo is refused.
findings.reasoning: photoPlan() creates the Draft with new StudioPlanData(authorUserId: $this->startAuthorId) (CreateStudioPlan.php:174-175), deliberately the author the page started with (class docblock :25-31, pinned by CreateStudioPlanPageTest.php:324-341). When CreateStudioPlanAction refuses that author, refuse() moves to the Post step and says 'This persona can't be chosen any more. Choose another one, or no author.' (:194-200), but the next photo again uses the same startAuthorId; only Create draft (which uses the chosen author) or a page reload gets out.
findings.scenario: An administrator opens New publication with Persona Anna drawn; another administrator limits Anna; the first one picks a photo, is told to choose another author, picks Boris and the photo again, and gets the same refusal every time.

findings.claim: normalize() casts the #[Url] status/role (Users) and status/type (Reports) to string before checking them, so an array query value raises an array-to-string warning that becomes a 500.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 08-02 (MINOR): ListUsers::normalize runs (string) $this->status and (string) $this->role (ListUsers.php:222-223) and ListReports::normalize (string) $this->status and (string) $this->type (ListReports.php:580-581) on mixed #[Url] properties that Livewire fills with arrays from ?status[]=x, although the docblocks promise any value 'reads as something the page offers' and q is already guarded with is_string (:225, :582). Laravel turns the warning into an ErrorException.
findings.scenario: A moderator follows /admin/users?role[]=admin or /admin/reports?type[]=post and gets a server error instead of the default tab.

findings.claim: The calls page number is only lower-bounded, so a forged ?page= produces an enormous OFFSET.
findings.reasoning: Already covered by 08-03 (MINOR), which named TranslationAiDiagnostics::page(): FILTER_VALIDATE_INT with only min_range (TranslationAiDiagnostics.php:91-96) feeds recentCalls()->paginate() (TranslationAiUsageQuery.php:206-215); with calls present a page near PHP_INT_MAX overflows ($page - 1) * 25 to a float and the int cast in offset() raises an ErrorException before the past-the-end clamp (:506-508) can run. The bot's 'expensive query' angle is not the issue; the 500 is.
findings.scenario: An administrator opens /admin/translation-ai?page=9223372036854775807 and gets a server error.

findings.claim: Reports (and Users) paginate at the stored page without clamping, so a page that empties shows the empty state although earlier pages have rows.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 08-04 (MINOR): ListReports::getViewData paginates at (int) $this->pageNumber (ListReports.php:266, ModerationReportsQuery.php:47-58) and the view shows 'No open reports' when the page has no rows (reports.blade.php:89-116); ListUsers does the same (ListUsers.php:163, ModerationUsersQuery.php:38-47). Closing the open reports of the last page (each leaves the Open tab), or sanctioning everyone on the last page of a status tab, is the normal way to get there.
findings.scenario: With 30 open reports a moderator works through page 2 and resolves its 5 rows: the page now says 'No open reports' with no pagination, while 25 remain on page 1.

findings.claim: sections() runs every navigation badge COUNT, and the sidebar and the topbar each call it, so every admin page runs the badge queries twice.
findings.reasoning: Badges are evaluated when the navigation is mounted, not when sections() reads them: Resource::getNavigationItems() calls ->badge(static::getNavigationBadge(), ...) eagerly (vendor Filament Resources/Resource/Concerns/HasNavigation.php:77), mountNavigation() runs once and sets isNavigationMounted (Navigation/NavigationManager.php:54-56, 220), and NavigationManager is bound scoped, one per request (FilamentServiceProvider.php:80). The second sections() call clones the mounted items; item()->getBadge() only evaluates the stored string.
findings.resolution_ru: Запросы счётчиков бейджей навигации якобы выполняются дважды, для сайдбара и топбара. Итог: бот ошибся, бейджи вычисляются один раз при монтировании навигации, NavigationManager один на запрос, а второй вызов sections() лишь клонирует готовые элементы и читает сохранённую строку.

findings.claim: The 'API key rejected' health check should apply across models with the same credential and stop applying after the credential changes, not be scoped to the configured model.
findings.reasoning: Scoping provider health to the configured provider and its model family is the documented design: 'Provider health is the configuration translations run on now: the configured provider and model ... A filter on an old model never changes it' (TranslationAiDiagnostics.php:33-37, health() docblock :218-228), pinned by TranslationAiPageTest.php:492-503 ('reads the key from the configured provider and its model alone, never an older model or another provider'). No credential identity is recorded on translation_ai_provider_calls, so there is nothing to key on.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка 'API key rejected' должна действовать для всех моделей с тем же ключом. Итог: бот ошибся, по задумке и документации здоровье считается для настроенного провайдера и его семейства моделей, это закреплено тестом, а ключ в translation_ai_provider_calls не пишется.

findings.claim: The Media health card should show a newer failed audit run instead of reporting the last completed run as Healthy.
findings.reasoning: Health is defined from the latest completed run: 'no completed run yet -> unknown; missing_masters > 0 -> critical; ...' (docs/architecture/media.md:919-927, MediaHealthResolver.php docblock) and the widget is documented as 'reading the same latest-completed MediaAuditRun the diagnostics page uses' (media.md:1006-1013). A run that failed says nothing about the media; the card links to Media Diagnostics, which lists recent runs.
findings.resolution_ru: Карточка Media health должна показывать более новый упавший прогон аудита. Итог: бот ошибся, по документации здоровье определяется последним завершённым прогоном; упавший прогон ничего не говорит о медиа, а карточка ведёт на Media Diagnostics со списком прогонов.

findings.claim: confirm() acts on whatever report is selected now, so the hide/ban confirmation should be bound to the report it was opened for.
findings.reasoning: Same reasoning as 08-19: the dialog is a UI step, not a permission. It is modal (confirm-dialog with scrim and focus trap), J/K stepping is ignored while a dialog is open (reports.blade.php:32-37), and it is keyed and drawn from the current report (confirmation.blade.php: wire:key confirm-<kind>-<detail id>, target and author shown), so what is confirmed is what is on screen. Every effect is re-authorized on locked rows: HidePostAction/HideCommentAction (moderate-content) and BanUserAction (UserPolicy::ban via ExecutesUserStatusTransition).
findings.resolution_ru: confirm() действует на текущий выбранный репорт, а не на тот, для которого открыт диалог. Итог: бот ошибся, диалог модальный, J/K при нём не работает, он привязан к текущему репорту и показывает его, а каждое действие заново авторизуется на заблокированных строках.

findings.claim: Approval should capture the discussion generation version when Review and confirm opens, so a generation taken in meanwhile is not approved unseen.
findings.reasoning: approve() re-checks that the plan is a Draft at the version this editor holds (EditStudioPlan.php:324-357) and ApproveStudioPlanAction refuses a stale version on the locked row, so a generation taken in by another tab is refused with Reload. The only same-page path that could move the version without a click is the discussion editor taking in a finished generation, and it polls only while visible (wire:poll.Ns.visible, studio-plan-discussion-editor.blade.php:55) while the Discussion step is hidden on the Publication step (studio-plan.blade.php:145); a proposal is otherwise taken in when the step is shown again (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:510-519). The confirmation shows counts, not texts (studio-plan/approval.blade.php).
findings.resolution_ru: Одобрение плана должно фиксировать версию генерации обсуждения на момент Review and confirm. Итог: бот ошибся, approve() и ApproveStudioPlanAction отклоняют устаревшую версию с предложением Reload, а редактор обсуждения на шаге Publication скрыт и не опрашивает сервер.

findings.claim: Raising the maximum from an option row overwrites an unsaved maximum in the top-bar draft.
findings.reasoning: True (EditRatingGroup.php:320-322), but deliberate and defensible: the above-max dialog the administrator confirms says 'Raise maximum to N and activate', so the draft then showing N is the decision just made; the clean-draft case is pinned (RatingGroupOptionsTest.php:172-178). Other unsaved fields are kept. A UX preference, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Повышение максимума из строки варианта перезаписывает несохранённый максимум в черновике. Итог: верно, но намеренно: администратор подтверждает 'Raise maximum to N and activate', так что N в черновике и есть его решение; остальные несохранённые поля не трогаются.

findings.claim: links() queries the result post or comment per row, an N+1 on the action plan.
findings.reasoning: Same as 08-30 (SKIP): StudioActionPlan::links (StudioActionPlan.php:318-334) does a primary-key lookup per Done CreatePost/CreateComment/CreateReply row, bounded to a page of rows on an admin-only screen.
findings.resolution_ru: StudioActionPlan::links() делает запрос на каждую строку плана (N+1). Итог: как и 08-30, это выборка по первичному ключу на выполненную строку, ограниченная одной страницей на админском экране; не меняем.

findings.claim: After the photo's Draft is deleted elsewhere, save() keeps planId, so every later save fails the same way.
findings.reasoning: True (CreateStudioPlan.php:97-103), and consistent with the editor's design: the refusal that keeps what was typed is pinned (CreateStudioPlanPageTest.php:252-261) and EditStudioPlan likewise treats a deleted draft as 'nothing here can be saved any more'. The draft can only be deleted by a deliberate, version-bound Delete from the list (ListStudioPlans.php:113-160); silently recreating it would undo that decision. Rare, with a manual way out (copy the text into a new publication).
findings.resolution_ru: Если черновик фото удалён в другом месте, save() держит planId и каждое сохранение падает. Итог: верно, но так же ведёт себя редактор: удаление это осознанное действие, и молча создать черновик заново значит его отменить; случай редкий, выход есть: перенести текст в новую публикацию.

findings.claim: age() uses an absolute diffInMinutes, so a future timestamp shows as elapsed time and the max(0) clamp never applies.
findings.reasoning: True mechanically (ModerationListFormat.php:30-39), but every caller passes a time already in the past: the oldest pending post and a pending post's created_at (ListPosts.php:371, 429) and the oldest open report (ListReports.php:281), all stamped by the application's own now() (or a Studio occurs_at that is due). No caller can reach the case; unlike 08-07 nothing visible is wrong.
findings.resolution_ru: age() берёт модуль diffInMinutes, будущая дата покажется прошедшим временем. Итог: механически верно, но все вызовы передают время в прошлом, проставленное now() приложения или наступивший occurs_at; до этого случая никто не доходит, видимой ошибки нет.

findings.claim: tagChoices() loads every tag on every render before limiting the offered ones.
findings.reasoning: True (EditsStudioPlan.php:1149-1165), but the same cost/benefit as 04-39 (SKIP): tags are a staff-curated list read as id and name only, on an admin-only editor, and ManageTags itself deliberately lists them all (ManageTags.php:31-33).
findings.resolution_ru: tagChoices() загружает все теги на каждый рендер. Итог: верно, но, как в 04-39, теги это список, который ведёт персонал, читаются только id и name в админском редакторе, а ManageTags сам сознательно выводит их все.

findings.claim: statusBadge(null) falls to the Active badge with a live dot.
findings.reasoning: Speculative: callers pass a User's non-null status cast or PersonasQuery::STATUSES cases (ModerationListFormat.php:47-50; ListPersonas.php:146, 152); no caller passes null.
findings.resolution_ru: statusBadge(null) показывает бейдж Active. Итог: умозрительно, вызывающий код всегда передаёт ненулевой статус пользователя или значение из PersonasQuery::STATUSES, null никто не передаёт.

findings.claim: min:3 runs on the untrimmed reason, so 'a  ' passes and is stored as 'a'.
findings.reasoning: True (ModeratesUsers.php:74-82), but the reason is optional (nullable) here, so a one-character reason is no worse than none, and staff can type any three characters anyway (same rationale as 05-61 SKIP / 08-13).
findings.resolution_ru: min:3 проверяет необрезанную причину, 'a  ' проходит и сохраняется как 'a'. Итог: верно, но причина здесь необязательна, так что причина из одного символа не хуже пустой, а персонал и так может ввести любые три символа.

findings.claim: is_numeric() plus (int) accepts non-integer ids, so '1.5' opens record 1 (EditUser, EditRatingGroup).
findings.reasoning: Same as 08-31 (SKIP): EditUser::mount (:23) still requires UserResource::canEdit on the resolved person and only redirects, and EditRatingGroup::mount (:99) is behind the admin-only resource; a hand-crafted '2.9' reaches only a record the same user may open directly.
findings.resolution_ru: is_numeric() плюс (int) пропускают '1.5' и открывают запись 1 в EditUser и EditRatingGroup. Итог: как в 08-31, EditUser всё равно проверяет canEdit и лишь делает редирект, EditRatingGroup закрыт админским ресурсом; подделанный id ведёт только к записи, доступной пользователю напрямую.

findings.claim: A concurrent duplicate option key surfaces as a database error instead of a draftOptionKey validation error.
findings.reasoning: Same as 02-65 (SKIP): only the Rule::unique preflight (EditRatingGroup.php:242) guards the key before the locked create; losing needs two administrators creating the same key in the same group within milliseconds, and the unique index keeps the data correct.
findings.resolution_ru: Одновременный дубликат ключа варианта даёт ошибку БД вместо ошибки валидации draftOptionKey. Итог: как и 02-65, нужны два администратора с одним ключом в одной группе за миллисекунды, а уникальный индекс сохраняет данные корректными.

findings.claim: An option deleted after saveOption()/setOptionActive() found it makes findOrFail throw a 404 instead of the stale-option toast.
findings.reasoning: True mechanically (UpdateRatingOptionAction.php:30 findOrFail under the lock), but the page re-reads the option in the same request just before (EditRatingGroup.php:214, 497), and a deletion between drawer open and save is already caught there with refuseMissing(); only a deletion in the milliseconds inside one request is left, the same class as 02-65.
findings.resolution_ru: Вариант, удалённый после поиска в saveOption()/setOptionActive(), даёт 404 из findOrFail вместо тоста. Итог: механически верно, но страница перечитывает вариант в том же запросе и ловит удаление через refuseMissing(); остаётся только окно в миллисекунды внутри одного запроса.

findings.claim: restoreAccess() builds the Undo sanction from the status read before the lock, so a concurrent change makes Undo apply an outdated sanction.
findings.reasoning: The read (ModeratesUsers.php:111-117) and the locked restore (:119) happen in the same request milliseconds apart; RestoreUserAccessAction re-authorizes and re-checks the source status on the locked rows (ExecutesUserStatusTransition), and the Undo is itself a sanction the administrator may apply directly. Same family as 08-27.
findings.resolution_ru: restoreAccess() строит санкцию для Undo по статусу до блокировки. Итог: чтение и восстановление идут в одном запросе с разницей в миллисекунды, RestoreUserAccessAction перепроверяет права и статус под блокировкой, а Undo это санкция, которую администратор вправе применить сам.

findings.claim: moderationOptions() should move its role checks into Policy abilities.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion like 08-35: the role checks only choose the hint shown (ModeratesUsers.php:136-157); availability also asks the policy, and every action re-authorizes against UserPolicy on locked rows (ExecutesUserStatusTransition, MarkUserTrustedAction).
findings.resolution_ru: Перенести проверки ролей из moderationOptions() в Policy. Итог: предложение по рефакторингу, как 08-35; роли там только выбирают подсказку, доступность спрашивает policy, а каждое действие заново авторизуется через UserPolicy на заблокированных строках.

findings.claim: The Users Undo (restore after a sanction, sanction again after a restore) should be bound to the transition it reverses, so a later sanction or restore is not undone.
findings.reasoning: Same as 08-27 (SKIP): undoSanction/sanctionAgain (ListUsers.php:123-146) live in a toast for a few seconds and go through RestoreUserAccessAction / the sanction actions, which re-authorize and re-check the status on locked rows; undoing another admin's newer decision needs that decision inside the toast window, and the Undo is an action the administrator may take directly anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: Undo для пользователей не привязан к переходу, который отменяет. Итог: как и 08-27, Undo живёт в тосте несколько секунд и идёт через действия, которые перепроверяют права и статус под блокировкой; само Undo администратор вправе выполнить напрямую.

findings.claim: Move saveOption()'s archive and capacity decisions into the shared domain layer.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion like 08-33: the page only pre-fills what the drawer shows as locked (EditRatingGroup.php:223-232); the authoritative range check already runs under the group lock in UpdateRatingOptionAction/CreateRatingOptionAction (ValidateRatingOptionTransitionAction). The archived recheck is 09-06.
findings.resolution_ru: Перенести решения saveOption() об архиве и вместимости в доменный слой. Итог: рефакторинг, как 08-33; страница лишь заполняет то, что панель показывает заблокированным, а главная проверка диапазона уже идёт под блокировкой группы в UpdateRatingOptionAction и CreateRatingOptionAction.

findings.claim: The report Undo should be bound to the closure it reverses, so a stale Undo cannot reopen a later decision and clear its note.
findings.reasoning: Same as 08-27 (SKIP): Undo is a toast-lived ReopenReportAction call (ListReports.php:163-173, 407-410) that re-authorizes under lock; reopening another moderator's newer decision needs that moderator to reopen and close the report again inside the toast window, and Reopen is offered on any closed report anyway. The case where the close itself did nothing and still offers Undo is 02-71 (MINOR).
findings.resolution_ru: Undo для репорта не привязан к закрытию, которое отменяет. Итог: как и 08-27, Undo живёт в тосте и вызывает ReopenReportAction с авторизацией под блокировкой, а Reopen и так доступен на любом закрытом репорте; Undo после закрытия, которое ничего не сделало, учтено в 02-71.

findings.claim: Validation errors thrown by UpdateStudioPlanAction (publishAt) are not followed to the step that shows the field.
findings.reasoning: validateDraft() already moves to the step of any page-level error (EditsStudioPlan.php:558-591, stepOf :1032-1040). The only errors the action adds are validatePlanDate's 'would run past 2038' (StudioDiscussionValidationRules.php:193-202, StudioVoteValidationRules.php:279-288), reachable only with a publish date within about 30 days of 2038; the error is still kept in the bag and shown once the Publication step is opened.
findings.resolution_ru: Ошибки валидации из UpdateStudioPlanAction (publishAt) не переводят на шаг с полем. Итог: validateDraft() уже переходит к шагу ошибки; действие добавляет лишь 'would run past 2038', достижимую только с датой примерно за 30 дней до 2038, и она всё равно видна на шаге Publication.

findings.claim: The author indicator should reuse the approval preflight's eligibility decision instead of repeating the role and status checks.
findings.reasoning: Refactoring suggestion: StudioPlanFormat::author only labels the card (StudioPlanFormat.php:96-100); approval asks the preflight and the action on locked rows.
findings.resolution_ru: Индикатор автора должен брать решение о допуске из preflight одобрения. Итог: предложение по рефакторингу; StudioPlanFormat::author только подписывает карточку, а одобрение спрашивает preflight и действие на заблокированных строках.

findings.claim: A slug collision with a concurrent save surfaces as a database error instead of a draftSlug validation error.
findings.reasoning: Same as 03-04 (SKIP): UniqueEffectiveTagSlug validates (ManageTags.php:131) before Create/UpdateTagAction write; losing needs two staff members saving the same new slug within milliseconds, and the unique index keeps the data correct.
findings.resolution_ru: Коллизия slug тега при одновременном сохранении даёт ошибку БД вместо ошибки draftSlug. Итог: как и 03-04, UniqueEffectiveTagSlug проверяет до записи; проиграть можно только если два сотрудника сохранят тот же slug за миллисекунды, а уникальный индекс сохраняет данные корректными.

findings.claim: ManageTags should paginate tags and search in the database instead of loading every tag.
findings.reasoning: Documented choice: 'The list is bounded and already on the page, so the search is the browser's' (ManageTags.php:31-33); tags are created only by staff. A redesign of the screen, not a defect (cf. 04-39).
findings.resolution_ru: ManageTags должна пагинировать теги и искать в БД. Итог: это задокументированный выбор: список ограничен и уже на странице, поэтому ищет браузер, а теги создаёт только персонал; это переделка экрана, а не дефект.

findings.claim: Edit source for a rating option should open that option's drawer, not only its group's page.
findings.reasoning: Feature request: the mapping is documented ('Options are edited on their group's page', TranslationSourceEditor.php:29-30) and EditRatingGroup has no URL parameter for an option drawer; nothing is broken.
findings.resolution_ru: Edit source для варианта рейтинга должен открывать его панель, а не страницу группы. Итог: это запрос фичи; поведение задокументировано (варианты правятся на странице группы), у EditRatingGroup нет параметра URL для панели варианта, ничего не сломано.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks the template's sections.
findings.reasoning: Audit PR bookkeeping, not code.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов из шаблона. Итог: это оформление аудиторского PR, а не код, не меняем.

findings.claim: Docstring coverage is below the configured threshold.
findings.reasoning: Style only.
findings.resolution_ru: Покрытие докстрингами ниже порога. Итог: это только стиль, не меняем.

findings.claim: The job's 120 s timeout exceeds the queue's 90 s retry_after, so a slow run can be redelivered while it still runs and followers are notified twice.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-35 / 06-04 (MINOR low): $timeout = 120 (NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostJob.php:19) against retry_after 90 on every connection (config/queue.php:43,71), with a non-atomic dedup pre-read in NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction. Verdict kept consistent. Note that each target runs exactly one worker process (numprocs=1 in infrastructure/config/supervisor/rateguru-staging-queue.conf:9 and install-bootstrap-services:1109), so a concurrent second delivery needs a second consumer of the queue; that keeps it low.
findings.scenario: With a second worker on the queue (scaled supervisor program), a notification run that takes over 90 s is handed to the second worker, both read 'not yet notified' for the same followers, and each follower gets two notifications for one post.

findings.claim: Per-recipient send failures are swallowed by the action, so the job succeeds and its 5 tries never re-deliver the missed notifications.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-37 (MINOR low): NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction catches Throwable per recipient, report()s and logs it and continues (NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction.php:96-111); handle() returns normally, so the job's tries=5/backoff (NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostJob.php:15-17) never fire. Both bots report the same thing; verdict kept consistent with 02-37.
findings.scenario: A deadlock or lock timeout on the two user rows LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier locks makes one follower's send fail; the job completes and that follower never gets the notification.

findings.claim: GenerateMediaVariantsJob's 120 s timeout exceeds the 90 s retry_after, allowing concurrent variant-generation attempts.
findings.reasoning: The timing mismatch is real (GenerateMediaVariantsJob.php:27 vs config/queue.php:71), but the consequence the bots name is already handled: every variant write is serialized per variant by MediaVariantWriter's lock (MediaVariantWriter.php:20,73-74,129; config/media.php:51-53), generation is idempotent, and each target runs a single worker process (supervisor numprocs=1). A second delivery would re-derive the same variants under the lock. If 10-01 is fixed by raising retry_after, this one goes with it.
findings.resolution_ru: Таймаут GenerateMediaVariantsJob 120 с больше retry_after 90 с, возможны параллельные попытки. Итог: последствие уже закрыто: запись варианта сериализована блокировкой MediaVariantWriter, генерация идемпотентна, воркер один; если 10-01 решат повышением retry_after, уйдёт и это.

findings.claim: The 3600 s audit job exceeds the 90 s retry_after, so a running audit can be redelivered and recorded as failed while the original continues.
findings.reasoning: With tries=1 (RunMediaAuditJob.php:35), a redelivered copy is failed by the worker before handle() (attempts 2 > tries 1), so no second audit runs; the job has no failed() method, so the MediaAuditRun row is untouched. The only effect would be a MaxAttemptsExceeded row in failed_jobs, which FailedMediaJobReader counts (only MediaAuditAlreadyRunningException is filtered, FailedMediaJobReader.php:117-128). Redelivery while running needs a second consumer, and each target runs one worker process (numprocs=1). A dedicated connection with retry_after > 3660 is infrastructure work out of proportion to a spurious diagnostics row in a topology the project does not run.
findings.resolution_ru: Аудит на 3600 с дольше retry_after 90 с, его могут доставить повторно и записать упавшим. Итог: при tries=1 копия падает до handle(), второго аудита нет, MediaAuditRun не меняется; отдельное соединение ради лишней строки в failed_jobs при топологии, которой нет, несоразмерно.

findings.claim: If an issue insert fails, the failure handler flushes the still-populated buffer again, which throws again, so the run is never marked Failed and stays Running.
findings.reasoning: flushIssueBuffer() clears the buffer only after a successful insert (RunMediaAuditJob.php:146-154). When the insert itself is what threw (from :71 or the interim flush at :135-136), the catch calls flushIssueBuffer() again (:93) with the same rows, a deterministic error repeats, and $run->update(Failed) at :95-98 and the error log at :100-103 are skipped. The row then reads Running in the history (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:721) and blocks a new audit from the page for the lock TTL (auditCurrentlyRunning, :379-385). Realistic deterministic insert failures are rare (no FK on asset ids; paths come from the app), hence low.
findings.scenario: An issue row the database refuses (e.g. a value it rejects) makes the audit fail; the run is left as Running for an hour on the diagnostics page, then shown as Running in the history forever, with no 'full audit failed' log.

findings.claim: pruneOldRuns() runs inside the audit's failure boundary, so a retention-cleanup error rewrites an already completed audit as Failed.
findings.reasoning: The Completed update (RunMediaAuditJob.php:73-86) is followed by pruneOldRuns() inside the same try (:88); any exception there lands in the catch, which overwrites status with Failed (:95-98) and rethrows, so the job is also recorded in failed_jobs and counted as a failed media job next time. The audit's results were complete and correct; health (latest completed run, MediaHealthResolver) then falls back to the previous run.
findings.scenario: The retention delete (which cascades to many media_audit_issues rows) hits a lock or statement timeout: a fully successful audit is shown as Failed, its fresh counters are hidden from the health card, and a spurious failed media job appears.

findings.claim: A failed audit keeps all counters at zero, so the diagnostics history reports 'Stopped after 0 assets' even after real work was done.
findings.reasoning: Counters are written only on success (RunMediaAuditJob.php:73-86) and default to 0 (create_media_audit_runs migration:22-26); the job's own docblock calls a failed run's snapshot 'all-zero counters' (:157-160). The page nevertheless renders failed runs as 'Stopped after '.assets_checked.' assets' (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:478-480), presenting that zero as a measured progress figure for every failed run.
findings.scenario: An audit fails after checking thousands of assets (partial issues already flushed); the history row reads 'Stopped after 0 assets'.

findings.claim: media_audit_issues.path is varchar(255), so an orphan path longer than 255 characters fails the insert.
findings.reasoning: The orphan scan only walks the app's own media directories (MediaOrphanScanner.php:40-41, config/media.php:31-34), whose files are written by the app under generated short names; media_assets.path and media_variants.path are themselves string(255). A >255-character path there is not something the application produces; widening a column for a hypothetical file placed by hand is not worth a migration.
findings.resolution_ru: media_audit_issues.path это varchar(255), длинный путь файла-сироты сломает вставку. Итог: скан идёт только по медиа-каталогам приложения с короткими сгенерированными именами, и media_assets.path тоже string(255); миграция ради гипотетического файла, подложенного руками, не нужна.

findings.claim: Abandoned Running audit runs should be reconciled so they eventually stop blocking new audits.
findings.reasoning: They already stop blocking: MediaDiagnosticsPage::auditCurrentlyRunning() counts a Running row only within the lock TTL and its docblock says an older one is treated as abandoned (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:374-385), and the job's real guard is the cache lock, which expires (RunMediaAuditJob.php:185-211). Related to 08-09, which only concerns a misconfigured shorter TTL.
findings.resolution_ru: Брошенные прогоны аудита в статусе Running надо разбирать, чтобы они не блокировали новые. Итог: бот ошибся, они уже не блокируют: auditCurrentlyRunning() учитывает Running только в пределах TTL блокировки, а настоящая защита job это кеш-блокировка, которая истекает.

findings.claim: Add a test producing 501+ issues to cover the interim and final flush.
findings.reasoning: A test-coverage request, not a defect; the flush logic is straightforward (RunMediaAuditJob.php:135-154).
findings.resolution_ru: Добавить тест на 501+ проблем для промежуточного и финального сброса. Итог: это запрос на покрытие тестами, а не дефект; логика сброса простая.

findings.claim: The job does not refuse an incomplete analysis, so a batch claimed while the photo analysis is being re-run still makes a paid request from the description being replaced.
findings.reasoning: The job's refusal checks Draft, isFor(asset, sourceHash) and configuration (GenerateStudioPostTextsJob.php:79-84) but never $context->complete. A re-run keeps the old result with status Queued (RequestStudioImageAnalysisAction.php:106-125), so the hash still matches and the job sends. StudioPostTextContext's docblock says nothing new is written from such a description (StudioPostTextContext.php:18-23), the request refuses it (RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction.php:110), and the discussion job refuses it (StudioDiscussionContext.php:67). Keeping texts when a re-run starts during the call is deliberate and tested (GenerateStudioPostTextsJobTest.php:342-358), so only the pre-send check is affected.
findings.scenario: An admin clicks Generate, then Re-run analysis before the worker picks the batch up; the batch is sent and paid for, and when the re-run returns a different description the texts are dropped as stale.

findings.claim: The catch around readStream() drops the exception without report(), so a storage outage only shows as 'could not be read'.
findings.reasoning: Turning any unreadable file into null is the reader's contract (ImageUnavailable, StudioAnalysisImageReader.php:34, :78-100), and the first read is expected to fail when the feed variant is missing — it falls back to the master (:49-60) — so a blanket report() would report normal fallbacks. The failure is still recorded and logged as image_unavailable on the analysis. Observability nicety, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: catch вокруг readStream() глотает исключение без report(). Итог: превращать нечитаемый файл в null это контракт reader, а первое чтение штатно падает без feed-варианта и уходит на мастер, так что report() шумел бы; сбой всё равно пишется как image_unavailable. Это не дефект.

findings.claim: The near-duplicate check uses Jaccard (shared/union), which is looser than the documented 'nine in ten words shared'.
findings.reasoning: True that alike() divides by the union (StudioPostTextSuggestions.php:140-147), so two 10-word texts sharing 9 words score 0.82 and both pass. But the constant is documented as 'the share of their words they have in common' (:24-29) and a stricter rule refuses the whole paid batch on one near-duplicate (:115-118), so tightening it costs more wasted calls than the occasional similar option it removes; an admin picks one option anyway. A wording mismatch, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка почти-дубликатов через Jaccard мягче задокументированного 'девять из десяти слов'. Итог: верно, но строгое правило бракует весь платный пакет из-за одного дубля, что дороже редкого похожего варианта, а админ всё равно выбирает один; это расхождение формулировки.

findings.claim: All four OpenAI clients accept an http:// base URL, so the bearer API key (and the prompt) would be sent in cleartext if one is configured.
findings.reasoning: Each endpoint check allows ['http', 'https'] (OpenAiTranslationProvider.php:362, OpenAiStudioPostTextGenerator.php:361, OpenAiStudioImageAnalyzer.php:312, OpenAiStudioDiscussionGenerator.php:444) and then sends Http::withToken($apiKey). The base URL is operator config (TRANSLATION_OPENAI_BASE_URL, CONTENT_STUDIO_OPENAI_BASE_URL; config/translation.php:91, config/content_studio.php:35), defaulting to https, and no test or doc relies on http (tests only refuse ftp/bare hosts). So it needs an operator typo, but the cost of refusing it is one condition per client.
