findings.scenario: An operator points CONTENT_STUDIO_OPENAI_BASE_URL at http://gateway.example/v1; every analysis sends the bearer key and the stored photo description over plain HTTP.

findings.claim: '/responses' is appended to the raw base URL, so a base URL with a query string yields a broken endpoint.
findings.reasoning: Correct reading of rtrim($baseUrl, '/').'/responses' (OpenAiTranslationProvider.php:366 and the three StudioAi clients), but the documented base URL is a path prefix (docs/architecture/translation-engine.md:359, studio-plans.md:2018) and no supported endpoint needs a query string. A base URL with one fails loudly on every call (provider_rejected, nothing billed). Supporting query strings is a feature.
findings.resolution_ru: '/responses' дописывается к сырому base URL, query string его ломает. Итог: верно, но по документации base URL это префикс пути, и ни одному поддерживаемому endpoint не нужен query string; такой URL явно падает на каждом вызове без списания, а поддержка query string это фича.

findings.claim: discussionHash records category/tag ids while the prompt sends their names, so a rename after queueing does not make the generation stale.
findings.reasoning: Same finding as 03-24 (SKIP): the hash (StudioDiscussionContext.php:112-122) uses $plan->category_id and $tagIds while the prompt gets names (:107-108). The effect is only an admin-reviewed proposal written with a taxonomy label's previous name, and changing the formula would mark every stored generation stale. Verdict kept consistent.
findings.resolution_ru: discussionHash учитывает id категорий и тегов, а промпт их имена, так что переименование не делает генерацию устаревшей. Итог: как и 03-24, последствие лишь в старом названии в предложении, которое проверяет админ, а смена формулы сделала бы устаревшими все генерации.

findings.claim: The client bootstrap gives localStorage precedence for every user, so a stale or guest value overrides a logged-in user's saved theme.
findings.reasoning: docs/design/themes.md:22-35 sets the priority for an authenticated user as users.theme_preference first and reserves localStorage for guests; ThemeManager::preferenceForUser renders that into data-theme-preference (ThemeManager.php:13-20). But theme-bootstrap.js:11 and app.js:15-22 (livewire:navigated) use `stored || root.dataset.themePreference`, so any value in localStorage wins, and nothing syncs it on login. The ThemeSwitcher meanwhile marks the DB value, so the switcher and the page disagree.
findings.scenario: A user picks Light on their laptop (stored in localStorage and the DB), later picks Dark on their phone (DB = dark); the laptop keeps rendering Light on every page while the switcher shows Dark selected.

findings.claim: The provider response DTO accepts malformed rows, and TranslationService indexes id/text without guarding their shape.
findings.reasoning: The DTO documents the contract: 'A provider only guarantees the shape — a list of string ids and string texts' (TranslationProviderResponse.php:9-12). The only provider enforces exactly that before constructing it — two keys, both strings, else InvalidProviderResponse (OpenAiTranslationProvider.php:275-291). TranslationService then checks ids and texts semantically (TranslationService.php:137-148). A future provider breaking the interface contract is a programming error, not a runtime input.
findings.resolution_ru: DTO ответа провайдера принимает строки неверной формы. Итог: бот ошибся, контракт DTO задокументирован, единственный провайдер проверяет форму id и text до создания DTO, а TranslationService затем проверяет их по смыслу; нарушение контракта будущим провайдером это ошибка программиста.

findings.claim: The blank-source check uses ASCII trim(), so a Unicode-whitespace-only source reaches a paid provider call.
findings.reasoning: Correct reading (TranslationItem.php:128; ProjectTranslationUnit::requiresTranslation, ProjectTranslationUnit.php:50-53). But the source is the English reference value of project content, typed by administrators; an NBSP-only category name is staff input like 05-61/03-27 (SKIP), not the accidental member paste of 02-19. The cost is one tiny request whose blank answer is refused per item. Not worth the change.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка пустого источника использует ASCII trim(), источник из Unicode-пробелов уйдёт в платный вызов. Итог: верно, но источник вводят администраторы, как в 05-61/03-27; цена это один крошечный запрос, пустой ответ на который отклоняется; не стоит изменения.

findings.claim: A full recovery batch does not chain another dispatcher pass because the continuation ignores 'resent' and 'exhausted'.
findings.reasoning: Documented intent: 'The minute is the schedule and the recovery' and the chain is for due actions — 'A run that sent a whole batch_size may have left more due, and asks for the next one' (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:1434-1461; job docblock DispatchDueStudioActionsJob.php:21-23). Lost and stale actions are recovered by the every-minute studio:dispatch-due run (routes/console.php:52), which the wake never replaces.
findings.resolution_ru: Полный пакет восстановления не запускает следующий проход диспетчера. Итог: бот ошибся, по документации цепочка нужна для due-действий, а потерянные и устаревшие действия подбирает ежеминутный studio:dispatch-due, который wake не заменяет.

findings.claim: Rating option existence/active checks in plan and vote saves are not locked against concurrent archive/deletion, so an inactive option can be saved or approved.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 03-25 (INVALID): the rating configuration stays its own to change; an option archived or deleted after a Draft save is found by approval's preflight (answer_inactive / vote_option_unavailable, docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:130-133) and refused again by the executor at run time (rating_option_unavailable). A save is a Draft; nothing is cast from it. Verdict kept consistent.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверки варианта рейтинга при сохранении плана и голоса не защищены блокировкой. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 03-25: сохранение это черновик, из него ничего не голосуется, а архивный или удалённый вариант находит preflight одобрения и снова отклоняет executor при запуске.

findings.claim: A successful response without a status field is treated as completed, so a malformed body can produce suggestions.
findings.reasoning: True that the translation provider defaults a missing status to 'completed' (OpenAiTranslationProvider.php:232) while the Studio clients require it (OpenAiStudioPostTextGenerator.php:260). But a response without status must still carry exactly one output_text that decodes to the strict {translations:[{id,text}]} shape (:266-291), and TranslationService then validates every id and text per item; a truncated body fails JSON decoding and an incomplete one carries status 'incomplete'. A cheap consistency tweak with no reachable failure.
findings.resolution_ru: Успешный ответ без поля status считается completed. Итог: верно, но такой ответ всё равно должен нести ровно один output_text строгой формы {translations:[{id,text}]}, TranslationService проверяет каждый id и текст, а обрезанное тело не пройдёт JSON; достижимого сбоя нет.

findings.claim: TranslationLocale::PATTERN and TranslationItem::CONTENT_TYPE_PATTERN end in '$', so a value with a trailing newline is accepted.
findings.reasoning: Correct regex reading (TranslationLocale.php:15, TranslationItem.php:31), but as in 05-38 (SKIP) no untrusted input reaches them: target/source locales come from installed languages (ProjectTranslationRequestFactory.php:54-78, LanguageRules::translationLocale, TranslatableField::REFERENCE_LOCALE) and the content type is built as '{section}.{field}' (:85-88). Verdict kept consistent with 05-38.
findings.resolution_ru: TranslationLocale::PATTERN и CONTENT_TYPE_PATTERN кончаются на '$' и пропускают завершающий перевод строки. Итог: по regex верно, но, как в 05-38, недоверенный ввод до них не доходит: локали берутся из установленных языков, а тип контента собирается как '{section}.{field}'.

findings.claim: The exception's stack trace can carry the prompt in generate()'s frame args, contradicting the 'nothing from the request is kept' docblock.
findings.reasoning: The docblock promises that no HTTP-client exception (whose trace holds the bearer header) is kept (StudioDiscussionGenerationFailedException.php:8-12), which holds. The only frame arg is the StudioDiscussionPrompt (admin-authored plan texts and Persona profiles, no key: the key is a local read from config). The exception is only ever caught in GenerateStudioDiscussionJob.php:97, which keeps just $error and $call; it is never reported or logged, so the trace never leaves memory.
findings.resolution_ru: Стек исключения может нести промпт в аргументах generate(), вопреки докблоку. Итог: бот ошибся, докблок обещает не хранить исключение HTTP-клиента с bearer-заголовком, и это так; в промпте нет ключа, а GenerateStudioDiscussionJob берёт лишь $error и $call и ничего не логирует.

findings.claim: trim() runs before the control-character check, so NUL or vertical tab at the edges of a model value is stripped instead of refused.
findings.reasoning: Correct: PHP's default trim() removes \0 and \x0B before the control check (StudioImageDescription.php:172-174, StudioPostTextSuggestions.php:106-109). The result is a clean string with no control characters, which is everything the check protects; the 'nothing is trimmed into shape' wording refers to dropping or padding items, and trimming edge whitespace is the defined normalization. No harmful value can get through.
findings.resolution_ru: trim() идёт до проверки управляющих символов, NUL и вертикальная табуляция по краям срезаются, а не отклоняются. Итог: верно, но в итоге строка чистая и без управляющих символов, что и защищает проверка; обрезка краёв это заданная нормализация, вредное значение не проходит.

findings.claim: A 413 is mapped to ProviderRejected ('Check the configured model') instead of a size-specific error.
findings.reasoning: True (OpenAiStudioImageAnalyzer.php:255-262; message in StudioImageAnalysisError.php:36), but the photo sent is capped at max_image_bytes (8 MB) and is normally the ~1280 px feed variant (StudioAnalysisImageReader.php:44-60), well under the API's request limit, so a 413 is not a realistic outcome. A new error case with its copy is not worth it.
findings.resolution_ru: 413 сводится к ProviderRejected ('Check the configured model') вместо ошибки размера. Итог: верно, но фото ограничено max_image_bytes (8 MB) и обычно это feed-вариант около 1280 px, сильно меньше лимита API, так что 413 нереален; новый тип ошибки с текстом того не стоит.

findings.claim: Two spellings of one locale (pt_BR, pt-br) are both accepted as existingTranslations keys.
findings.reasoning: Correct reading of validExistingTranslations (TranslationItem.php:203-220), but the only consumer builds the map from installed languages, each once (ProjectTranslationRequestFactory existingTranslations, 'never a language that is not installed'), so no request carries two spellings. Defensive check for a consumer that does not exist.
findings.resolution_ru: Два написания одной локали (pt_BR, pt-br) оба принимаются как ключи existingTranslations. Итог: верно, но единственный потребитель строит карту из установленных языков, каждый по разу, так что двух написаний в запросе не бывает; это защита для несуществующего потребителя.

findings.claim: A date-mode plan without publish_at is scheduled for 'now', so the Publication preview of such a Draft shows an immediate post.
findings.reasoning: True that moments() substitutes the approval moment (StudioPlanSchedule.php:61-63) and StudioActionPlan::summary()/preview() use it (StudioActionPlan.php:68,102). But the Publication step shows 'Publication date not selected' for exactly this state (publication.blade.php:42-43), summary['editorial'] is null there (StudioActionPlan.php:90), and approval refuses it (incomplete_plan preflight). A preview of an incomplete Draft, already flagged on screen.
findings.resolution_ru: План с режимом даты без publish_at планируется на 'сейчас', превью показывает немедленный пост. Итог: верно, но шаг Publication тут пишет 'Publication date not selected', summary['editorial'] равен null, а одобрение такой план отклоняет; это превью неполного черновика.

findings.claim: A registry driver that passes is_a() but cannot be instantiated throws BindingResolutionException instead of TranslationConfigurationException.
findings.reasoning: Correct reading (TranslationProviderRouter.php:55-67), but drivers are classes listed in config/translation.php (:81-84), not environment values; the only one is OpenAiTranslationProvider, a concrete class. A non-instantiable driver is a developer error that fails every test touching translation; in a chunk job it would still end the chunk via failed(). Not worth wrapping.
findings.resolution_ru: Драйвер, который проходит is_a(), но не создаётся, бросает BindingResolutionException. Итог: драйверы это классы из config/translation.php, а не переменные окружения, единственный из них конкретный; неинстанцируемый драйвер это ошибка разработчика, которую поймают тесты.

findings.claim: Configurations should be rejected when the job timeout leaves too little margin beyond the provider timeout.
findings.reasoning: The provider timeouts are code constants, not environment settings (config/translation.php:95-96: connect 5, timeout 45), and the nesting is already pinned with a margin: GenerateProjectTranslationChunkJobTest.php:44-62 asserts timeout 75 <= retry_after - 10, < worker timeout, and connect+timeout (50) < 75. Documented in the job docblock (:37-45) and docs/architecture/translation-engine.md:133.
findings.resolution_ru: Нужно отвергать конфигурацию, где таймаут job слишком близок к таймауту провайдера. Итог: бот ошибся, таймауты провайдера это константы в коде, а не настройки окружения, и вложенность с запасом уже закреплена в GenerateProjectTranslationChunkJobTest и задокументирована.

findings.claim: The chunk claim relies on a 15 s cache lock; if it expires between read and write two workers could both claim and both pay.
findings.reasoning: claim() reads and writes the chunk under the batch lock in a few cache operations (ProjectTranslationGenerationStore.php:235-257, LOCK_SECONDS 15 at :64), so expiry mid-claim needs a >15 s stall of the cache between a get and a put while a second delivery of the same chunk job is running. With tries=1 a redelivered copy is failed before handle(), and each target runs one worker. Duplicate delivery is pinned as sending nothing (GenerateProjectTranslationChunkJobTest 'sends nothing when the same job is delivered twice'). A fencing token would cost far more than this residual risk.
findings.resolution_ru: Захват чанка держится на 15-секундной кеш-блокировке, при её истечении два воркера заплатят дважды. Итог: нужен простой кеша дольше 15 с между get и put при параллельной повторной доставке, а при tries=1 копия падает до handle(), воркер один; fencing token дороже такого риска.

findings.claim: provider_request_id should keep the x-request-id header and store the response body id separately.
findings.reasoning: All four OpenAI clients deliberately prefer the response id and fall back to the header id (OpenAiStudioPostTextGenerator.php:184, OpenAiStudioDiscussionGenerator.php:190, OpenAiStudioImageAnalyzer.php:141, OpenAiTranslationProvider.php:145, with 'its id and usage are kept' comments). Either id identifies the call to OpenAI; storing both is a schema change for a diagnostics preference.
findings.resolution_ru: provider_request_id должен хранить заголовок x-request-id, а id из тела отдельно. Итог: все четыре клиента OpenAI намеренно берут id ответа с откатом на заголовок; любой из них идентифицирует вызов, а хранение обоих это смена схемы ради удобства диагностики.

findings.claim: Reject a configured post_text_generation.timeout that could outlast the job's deadline.
findings.reasoning: The value is a code constant (config/content_studio.php:73-74: connect 5, timeout 70), not an environment setting, and the nesting is pinned: GenerateStudioPostTextsJobTest.php:49-50 asserts timeout 70 and connect+timeout < the job's 80 s.
findings.resolution_ru: Отвергать post_text_generation.timeout, который может пережить дедлайн job. Итог: бот ошибся, это константа в коде (connect 5, timeout 70), а не настройка окружения, и вложенность закреплена тестом: connect+timeout меньше 80 с job.

findings.claim: Under QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync the wake runs the dispatcher inline; it should always be enqueued asynchronously.
findings.reasoning: Every deployed target runs QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis (infrastructure/templates/environment/*.env.example) and the default is database (config/queue.php:16); sync is a test convenience. Consistent with 02-62 (SKIP: the sync remark is not a production concern).
findings.resolution_ru: При QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync wake запускает диспетчер синхронно. Итог: все развёрнутые окружения работают на redis, по умолчанию стоит database, а sync это удобство для тестов; как и в 02-62, для продакшена это не проблема.

findings.claim: Overdue roots and replies should be dispatched chronologically, with each reply delayed until its parent is published.
findings.reasoning: A reply already waits for its parent: it is planned under 'node:<parent>' (StudioPlanSchedule.php:94-96) and the dispatcher only sends actions with no parent or a parent Done (DispatchDueStudioActionsAction.php:32-33, 85-86, 124-125). Execution order of overdue comments does not change what readers see, because each comment is dated its own occurs_at (ExecuteStudioAction.php:373, 438).
findings.resolution_ru: Просроченные комментарии и ответы надо отправлять по времени, ответ после родителя. Итог: бот ошибся, ответ уже ждёт родителя: диспетчер шлёт только действия без родителя или с родителем в Done, а порядок не меняет видимое, ведь каждый комментарий датирован своим occurs_at.

findings.claim: Validate the requested node count and persona count against the generation limits in the generator before sending.
findings.reasoning: The limits are validated when the generation is requested (RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction.php:284-305: personaUserIds max max_personas, rootCount+replyCount <= min(max_nodes, MOST_NODES)), and they are code constants (config/content_studio.php:114-115), so they cannot change between request and job except by a deploy. The answer is validated again against the discussion rules (StudioDiscussionProposal::from).
findings.resolution_ru: Проверять число узлов и персон по лимитам генерации прямо в генераторе. Итог: бот ошибся, лимиты проверяются при запросе генерации и это константы в коде, которые до job меняются только деплоем; ответ ещё раз проверяется правилами обсуждения в StudioDiscussionProposal::from.

findings.claim: Decoding to PHP arrays lets a JSON object pass where a list (e.g. subjects) is required.
findings.reasoning: Only an empty object can pass: StudioImageDescription::items() requires array_is_list (StudioImageDescription.php:184), which any non-empty object fails, and an empty {} means the same as an empty list. The answer is also strict Structured Output against a schema declaring arrays (:120-139).
findings.resolution_ru: Декодирование в массивы PHP пропускает JSON-объект там, где нужен список. Итог: бот ошибся, пройти может только пустой объект, так как items() требует array_is_list, а пустой {} значит то же, что пустой список; к тому же ответ это строгий Structured Output по схеме с массивами.

findings.claim: The context loads Persona accounts without checking they are still Personas and not deleted.
findings.reasoning: Role and deletion are checked on locked rows when the generation is requested (RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction.php:175-181); a deletion between request and job changes the Persona's fingerprint (name becomes 'A deleted account', StudioDiscussionPersona.php:94-98) so the job refuses as stale_context; and taking a proposal in re-validates the discussion against current users (ApplyStudioDiscussionGenerationAction.php:95, 153-168). What remains is a demotion within the seconds before the job runs, costing one call whose proposal cannot be taken in.
findings.resolution_ru: Контекст загружает аккаунты Persona без проверки роли и удаления. Итог: роль и удаление проверяются под блокировкой при запросе, удаление до job даёт stale_context, принятие перепроверяет пользователей; остаётся понижение роли за секунды до job ценой одного вызова.

findings.claim: ordered() should validate the whole stored tree and reject nodes with non-root parents instead of omitting them.
findings.reasoning: A reply to a reply cannot be stored: every save validates 'two levels and no loop' (StudioDiscussionValidationRules.php:33, 264-280; docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:321).
findings.resolution_ru: ordered() должен проверять всё дерево и отвергать узлы с некорневым родителем. Итог: бот ошибся, ответ на ответ сохранить нельзя: каждое сохранение проверяет правило 'два уровня и без циклов'.

findings.claim: nameOf() drops a display_name/name of '0' through PHP truthiness and can fall back to the username.
findings.reasoning: True of `?:` (StudioDiscussionPersona.php:100), but users.name is NOT NULL (create_users_table:16) and a Persona named '0' with an empty name is not realistic; the username fallback is the Persona's public handle, not a secret.
findings.resolution_ru: nameOf() из-за truthiness PHP теряет имя '0' и откатывается на username. Итог: верно для ?:, но users.name NOT NULL, а Persona с именем '0' нереальна; запасной username это публичный ник Persona, а не секрет.

findings.claim: A regenerated part is checked for duplicate text only among its own new texts, not against the unchanged comments of the discussion.
findings.reasoning: True (StudioDiscussionProposal.php:94-101), but the documented rule is 'no two texts the same' within the answer (docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:1240), and a discussion saved by hand has no uniqueness rule at all (StudioDiscussionValidationRules has none for bodies). A proposal is reviewed by an admin before it is taken in.
findings.resolution_ru: Перегенерированная часть проверяется на дубли только среди своих новых текстов. Итог: верно, но задокументированное правило 'нет двух одинаковых текстов' действует внутри ответа, у ручного обсуждения такого правила нет вовсе, а предложение перед принятием смотрит админ.

findings.claim: Single-line titles accept U+2028/U+2029.
findings.reasoning: True (StudioPostTextSuggestions.php:97), same class of issue as 03-27 (SKIP): cosmetic, and a suggestion only becomes a title when an admin picks it. Verdict kept consistent.
findings.resolution_ru: Однострочные заголовки принимают U+2028/U+2029. Итог: верно, но, как в 03-27, это косметика, а подсказка становится заголовком, только когда её выберет администратор.

findings.claim: Placeholder validation messages include the placeholder text, which could expose source content.
findings.reasoning: Placeholders are the catalog's own tokens such as '{name}' (ProjectTranslationUnit::placeholders), not user text, and the message wording is pinned by TranslationBatchRequestTest.php:231-233. Every consumer catches InvalidTranslationRequestException without using its message (GenerateProjectTranslationChunkJob.php:193, GenerateProjectTranslationSuggestionAction.php:100, StartProjectTranslationGenerationAction.php:84, TranslationCenterPage.php:364).
findings.resolution_ru: Сообщения валидации плейсхолдеров содержат их текст и могут раскрыть исходник. Итог: бот ошибся, плейсхолдеры это токены каталога вроде '{name}', а не пользовательский текст, формулировка закреплена тестом, и ни один потребитель исключения не использует сообщение.

findings.claim: Reject an item whose placeholder exceeds maxLength or contains a newline when multiline is false.
findings.reasoning: A placeholder must appear in the source (TranslationItem.php:189), so such an item needs an English source that itself breaks its field's maxLength or single-line rule, which the catalog's own fields do not produce. Speculative.
findings.resolution_ru: Отвергать элемент, чей плейсхолдер длиннее maxLength или содержит перевод строки при multiline=false. Итог: плейсхолдер обязан быть в источнике, значит нужен английский источник, сам нарушающий правила поля, а поля каталога таких не дают; это умозрительно.

findings.claim: The PR description is missing template sections.
findings.reasoning: PR-description check, not code.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR не хватает разделов шаблона. Итог: это проверка описания PR, а не код, не меняем.

findings.claim: The screenshot runner's child Pest process is not isolated to a test database, so it runs against whatever database the parent environment points at.
findings.reasoning: PestVisualScreenshotRunner.php:11-18 passes only two variables; Symfony Process merges the parent's $_ENV/getenv() into the child (vendor/symfony/process/Process.php:333-341, getDefaultEnv), and artisan has already loaded .env into them through Laravel's putenv adapter. phpunit.xml's <env> entries (DB_DATABASE=rateguru_test, APP_ENV=testing) have no force="true", and PHPUnit only sets them when getenv() is false (PhpHandler::handleEnvVariables), so the child keeps .env's DB_DATABASE=rateguru and APP_ENV=local. tests/Pest.php:135-137 applies RefreshDatabase to tests/Browser, so VisualScreenshotBrowserTest's first test runs migrate:fresh on the developer's database. `php artisan test` avoids exactly this by clearing .env keys first (Collision TestCommand::clearEnv); `composer test:browser` is unaffected because composer never loads .env. cubic's production angle does not apply: the deployed artifact is built with composer --no-dev (install-bootstrap-runtime:97), so vendor/bin/pest does not exist there.
findings.scenario: A developer runs `php artisan visual:screenshot all` as .github/pull_request_template.md:23 asks. Each target's child process runs migrate:fresh against the local `rateguru` database, which is the .env default (.env.example:26). All local data is dropped and the database is left migrated but empty. docs/testing/visual-regression.md says the database is refreshed only with --fresh.

findings.claim: posts:purge accepts a destructive --older-than shorter than the configured retention without the --force acknowledgement that comments:purge-deleted and moderation:purge-content require.
findings.reasoning: PostsPurgeCommand.php:117-131 accepts any digit override and has no --force option (:25-29), so `--older-than=0` hard-deletes every author-deleted post, and owners can still restore those until retention ends. The project adopted the rule 'any destructive --older-than override more aggressive than the configured policy requires --force' for the two newer cleanup commands (commit c671e543; CommentsPurgeDeletedCommand.php:54-60; ModerationPurgeContentCommand.php:72-83; moderation-content-lifecycle.md:63-67). posts:purge predates that rule and never received it. Today's behaviour is pinned by PostsPurgeCommandTest.php:40-48 and PostRetentionTest ('still honors an explicit --older-than override under bad config'), so this is an inconsistency rather than an accident.
findings.scenario: An operator testing a fix runs `php artisan posts:purge --older-than=0`, meaning to add --dry-run. Every author-deleted post still inside its 30-day restore window is permanently destroyed, along with its comments, votes and reports.

findings.claim: (int) saturates an --older-than above PHP_INT_MAX instead of rejecting it.
findings.reasoning: The saturation is real (CommentsPurgeDeletedCommand.php:129-135, ModerationPurgeContentCommand.php:170-176, PostsPurgeCommand.php:125-131), and the effect is worse than the bot says: nothing fails later. With the project's PHP 8.5.8 and Carbon 3.15, now()->subDays(PHP_INT_MAX) overflows back to now, and subDays(PHP_INT_MAX-1) gives tomorrow. The cutoff in CommentRetentionPurgeService::cutoff (:133-141), PostRetentionPurgeService.php:123-131 and ModerationContentPurgeService.php:207-219 therefore admits every deleted row, and purge() revalidates against the same wrapped cutoff. The --force gates compare `override < configured`, so PHP_INT_MAX passes them. The bot's fix is not enough: RetentionDays::parse (RetentionDays.php:52-74) accepts values up to PHP_INT_MAX, so POST_AUTHOR_DELETE_RETENTION_DAYS=9223372036854775807 used as 'forever' has the same effect on the scheduled daily purge. media:purge's FILTER_VALIDATE_INT also accepts PHP_INT_MAX.
findings.scenario: An operator who wants to purge only ancient comments runs `comments:purge-deleted --older-than=99999999999999999999`, or sets the post retention to PHP_INT_MAX to mean 'never'. The override saturates to PHP_INT_MAX and the cutoff becomes now. No --force is asked for, and every author-deleted leaf comment or post is permanently purged at once, whatever its age.

findings.claim: purge() does not synchronize with asset attachment, so a post can claim an asset after the reference check.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 08-16, 06-13 and 03-21 (INVALID). purge() only touches trashed, grace-expired assets (MediaLifecycleService.php:47-79, 142-144). The only path that attaches an existing asset, CreatePostAction::lockStoredPostImage (CreatePostAction.php:208-220), locks the row and refuses a trashed() asset. Every other reference is created together with a fresh asset in one transaction (SetStudioPlanImageAction, SetPersonaAvatarAction, UpdateUserProfileAction). Nothing can claim an asset that purge is eligible to delete.
findings.resolution_ru: purge() не синхронизирован с привязкой ассета, пост может занять его после проверки ссылок. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 08-16, 06-13, 03-21: purge трогает только удалённые ассеты с истёкшим сроком, а единственная привязка существующего ассета блокирует строку и отклоняет trashed().

findings.claim: The orphan snapshot is stale at deletion time, so a concurrent upload or variant write can claim a candidate and still lose its file.
findings.reasoning: Same as 06-12 and 06-11 (INVALID). A file is a candidate only when its lastModified is older than orphan_grace_hours (24h, MediaOrphanScanner.php:36-48), so an upload or variant written around the scan is never one; docs/architecture/media.md ('Physical orphan detection') records this as the guard. Deletion happens only on a manual `media:purge --orphans --force`, which is not scheduled. Regenerating a variant onto a path that has been orphaned for over 24h during that run is contrived and heals on the next generate-variants run.
findings.resolution_ru: Снимок сирот устаревает к удалению, параллельная загрузка может потерять файл. Итог: бот ошибся, как в 06-12 и 06-11: кандидат это файл старше orphan_grace_hours (24 ч), удаление только ручное через media:purge --orphans --force, а остальное надуманно и лечится generate-variants.

findings.claim: The recalculation commands rewrite posts.updated_at, contrary to a documented convention that technical recalculations run under Post::withoutTimestamps().
findings.reasoning: No such convention exists. docs/architecture/content-studio-phase-0.md:283 records the decision that the actions themselves stay unchanged and that only Content Studio's executor wraps its technical writes in withoutTimestamps(). The reason is to keep a backdated historical post's dates (ExecuteStudioAction.php:76-87, Post.php:40-43). Ordinary member votes and comments rewrite updated_at through the same RecalculatePostScoreAction and RecalculatePostCountersAction on every interaction. Nothing outside Studio reads posts.updated_at (grep of app/ and resources/ finds no reader), so the command's rewrite has no observable effect.
findings.resolution_ru: Команды пересчёта переписывают posts.updated_at вопреки соглашению о withoutTimestamps(). Итог: бот ошибся, такого соглашения нет: так обёрнут только executor Content Studio ради дат исторических постов, голоса и комментарии тоже меняют updated_at, а вне Studio его не читают.

findings.claim: The hot-score sweep can overwrite a concurrent vote's newer score with one calculated from stale counters.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 02-63 (MINOR). The command calls RecalculatePostScoreAction::handle() without a transaction or lock (RecalculateHotScoresCommand.php:29-34). The action's refresh() and save() (RecalculatePostScoreAction.php:17-30) can straddle a vote that commits its own score. Only hot_score is affected, and only until the next activity or run, but it becomes routine once the command is scheduled as 02-64 proposes.
findings.scenario: While the command runs, a post receives a vote. The command has already read the pre-vote counters, the vote commits its score, and the command then saves the pre-vote score over it.

findings.claim: rebuild() coerces wrong-typed snapshot values (max_length '50', non-array placeholders) to null or [], so the constraints are dropped instead of the snapshot being refused.
findings.reasoning: Snapshots are written only by ProjectTranslationGenerationSnapshot::item() (:24-37) from an already validated TranslationItem, so max_length is int|null and placeholders is a list. The cache serializes PHP values, so the types survive the round trip. A wrong-typed value needs a hand-corrupted cache entry, and the result is still only a draft that an administrator reviews. A docblock-precision issue, not a reachable defect.
findings.resolution_ru: rebuild() приводит неверные типы в снимке к null или [] вместо отказа. Итог: снимки пишет только item() из проверенного TranslationItem, кеш сохраняет типы PHP, так что нужен испорченный вручную кеш, и итог всё равно черновик для администратора; это точность докблока.

findings.claim: The deploy-time sharing verifier checks the `public` filesystem disk's URL instead of the disk media is actually stored on (config('media.disks.public')).
findings.reasoning: VerifySharingConfigurationCommand.php:39 and :57-61 always read filesystems.disks.public.url. New media is stored on config('media.disks.public') (MediaStoreRequest.php:26,38), which is MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK. AGENTS.md:59 says moving to S3 or a CDN is meant to be just a disk change. Every target sets MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK=public today, so this is latent, but after that documented switch the deploy gate (DeployTest.php:881-883) would validate an unused disk.
findings.scenario: A target switches to MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK=s3 with an http:// or foreign-host URL. rateguru:sharing:verify still checks the untouched `public` disk and passes, so the deploy proceeds and post images reach Facebook over HTTP or from the wrong host, which is exactly what the check exists to stop.

findings.claim: --post-id is not validated: a non-numeric value crashes, an unknown id exits 0, and --post-id=0 recalculates every post.
findings.reasoning: All three are accurate (RecalculatePostCountersCommand.php:17-23), but nothing goes wrong. A non-numeric id raises a PostgreSQL bigint error, so the run fails loudly. An unknown id prints 'Recalculated counters for 0 posts.' And '0' is falsy, so it runs the whole-table recount, which is an idempotent, locked recalculation of correct values (RecalculatePostCountersAction.php:15-48). This is an operator-only repair command whose worst case is a longer run. Same class as 08-31 and 09-26.
findings.resolution_ru: --post-id не проверяется: нечисловое значение падает, неизвестный id даёт код 0, 0 пересчитывает все посты. Итог: всё так, но вреда нет: нечисловой id явно падает в PostgreSQL, неизвестный даёт 0 постов, полный пересчёт идемпотентен; худший случай это долгий прогон.

findings.claim: rateguru:admin:create trims the email but does not lowercase it, so the admin row can hold a mixed-case address that lowercase login does not match.
findings.reasoning: Part of 01-03 (BUG), whose reasoning already names CreateAdminUserCommand.php:24 and whose fix lowercases on every write path. The command stores the address as typed (:24, :62-69). Login is an exact WHERE email = ? on PostgreSQL, where comparison is case-sensitive (01-03). The self-service paths require lowercase, and the unique index is case-sensitive.
findings.scenario: An operator runs `rateguru:admin:create --email=Ivan@Example.com`. Signing in as ivan@example.com fails with 'These credentials do not match', and so does a password reset with the lowercase spelling. A member can also register ivan@example.com as a second account for the same mailbox.

findings.claim: A non-ArgvInput Artisan::call() (queue, scheduler, web) counts as answerable, so the command asks and takes the default 'no' instead of refusing.
findings.reasoning: Documented intent. AsksOnATerminal.php:24-32 states that ArrayInput is treated as answerable because that is how the test harness invokes commands, and that the helper decides only the message, not the safety. Both users return FAILURE when a confirmation is declined or unanswerable (SetupProjectPresetCommand.php:72-90, ImportStudioPersonasCommand.php:149-153), so the default 'no' can never be reported as success or apply anything. No production code calls these commands through Artisan::call: the only programmatic call in app/ is migrate:fresh in CaptureVisualScreenshotCommand.
findings.resolution_ru: Artisan::call() без ArgvInput считается интерактивным, команда спрашивает и берёт 'no' вместо отказа. Итог: бот ошибся, так задумано ради тестов: обе команды возвращают FAILURE при отказе или невозможности ответить, а продакшен-код их через Artisan::call не вызывает.

findings.claim: With --orphans, the --asset and --older-than options are silently ignored, so a run the operator meant to narrow deletes every orphan.
findings.reasoning: handle() validates --older-than and then dispatches to purgeOrphans() (MediaPurgeCommand.php:50-58). purgeOrphans() takes neither option and deletes every scanner candidate older than the fixed orphan_grace_hours (:132-165). media.md:769-780 describes the two modes as independent and lists --asset and --older-than as DB-mode options only. Nothing rejects the combination, so an operator gets a broader destructive run than they asked for, with no warning.
findings.scenario: An operator who wants to keep recent orphans for forensic recovery runs `media:purge --orphans --force --older-than=30`. Every orphan older than 24 hours is deleted instead of only those older than 30 days.

findings.claim: With no preset argument and no terminal, the picker reaches choice() instead of refusing with the --force message.
findings.reasoning: True (SetupProjectPresetCommand.php:32-40 checks only isInteractive()), but harmless. With stdin at EOF, Symfony's question helper throws a MissingInputException ('Aborted.') and the command exits non-zero. If a preset were somehow chosen, the canAskForConfirmation() guard at :66-70 would still refuse before anything is applied. The only difference is a clearer error message.
findings.resolution_ru: Без аргумента пресета и без терминала выбор доходит до choice(), а не до отказа про --force. Итог: безвредно: при EOF Symfony бросает MissingInputException и команда выходит с ошибкой, а canAskForConfirmation() отказал бы до применения; разница только в тексте ошибки.

findings.claim: A bare `--post` with no id falls through to the full candidate purge instead of a targeted run.
findings.reasoning: `{--post=}` is VALUE_OPTIONAL. Symfony's ArgvInput leaves the value null when no value follows, or when the next token is another option (ArgvInput.php:244-262), so postIdFilter() returns null (:151-153) and handle() runs the whole candidate sweep (:87-100). On its own that sweep is what the daily schedule does. Combined with an override, and given that posts:purge has no --force (11-02), it widens a run meant for one post to every author-deleted post. comments:purge-deleted --comment, moderation:purge-content --id and media:purge --asset share the pattern.
findings.scenario: `php artisan posts:purge --post --older-than=0` was meant to remove a single post immediately. The id was forgotten, so the run hard-deletes every author-deleted post.

findings.claim: --chunk and --id are validated after the retention-disabled early return, so invalid values exit 0 when retention is disabled.
findings.reasoning: True (ModerationPurgeContentCommand.php:66-97), but that branch does nothing at all; it prints 'disabled; nothing to purge'. Invalid options there change no data and hide nothing that a later enabled run would not reject. Cosmetic option-order hygiene.
findings.resolution_ru: --chunk и --id проверяются после раннего выхода при выключенном retention, неверные значения дают код 0. Итог: верно, но эта ветка ничего не делает и пишет 'disabled; nothing to purge'; данные не меняются, а включённый прогон такие значения отклонит. Косметика порядка проверок.

findings.claim: The audit labels soft-deleted assets that are still referenced, including ones whose grace has expired, as 'Soft-deleted, within grace period'.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 06-07 (MINOR). MediaAuditService.php:67-78 counts every trashed asset that is not both grace-expired and unreferenced as softDeletedWithinGrace, and MediaAuditCommand.php:39 prints that counter under the 'within grace period' label. A trashed but referenced asset is a gap state that the design never produces, and it hides the post's image.
findings.scenario: See 06-07. An asset is soft-deleted while a post still points at it. media:audit reports it as 'within grace period', so nobody investigates, while the post renders without its image.

findings.claim: rateguru:admin:create accepts any non-empty username, bypassing the lowercase/underscore and 32-character invariant.
findings.reasoning: True (CreateAdminUserCommand.php:25,34-38), but the app already tolerates usernames outside today's rule ('A username kept as it is is not held to today's rules', UserEditor.php:252). Login is by email, and /u/{username} resolves any stored value. The command is a one-off, trusted operator bootstrap documented in docs/deployment/admin-user-creation.md, so this is hardening of the same kind as 01-31.
findings.resolution_ru: rateguru:admin:create принимает любой непустой username в обход правил формата и длины. Итог: верно, но приложение уже допускает username вне текущего правила, вход идёт по email, /u/{username} находит любое значение; это разовая доверенная команда оператора, как в 01-31.

findings.claim: The ready-state check is not atomic with saving the translation, so a concurrent discard can still let the write through and leave the item marked discarded.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 03-32 (SKIP). The Ready read and the project-translation write in SaveProjectTranslationGenerationAction are not under the batch lock, and resolve() (:327-362) records the outcome later. The batch belongs to one administrator, so the race is that administrator pressing Save and Discard on the same suggestion at the same moment, and the guarded write still refuses outdated or already-translated units.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка Ready не атомарна с сохранением перевода, одновременный Discard может пропустить запись. Итог: как и 03-32, пакет принадлежит одному администратору, гонка требует нажать Save и Discard на одной подсказке разом, а защищённая запись отклоняет устаревшие единицы.

findings.claim: A declared but missing chunk is dropped from the loaded batch, so items disappear and the batch can be marked completed.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true (load(), :527-544; statusOf only sees loaded chunks). But meta and chunks are written together by one putMany with the same absolute expiry (:571-575), so they expire together. A single chunk key vanishing needs key-level eviction or manual deletion, and no maxmemory or eviction policy is configured anywhere in infrastructure/. Redis is also the queue, so eviction would lose jobs too. Even then the loss is regenerable AI drafts, not content.
findings.resolution_ru: Пропавший чанк выпадает из пакета, и пакет может стать completed. Итог: механически верно, но meta и чанки пишутся одним putMany с общим сроком; пропажа одного ключа требует вытеснения, которое не настроено, или ручного удаления, и теряются лишь AI-черновики.

findings.claim: The health command always exits successfully, so automation cannot gate on a mis-wired integration.
findings.reasoning: It is a human-read diagnostic report (docs/observability/observability-foundation.md:182). No deploy script or workflow runs it (grep finds only docs and tests), and it already warns about the gaps it detects (:153-155, :225-227, :246-248). Turning it into a gate is a feature request.
findings.resolution_ru: Команда проверки здоровья всегда выходит успешно, автоматизация не может на неё опереться. Итог: это диагностический отчёт для человека, ни один скрипт деплоя или workflow его не запускает, и он уже предупреждает о найденных пробелах; превратить его в гейт это запрос фичи.

findings.claim: --fresh ignores migrate:fresh's exit status, so a failed reset still captures screenshots and exits successfully.
findings.reasoning: A failed migration or seed throws, and Command::call() runs the command directly without catching, so the exception aborts visual:screenshot. migrate:fresh returns FAILURE without throwing only when destructive commands are prohibited (never configured here; no prohibitDestructiveCommands call in app/) or when production confirmation is refused, and --fresh is already refused outside local/testing/ci (:34-38). The reset is in any case overridden by the child's RefreshDatabase; see 11-01.
findings.resolution_ru: --fresh игнорирует код возврата migrate:fresh. Итог: бот ошибся, упавшая миграция или сид бросает исключение и прерывает команду; FAILURE без исключения бывает лишь при запрете деструктивных команд (здесь не настроен) или в продакшене, а там --fresh и так запрещён.

findings.claim: The missing-variant precheck runs outside the per-asset try, so one asset's exception aborts the whole backfill.
findings.reasoning: isMissingAnyVariant() (:72, :166-191) runs before the try at :78. It calls wouldUpscale($asset->width, $asset->height), which takes ints (MediaVariantSpecification.php:30), so a dimensionless Ready asset raises a TypeError there. This is the asset class 06-05 (MINOR) covers, and 06-05 assumed the command catches per asset; it does so only under --force. A remote storage->exists() failure escapes the same way. The exception leaves chunkById and ends the run, and every later asset, whose ids are higher, is never processed on any rerun.
findings.scenario: A legacy post image without dimensions sits at id 1200. Every `media:generate-variants` run (default --missing-only mode) crashes on it with a TypeError, so assets 1201 and up never receive their missing variants.

findings.claim: checked() can mark an invalid-UTF-8 provider response as successful.
findings.reasoning: Provider text can never be invalid UTF-8. OpenAiTranslationProvider decodes both the HTTP body and the structured output with json_decode(..., JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR) (:134, :270). PHP's decoder rejects malformed UTF-8 and unpaired \u surrogates ('Malformed UTF-8 characters', 'Single unpaired UTF-16 surrogate', reproduced on PHP 8.5.8), and it only produces valid UTF-8 strings. The provider contract guarantees string texts (10-18).
findings.resolution_ru: checked() может принять ответ провайдера с невалидным UTF-8. Итог: бот ошибся, провайдер декодирует тело и вывод через json_decode с JSON_THROW_ON_ERROR, который отвергает битый UTF-8 и непарные суррогаты и выдаёт только валидные строки (проверено на PHP 8.5.8).

findings.claim: The $voters docblock says 'given to' although the list holds the whole drawn pool plus kept Personas.
findings.reasoning: Docblock wording only (BuiltStudioPostVotes.php:13); no behaviour depends on it.
findings.resolution_ru: Докблок $voters говорит 'given to', хотя список содержит весь пул и оставленные Persona. Итог: это только формулировка докблока, от неё ничего не зависит.

findings.claim: isPresent() uses ASCII trim(), so a translation made only of NBSP or ideographic spaces counts as present and visitors see a blank label.
findings.reasoning: Same class as 10-19 (SKIP). Stored project translations are typed by administrators, or come from AI drafts an administrator saves (UpdateProjectTranslationAction), so a whitespace-only value is staff input, like 05-61 and 03-27, not an accidental member paste as in 02-19. The visible result, a blank label, would be spotted and fixed on the Languages page.
findings.resolution_ru: isPresent() использует ASCII trim(), перевод из одних NBSP считается заполненным и посетитель видит пустую подпись. Итог: как и 10-19, переводы вводят или сохраняют администраторы, это ввод персонала, как в 05-61 и 03-27; пустую подпись заметят и исправят на странице Languages.

findings.claim: Str::limit measures display width, so CJK and emoji names are cut at about 127 characters although users.name accepts 255.
findings.reasoning: Confirmed (Str::limit of 200 CJK characters at 255 returns 127). But it only matters for provider display names longer than 127 wide characters, which do not occur in practice. The cut is always within the column, and the name is editable afterwards.
findings.resolution_ru: Str::limit меряет ширину отображения, имена на CJK и эмодзи режутся примерно на 127 символах при лимите 255. Итог: подтверждено, но имена от провайдера длиннее 127 широких символов на практике не встречаются, обрезка всегда в пределах колонки, а имя потом можно изменить.

findings.claim: The [OK] prefix is hard-coded, so a disabled redaction setting still prints OK.
findings.reasoning: Same as 05-36 (SKIP). config/observability.php hard-codes redaction 'enabled' => true with no env override, so the line always reads 'enabled'. SensitiveDataRedactor never reads the flag anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: Префикс [OK] зашит, отключённая редакция всё равно печатает OK. Итог: как и 05-36, в config/observability.php редакция зашита как 'enabled' => true без env, так что строка всегда верна, а SensitiveDataRedactor этот флаг вообще не читает.

findings.claim: An invalid --chunk falls back to 1 instead of the default 200.
findings.reasoning: Only an operator typo triggers it, and the command warns 'Invalid chunk size provided; using 1.' (:220-224). The run is still correct, only slower. MediaPurgeCommand and RecalculateHotScoresCommand behave the same way. Style.
findings.resolution_ru: Неверный --chunk откатывается на 1, а не на 200 по умолчанию. Итог: это бывает только при опечатке оператора, команда предупреждает 'using 1', прогон корректен, просто медленнее; MediaPurgeCommand и RecalculateHotScoresCommand ведут себя так же. Это стиль.

findings.claim: Each candidate's variant files are checked for existence twice (precheck and generateAll()).
findings.reasoning: True for the default mode (:185 and MediaVariantGenerator::isAlreadyGenerated). The cost is a few extra existence checks per asset in a manual backfill, on the local disk every target uses. Performance micro-optimisation.
findings.resolution_ru: Файлы вариантов каждого кандидата проверяются на существование дважды. Итог: верно для режима по умолчанию, но это пара лишних проверок на ассет при ручном бэкфилле на локальном диске; это микрооптимизация.

findings.claim: With --force, $generated increments even when generateAll() writes nothing.
findings.reasoning: generateAll() rethrows every write failure (MediaVariantGenerator.php:86-97), so failures are counted correctly. Only an asset whose applicable specifications are all skipped as upscales, or excluded by --variant, is over-counted in the summary line. Summary wording.
findings.resolution_ru: С --force счётчик $generated растёт, даже когда generateAll() ничего не пишет. Итог: ошибки записи generateAll() пробрасывает, и они считаются верно; завышается лишь сводка для ассета, все спецификации которого пропущены или исключены --variant. Это формулировка сводки.

findings.claim: The verifier rejects an HTTPS APP_URL written with an uppercase scheme.
findings.reasoning: True for :30 and :77, whereas the image-URL scheme is lowercased (:57). But it fails closed, with the deploy refused and the reason printed, and no target writes APP_URL as 'HTTPS://'. The templates and environment contract use lowercase. Not worth a change.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка отвергает HTTPS APP_URL со схемой в верхнем регистре. Итог: верно, но отказ идёт в безопасную сторону: деплой отклоняется с причиной, а ни одно окружение не пишет 'HTTPS://', шаблоны используют нижний регистр; не стоит изменения.

findings.claim: The diagnostics reader does not trim the model name as the provider does, so whitespace makes it report no pricing.
findings.reasoning: It needs a quoted TRANSLATION_OPENAI_MODEL with surrounding spaces, since dotenv trims unquoted values. The effect is the diagnostics page showing unknown rates; recorded call costs are priced from the provider-reported model. Cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: Reader диагностики не обрезает имя модели и из-за пробелов не находит цены. Итог: нужен TRANSLATION_OPENAI_MODEL в кавычках с пробелами, так как dotenv обрезает значения без кавычек; страница покажет неизвестные тарифы, а стоимость вызовов считается по модели от провайдера.

findings.claim: In a --type=all dry run, comments that would go with purgeable posts are reported as parent_post_hold instead of being counted with the post deletion.
findings.reasoning: The per-target outcome is accurate: a comment under a Hidden post is owned by post-level cleanup, and ParentPostHold is the documented outcome for it (moderation-content-lifecycle.md 'Purge eligibility'). A real run differs only because the post pass has already removed those comments, so they are never visited. Dry-run summary wording; nothing is deleted or held wrongly.
findings.resolution_ru: В dry run с --type=all комментарии под удаляемыми постами показаны как parent_post_hold. Итог: исход верен: такой комментарий убирает очистка поста, ParentPostHold это задокументированный исход, а реальный прогон их не посещает; ничего не удаляется и не держится неверно.

findings.claim: The verifier should also check the URL port against a separately configured public port.
findings.reasoning: No 'public port' setting exists in the app or the environment contract; grep finds only the mail-inbound SMTP port. The command verifies HTTPS and host as designed. Speculative feature.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверять порт URL против отдельно настроенного публичного порта. Итог: такой настройки нет ни в приложении, ни в контракте окружения, команда проверяет HTTPS и хост, как задумано; это умозрительная фича.

findings.claim: Translations are not validated against the glossary before being reported as successful.
findings.reasoning: No consumer passes a glossary: 'The glossary is empty for now and is the caller's to pass' (translation-engine.md:90, :274-276; ProjectTranslationRequestFactory.php:46-54). Every result is a draft that an administrator reviews before it is saved. Glossary enforcement is a feature for when a glossary exists.
findings.resolution_ru: Переводы не проверяются по глоссарию перед отчётом об успехе. Итог: ни один потребитель не передаёт глоссарий, по документации он пока пуст, а каждый результат это черновик, который администратор смотрит перед сохранением; проверка глоссария это фича на будущее.

findings.claim: A throwing logger in logFailedCall() interrupts translation and hides the provider error.
findings.reasoning: Same class as 05-37 and 02-85 (SKIP): a log backend that throws is a broken platform, not a translation defect. The warning is written only for an already failed call (:128-145), and the caller sees an error either way.
findings.resolution_ru: Логгер, бросающий исключение в logFailedCall(), прерывает перевод и прячет ошибку провайдера. Итог: как в 05-37 и 02-85, падающий бэкенд логов это сломанная платформа, а не дефект перевода; лог пишется только для уже упавшего вызова, ошибку видно в любом случае.

findings.claim: The running flag uses the pointer snapshot taken before read(), which may itself complete the batch.
findings.reasoning: True: read() can fail stale chunks, complete the batch and release the pointer, while :67 still reports running. For one render of the technical diagnostics block, a completed batch is shown as running, and the next poll corrects it. Cosmetic and transient.
findings.resolution_ru: Флаг running берётся из снимка до read(), который сам может завершить пакет. Итог: верно, но лишь на один рендер технического блока диагностики завершённый пакет покажется запущенным, а следующий опрос это исправит; косметика и временно.

findings.claim: Chunks are split only against provider limits, not against TranslationService's logical batch limits, so a chunk could exceed the latter.
findings.reasoning: The provider limits sit well inside the logical ones: max_items 50 and max_payload_chars 60,000 (config/translation.php:99-100) against max_batch_items 500 and max_batch_chars 500,000 (:31-32). Every chunk cut to provider limits therefore fits the logical ones. The planner documents that the logical limit is per call and that each chunk is its own call (ProjectTranslationGenerationPlanner.php:20-21). The logical limit is a guard against a runaway consumer, not a working size.
findings.resolution_ru: Чанки режутся по лимитам провайдера, а не по логическим лимитам TranslationService. Итог: бот ошибся, лимиты провайдера (50 элементов, 60 000 символов) намного меньше логических (500 и 500 000), так что любой чанк в них влезает; логический лимит лишь страховка.

findings.claim: A provider whose settings omit the api_key key is shown as 'Not required' even when it needs credentials.
findings.reasoning: The only registered provider always defines 'api_key' => env(...) (config/translation.php:88), so a missing value reads as API_KEY_MISSING. 'Not required' needs a hand-written provider entry without the key, and even then the separate `ready` check (:54-67) builds the provider, refuses it and reports not ready.
findings.resolution_ru: Провайдер без ключа api_key в настройках показывается как 'Not required'. Итог: единственный провайдер всегда задаёт 'api_key' => env(...), пустое значение читается как API_KEY_MISSING; 'Not required' бывает лишь у самописного провайдера, и проверка ready его отклонит.

findings.claim: completed_at bounds lose fractional-second precision, so calls at sub-second boundaries are misassigned.
findings.reasoning: completed_at is a second-precision dateTime (migration :22) and the bound is formatted to seconds, so at most a call completed within the current second can fall outside a 'last N days' window. This is a diagnostics dashboard aggregate. Negligible.
findings.resolution_ru: Границы completed_at теряют доли секунды. Итог: completed_at хранится с точностью до секунды, граница форматируется так же, так что из окна 'last N days' может выпасть лишь вызов текущей секунды; это агрегат дашборда диагностики, эффект пренебрежимый.

findings.claim: With no English catalogs, every language is treated as fully translated.
findings.reasoning: That needs a release with no lang/en/*.php at all, which breaks the whole UI and is caught in CI by TranslationParityTest (class docblock :8-10). Not a reachable state for a deployed build.
findings.resolution_ru: Без английских каталогов каждый язык считается полностью переведённым. Итог: для этого нужен релиз вообще без lang/en/*.php, что ломает весь интерфейс и ловится в CI тестом TranslationParityTest; для развёрнутой сборки это состояние недостижимо.

findings.claim: The copied-catalog comparison should be strict per key and independent of key order.
findings.reasoning: PHP's array == is already independent of key order. Its only looseness is numeric-string equality ('1' == '01'), and a whole catalog of numerically equal but differently spelled lines does not occur. Using === would make the check order-sensitive and so weaker.
findings.resolution_ru: Сравнение скопированного каталога должно быть строгим по ключам и не зависеть от порядка. Итог: == в PHP уже не зависит от порядка ключей, а его единственная нестрогость ('1' == '01') на целом каталоге не встречается; === сделал бы проверку зависимой от порядка, то есть слабее.

findings.claim: A PHP catalog with a syntax error aborts the whole inspection instead of failing only that locale.
findings.reasoning: Catalogs are committed release code, linted and parity-checked in CI. A ParseError in lang/{locale}/*.php would also break Laravel's translator for that locale everywhere. Failing loudly on the Languages page is acceptable for a broken release.
findings.resolution_ru: Каталог PHP с синтаксической ошибкой обрывает всю проверку, а не только эту локаль. Итог: каталоги это код релиза, проверяемый в CI, а ParseError и так сломает переводчик Laravel для этой локали везде; громкое падение на странице Languages приемлемо для сломанного релиза.

findings.claim: flatten() drops empty arrays, so an extra empty-array key in a translation is not reported.
findings.reasoning: True (:241-245), but an empty array under a key English does not have is never read by anything. A key English has as a string still shows up as missing in the translation. No user-visible effect.
findings.resolution_ru: flatten() отбрасывает пустые массивы, лишний ключ с пустым массивом в переводе не отмечается. Итог: верно, но пустой массив под ключом, которого нет в английском, никто не читает, а ключ, который в английском строка, всё равно покажется отсутствующим; видимого эффекта нет.

findings.claim: path() does not recognise Windows drive-letter absolute paths.
findings.reasoning: The app runs on Linux hosts (infrastructure/scripts) and macOS development, and the persona files live in the repository and are passed relative to the root. Windows is not a supported platform.
findings.resolution_ru: path() не распознаёт абсолютные пути Windows с буквой диска. Итог: приложение работает на Linux и разрабатывается на macOS, файлы персон лежат в репозитории и передаются относительно корня; Windows не поддерживается.

findings.claim: A comment, and the operator warning, carry release bookkeeping ('Phase 6B') instead of describing the logging policy.
findings.reasoning: CLAUDE.md forbids phase numbers in comments and operator output outside the listed exceptions, and app/ is not one of them. ObservabilityHealthCommand.php:214 (docblock) and :226 (the warn() text an operator reads) say 'Phase 6B'. ReleaseBookkeepingTest scans only infrastructure, CI and architecture tests, so it does not catch these. The same token appears in ObservabilityServiceProvider.php:23 and NightwatchPrivacy.php:151.
findings.scenario: An operator running rateguru:observability:health on a target with Nightwatch log ingestion sees 'Phase 6B deliberately leaves this off', which tells them nothing about why. The comment ages the same way.

findings.claim: forgetRunning() compares and deletes the running pointer non-atomically, so cleanup can delete a newer batch's pointer.
findings.reasoning: Same class as 03-28 (SKIP; forgetActive). It needs StartProjectTranslationGenerationAction's whole locked sequence (several cache round trips: read the pointer, read the batch, forget, putMany, two puts; StartProjectTranslationGenerationAction.php:88-107) to fit between one Redis GET and the next DEL inside persist() (:577). The worst case is a second batch for the same language.
findings.resolution_ru: forgetRunning() сравнивает и удаляет указатель не атомарно и может стереть указатель нового пакета. Итог: как в 03-28, для этого весь заблокированный Start должен уместиться между одним GET и DEL в Redis; худший случай это второй пакет для того же языка.

findings.claim: Admission under the language lock needs fencing, so that a holder whose 15 s lease expired cannot publish or dispatch.
findings.reasoning: Same class as 10-31 (SKIP). The language lock is held only for a few cache operations (:468-471, StartProjectTranslationGenerationAction.php:88-107). Losing it requires a stall of more than 15 s inside that critical section while a second Start runs. Fencing tokens would cost far more than this residual duplicate-batch risk.
findings.resolution_ru: Допуск под блокировкой языка требует fencing против держателя с истёкшей 15-секундной арендой. Итог: как в 10-31, блокировка держится несколько операций кеша, потерять её можно лишь при простое дольше 15 с во время второго Start; fencing token дороже риска лишнего пакета.

findings.claim: putMany()/put() return values are ignored, so a false (failed) write is treated as success.
findings.reasoning: Store outages surface as exceptions, which guard() converts to CannotGenerateTranslationsException. A silent false from SETEX needs a Redis maxmemory limit with noeviction, and none is configured in infrastructure/. Hardening for a configuration that does not exist.
findings.resolution_ru: Результаты putMany()/put() игнорируются, false принимается за успех. Итог: сбои хранилища приходят исключениями, которые guard() превращает в CannotGenerateTranslationsException, а тихий false требует maxmemory с noeviction, чего в infrastructure/ нет; не меняем.

findings.claim: An interactive suggestion should carry a fingerprint of the English source and be refused when that source changed.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 03-31 (SKIP). An interactive suggestion is documented as an ordinary draft that becomes content only through UpdateProjectTranslationAction 'like any other draft', and the ordinary save is deliberately unguarded (translation-engine.md 'Save stays explicit'). Guarding it would mean stale-tab protection for every manual draft, which is a feature.
findings.resolution_ru: Интерактивная подсказка должна нести отпечаток английского источника. Итог: как и 03-31, по документации подсказка это обычный черновик, сохраняемый через UpdateProjectTranslationAction, а обычное сохранение намеренно не защищено; такая защита для всех черновиков это фича.

findings.claim: Nightwatch log-ingestion detection always reads the `stack` channel's list instead of the active logging.default channel's graph.
findings.reasoning: The docblock records the design assumption that the stack is the per-target switch (:209-216), and LOG_CHANNEL defaults to stack (config/logging.php:21). The only possible error that env alone can produce is a false ENABLED warning when LOG_CHANNEL is not stack but LOG_STACK lists nightwatch. A missed detection would need a code change to config/logging.php. Diagnostic accuracy only.
findings.resolution_ru: Обнаружение Nightwatch читает канал stack, а не активный logging.default. Итог: докблок фиксирует, что stack это переключатель на окружение, LOG_CHANNEL по умолчанию stack; через env возможно лишь ложное ENABLED, а пропуск требует правки config/logging.php. Это точность диагностики.

findings.claim: Expanded IPv6 loopback spellings (0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1) are not recognised as loopback.
findings.reasoning: The result is a false 'NOT LOOPBACK' warning in a diagnostic; it never hides an exposed listener. The configured value is ::1 or 127.0.0.1. Negligible.
findings.resolution_ru: Развёрнутые записи IPv6 loopback (0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1) не считаются loopback. Итог: результат это ложное предупреждение 'NOT LOOPBACK' в диагностике, открытый слушатель оно не прячет, а в конфиге стоит ::1 или 127.0.0.1; эффект пренебрежимый.

findings.claim: The PR description lacks the Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review and Mobile QA sections.
findings.reasoning: Bookkeeping for the audit PR, not a code finding (same as 01-37, 02-88, 03-35 and later batches).
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов Verification, Architecture Review, Visual Review и Mobile QA. Итог: это оформление аудиторского PR, а не находка в коде, как и в 01-37, 02-88, 03-35 и следующих пакетах.

findings.claim: CommentStatus (visible|hidden) cannot hydrate rows created with the comments.status schema default 'published'.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause as 06-09 (MINOR): database/migrations/2026_05_14_183711_create_comments_table.php:16 still declares string('status')->default('published') and no later migration changes it, while the enum has only Visible/Hidden. Every current writer (AddCommentAction, factories, seeders) sets status explicitly, so no defaulted rows exist today; the risk is any future insert that omits status. Verdict kept consistent with 06-09.
findings.scenario: As 06-09: a raw insert or import that relies on the default creates a 'published' comment; loading it throws ValueError on the post page and it is excluded from every Visible/Hidden query.

findings.claim: invalidUrl() embeds the full raw URL in the exception message, so query tokens or other URL contents reach logs/Sentry wherever the exception is reported.
findings.reasoning: invalidUrl() returns "The provided URL is not valid: '{$url}'." (:26-29), while every sibling factory that also receives $url deliberately omits it (privateAddress :21-24, userinfoForbidden :31-34, ambiguousHost, dnsResolutionFailed), and UrlImportValidator::logUnsafeBlocked logs only source_host (UrlImportValidator.php:270-283). It is thrown for control characters, unparsable URLs, empty or malformed hosts (UrlImportValidator.php:57,69,102,115,122) and for an unresolvable redirect Location (SafeImportHttpClient.php:83). The preview paths catch it silently (ImportUrlForm.php:53, EditsStudioPlan.php:709), but the image-download paths catch Throwable and report() it (UploadPostForm.php:94-95, EditsStudioPlan.php:357-358), sending the message to Sentry, laravel.log and Nightwatch, whose redactException does not touch URLs. docs/observability/observability-foundation.md:148 lists 'Full URLs with secrets in query string' under What NOT to Log.
findings.scenario: A remote image host answers the Studio photo import with a 302 whose Location is malformed but carries a share token; resolveRedirectUrl throws invalidUrl($location), EditsStudioPlan reports it, and the full Location with the token lands in Sentry and the error log.

findings.claim: sanitizeUrl() redacts only top-level query keys containing token/key/auth/password/secret, so signed-URL credentials (X-Amz-Signature, sig, hm) and nested keys (a[token]) survive into exception messages.
findings.reasoning: sanitizeUrl (:80-105) parse_str()s the query and redacts a key only if its lower-cased name contains one of five substrings (:90-98), checking top-level keys only. Running requestFailed() on real shapes confirms the full AWS presigned query (X-Amz-Credential/X-Amz-Signature), an Azure SAS 'sig', a Discord 'hm' HMAC and 'a[token]=...' are all kept verbatim. These messages are reported on the download paths (UploadPostForm.php:94-95, EditsStudioPlan.php:357-358 report() every Throwable from StoreImportedImageAction::download -> SafeImportHttpClient). The class docblock (:30-41) and NightwatchPrivacy::redactOutgoingRequest (NightwatchPrivacy.php:160-178, which drops the whole query because names and values are arbitrary third-party strings such as presigned-URL credentials) show the intent that query secrets never reach observability; observability-foundation.md:148 says the same. Both bot findings share this root cause (a denylist of key names) and one fix.
findings.scenario: An admin pastes a 7-day S3 presigned link to a 12 MB photo into the Studio photo import; the download exceeds the byte cap, ImportFetchException::responseTooLarge() embeds the URL with X-Amz-Credential and X-Amz-Signature intact, and EditsStudioPlan report()s it, so a still-valid bearer link to the object is stored in Sentry and laravel.log.

findings.claim: becausePostStatusIsInvalid() has no isStatusInvalid() predicate, so Content Studio cannot classify that refusal and should map it explicitly.
findings.reasoning: The exception has exactly two reasons (:14-16), so '! isNotAllowed()' already identifies the status case. The only Studio caller is ExecuteStudioAction::createPost, which approves a post CreatePostAction just created in the same transaction, and a Persona's post is always Pending (CreatePostAction.php:98-109), so the status refusal cannot occur there; ExecuteStudioAction::failureOf mapping it to UnexpectedFailure (:981-982) is correct. Adding a predicate is API symmetry, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: У becausePostStatusIsInvalid() нет предиката isStatusInvalid(). Итог: причин у исключения две, так что '! isNotAllowed()' уже определяет статус; в Studio такой отказ невозможен, пост Persona всегда Pending, и маппинг в UnexpectedFailure верен; предикат это симметрия API, а не дефект.

findings.claim: Control characters in the contact name flow into the Reply-To display name and can produce a malformed header, losing the message.
findings.reasoning: The name is turned into a Symfony\Component\Mime\Address when the mail is built, and Address::__construct strips every control character except TAB from the name (vendor/symfony/mime/Address.php:51: preg_replace('/[\x00-\x08\x0A-\x1F\x7F]/', '', $name)). The remaining text is phrase-encoded: rendering Reply-To for the name "Evil\tName\x01\r\nBcc: x@y.z" yields 'Reply-To: Evil\t=?utf-8?Q?NameBcc=3A_x=40y=2Ez?= <a@example.com>', a valid header with no injection and no send failure.
findings.resolution_ru: Управляющие символы в имени из формы контакта попадают в Reply-To и ломают заголовок. Итог: бот ошибся, Symfony Address вырезает из имени все управляющие символы, кроме TAB, а остальное кодируется как phrase; заголовок валиден, без инъекции и без сбоя отправки.

findings.claim: The contact form accepts reply-to addresses that Symfony Mime rejects, so the queued mail fails after the visitor was told the message was sent.
findings.reasoning: The rule is ['required','string','lowercase','email','max:254'] (SubmitContactMessageRequest.php:16); Laravel's plain 'email' is egulias RFCValidation (ValidatesAttributes.php:982-1007), which accepts RFC comments. Symfony's Address (built in the queue worker from ContactMessageMail::envelope() replyTo, ContactMessageMail.php:27-29) runs its own addr-spec check and rejects them: verified 'a(comment)@example.com' passes the request rules but new Address() throws RfcComplianceException, so every ContactMessageMail job for that submission fails while SubmitContactMessageController has already reported success. The bot's tab example is wrong (RFCValidation rejects a tab in a quoted local part), but the mismatch is real. Unrelated to 01-12 (that one is the 'lowercase' rule rejecting valid input).
findings.scenario: A visitor submits /contact with email 'ann(work)@example.com'; validation passes, the page says the message was sent, and each administrator's queued ContactMessageMail fails with RfcComplianceException until it lands in failed_jobs, so no administrator receives it.

findings.claim: The color() docblock says the diagnostics page's health badge uses it, but MediaDiagnosticsPage::healthBadge() has its own mapping (Unknown -> 'neutral').
findings.reasoning: True: MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:695-702 maps the cases itself, with labels and a dot flag color() does not provide, and uses the page's own 'neutral' tone. It is an inaccurate docblock; nothing renders wrongly.
findings.resolution_ru: Докблок color() говорит, что его использует бейдж здоровья на странице диагностики, хотя там своё сопоставление. Итог: верно, MediaDiagnosticsPage::healthBadge() сопоставляет статусы сам; это неточный докблок, ничего неправильно не отображается.

findings.claim: The '30 days' and '2038' wording in two messages is hardcoded and could drift from the limit constants.
findings.reasoning: The values currently match: StudioDiscussionValidationRules::LATEST_OFFSET_SECONDS = 2_592_000 (30 days, StudioDiscussionValidationRules.php:62) and StudioPlanValidationRules::LATEST_PUBLISH_AT = '2038-01-18 23:59:59' (StudioPlanValidationRules.php:41); the same '2038' wording is hardcoded in those rule classes too (:86, :174, :199). Speculative future drift, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Формулировки '30 days' и '2038' в двух сообщениях зашиты и могут разойтись с константами. Итог: сейчас значения совпадают с LATEST_OFFSET_SECONDS и LATEST_PUBLISH_AT, а та же формулировка '2038' зашита и в самих классах правил; это гипотетическое расхождение в будущем, не дефект.

findings.claim: normalizedIds() converts numeric strings before returning a mixed list, contrary to its docblock ('left as it came').
findings.reasoning: Accurate observation about the docblock: ['5','abc'] comes back as [5,'abc'] (:138-147). Behaviourally harmless: the list is then validated with 'tagIds.*' / 'authorAnswerOptionIds.*' => ['integer:strict', ...] (StudioPlanValidationRules.php:59,61), which still refuses 'abc' at the same index. Docstring precision only.
findings.resolution_ru: normalizedIds() приводит числовые строки, хотя докблок говорит 'left as it came'. Итог: про докблок верно, но поведение безвредно: список затем проверяется правилом integer:strict, которое всё равно отклоняет 'abc' на том же индексе; это только точность докблока.

findings.claim: becauseRateLimited() should require a non-null int retryAfterSeconds.
findings.reasoning: The single caller always passes a value (AddCommentAction.php:67, from ActionRateLimiter's RateLimiter::availableIn), and the consumer already tolerates null (ExecuteStudioAction.php:182 '?? 60'). Tightening the signature is type hygiene with no behavioural effect.
findings.resolution_ru: becauseRateLimited() должен требовать ненулевой int retryAfterSeconds. Итог: единственный вызов всегда передаёт значение, а потребитель уже переносит null через '?? 60'; ужесточение сигнатуры это гигиена типов без влияния на поведение.

findings.claim: via() should recheck, synchronized with unfollow/preference writes, that the follower still follows the author and wants notifications.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause and verdict as 02-34 (SKIP): eligibility is read per 500-row chunk in NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction (:56-66) seconds before LifecycleSafeDatabaseNotifier writes; a follower who unfollows or opts out inside that window getting one last in-app notification is an accepted edge, and serializing unfollow/preference writes against the sender is out of proportion.
findings.resolution_ru: via() должен перепроверять, что подписчик всё ещё подписан и хочет уведомления. Итог: как и 02-34, право читается по чанку из 500 строк за секунды до записи, последнее уведомление отписавшемуся в этом окне это принятый крайний случай, а сериализовать отписку с отправкой несоразмерно.

findings.claim: Each follower's notification should recheck post visibility under the same lock as post deletion so none is written for a just-removed post.
findings.reasoning: Same root cause and verdict as 02-36 (SKIP): the job and action check the post is Published before sending (NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostAction.php:44-46); a post hidden during the seconds a send runs yields a few notifications whose link now 404s, which is harmless, and a per-recipient post lock would serialize the send against moderation.
findings.resolution_ru: Уведомление подписчику должно перепроверять видимость поста под блокировкой удаления. Итог: как и 02-36, перед отправкой проверяется, что пост Published; пост, скрытый за секунды рассылки, даст пару безвредных ссылок на 404, а блокировка на получателя сериализует рассылку.

findings.claim: The /up dependency probes have no short end-to-end deadline, so a hung database or cache can hold a worker.
findings.reasoning: DiagnoseHealthDependencies (:28-41) runs 'select 1' and one cache get, the same calls every page makes.
