A hung dependency blocks /up exactly as long as it blocks any request, bounded by PHP-FPM's request_terminate_timeout = 120s (infrastructure/config/php-fpm/rateguru-production.conf:16), and the deploy/restore/recovery health-check caller already gives up after curl --max-time 5 (infrastructure/scripts/health-check:53), which correctly reads as unhealthy. Connection timeouts are a config/database.php concern for all traffic, not a probe defect; PHP has no cheap per-call deadline to add here.
findings.resolution_ru: У проверок зависимостей /up нет короткого дедлайна, зависшая БД или кеш держит воркер. Итог: /up делает 'select 1' и один get кеша, как любая страница, зависание ограничено request_terminate_timeout 120s, а health-check сдаётся через curl --max-time 5 и видит нездоровье.

findings.claim: In queue workers the deployment facts (release, commit, target) are replaced by the values dehydrated into the job payload, so a job runs under the dispatcher's release rather than the worker's.
findings.reasoning: shareDeploymentContext() adds the facts once at boot (:62-73). Laravel's ContextServiceProvider rehydrates every job on JobProcessing (vendor ContextServiceProvider.php:53-55) with Repository::hydrate(), which does flush()->add($payloadData) (Repository.php:691-693); the worker also forgets scoped instances, including the Context repository, before each job (QueueServiceProvider.php:267). So inside a worker the release/commit come only from the payload. The provider docblock (:47-57) and external-integrations.md:35-36 state the intent that release identity reflects what is running; ObservabilityContextTest.php:61-97 pins the round trip but with identical dispatcher/worker config, so it does not distinguish. Sentry's native release and Nightwatch's native deploy come from config and are unaffected; log records' extra and Nightwatch's Context blob are.
findings.scenario: A fix is deployed as release B and the operator runs queue:retry for jobs that failed under release A (or jobs queued just before the deploy run after it); their log lines and Nightwatch context say release A / commit A while the code executing is B, misleading deploy/rollback correlation.

findings.claim: Nightwatch query records are not redacted, so values written as SQL literals instead of bindings would be transmitted.
findings.reasoning: Leaving query records unredacted is a documented decision (:117-123): Nightwatch receives the parameterized QueryExecuted::$sql and the bindings are not part of the record, which tests/Feature/Observability/NightwatchIngestPrivacyTest.php:50 verifies against the bytes about to be transmitted. No application query inlines a runtime value. Every whereRaw/orWhereRaw/orderByRaw in app/ uses '?' bindings or constant SQL (e.g. FeedQuery.php:77-78, ModerationUsersQuery.php:123-125, StudioActionsQuery.php:150-156), and nothing uses whereIntegerInRaw or DB::statement with interpolation. The bot names no query that would leak.
findings.resolution_ru: Записи запросов в Nightwatch не маскируются, литералы в SQL уйдут наружу. Итог: бот ошибся, решение задокументировано: Nightwatch получает параметризованный SQL без bindings, это проверяет тест, а запросы приложения не вставляют значения в SQL; утекающий запрос бот не назвал.

findings.claim: The Sentry scope user set on Authenticated is never cleared on Logout, so later errors in the same request keep the user ID.
findings.reasoning: Under PHP-FPM, Sentry hub/scope state does not outlive the request, and no queue job authenticates a user (Auth::login appears only in the HTTP auth actions), so the ID cannot leak into another request or job. Within a logout request (LogoutUserAction, EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned.php:30, DeleteUserAccountAction.php:35), an error raised after logout is still an error of the request that user made, so attributing it to their internal ID is accurate. Only the ID is ever attached (:153-162). No practical effect.
findings.resolution_ru: Пользователь в scope Sentry не сбрасывается при Logout. Итог: в PHP-FPM состояние Sentry не переживает запрос, job-ы пользователя не аутентифицируют, а ошибка после выхода всё равно относится к запросу этого пользователя; прикрепляется только внутренний ID, практического эффекта нет.

findings.claim: The PR description is missing template sections and test/review results.
findings.reasoning: PR-description check on the review-only audit PR, not a code finding.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR не хватает разделов шаблона и результатов тестов и ревью. Итог: это проверка описания аудиторского PR только для ревью, а не находка в коде.

findings.claim: BinaryChoice accepts any number of options but always renders a two-column grid, so one or three options silently produce a wrong control.
findings.reasoning: True that nothing checks count($options) (BinaryChoice.php:18) while the view hard-codes grid-cols-2 (resources/views/components/ui/binary-choice.blade.php:4). But the component has no production caller: its only uses are the dev UI kit (resources/views/dev/ui-kit.blade.php:49,251; dev/partials/platerate-post-card.blade.php:31), served only behind EnsureDevEnvironment (routes/web.php:43-67), and none passes options. Speculative hardening of a design-kit component.
findings.resolution_ru: BinaryChoice принимает любое число вариантов, но всегда рисует сетку в две колонки. Итог: верно, но у компонента нет продакшен-использования: он есть только в dev UI kit за EnsureDevEnvironment, и options там никто не передаёт; это умозрительное укрепление компонента дизайн-кита.

findings.claim: The $name prop does not make BinaryChoice a form control: it sits on type="button" elements and the selection lives only in Alpine state, so a form submits no value.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true (binary-choice.blade.php:11-19: type="button" buttons, state in x-data, change announced via a choice-changed event). But no form anywhere uses the component; its only callers are the dev-only UI kit pages (routes/web.php:67, EnsureDevEnvironment), and the event is its integration point. Nothing is lost today; making it a form control is a feature for a future caller.
findings.resolution_ru: $name не делает BinaryChoice полем формы: кнопки type="button", выбор живёт только в Alpine. Итог: механически верно, но ни одна форма компонент не использует, он есть только на dev-страницах UI kit, а точка интеграции это событие choice-changed; сделать его полем формы это фича.

findings.claim: Every feed card builds share metadata eagerly, and forPost() does per-image storage existence checks, adding dozens of filesystem or remote-storage calls to a feed render.
findings.reasoning: True that post-card.blade.php:210-213 renders <x-sharing.share-buttons> inside the share modal for every card when show_share_buttons is on (default true, ProjectSettingsManager.php:38), and that forPost() calls PostImagePresenter::openGraph() and shareUrl(), each doing MediaStorage::exists() on the eager-loaded variants (PostImagePresenter.php:242-272,120-142,315-325) - about two checks per card, 12 cards per page (FeedQuery default_per_page). But production and staging use the local 'public' disk (infrastructure/templates/environment/production.env.example:30, docs/architecture/media.md:176-178 'no S3 deployment'), where exists() is a stat call; the remote-storage cost is hypothetical. Deferring the share panel to open time is a refactor whose cost exceeds today's value; revisit if media moves to object storage.
findings.resolution_ru: Каждая карточка ленты заранее строит данные шаринга, forPost() проверяет файлы изображений. Итог: верно, около двух проверок на карточку, но продакшен и staging используют локальный диск public, где exists() это stat; переделка дороже пользы до перехода на объектное хранилище.

findings.claim: max:100 only covers a typed slug; a blank slug is derived from the name with no length check, and transliteration can make it longer than 100 characters.
findings.reasoning: ManageTags.php:131 applies 'max:100' to draftSlug, which is empty when the admin clears the generated slug; UniqueEffectiveTagSlug.php:32 then computes the effective slug from the name and checks only uniqueness, and CreateTagAction::slug (:35-38) / UpdateTagAction (:23-26) save it unchecked. The name allows 80 characters (ProjectTranslationCatalog.php:76-77), and Str::slug expands some characters up to 3x (measured: 80 x 'щ' -> 240 chars, 80 x '@' -> 239, 80 x 'ß' -> 160), so a slug of 101-240 chars is saved (still within varchar(255), tags migration :17). Reachability is narrow: on create the drawer pre-fills draftSlug from the name (EditsTaxonomyInDrawer.php:52-57), so the max:100 error shows unless the admin blanks the slug field; realistic names barely expand (a 75-char Russian phrase -> 76).
findings.scenario: A moderator creates a tag, clears the generated slug field and saves a long name heavy in expanding characters; the tag is saved with a 120-character slug. Later, renaming that tag with the slug locked fails with 'Keep the slug to 100 characters or fewer.' (save() re-validates draftSlug = $tag->slug, ManageTags.php:117-135) until the slug is unlocked and shortened.

findings.claim: canReport ignores the viewer's lifecycle capability, so Limited, Banned and Shadowbanned users see a comment Report action that always fails.
findings.reasoning: CommentItem.php:39 sets canReport from exists + logged in + not own comment only, so the comment menu (comment-item.blade.php:50,70-79) offers Report to any signed-in user. UserStatus::canReport() is Active-only (UserStatus.php:49-52; docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:222) and ReportContentAction refuses everyone else (:42-44), so submit ends in the 'User is not allowed to report content.' error inside the modal (ReportModal.php:49-52). No authorization gap, since the action enforces it, but the post menus hide Report through PostPolicy::report (PostPolicy.php:67-71; PostFeed.php:73, PostShow.php:94, PostDrawer.php:124), so comments are inconsistent. No doc or test asks for the action to stay visible; CommentItemComponentTest only covers an Active viewer. ProfilePage::getCanSeeReportUserPlaceholderProperty (ProfilePage.php:114-118) has the same gap for user reports.
findings.scenario: A Limited member opens a comment's '...' menu, picks Report, chooses a reason and submits; the modal answers 'User is not allowed to report content.' On comments where the member has no delete/hide rights, the whole menu exists only for this dead action.

findings.claim: A known preset whose settings or feature_flags is missing or not an array is reported as 'Unknown project preset' instead of a configuration error.
findings.reasoning: True: ApplyProjectPresetAction.php:47-49 throws UnknownProjectPresetException::for() for a malformed known preset, so SetupProjectPresetCommand prints 'Unknown project preset: [key].' and fails (:96-99). But presets are repository config read only by the rateguru:setup CLI, the shipped presets are pinned by tests/Feature/Support/Settings/ProjectPresetsConfigTest.php, and nothing is applied, so the only effect is a misleading message to an operator who hand-broke config. Same class as 02-78/02-80 (SKIP, operator-config validation).
findings.resolution_ru: Сломанный известный пресет сообщается как 'Unknown project preset', а не как ошибка конфигурации. Итог: верно, но пресеты читает только CLI rateguru:setup, поставляемые закреплены тестом, и последствие лишь неточное сообщение оператору, который сам сломал конфиг.

findings.claim: A plan whose photo has been removed is refused with a message about incomplete analysis instead of a missing-photo error telling the administrator to reload and add a photo.
findings.reasoning: The bot names the NotConfigured factory, but that one is only thrown when the generator is unconfigured (RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction.php:75-77). The real gap is at :95-97: when the locked plan's image_asset_id is null it throws becauseAnalysisIsMissing() before the mismatch check at :99, so a photo removed after the editor rendered (RemoveStudioPlanImageAction.php:55) produces the toast 'Text suggestions will be available when photo analysis is complete.' (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard.php:125-128), which waiting never resolves. The card re-renders into its 'changed' warning with Reload (card :188, view :72-78), so the wrong message is transient. RequestStudioImageAnalysisAction gives a removed photo its own ImageMissing reason (:91-93), and the only no-photo test asserts just the exception class (RequestStudioPostTextGenerationActionTest.php:152-157).
findings.scenario: Admin A has the editor open on the Post step; admin B removes the plan's photo. A clicks Generate suggestions: nothing is sent, but the toast says suggestions will come once analysis completes, while the card underneath asks to reload because the photo changed.

findings.claim: The slug existence check races with concurrent saves; the loser should get a draftSlug validation error instead of a raw unique-constraint exception.
findings.reasoning: Same as 03-04 and 09-36 (SKIP): UniqueEffectiveTagSlug.php:44-50 checks before Create/UpdateTagAction write, and tags.slug is unique (create_tags_table.php:17). Losing needs two staff members saving the same new slug within milliseconds; the unique index keeps the data correct and the only effect is an error instead of a field message.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка уникальности slug тега гонится с параллельным сохранением. Итог: верно в теории, но нужны два сотрудника с одним новым slug в пределах миллисекунд; уникальный индекс tags.slug сохраняет данные, последствие лишь ошибка вместо сообщения у поля.

findings.claim: The PR description is missing template sections and test/review results.
findings.reasoning: PR-description check on the review-only audit PR, not a code finding (same as 01-37 and later batches).
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов шаблона и результатов тестов. Итог: это замечание к описанию служебного audit PR, а не к коду, не меняем.

findings.claim: Docstring coverage is below the configured threshold.
findings.reasoning: Documentation-coverage metric; no behavioural defect (same as 01-38).
findings.resolution_ru: Покрытие docstring ниже порога. Итог: это метрика документации, дефекта поведения нет.

findings.claim: profile_website_url is rendered into href without a scheme check, so a stored javascript: URL would run script on click.
findings.reasoning: Already triaged as 05-20: the only write path validates with Laravel's 'url' rule, whose scheme list does not contain javascript/vbscript, and the value is Blade-escaped with rel=noopener noreferrer. In addition, <x-profile.header> has no production caller (only tests/Feature/Livewire/ProfileHeaderComponentTest.php); the public profile renders its own markup in livewire/profile/profile-page.blade.php:28-37.
findings.resolution_ru: profile_website_url попадает в href без проверки схемы, javascript: URL выполнит скрипт. Итог: бот ошибся: единственный путь записи валидирует правилом url без javascript/vbscript, значение экранируется, а у x-profile.header нет продакшн вызова, только тест.

findings.claim: The profile header prints '@'.username instead of public_username, exposing a tombstone's deleted_* handle.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true for the component, but <x-profile.header> is rendered only by ProfileHeaderComponentTest; no view uses it. The real profile page is ProfilePage, which 404s for tombstones (ProfilePage.php:39-44, withoutTombstoned), so no deleted_* handle can reach a public page. Dead-component hygiene, not a leak.
findings.resolution_ru: Шапка профиля выводит username вместо public_username и раскрывает deleted_* handle. Итог: формально так, но x-profile.header рендерится только в тесте, а настоящая ProfilePage отдаёт 404 для tombstone. Утечки нет, это гигиена мёртвого компонента.

findings.claim: The livewire:navigated handler writes the server-rendered preference into localStorage, and the bootstrap then lets localStorage override the account/default preference, so later server-side changes never apply in that browser.
findings.reasoning: app.js:17-23 calls rgSetTheme(stored || dataset.themePreference), and rgSetTheme always does localStorage.setItem (app.js:12). Livewire fires livewire:navigated on the initial load too (navigate plugin's setTimeout -> alpine:navigated -> livewire:navigated in livewire.esm.js), so every browser stores the first preference it is served even if the visitor never touched the switcher; theme-bootstrap.js:11 and app.js:21 then prefer that stored value forever. docs/design/themes.md:23-35 says an authenticated user's preference comes from users.theme_preference and a guest's localStorage holds the guest's own choice before ProjectSettings.default_theme. The read-precedence half is the same root cause as 10-17 (MINOR); one fix should cover both.
findings.scenario: An administrator changes the project default theme from dark to light; every guest who has visited before keeps dark, because their first page load copied 'dark' into localStorage. Likewise a user who sets Light on their phone keeps seeing Dark on their laptop, and after logout a guest in that browser inherits the account's theme.

findings.claim: The prefers-color-scheme listener is registered only when the page first loads with System, so choosing System later does not follow OS theme changes.
findings.reasoning: theme-bootstrap.js:25-33 adds the matchMedia change listener only inside `if (preference === 'system')` at first load; rgSetTheme('system') (app.js:6-13) resolves the current OS scheme once and registers nothing, and the inline head script is not re-run on wire:navigate. docs/design/themes.md:82 states the script listens to prefers-color-scheme changes 'when in system mode'.
findings.scenario: A user on Light switches to System in the evening; when the OS flips to dark mode at sunset the open page stays light until the next navigation or reload.

findings.claim: The aria-modal drawer neither moves focus in, traps Tab, nor restores focus on close.
findings.reasoning: True of x-ui.drawer, but its only caller is resources/views/dev/ui-kit.blade.php:247, served only behind EnsureDevEnvironment (routes/web.php:43-67). The production post drawer is a separate implementation (livewire/feed/post-drawer.blade.php:49-88) that focuses the panel, makes it inert when closed and returns focus to the opener. Same handling as 13-01/13-02 for dev-kit components.
findings.resolution_ru: Drawer с aria-modal не переносит, не удерживает и не возвращает фокус. Итог: верно для x-ui.drawer, но он используется только в dev UI kit за EnsureDevEnvironment; продакшн drawer поста реализован отдельно и с фокусом работает правильно.

findings.claim: The drawer does not lock and restore document scroll on open/close.
findings.reasoning: Dev-kit-only component (only caller dev/ui-kit.blade.php:247 behind EnsureDevEnvironment). The production post drawer already locks scroll with the overflow-hidden class on <html> and releases it on every close path (post-drawer.blade.php:51,72,86).
findings.resolution_ru: Drawer не блокирует и не восстанавливает прокрутку страницы. Итог: компонент только для dev UI kit; продакшн drawer поста уже блокирует прокрутку через overflow-hidden на html и снимает её при любом закрытии.

findings.claim: side="left" uses a horizontal off-screen transform although mobile renders a bottom sheet.
findings.reasoning: No caller passes side="left"; the component's only use is the dev UI kit (dev/ui-kit.blade.php:247, default side). Speculative fix for an unused variant of a dev-only component.
findings.resolution_ru: side="left" использует горизонтальный сдвиг, хотя на мобильных это нижняя панель. Итог: side="left" никто не передаёт, компонент используется только в dev UI kit; править неиспользуемый вариант не нужно.

findings.claim: x-ui.skeleton emits width/height as class names, but the post drawer passes CSS values (16rem, 70%, 45%), so its loading skeleton collapses and loses its widths.
findings.reasoning: skeleton.blade.php:33-39 puts $width/$height straight into the class list, and the component's contract is Tailwind classes (SkeletonComponentTest.php:30-38 uses w-32/h-12; post-feed and comments-section pass w-3/4, h-48). post-drawer-content.blade.php:4-6 passes height="16rem" and width="70%"/"45%", producing the non-existent classes '16rem' and '70%': the block keeps no height (an empty bordered div, about 2px tall) and the lines fall back to full block width.
findings.scenario: While the drawer loads a post (wire:loading at post-drawer-content.blade.php:3), the placeholder shows a 2px line and two full-width bars instead of an image-sized block and two shorter lines.

findings.claim: animate-pulse runs even when the user prefers reduced motion.
findings.reasoning: The pulse is an opacity animation, not movement, and SkeletonComponentTest.php:5-15 pins 'animate-pulse' as the intended treatment; docs/design/phase-37-ui-polish-review.md (RG-615) deliberately gated only the transitions with motion-safe. Accessibility polish rather than a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: animate-pulse работает и при включённом reduced motion. Итог: это анимация прозрачности, а не движения; SkeletonComponentTest закрепляет её намеренно, а motion-safe по решению ревью UI применили только к переходам. Доработка доступности, не дефект.

findings.claim: White text on bg-rg-danger is about 3.8:1 in the dark theme, below WCAG AA for 13px text.
findings.reasoning: danger-button.blade.php:1 uses text-white on bg-rg-danger; in the dark theme --rg-danger is #ef4444 (theme.css:107), which gives 3.76:1 against white, under the 4.5:1 AA minimum for 13px semibold text (the light theme uses #dc2626, theme.css:153, 4.83:1, which passes). The button is the account-deletion action on the profile page (profile/partials/delete-user-form.blade.php:18). The project checks AA contrast for admin tokens (tests/Feature/Admin/AdminThemeTest.php:162-172) and lists 'Text contrast is acceptable' in docs/design/ui-review-checklist.md:24.
findings.scenario: A low-vision user on the default dark theme cannot comfortably read 'Delete account' on its red button.

findings.claim: When a fourth toast evicts the oldest one while focus is inside it, `focused` stays true and the remaining toasts never auto-dismiss.
findings.reasoning: push() drops the oldest toast (toast-stack.blade.php:57-58) without re-checking focus; per spec, removing the focused element fires no focusout, so the focusout handler (:109) never clears `focused`, and start() is skipped while focused (:61-63, :92-93). remove() already handles exactly this case by reconciling after the next tick (:77-85), so the eviction path is an inconsistency with the component's own design.
findings.scenario: An administrator tabs to the Undo button of the oldest of three toasts; a fourth toast arrives and evicts it. Focus falls to <body>, but the stack still counts as focused, so the three remaining toasts stay on screen until each is dismissed by hand.

findings.claim: Two identical messages arriving within the 50 ms delayed write are announced once.
findings.reasoning: announce() clears the region and writes after 50 ms (toast-stack.blade.php:65-72), which already makes the same message twice in a row heard twice in the normal case. Only two identical toasts raised within 50 ms coalesce into one announcement, which is arguably the desired de-duplication. No practical defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Два одинаковых сообщения за 50 мс озвучиваются один раз. Итог: announce() очищает область и пишет через 50 мс, так что повтор обычно озвучивается дважды; склеиваются только тосты в пределах 50 мс, что скорее полезная дедупликация. Дефекта нет.

findings.claim: A blank `label` is not rejected, leaving the icon-only button without an accessible name.
findings.reasoning: Every caller passes a literal, non-empty label (for example pagination.blade.php:44,74 'Previous page'/'Next page', date-time-field.blade.php:595-601). Fail-fast validation would be hardening against a caller mistake that does not exist.
findings.resolution_ru: Пустой label не отклоняется, и кнопка-иконка остаётся без доступного имени. Итог: все вызовы передают непустой литерал; проверка защищала бы от ошибки вызывающего, которой нет.

findings.claim: Clicking an item inside the dropdown does not close it.
findings.reasoning: x-ui.dropdown's only caller is resources/views/dev/ui-kit.blade.php (dev route behind EnsureDevEnvironment); production menus are written inline with their own close handlers (e.g. comment-item.blade.php:87,99, layouts/app.blade.php:94-105).
findings.resolution_ru: Клик по пункту dropdown не закрывает меню. Итог: x-ui.dropdown используется только в dev UI kit за EnsureDevEnvironment; продакшн меню написаны inline со своими обработчиками закрытия.

findings.claim: The dropdown trigger exposes no aria-haspopup/aria-expanded.
findings.reasoning: Dev-kit-only component (sole caller dev/ui-kit.blade.php). Production menu triggers set these attributes themselves (layouts/app.blade.php:104-105, comment-item.blade.php:55-56).
findings.resolution_ru: Триггер dropdown без aria-haspopup/aria-expanded. Итог: компонент только для dev UI kit; продакшн триггеры меню выставляют эти атрибуты сами.

findings.claim: The padding prop does not reliably override the variant's padding, because both utilities are emitted.
findings.reasoning: True in principle (card.blade.php:26-34 emits $variantClass with p-4/p-5 plus $paddingClass), but no production caller passes `padding`: post-card.blade.php:3, post-feed.blade.php:3, pages/contact.blade.php:19 and pages/static.blade.php:19 pass only variant/class. A latent API wart.
findings.resolution_ru: Проп padding не перебивает padding варианта, выводятся оба класса. Итог: верно в теории, но ни один продакшн вызов не передаёт padding, только variant/class. Это скрытый недочёт API.

findings.claim: After voting in a two-option group, the results view never shows which option the user chose; option A is always highlighted.
findings.reasoning: The binary branch (rating-options.blade.php:49-73) always colours option A with text-rg-good and B with text-rg-text2, whatever $selectedOptionId is, and adds no selected marker, while the multi-option branch highlights the chosen option (:79-91). docs/rating/configurable-voting.md:57 says RatingVoting 'displays the selected option and distribution'.
findings.scenario: A user votes for the second answer of a yes/no question; the results show the first answer in the accent colour and nothing marks their own vote, so they may think their vote went to the other side.

findings.claim: After a vote the options disappear, so users cannot change their rating.
findings.reasoning: Deliberate design: rating-options.blade.php:20-27 renders 'Vote buttons (no stats) while the user has not voted yet' and the results only afterwards, introduced by commit f2d2dc03 ('binary results display; voted-only histogram'), which replaced the earlier always-clickable options. That the action can replace a vote (configurable-voting.md:39) is a backend property, not a UI promise; re-voting from the results view is a product request.
findings.resolution_ru: После голосования варианты исчезают, оценку нельзя изменить. Итог: бот ошибся, это намеренный дизайн: кнопки до голоса, результаты после (коммит f2d2dc03). Замена голоса это свойство бэкенда, а переголосование из результатов это продуктовый запрос.

findings.claim: A disabled textarea's preset chips can still write into it and fire input.
findings.reasoning: The only caller with presets is filament/pages/moderation/reason.blade.php:14-26, which never passes disabled. A textarea disabled through a disabled fieldset (studio-plan pages) has its chip buttons disabled by the same fieldset. Latent combination with no caller.
findings.resolution_ru: Чипы-пресеты могут писать в отключённый textarea. Итог: единственный вызов с пресетами (moderation/reason) не передаёт disabled, а при отключении через fieldset чипы отключает тот же fieldset. Такого сочетания ни в одном вызове нет.

findings.claim: The counter and preset state update only on user input, so they go stale when Livewire changes the bound value from the server.
findings.reasoning: length/current are set once from the rendered value (textarea.blade.php:49-52) and afterwards only in x-on:input (:110); wire:model writes a server-side change into the textarea without an input event. The Studio plan Post step does exactly that: using an AI text suggestion sets postTitle/postDescription on the server (EditsStudioPlan.php:423-434) while the textarea with a limit counter stays rendered (studio-plan/post.blade.php:21-45).
findings.scenario: An administrator with an empty title clicks Use on a 70-character suggestion; the title fills in but the counter still reads '0 / N', and if a long suggestion went past the limit the counter would not turn red.
findings.reconsidered_because: Livewire's redraw writes the new count.
findings.resolution_ru: Счётчик и пресеты textarea обновляются только от ввода и отстают, когда значение меняет сервер. Итог: оставили как есть, перерисовка Livewire сама пишет новый счётчик.

findings.claim: wire:keydown.stop / wire:click.stop on the comment's menu wrapper and footer swallow events, so Escape never closes the actions menu or report dialog and clicking Reply leaves the menu open.
findings.reasoning: The wrapper at comment-item.blade.php:51 and the footer at :112 stop every keydown and click. The menu closes only through window/document listeners (x-on:keydown.escape.window at :21, x-on:click.outside at :67), and the comment's report dialog closes on Escape only through report-modal.blade.php:14's window listener; Alpine's .outside listens on document in the bubble phase. Unlike post-card, where the footer's stop protects the card's own Enter/click handlers, nothing above a comment listens for click or keydown (comments-section and the drawer have none), so these stops protect nothing. Note that removing them outright would let Escape also reach the drawer's window listener (post-drawer.blade.php:89).
findings.scenario: A keyboard user opens a comment's actions menu, chooses Report and starts typing the reason; Escape does nothing, so the only way out is tabbing to the close button. A mouse user with the menu open clicks Reply and the menu stays open over the comment.

findings.claim: For a tombstoned author the comment shows the stored English name instead of the localized deleted-user label.
findings.reasoning: comment-item.blade.php:29 and :40 fall back to $comment->user?->name, which for a tombstone is the constant 'Deleted user' written by AnonymizeUserAccountAction.php:66 (User::TOMBSTONE_DISPLAY_NAME). User.php:46-50 and docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:164-168 say public UI shows the reader's own translation (ui.user.deleted) through resolved_display_name, which post-card.blade.php:37,43, post-show and the drawer use. DeletedUserPresentationTest.php:43-55 passes only because it renders in English.
findings.scenario: A German reader opens a post whose commenter deleted their account: every other surface says 'Gelöschter Nutzer', but the comment author reads 'Deleted user' (and the avatar shows 'D').

findings.claim: The hard-coded mode list duplicates App\Enums\AuthModalMode and can drift.
findings.reasoning: The lists match today (AuthModalMode.php:12-14; auth-modal.js:5), and the server already normalizes modes through AuthModalMode::fromInput. Passing the cases from Blade is a drift-prevention refactor with no current defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Список режимов в auth-modal.js дублирует AuthModalMode и может разойтись. Итог: сейчас списки совпадают, а сервер нормализует режим через AuthModalMode::fromInput; передача значений из Blade это рефакторинг без текущего дефекта.

findings.claim: A modified click on the guest upload button returns early and does nothing, because a button has no browser default.
findings.reasoning: True for the button at layouts/app.blade.php:192-195 (the header links get the browser's new-tab behaviour). A shift/ctrl-click on a button doing nothing is a negligible edge with no data or flow impact; a plain click works.
findings.resolution_ru: Клик с модификатором по кнопке загрузки для гостя ничего не делает. Итог: верно для этой кнопки, но shift/ctrl-клик без эффекта пренебрежимый случай без влияния на данные и сценарий; обычный клик работает.

findings.claim: A vote error shown under a feed card is never cleared after a later successful vote.
findings.reasoning: The card sets postVoteError from post-vote-error (post-card.blade.php:9-10, shown at :236-242) and nothing resets it. PostVoting dispatches post-vote-error on refusals including the transient rate limit (PostVoting.php:72-75, CannotVoteException::becauseRateLimited) and post-voted on success (:81), and clears only its own $error (:32). Alpine state survives Livewire morphs, so the message persists.
findings.scenario: A user votes too fast and sees the rate-limit message; a few seconds later the vote succeeds, but the card still says the vote was refused.

findings.claim: Enter (and Space) on nested controls of a feed card bubbles to the card's keydown handlers, so select-post fires alongside the control's own action.
findings.reasoning: The card handles wire:keydown.enter and wire:keydown.space.prevent (post-card.blade.php:14-15). The vote rail, ratings and footer stop keydown (:18, :92, :110), but the author links (:33, :41), the category link (posts/category-link.blade.php:7-10) and the image-open button (media/post-image.blade.php:47-51) stop only click. Enter on the image button therefore dispatches select-post and then clicks the button, so the drawer and the fullscreen viewer open together; Space is default-prevented by the card, so it opens the drawer instead of the image.
findings.scenario: A keyboard user tabs to a post's image and presses Enter: the post drawer slides in while the fullscreen image dialog also opens behind it.

findings.claim: If nothing is focused when the overlay opens, opener is document.body, so the heading fallback never runs.
findings.reasoning: True (overlay.blade.php:20, :37), but when the opener was <body> focus simply returns to <body>, the same place the page was in before; the fallback exists for an opener that left the page. This mostly happens to mouse users (e.g. Safari not focusing clicked buttons). Negligible a11y polish.
findings.resolution_ru: Если при открытии overlay ничего не в фокусе, opener равен body и запасной фокус на заголовок не срабатывает. Итог: верно, но фокус возвращается на body, где страница и была; запасной вариант нужен для opener, ушедшего со страницы. Мелкая доработка доступности.

findings.claim: A caller-supplied class would be emitted as a duplicate attribute before the modal's own class, losing fixed/inset/z-50.
findings.reasoning: True for the API shape (ui/modal.blade.php:29 then :47/:49), but none of the 16 production <x-ui.modal> callers passes class (they pass title/state/size/flags/data-testid). Latent API hazard only.
findings.resolution_ru: Переданный class выводится дублирующим атрибутом и теряет fixed/inset/z-50. Итог: верно для формы API, но ни один из 16 продакшн вызовов x-ui.modal не передаёт class. Только скрытый риск API.

findings.claim: Clicking the dimmed overlay does not close the modal, because a full-size wrapper sits above the backdrop.
findings.reasoning: The backdrop (ui/modal.blade.php:55-59) is fixed inset-0 and closes on click, but the following wrapper (:61, relative, min-h-full, full width) is positioned later in the same stacking context and covers it everywhere except the root's px-4/py-6 padding; clicks on it bubble to the root's bare x-on:click.stop (:38) and nothing closes. docs/design/phase-10-upload-ui-review.md:16 records backdrop-click close as implemented; AuthModalBrowserTest.php:178-181 only clicks at x=4, inside the padding strip.
findings.scenario: A user opens the share dialog on a desktop feed and clicks on the dim area beside it to dismiss it; nothing happens unless they hit the 24px edge strip.

findings.claim: One Escape closes both the login dialog and the post drawer under it.
findings.reasoning: The auth dialog closes on Escape through a window listener (auth/modal.blade.php:43 close-on-escape -> ui/modal.blade.php:39), and the post drawer independently dispatches request-close-overlay on every window Escape (livewire/feed/post-drawer.blade.php:89, handler :67-76 with no check for an overlay on top). The drawer host starts below the 60px header (post-drawer.blade.php:7), so a guest can open Log in from the header while a post is open.
findings.scenario: A guest reading a post in the drawer clicks Log in, changes their mind and presses Escape: the login dialog closes and the post they were reading closes with it.

findings.claim: The below-header placement is measured only on open and window resize, so opening the mobile search row while the image viewer is open leaves the viewer under the taller header.
findings.reasoning: Mechanically true (ui/modal.blade.php:44-45, modal.js:28-41). It needs the user to open the header's search row over an already open image viewer; the overlap lasts only while the search row is open and disappears when it is closed. Adding a ResizeObserver for that path costs more than the transient glitch.
findings.resolution_ru: Позиция под шапкой меряется только при открытии и resize, поэтому строка поиска на мобильном перекрывает открытый просмотрщик. Итог: верно, но перекрытие временное и пропадает при закрытии поиска; ResizeObserver ради этого дороже самого сбоя.

findings.claim: The layout code finds the backdrop by data-testid, a test hook.
findings.reasoning: Style/maintainability: the attribute is rendered by ui/modal.blade.php:56 and pinned by ModalComponentTest.php:29, so it cannot silently disappear. Renaming the hook has no behavioural value.
findings.resolution_ru: Код раскладки ищет backdrop по data-testid. Итог: это вопрос стиля; атрибут рендерит ui/modal.blade.php и закрепляет ModalComponentTest, так что тихо он не пропадёт. Переименование хука поведение не меняет.

findings.claim: Minute stepping wraps within the hour instead of carrying, so '5 minutes later' at :55 goes back to :00 of the same hour.
findings.reasoning: stepMinute (date-time-field.blade.php:345-350) wraps (next + 60) % 60 and keeps this.hour, and stepHour (:342-344) likewise wraps within the day. The buttons are labelled '5 minutes later'/'5 minutes earlier' and 'Hour later'/'Hour earlier' (:595-601), which promise relative moves. The field schedules Studio publications (studio-plan/publication.blade.php:30-41).
findings.scenario: An administrator sets 10:55 and presses '5 minutes later' expecting 11:00; the draft becomes 10:00, 55 minutes earlier. At 23:00 'Hour later' gives 00:00 of the same day, 23 hours earlier.

findings.claim: maxHeight floors at 240px, so the dialog can exceed the room between the bars on a very short window.
findings.reasoning: True (date-time-field.blade.php:382-391), but it only applies when the usable height between the admin bars is under ~256px, and the 240px floor is a deliberate minimum so the grid stays usable. Edge case on an admin desktop UI.
findings.resolution_ru: maxHeight не опускается ниже 240px, диалог может не влезть в очень низкое окно. Итог: верно, но только когда между панелями админки меньше ~256px, а минимум 240px намеренный, чтобы сетка оставалась удобной. Крайний случай в десктопной админке.

findings.claim: show() does not clamp an existing out-of-range value, so the calendar can open at a disallowed date.
findings.reasoning: The only caller bounds the field from 1970 to 2038 (studio-plan/publication.blade.php:33-35, hint 'Any date from 1970 to 2038') and the server validates the same range, so a stored value outside min/max cannot occur. Even then Apply refuses it with a message (:359-363, :423-426).
findings.resolution_ru: show() не ограничивает значение вне диапазона, календарь откроется на недопустимой дате. Итог: единственный вызов ограничивает поле 1970–2038, сервер проверяет тот же диапазон, так что такого значения не бывает; и даже тогда Apply отклонит его с сообщением.

findings.claim: An optional date-time field offers no way to clear the value.
findings.reasoning: Feature request. The only caller shows 'Publication date not selected' for a blank value (publication.blade.php:42-44) and the way to have no date is to switch the publication mode to 'now' (radio-cards at :24), not to blank the field.
findings.resolution_ru: У необязательного поля даты нет способа очистить значение. Итог: это запрос на фичу; чтобы не было даты, переключают режим публикации на 'now', а не очищают поле, пустое значение показывается как 'Publication date not selected'.

findings.claim: The wordmark split fails for names that start with an acronym, such as the shipped AIGuru preset, which loses its accent-coloured tail.
findings.reasoning: brand-wordmark.blade.php:6 requires an uppercase letter followed by at least one non-uppercase character, so 'AIGuru' does not match and renders single-tone, while RateGuru/NatureGuru/BreastGuru split. AIGuru is a supported preset (config/project_presets.php:153; ApplyProjectPresetActionTest.php:72), and the comment at :3-5 says only names without an inner capital render single-tone.
findings.scenario: A project applies the AIGuru preset; its header and auth pages show a plain 'AIGuru' instead of 'AI' + accent 'Guru' like every other preset.

findings.claim: copyShareUrl assumes the Clipboard API is available and succeeds.
findings.reasoning: x-share.post-share-panel's only caller is the dev UI kit (dev/ui-kit.blade.php, EnsureDevEnvironment). The production share dialog uses x-share.copy-link-button (sharing/share-buttons.blade.php:10-14), which already has the execCommand fallback and an error message.
findings.resolution_ru: copyShareUrl считает, что Clipboard API доступен и не падает. Итог: x-share.post-share-panel используется только в dev UI kit; продакшн диалог шаринга использует x-share.copy-link-button, где уже есть fallback через execCommand и сообщение об ошибке.

findings.claim: The share panel's 'Copied' and instruction texts are hard-coded English.
findings.reasoning: Dev-kit-only component (sole caller dev/ui-kit.blade.php). Production copy controls use sharing.copied/sharing.copy_failed translations (copy-link-button.blade.php:3-4, :65).
findings.resolution_ru: Тексты 'Copied' и инструкции в панели шаринга захардкожены на английском. Итог: компонент только для dev UI kit; продакшн кнопки копирования используют переводы sharing.copied/sharing.copy_failed.

findings.claim: type="button" choices never submit their name/value, so a form receives no selection.
findings.reasoning: Same finding as 13-02 (SKIP): the component's only callers are the dev UI kit pages (dev/ui-kit.blade.php, dev/partials/platerate-post-card.blade.php), and no form uses it.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопки type="button" не отправляют name/value, форма не получит выбор. Итог: то же, что 13-02 (SKIP): компонент используется только на страницах dev UI kit, ни одна форма его не использует.

findings.claim: Disabled buttons still change colour on hover.
findings.reasoning: Cosmetic: disabled buttons are already 45% opacity with cursor-not-allowed (button.blade.php:36), and the hover tint does not make them actionable.
findings.resolution_ru: Отключённые кнопки меняют цвет при наведении. Итог: косметика: они уже с прозрачностью 45% и cursor-not-allowed, а оттенок при наведении не делает их активными.

findings.claim: ring-opacity-5 no longer exists in Tailwind v4, so the ring becomes solid black.
findings.reasoning: Correct about Tailwind v4, but components/dropdown.blade.php is an unused Breeze leftover: no view renders <x-dropdown>, and RawColorGuardTest.php:32 excludes it as legacy. No user sees it.
findings.resolution_ru: ring-opacity-5 нет в Tailwind v4, кольцо станет сплошным чёрным. Итог: про Tailwind v4 верно, но components/dropdown.blade.php неиспользуемый остаток Breeze: x-dropdown нигде не рендерится, RawColorGuardTest исключает его как legacy. Пользователи его не видят.

findings.claim: The language switcher trigger exposes neither aria-haspopup nor aria-expanded.
findings.reasoning: locale-switcher.blade.php:9-15 toggles `open` but announces no popup or state, while the neighbouring user-menu trigger in the same header sets aria-haspopup and :aria-expanded (layouts/app.blade.php:104-105) and the mobile search trigger sets x-bind:aria-expanded (:63). The switcher is in the production header for every visitor.
findings.scenario: A screen-reader user activates 'Switch language' and hears no indication that a list opened or whether it is expanded.

findings.claim: request('search') can be an array (?search[]=x); echoing it in value="{{ $value }}" raises a TypeError and a 500 on every page with the header.
findings.reasoning: layouts/app.blade.php:45-47, :246-248 and :323-325 pass :value="request('search')" to x-ui.search-form, which echoes it with {{ }} (search-form.blade.php:24); e() calls htmlspecialchars, which throws a TypeError for an array. The app layout renders this header on every public page. FeedPage itself survives (Livewire's BaseUrl::setPropertyFromQueryString swallows TypeErrors for typed #[Url] properties), so the layout is the failure point. Same class of issue as 08-02 (MINOR).
findings.scenario: Anyone opening /?search[]=x, /about?search[]=x or /posts/1?search[]=x gets a server error page, and each hit is reported as an exception.

findings.claim: room is floored at 132px, which can exceed the measured space and contradicts the 'never taller than the room' comment.
findings.reasoning: True (combobox.blade.php:107 vs the comment at :32-35), but it bites only when neither side has 132px after the 88px chrome, i.e. a usable admin viewport below roughly 490px. The floor is a deliberate usability minimum (about three options); shrinking further would make the list unusable instead. Edge case on a desktop admin UI.
findings.resolution_ru: room не опускается ниже 132px, что противоречит комментарию 'never taller than the room'. Итог: верно, но только при высоте окна админки меньше ~490px; минимум намеренный (около трёх опций), меньше список станет непригодным. Крайний случай десктопной админки.

findings.claim: place() does not adjust the popover horizontally, so it can overflow a trigger near the right edge.
findings.reasoning: Horizontal placement is handled per screen in CSS: the popover is left-aligned with max-width calc(100vw - 32px) (filament/admin/components.css:2210-2221), and the one right-edge caller, Translation AI, is right-aligned explicitly (components.css:9686-9690). The other callers sit at the left of their columns. Speculative.
findings.resolution_ru: place() не сдвигает popover по горизонтали, у правого края он может вылезти. Итог: горизонталь решается в CSS: popover выровнен влево с max-width calc(100vw - 32px), а единственный вызов у правого края (Translation AI) явно выровнен вправо. Спекулятивно.

findings.claim: The default id is shared, so two comboboxes without an explicit id collide in their ARIA ids.
findings.reasoning: Every production caller passes a unique id (translation-center.blade.php:49, translation-ai.blade.php:28, studio-plan/post.blade.php:205 and :266 per group). Latent only.
findings.resolution_ru: id по умолчанию общий, два combobox без id конфликтуют в ARIA id. Итог: каждый продакшн вызов передаёт уникальный id. Только скрытый риск.

findings.claim: Bound selections and option values are compared strictly, so a numeric bound value would not match the string option values.
findings.reasoning: The component casts every option value and the initial value to strings (combobox.blade.php:47, :51), and the wire:model callers deliberately keep their properties as strings: EditsStudioPlan.php:124 (public string $categoryId) and :497-507, which fills authorAnswers 'every value as text' with (string) option ids. The other callers cancel the choose event and set the value server-side. No caller binds a number.
findings.resolution_ru: Выбранные значения и значения опций сравниваются строго, число не совпадёт со строкой. Итог: бот ошибся: компонент приводит все значения к строкам, вызовы с wire:model намеренно держат свойства строками, а остальные ставят значение на сервере.

findings.claim: The badge element exists only if the initially selected option has a badge, so a later selection's badge cannot show.
findings.reasoning: True for mixed lists, but the two callers with badges give every option a badge (TranslationCenterPage.php:583-585, TranslationAiDiagnostics.php:209), and both cancel the choose event and let the server re-render (translation-center.blade.php:56, translation-ai.blade.php:35-36). Latent.
findings.resolution_ru: Бейдж есть, только если он был у изначально выбранной опции, поэтому бейдж нового выбора не покажется. Итог: верно для смешанных списков, но у обоих вызовов с бейджами он есть у каждой опции, и оба отменяют choose и перерисовывают с сервера. Скрытый риск.

findings.claim: The static initial tone class stays after the selection changes, so two tone classes can apply.
findings.reasoning: Only reachable when `selected` changes client-side on a badged list; both badged callers preventDefault the choose event and re-render from the server (translation-center.blade.php:56; translation-ai.blade.php:35-36, wire:key includes the model). Latent.
findings.resolution_ru: Статический класс тона остаётся после смены выбора, могут примениться два тона. Итог: это возможно только при смене selected на клиенте в списке с бейджами, а оба таких вызова отменяют choose через preventDefault и перерисовывают с сервера. Скрытый риск.

findings.claim: The clear button's visibility relies on :placeholder-shown, so an empty placeholder would leave it visible on an empty field.
findings.reasoning: The default placeholder is 'Search' (search-field.blade.php:2) and every caller passes a non-empty one (tags, comments, posts, users, media diagnostics, ...). Latent.
findings.resolution_ru: Видимость кнопки очистки завязана на :placeholder-shown, с пустым placeholder она останется на пустом поле. Итог: placeholder по умолчанию 'Search', и каждый вызов передаёт непустой. Скрытый риск.

findings.claim: The clear button and the textarea presets dispatch only input, not change, so change-based bindings miss them.
findings.reasoning: Documented contract: 'It empties the field the way typing would — an input event, so x-model and wire:model follow' (search-field.blade.php:18-21; textarea.blade.php:27-29). Every clearable search field is bound with wire:model.live.debounce or x-model, and the only preset textarea with plain wire:model, all input-driven. No change-based binding exists.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопка очистки и пресеты textarea шлют только input, без change, и привязки на change их пропустят. Итог: это документированный контракт (событие input, чтобы следовали x-model и wire:model); все привязки здесь работают от input, привязок на change нет.

findings.claim: A read-only search field can still be cleared by the clear button.
findings.reasoning: No caller renders a read-only search field; the component has a `disabled` prop that already disables the clear button (search-field.blade.php:46, :56). Latent.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопка очистки работает и в поле только для чтения. Итог: ни один вызов не рендерит read-only поле поиска, а проп disabled уже отключает кнопку очистки. Скрытый риск.

findings.claim: When navigator.clipboard.writeText rejects, the code shows the failure message without trying execCommand.
findings.reasoning: Rejection is handled gracefully: the message sharing.copy_failed tells the user to select and copy manually (copy-link-button.blade.php:26-28, :59-66), and the URL input selects itself on click (:43). A second automatic attempt is a nice-to-have.
findings.resolution_ru: При отказе clipboard.writeText сразу показывается ошибка без попытки execCommand. Итог: отказ обработан: sharing.copy_failed просит скопировать вручную, а поле с URL выделяется по клику. Вторая автоматическая попытка лишь приятное дополнение.

findings.claim: Interpolating the labels into quoted JS literals breaks the Alpine expression as soon as a translation contains an apostrophe.
findings.reasoning: copy-link-button.blade.php:50 and :55 build `'{{ $copiedLabel }}'`/`'{{ $label }}'` inside Alpine expressions; Blade escapes ' to ', which the browser decodes back before Alpine evaluates, so a label with an apostrophe becomes a syntax error. None of the 40 locales' sharing.copy_link/sharing.copied contains one today, so this is latent, but this is production share UI and the project already uses @js elsewhere for the same purpose.
findings.scenario: A translation such as "Copier l'URL" lands in lang/fr/sharing.php: the share dialog's copy button throws an Alpine expression error on every render and its aria-label never switches to 'copied'.

findings.claim: A blank name gives the avatar the accessible name '?'.
findings.reasoning: Callers already fall back to ui.user.unknown when there is no user (comment-item.blade.php:29, post-card.blade.php:37), and names are required at sign-up. Only a user with an empty name string would reach '?'. Edge-case polish.
findings.resolution_ru: При пустом имени у аватара доступное имя '?'. Итог: вызовы уже подставляют ui.user.unknown, если пользователя нет, а имя обязательно при регистрации; '?' получит только пользователь с пустой строкой в имени. Полировка крайнего случая.

findings.claim: Past the last page, Previous moves back only one page and can stay on empty pages.
findings.reasoning: The component already treats a page past the last as empty (pagination.blade.php:31-36) and always renders direct links to page 1 and the last page (:29), so the user can jump straight back. Cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: За последней страницей Previous идёт назад на одну страницу и может оставаться на пустых. Итог: компонент уже считает такую страницу пустой и всегда показывает прямые ссылки на первую и последнюю страницу, так что вернуться можно сразу. Косметика.

findings.claim: With non-numeric text in the field, a step restarts from min ?? 0 instead of the last held number.
findings.reasoning: Clicking a − or + button blurs the input first, and blur restores the last held number (number-stepper.blade.php:89), so the button path already steps from it. Only Arrow keys on an emptied field start from the minimum, which is how a native number input behaves. Intended-looking behaviour.
findings.resolution_ru: При нечисловом тексте шаг начинается с min ?? 0, а не с последнего числа. Итог: клик по −/+ снимает фокус, и blur восстанавливает последнее число; только стрелки на очищенном поле начинают с минимума, как нативный number input. Похоже на задуманное.

findings.claim: When an invalid value is restored on change, change-only listeners are never told the restored value.
findings.reasoning: change.capture stops the change event and restores `kept` (number-stepper.blade.php:92), and kept follows every whole value typed (:91). wire:model callers already saw kept through input events, but the Studio votes editor binds the field with a change-only listener, x-on:change="$wire.setRatingTotal(...)" (livewire/admin/studio-plan-post-votes-editor.blade.php:340), which hears nothing, so the field shows a number the server never received.
findings.scenario: The Answers field holds 10; the administrator types 15, then a stray letter (or clears it after typing '1'), and tabs away: the field shows 15 (or 1), setRatingTotal is never called, and the plan keeps 10 answers while the editor displays 15.

findings.claim: An array-valued email query parameter or flashed old input makes the reset page throw and return 500.
findings.reasoning: NewPasswordController::create passes the raw request to the view (NewPasswordController.php:19-22), and reset-password.blade.php:11 binds :value="old('email', $request->email)" on x-text-input; an array is not escaped by sanitizeComponentAttribute and ComponentAttributeBag::__toString calls trim($value) on it (vendor ComponentAttributeBag.php:502), a TypeError. A failed POST with email[]=x flashes the array back through withInput as well. Same class as 01-10/08-02 (MINOR).
findings.scenario: Opening /reset-password/{token}?email[]=a, or submitting the form with a tampered email[] field, gives a server error page and an error report instead of the form.

findings.claim: Icon-only action buttons (the 'more' usage) have no accessible name.
findings.reasoning: Every production caller fills the slot (comment count, Share, Save: post-card.blade.php:113-125, post-show.blade.php:145-151, save-post-button.blade.php:18-29, which also sets aria-label); the only icon-only use, icon="more", is in the dev partial dev/partials/platerate-post-card.blade.php:49. Callers can already pass aria-label through $attributes.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопки действий только с иконкой (вариант 'more') без доступного имени. Итог: все продакшн вызовы заполняют слот, а единственная кнопка без текста (icon="more") в dev partial; aria-label и так можно передать через $attributes.

findings.claim: The verify-email page uses raw gray text colours instead of theme tokens.
findings.reasoning: True (verify-email.blade.php:2, :7, :26 keep Breeze's text-gray-600/hover:text-gray-900), but the page is orphaned: no route uses the 'verified' middleware and nothing links to verification.notice (routes/auth.php:64-65 is reached only by typing /verify-email). Cosmetic on an unreachable page.
findings.resolution_ru: Страница verify-email использует сырые серые цвета вместо токенов темы. Итог: верно, но страница осиротевшая: middleware verified нигде не используется и на verification.notice ничего не ссылается. Косметика на недоступной странице.

findings.claim: The menu is clamped only on the right, so it can overflow the left edge when the trigger is near it.
findings.reasoning: The menu is right-aligned to a trigger that sits in a table row's last column (row-menu.blade.php:7-10, :60); for its right edge to come within 272px of the window's left edge the trigger would have to be in the leftmost quarter of a narrow screen, which the sideways-scrolling table card does not produce. Speculative.
findings.resolution_ru: Меню ограничено только справа и может вылезти за левый край. Итог: меню выровнено вправо к триггеру в последней колонке таблицы; до левого края оно дойдёт, только если триггер в левой четверти узкого экрана, чего таблица с прокруткой не даёт. Спекулятивно.

findings.claim: The active feed tab has no screen-reader-only 'selected' label.
findings.reasoning: Dev reference partial included only from dev/partials/platerate-reference-composition.blade.php, inside the dev UI kit route behind EnsureDevEnvironment (routes/web.php:43-67). Not shipped UI.
findings.resolution_ru: У активной вкладки ленты нет скрытой метки 'selected' для скринридеров. Итог: это dev partial, подключаемый только в dev UI kit за EnsureDevEnvironment, а не выпускаемый UI.

findings.claim: Switching off allow_user_uploads only hides the upload UI; UploadPostForm::submit() still creates posts, so the site-wide pause can be bypassed.
findings.reasoning: The flag is read only in resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php:76/178/191 to decide whether to render the upload button and the <livewire:feed.upload-post-form/> modal; UploadPostForm::mount()/submit() (UploadPostForm.php:59-77) check only auth()->check(), and CreatePostAction has no featureFlag check. The admin surface promises a real pause: ProjectSettingsPage::FLAGS (line 75) says 'pause all new posts across the site' and the confirmation (project-settings/confirmation.blade.php:25) says 'Nobody can create new posts until uploads are turned back on'. docs/admin/project-settings.md:127-131 and docs/admin/phase-45-project-settings-review.md record the missing backend guard as unimplemented future work, not as intended behaviour.
findings.scenario: An admin pauses uploads during a spam wave. Any signed-in user whose tab was loaded before the pause still has the upload modal (and a valid component snapshot) in the page; they open it and submit, and CreatePostAction creates the post. A scripted client replaying a saved snapshot does the same indefinitely.

findings.claim: wire:click.prevent on the Edit links cancels Ctrl/Cmd/Shift-click, so the links cannot be opened in a new tab as the docblock promises.
findings.reasoning: The name link (line 26), the Edit button (line 52) and the menu item (line 56) all have href=editUrl plus wire:click.prevent=editPersona(id); Livewire calls preventDefault on every click event including modified ones, so Cmd/Ctrl-click opens the drawer in the current tab. Middle-click (auxclick) and the context menu still work. The docblock (lines 6-9) says each link 'can open in a new tab'; reports.blade.php:35 already skips modified clicks for its own shortcuts, so the pattern exists.
findings.scenario: A moderator Cmd-clicks two persona names to compare them in tabs; instead the drawer opens in place for the first one and no tab opens.

findings.claim: 'Differs from preset' never shows on Site identity fields because preset() only collects the labels fields.
findings.reasoning: True that preset() (ProjectSettingsPage.php:344-372) compares only TEXT_FIELDS['labels'], the defaults and the flags, but this is deliberate: its docblock lists exactly those, and docs/design/admin/design-contract.md:974-975 states 'The site's identity is the project's own and is not compared.' The shared text.blade.php partial renders the note for both tabs, and differs() is simply false for identity paths.
findings.resolution_ru: 'Differs from preset' не показывается на полях Site identity, так как preset() собирает только поля labels. Итог: бот ошибся, это намеренно: docblock перечисляет именно эти поля, а design-contract.md прямо говорит, что идентичность сайта не сравнивается.

findings.claim: The inspector's explanation is derived from the audit-time issue type while the files and footer reflect the disk now, so they can contradict each other.
findings.reasoning: 'explain' is a match on $issue->issue_type (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:573-579), while files/filesSummary/canRegenerate come from inspectAsset() run now (lines 594-603). The issue list is the last audit's snapshot (design-contract.md:1416-1418), so after a regeneration or a restored master the notice still says variants/master are missing while the list says 'All present' — and for a MissingMasterFile issue with the master back, the footer offers 'Regenerate missing variants' under text saying nothing can be regenerated.
findings.scenario: An admin restores a missing master from backup and reopens the issue: the notice says 'nothing can be regenerated from it', the file list shows the master on disk, and the footer offers Regenerate — contradictory guidance.

findings.claim: Turning off the editor's Active switch hides the group with no confirmation, unlike the list's Deactivate.
findings.reasoning: In the editor the switch only changes the draft (wire:model.live=draftActive); nothing is written until Save in the top bar, which itself is the confirmation step, and its hint says 'Turning it off keeps all votes.' design-contract.md:924-931 specifies exactly this: settings are a draft saved from the top bar, Active is sent as it changes only so its errors show. The list's confirmation exists because its Deactivate writes immediately.
findings.resolution_ru: Выключение Active в редакторе скрывает группу без подтверждения, в отличие от Deactivate в списке. Итог: бот ошибся: переключатель меняет только черновик, запись идёт по Save, который и есть подтверждение, как в design-contract.md; в списке запись сразу.

findings.claim: The blocked dialog's else-branch assumes active > max; when the stored range itself is out of bounds it can print zero or negative counts.
findings.reasoning: The dialog opens when UpdateRatingGroupAction throws (ManageRatingGroups.php:82-87); besides the holds check it throws for min < 2 or max > 15 (UpdateRatingGroupAction.php:42-48). But no writer can store such a range: CreateRatingGroupAction.php:34-40 and UpdateRatingGroupAction enforce 2..15, ApplyProjectPresetAction uses FEWEST/MOST_OPTIONS, and the pre-Admin-v2 Filament form enforced 2..10 (git show 23f459d2^:…/RatingGroupForm.php). The row is read in the same request right after the refusal, so the only remaining path is a concurrent change within milliseconds or a manual DB edit.
findings.resolution_ru: Ветка else диалога блокировки предполагает active > max, при диапазоне вне границ счётчики будут нулевыми или отрицательными. Итог: бот ошибся: ни один путь записи такой диапазон не сохраняет, остаются лишь гонка за миллисекунды или ручная правка БД.

findings.claim: $firstId is the current page's first row, so ?page=3 auto-opens page 3's first report instead of the list's first.
findings.reasoning: Opening the first report visible on the page is the intended behaviour: the docblock (lines 9-10) and design-contract.md:1345 say 'opened wide with nothing chosen, the first report opens' — i.e. of the list on screen. Opening page 1's first report while page 3 is displayed would select a row that is not shown, which is worse.
findings.resolution_ru: $firstId берётся с текущей страницы, и ?page=3 открывает первый отчёт третьей страницы. Итог: бот ошибся, так задумано (docblock, design-contract.md): открывается первый отчёт видимого списка, а отчёт первой страницы был бы невидимой строкой.

findings.claim: A page past the last one shows the empty state with no pager while the toolbar still counts comments; ListComments does not clamp pageNumber.
findings.reasoning: getViewData() (ListComments.php:226-231) paginates with the raw pageNumber and never compares it with lastPage(), unlike ListPersonas.php:131-136, StudioActionQueue and ListStudioPlans. comments.blade.php:51-79 renders the pager only when $rows !== [], so the empty branch says 'Nothing matches this state' while the role=status count (line 47) shows the real total. Acting on rows does not adjust pageNumber (only lines 99/107/113 touch it).
findings.scenario: A moderator on the last page of 'Reported' hides its only comment; the page re-renders empty with 'No comments here' and '26 comments' in the toolbar and no pager, so they must switch tabs to get back.

findings.claim: Author search matches only username although the row may display the author's name.
findings.reasoning: The search is specified as 'the text, the author's username, the post's title and the comment's id' (design-contract.md:1311; query docblock line 18), and that is what ModerationCommentsQuery.php:85-89 implements. The name fallback in ListComments row() only applies to accounts with a null username (registration, social sign-up and personas always set one), so the mismatch is a documented scope, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Поиск по автору идёт только по username, хотя в строке может быть имя. Итог: бот ошибся: поиск задан как текст, username, заголовок поста и id комментария, так и сделано; имя выводится только при null username, а регистрация, соцвход и персоны его задают.

findings.claim: The 'leaving' flag does not bypass the editor's beforeunload guard, so deleting a draft with unsaved values can still prompt.
findings.reasoning: The page guard (studio-plan.blade.php:57) compares the $wire draft with $wire.saved, and EditStudioPlan::delete() (EditStudioPlan.php:426-432) refills the draft and sets saved from the deleted plan before redirecting, so both are equal. Livewire merges the new snapshot before processing the redirect effect (vendor livewire.esm.js:12870-12874 then supportRedirects), so changes is 0 when beforeunload fires. 'leaving' is only needed by the discussion-votes sub-editor, whose guard does check it (studio-plan-discussion-votes-editor.blade.php:28). AdminStudioPlansBrowserTest.php:212 covers the delete-and-land flow.
findings.resolution_ru: Флаг leaving не обходит beforeunload, и удаление черновика с правками спросит подтверждение. Итог: бот ошибся: delete() до редиректа выравнивает черновик и saved, Livewire применяет снимок раньше редиректа; leaving нужен только редактору discussion-votes.

findings.claim: A concurrent hide makes the confirmation report a false success and offer Undo for another moderator's action.
findings.reasoning: confirm() pre-checks status on an unlocked read (ListComments.php:180) and then calls HideCommentAction, which under its lock silently returns when the comment is already Hidden or gone (HideCommentAction.php:54). attempt() then sees no exception and the page toasts 'Comment #id hidden' with Undo (line 187). The window is only the few queries between the pre-check and the lock.
findings.scenario: Two moderators confirm hiding the same reported comment at the same moment; both get 'hidden' with Undo, and the one who clicks Undo restores the comment the other hid, logged as their own restore.

findings.claim: Concurrent enable/disable requests overwrite each other because the full enabled-locale list is computed before the settings-row lock.
findings.reasoning: enableLanguage()/disableLanguage() build the whole list from $locales->enabledCodes() (LanguagesPage.php:217, 258), read from the per-request ProjectSettingsManager memo, then UpdateProjectLocaleSettingsAction inspects catalogs and only afterwards locks the row and overwrites enabled_locales wholesale (UpdateProjectLocaleSettingsAction.php:55-68). Nothing re-reads the locked row, so a change committed in between is lost while both admins get a success toast.
findings.scenario: Admin A enables Russian while admin B enables Bulgarian; both read [en], A writes [en, ru], B writes [en, bg]; Russian is silently no longer offered although A saw 'Russian enabled'.

findings.claim: The NAV-03 specimen tabs are unwired buttons that do not change the filter.
findings.reasoning: This is the internal Admin UI kit specimen gallery; its tabs, like other specimen buttons there (e.g. localization.blade.php 'Discard all'), are static illustrations of the component, not a working list. No user-facing behaviour depends on it.
findings.resolution_ru: Вкладки образца NAV-03 не подключены и не меняют фильтр. Итог: это внутренняя галерея образцов Admin UI kit, вкладки там статичная иллюстрация компонента, а не рабочий список; от неё не зависит никакое поведение для пользователей.

findings.claim: The client-side URL check rejects valid image links with an explicit port, and importFrom() never sends them to the server.
findings.reasoning: The regex /^https?:\/\/[^\s\/?#]+\.[a-z]{2,}(?:[\/?#]\S*)?$/i requires the host to end in .letters followed by / ? # or end, so 'https://example.com:8443/a.jpg' (and IDN or punycode hosts such as xn--p1ai) is flagged incomplete and importFrom returns at line 93; the server (EditsStudioPlan::importImage, which validates and uses the safe client) never sees it. The user only sees 'Paste the full link, starting with https://'.
findings.scenario: An editor pastes a direct image link served on a non-default port or from a .рф domain; the import never starts and the hint wrongly says the link is incomplete.

findings.claim: Regenerate stays clickable during its request and each click dispatches a non-unique GenerateMediaVariantsJob, so double-clicks queue duplicate work.
findings.reasoning: The buttons have no wire:loading.attr=disabled and regenerateVariants() dispatches unconditionally (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:232-245); GenerateMediaVariantsJob is not ShouldBeUnique. Duplicates are mostly harmless — MediaVariantGenerator skips variants that already exist and writes via updateOrCreate — but two jobs on parallel workers can race on the same variant and one fails and retries, adding log noise.
findings.scenario: An admin double-clicks Regenerate on a large asset; two jobs decode the master and write the same variants concurrently, one may log 'variant generation failed' and retry.

findings.claim: The Character column shows speech_style instead of the persona's character field.
findings.reasoning: The column content is specified as 'the short description with the speech style and emoji under it' (design-contract.md:1231-1232; row docblock lines 5-6), and PersonaResourceTest.php:93-118 pins 'style' => speech_style in the row. The persona's long character notes are deliberately not shown in the list (they are searched, per the toolbar spec).
findings.resolution_ru: Колонка Character показывает speech_style вместо поля character. Итог: бот ошибся: колонка задана как краткое описание со стилем речи и эмодзи, PersonaResourceTest это закрепляет; длинные заметки о характере намеренно не показываются, по ним ищут.

findings.claim: The public-profile URL assumes every Persona has a username; a null username would break the whole list.
findings.reasoning: Personas are only created by CreatePersonaAction, which always sets a unique username (CreatePersonaAction.php:115-118); UpdatePersonaAction only changes it to another validated value; UpdateUserAccountAction refuses personas and refuses turning an account into one (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:54-56); anonymization sets a tombstone username and PersonasQuery excludes tombstoned rows (withoutTombstoned). The Persona role postdates the username column, so no legacy persona can lack one.
findings.resolution_ru: URL профиля предполагает username у каждой Persona, null сломает список. Итог: бот ошибся: персоны создаёт только CreatePersonaAction с уникальным username, его не обнуляют, tombstone исключены из PersonasQuery, а роль Persona появилась позже колонки username.

findings.claim: The legend has no entry for the 'over' slot state (an active option above the maximum).
findings.reasoning: x-admin.ui.range-slots renders 'over' for active slots beyond max (range-slots.blade.php:31,36), but the legend lists only active/allowed/required/outside. The state is reachable: UpdateRatingGroupAction only checks the range against active options when the group is active (lines 50-58), so an inactive group's maximum can be lowered below its active count from the editor (design-contract.md:933-935 describes saving that while inactive).
findings.scenario: An admin lowers an inactive group's maximum from 5 to 3; the list shows two orange slots that the legend does not explain, next to an 'Above maximum' legend entry that refers to the grey unused slots.

findings.claim: The icon-only bell button has no accessible name.
findings.reasoning: This partial is only used by the /dev/ui-kit reference composition, served behind EnsureDevEnvironment (routes/web.php:43-67); it is a static design reference, not a product screen.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопка-колокольчик только с иконкой без доступного имени. Итог: этот partial используется только в эталонной композиции /dev/ui-kit за EnsureDevEnvironment; это статичный дизайн-образец, а не экран продукта.

findings.claim: The acknowledgement error is not tied to its checkbox: aria-invalid is set but there is no aria-describedby to the message.
findings.reasoning: The checkbox gets aria-invalid (line 30) while the @error paragraph (line 32) has no id and nothing references it; the textarea above passes :error to its component, which wires the description. The confirm button is usually disabled until the box is ticked, so the error is rare, but when shown a screen-reader user hears only 'invalid'.
findings.scenario: A screen-reader moderator submits the finalize dialog without ticking (e.g. a stale client state); focus lands on an 'invalid' checkbox with no reason announced.

findings.claim: aria-controls points at rg-admin-report-panel even before the panel exists.
findings.reasoning: A dangling IDREF in aria-controls is ignored by assistive technology and has no functional effect; the panel appears with that id as soon as a report is selected. Pure markup hygiene.
findings.resolution_ru: aria-controls указывает на rg-admin-report-panel до появления панели. Итог: висячий IDREF в aria-controls вспомогательные технологии игнорируют, функционального эффекта нет, а панель с этим id появляется при выборе отчёта. Чистая гигиена разметки.

findings.claim: The Copy path button shows 'Copied' even when the clipboard write did not happen.
findings.reasoning: The handler is navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...); copied = true — it does not await the promise, so a rejected write (permission denied, unfocused document) or a missing navigator.clipboard (non-secure context) still shows 'Copied', and the rejection is unhandled. components/share/copy-link-button.blade.php:16-17 already guards with isSecureContext and await.
findings.scenario: On a non-HTTPS admin host (staging over http) the button says 'Copied' while nothing is on the clipboard.

findings.claim: The 'Degraded' specimen badge has a dot although STS-01 reserves dots for healthy/running states.
findings.reasoning: Specimen content of the internal UI kit gallery; it does not affect any production badge mapping.
findings.resolution_ru: Образец бейджа 'Degraded' с точкой, хотя STS-01 оставляет точки для healthy/running. Итог: это содержимое образца во внутренней галерее UI kit, на маппинг бейджей в продакшне не влияет.

findings.claim: The warning specimen row omits the 'Warning' label listed by the spec.
findings.reasoning: Specimen completeness in the internal UI kit gallery; no behaviour depends on it.
findings.resolution_ru: В образце warning нет метки 'Warning' из спецификации. Итог: это полнота образца во внутренней галерее UI kit, от неё ничего не зависит.

findings.claim: The 'Running' specimen badge has no dot although STS-01 says running work gets one.
findings.reasoning: Specimen content in the UI kit gallery (design-contract.md:447 does give running work a dot, so it is a cosmetic specimen inconsistency); production screens map their own statuses.
findings.resolution_ru: Образец бейджа 'Running' без точки, хотя STS-01 её требует. Итог: это образец в галерее UI kit, несоответствие косметическое; продакшн экраны маппят свои статусы сами.

findings.claim: Past the last page, the unfiltered empty state says 'No issues — the last audit found nothing to fix' while the toolbar counts issues.
findings.reasoning: The issues are paginated with the raw pageNumber (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:441) and normalize() (line 768) only clamps to >= 1. With rows empty and no filter, media-diagnostics.blade.php:119-121 shows the success empty state 'No issues · The last audit found nothing to fix.' even though $total > 0.
findings.scenario: An admin reloads ?page=4 after a new audit finished with 40 issues; the health page claims the audit found nothing to fix, next to '40 issues'.

findings.claim: The specimen's summary counts (2 and 2) contradict the specimen rows below (3 and 3).
findings.reasoning: Static illustrative copy in the UI kit gallery; no data or behaviour involved.
findings.resolution_ru: Счётчики в образце (2 и 2) не совпадают со строками ниже (3 и 3). Итог: это статичный иллюстративный текст в галерее UI kit, данных и поведения не касается.

findings.claim: The unsaved-changes note has no live region, so its changes are not announced.
findings.reasoning: Accessibility preference rather than a defect: the count changes on almost every keystroke in the draft, and a role=status there would announce continuously while the user types; the Save/Discard controls next to it are focusable and labelled.
