findings.resolution_ru: Пометка о несохранённых изменениях без live region, изменения не озвучиваются. Итог: это вопрос предпочтения, а не дефект: счётчик меняется почти на каждое нажатие, и role=status озвучивал бы непрерывно; кнопки Save/Discard рядом фокусируемые и подписаны.

findings.claim: The client trims the reason before its 3-character check but the server validates the untrimmed value with min:3, then stores the trimmed one.
findings.reasoning: ListPosts::confirm() validates 'reason' with min:3 on the raw property (line 237) and trims afterwards (line 248); Livewire skips the TrimStrings middleware for its update requests (vendor HandleRequests.php:88), so '  a  ' passes min:3 and 'a' is recorded. Same pattern in ListComments::confirm() (lines 150, 161) and ListReports::confirm(). Only reachable by bypassing the disabled confirm button, so impact is a malformed audit reason.
findings.scenario: A moderator (or a scripted request) sends reason '  x  ' for Finalize removal; FinalizePostRemovalAction records 'x' as the internal reason, below the documented 3-character minimum.

findings.claim: Escape closes the floating report panel only when focus is inside it, and opening a report leaves focus on the row button.
findings.reasoning: The listener is x-on:keydown.escape on the <aside> (line 26), not .window, and neither select() (ListReports.php:122-129) nor the view moves focus into the panel. The docblock (lines 10-12) promises the overlay is 'closed with its close button or Escape'. The close button still works.
findings.scenario: On a narrow window a moderator clicks a report row; the panel floats over the list, they press Escape and nothing happens.

findings.claim: Completed vote actions never have a link, but the fallback text says what they wrote is no longer on the site.
findings.reasoning: StudioActionPlan::links() returns links only for CreatePost/CreateComment/CreateReply and [] for every vote type (StudioActionPlan.php:324-333). row.blade.php:130-131 shows 'What it wrote isn’t on the site now.' whenever links are empty and the state is Done, so every completed post vote, comment vote and rating answer — usually most of a plan's actions — carries a false statement.
findings.scenario: An admin reviewing a finished plan sees 'What it wrote isn’t on the site now' under dozens of successful votes and concludes they were removed.

findings.claim: The icon-only post-actions button has no accessible name.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only reference partial for /dev/ui-kit behind EnsureDevEnvironment (routes/web.php:43-67); not a product screen.
findings.resolution_ru: Кнопка действий поста только с иконкой без доступного имени. Итог: это dev partial для /dev/ui-kit за EnsureDevEnvironment, а не экран продукта.

findings.claim: Clicking the indeterminate select-page checkbox clears the selection instead of selecting the remaining rows.
findings.reasoning: That is the specified behaviour: togglePage()'s docblock says 'Selects every row on the page, or clears a selection that has any' (ListPosts.php:153-159), the header box is drawn checked whenever anything is selected (posts.blade.php:126), so a click unchecking it matches the native checkbox semantics, and PostResourceBulkActionsTest.php:18-31 pins toggle-to-clear.
findings.resolution_ru: Клик по частично отмеченному чекбоксу страницы снимает выбор, а не выбирает остальные строки. Итог: бот ошибся, так задано: togglePage() выбирает все строки или снимает любой выбор, как нативный чекбокс; тест это закрепляет.

findings.claim: The specimen's 'n missing' meta rounds down, so a 63% row shows 39 instead of 38 missing.
findings.reasoning: Illustrative numbers in the UI kit's FRM specimen (104 - intdiv(...)); no production data uses this calculation.
findings.resolution_ru: Мета 'n missing' в образце округляет вниз, 63% даёт 39 вместо 38. Итог: это иллюстративные числа в образце FRM в UI kit, продакшн данные этот расчёт не используют.

findings.claim: The 'All models' specimen row wording should match the production filter.
findings.reasoning: Wording of a static specimen row in the UI kit gallery.
findings.resolution_ru: Формулировка строки 'All models' в образце должна совпадать с продакшн фильтром. Итог: это текст статичной строки образца в галерее UI kit, не меняем.

findings.claim: The card's wire:key should include searchable values (e.g. the language name) so the search snapshot refreshes when they change.
findings.reasoning: The search strings are built from the installed-locale config only — label, native name and code (LanguagesPage.php:524) — which cannot change during a page's lifetime; the key already changes with the set of rows (languages.blade.php:16, 107), which is the only thing an enable/disable or tab switch changes.
findings.resolution_ru: wire:key карточки должен включать искомые значения, чтобы снимок поиска обновлялся. Итог: бот ошибся: строки поиска строятся только из конфига установленных локалей и не меняются за жизнь страницы, а ключ уже меняется вместе с набором строк.

findings.claim: The catalog-issues notice says the language 'cannot be enabled' even when it is already enabled.
findings.reasoning: LanguagesPage::missing() lists catalog issues for any language (LanguagesPage.php:462-479), and the drawer's notice is unconditional (missing.blade.php:55-57). UpdateProjectLocaleSettingsAction deliberately leaves an already-offered language enabled when a release breaks its catalog (class docblock), so an enabled language with issues is a real state where the text is wrong and hides that visitors still get it.
findings.scenario: After a release breaks the German catalog, an admin opens German's drawer and reads it 'cannot be enabled' although German is live for visitors, so they do not realise visitors are affected.

findings.claim: Overlapping Refresh requests clear the skeleton when the first one finishes rather than the last.
findings.reasoning: Only affects a double-clicked Refresh: the skeleton disappears a moment early and the rows update again when the second response lands. Cosmetic; a counter adds code for no practical gain.
findings.resolution_ru: Перекрывающиеся запросы Refresh снимают скелетон по первому ответу, а не по последнему. Итог: это касается только двойного клика: скелетон пропадает чуть раньше, строки обновятся при втором ответе. Косметика, счётчик добавил бы код без практической пользы.

findings.claim: The client counts UTF-16 code units for the 3-character minimum while the server counts characters, so two emoji enable the button but fail server-side.
findings.reasoning: Technically true ('😀😀'.length is 4, mb_strlen 2), but the outcome is only that the server shows 'Say a little more: at least 3 characters.' — the server stays authoritative and nothing wrong is stored. Not worth code for emoji-only moderation reasons.
findings.resolution_ru: Клиент считает минимум 3 символа в UTF-16, а сервер в символах, и два эмодзи включают кнопку, но не проходят сервер. Итог: формально так, но сервер просто покажет сообщение про минимум 3 символа и ничего неверного не сохранит. Код ради причин из эмодзи не нужен.

findings.claim: The viewer should show an unavailable state and hide 'Open original' when the original image fails to load.
findings.reasoning: Speculative enhancement: a missing master is already surfaced by Media diagnostics; here the img alt shows the post title and the link simply 404s. No data or authorization impact.
findings.resolution_ru: Просмотрщик должен показывать недоступность и прятать 'Open original', если оригинал не загрузился. Итог: это спекулятивное улучшение: пропавший оригинал уже показывает Media diagnostics, здесь alt выводит заголовок поста, а ссылка просто даёт 404.

findings.claim: revert(path) defers $wire.set, so a guarded flag reverted to the preset skips its confirmation until Save.
findings.reasoning: updatedData() only intercepts a guarded flag switching to false (ProjectSettingsPage.php:189-200). Every preset sets allow_user_uploads and allow_guest_viewing to true (config/project_presets.php:29-30, 89-90, 172-173, 249-250), so a Revert can only set a guarded flag to true, which never needs confirmation. Sign-in providers are not part of preset values.
findings.resolution_ru: revert(path) откладывает $wire.set, и защищённый флаг, возвращённый к пресету, пропускает подтверждение. Итог: бот ошибся: updatedData() перехватывает только переход защищённого флага в false, а все пресеты ставят эти флаги в true, и Revert подтверждения не требует.

findings.claim: The Translate links leave Project settings without warning, losing an unsaved draft.
findings.reasoning: Project settings counts unsaved changes into the adminEditor store (project-settings.blade.php:53) but, unlike the user, persona and studio-plan editors (user-editor.blade.php:25, persona-editor.blade.php:25, studio-plan.blade.php:57), registers no beforeunload guard, and the panel is not in SPA mode. The Translate links (text.blade.php:60, pages.blade.php:72) are plain same-tab links placed right under the fields being edited.
findings.scenario: An admin edits the site tagline, then clicks Translate to translate it; the page navigates to Translation Center, the unsaved English text is discarded, and Translation Center shows the old source.

findings.claim: The ban title and hide details dereference $author['name'] and fail when the target's author is missing or the target was purged.
findings.reasoning: For Post/Comment targets the author cannot be null: posts.user_id and comments.user_id are NOT NULL with restrictOnDelete (create_posts/comments migrations), User has no soft deletes, and anonymization keeps the row. Targets are loaded withTrashed (ModerationReportsQuery.php:160-164), and purging a post or comment deletes the reports pointing at it (PostGraphDeletionService docblock), so current() returns null and nothing renders. askToBan() requires a non-null author (ListReports.php:187-195).
findings.resolution_ru: Заголовок бана и детали скрытия обращаются к $author['name'] и падают, если автора нет или цель удалена. Итог: бот ошибся: user_id у постов и комментариев NOT NULL, пользователи не удаляются, при очистке поста удаляются и его жалобы, а askToBan() требует автора.

findings.claim: The executor-off banner should say actions already in progress may still publish.
findings.reasoning: docs/architecture/studio-plans.md:1700-1705 defines off as 'sends nothing … a run a worker already claimed finishes', and the switch-off confirmation already says 'A run a worker already began finishes' (studio-action-queue.blade.php:165). The banner describes the steady state seconds later; copy nuance only.
findings.resolution_ru: Баннер выключенного исполнителя должен говорить, что уже начатые действия могут опубликоваться. Итог: это нюанс текста: подтверждение выключения уже говорит, что начатый запуск завершится, а баннер описывает состояние через несколько секунд.

findings.claim: The above-max dialog presents the active-option count as the maximum instead of showing both values.
findings.reasoning: The dialog opens when activating an option is refused for the maximum (EditRatingGroup.php:517-521), i.e. active >= max_options, and says '{group} already has {active} active options, the maximum allowed.' When active equals max that is right, but an inactive group's maximum can be saved below its active count (UpdateRatingGroupAction.php:50-58 checks the range only for active groups), and then the sentence misstates the maximum.
findings.scenario: An inactive group has 5 active options and its maximum was lowered to 3; activating a sixth says '5 active options, the maximum allowed' and offers to raise the maximum to 6, hiding that the maximum is actually 3.

findings.claim: A failed import leaves imported[source] set to the URL, so after switching source and back the same URL can neither be retried by typing nor via Try again.
findings.reasoning: importFrom() records imported[source] = url before the request (line 97) and only rg-studio-photo-kept clears it (line 107); the server likewise records importedFrom before downloading (EditsStudioPlan.php:347). After a failure Try again is shown only while the field's error exists (image.blade.php:262-264), and updatedImageSource() resets the error bag (EditsStudioPlan.php:319-323). So after switching source and back, the field still holds the URL, re-entering it is ignored on both sides, and no Try again is offered.
findings.scenario: An editor's link import fails because the remote host was briefly down; they glance at the Post link tab and return to Image link — the same URL now does nothing when pasted again and there is no Try again button until they alter the URL.

findings.claim: With post_detail_overlay_mode off, profile and saved-post cards have no detail host, so clicking a card does nothing.
findings.reasoning: The global PostDrawer overlay is mounted only inside @if(featureFlag('post_detail_overlay_mode', false)) (layouts/app.blade.php:342-389), and the flag defaults to false in every preset (config/project_presets.php:27,87,170,247; ProjectSettingsManager.php:41). x-feed.post-card only dispatches 'select-post' (components/feed/post-card.blade.php:13-15,115) and has no link to posts.show; the only listeners are the feed page (feed-page.blade.php:68, plus its own drawers at 130/140) and the overlay PostDrawer (PostDrawer::getListeners, post-drawer.blade.php:40). profile-page.blade.php:149/207 and saved-posts-page.blade.php:13 render the card with no drawer, so the event reaches nobody. SavedPostsPageTest:80 only covers the flag turned on.
findings.scenario: Default configuration: a visitor opens /u/someone, clicks a post card (or its comments button) on the Posts tab, or on the owner's Saved tab / Saved posts page — nothing opens and there is no other way to reach the post from that page.

findings.claim: The user editor submits its whole draft and UpdateUserAccountAction writes every field, so a stale editor silently overwrites changes made by another administrator meanwhile.
findings.reasoning: UserEditor::save() sends name, username, email and role from the draft regardless of whether they changed (app/Livewire/Admin/UserEditor.php:138-146); only trust is diffed against the #[Locked] $saved baseline (line 144). UpdateUserAccountAction locks the fresh row but forceFills name/username/email/role unconditionally (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:59-65) and clears email_verified_at when the email differs (67-69). The project explicitly guards trust against this ('never puts back a trust level set since the editor read the account', UpdateUserAccountActionTest.php:133-143) but not the other fields, and nothing compares the locked row with the baseline.
findings.scenario: Admin A opens moderator X's editor. Admin B demotes X to User. A, still on the stale drawer, fixes a typo in X's name and saves: role 'moderator' (A's unchanged draft) is written back, re-granting moderator access with no confirmation (role equals A's baseline, so the role dialog never shows). Likewise an email X changed and verified meanwhile is reverted and left unverified.

findings.claim: A tag attached only to soft-deleted (still restorable) posts is treated as unused and can be deleted, cascading the pivot rows so a restored post loses its tag.
findings.reasoning: Post uses SoftDeletes (app/Models/Post.php:31) and Tag::posts() is a plain belongsToMany (Tag.php:29-32), so both the admin count (ManageTags::tags withCount('posts'), ManageTags.php:266-279, feeding confirmation.blade.php:10-14) and the domain invariant ($locked->posts()->exists(), DeleteTagAction.php:35) exclude trashed posts. post_tag cascades on tag delete (community-fk-safety.md:54). Author-deleted posts are restorable within the window and 'child data ... was never touched, so it needs no restore' (RestoreDeletedPostAction.php:13-19,67). DeleteTagAction's own docblock promises 'The pivot is never silently detached' (line 17); DeleteTagActionTest has no trashed-post case.
findings.scenario: An author tags a post #harbour (the only post with it) and deletes the post. The admin Tags list shows #harbour with 0 posts; the admin deletes it, the pivot row cascades. The author restores the post within the restore window and it comes back without its tag.

findings.claim: Both generated-suggestion save handlers treat a response with saved: 0 as a transport failure, so a save in which every row was skipped is reported as 'the server did not answer' and its outcomes are never applied.
findings.reasoning: TranslationCenterPage::saveGenerated/saveAllGenerated return ['saved' => true, ...$action->handle(...)] (TranslationCenterPage.php:204-206, 219-221); the spread overrides 'saved' with SaveProjectTranslationGenerationAction's integer count (SaveProjectTranslationGenerationAction.php:122-127). The browser checks `if (! result?.saved)` in saveAll (script.blade.php:739) and saveGeneratedRow (771), so saved === 0 takes the failure branch: toast 'Nothing was saved: the server did not answer. Try again.' and applySaved()/applyGeneration() are skipped. The server has already marked those items Skipped in the store (handle(), resolve() at line 121).
findings.scenario: Another administrator saves the translations meanwhile (already_translated) or the English changes after the rows were filled (source_changed); Save all (or Save on one such row) returns saved: 0. The page says the server did not answer, keeps showing the suggestions as ready, and a retry fails again with a not-ready refusal until reload.

findings.claim: switchTo() drops every volatile draft before the locale $set succeeds, so a failed switch loses them.
findings.reasoning: switchTo calls this.dropVolatile() (script.blade.php:910, resetting each volatile row via reset() at 391-397) before Promise.resolve(this.server().$set('locale', code)); the catch only restores the locale and polling (915-921). Livewire 4 rejects the action promise on a failed request (livewire.esm.js rejectPromise). The administrator did confirm 'Switching ... drops them' (switchText, 895-900), so the loss only matters when the switch then fails and the page stays on the old language.
findings.scenario: Admin has 3 edited rows, chooses another language, confirms 'Discard and switch'; the request fails (network/server error). The page stays on the old language with the toast 'The language was not switched', but the 3 drafts are gone.

findings.claim: A poll in flight when the component is destroyed still applies its result and schedules another timer, so the replaced Alpine instance can keep polling the old locale.
findings.reasoning: destroy() only clears pollTimer and the visibility listener (script.blade.php:107-110); poll() has no 'destroyed' guard and always ends with schedulePoll() (654-685), which re-arms while generationRunning (645-651). Livewire 4 defers an action while one is in flight for the same component, so a poll fired during a slow locale $set is sent after it and resolves after destroy() ran, re-arming a timer on the detached instance with the captured $wire.
findings.scenario: During a running background generation, the admin switches language and the re-render takes over a second; the old instance's poll lands after destroy() and keeps calling generationStatus(oldLocale) every second until that batch finishes, adding a request per second that also serialises ahead of the new page's own actions.

findings.claim: An in-flight generation poll can overwrite a newer Save all or Discard result with stale batch state.
findings.reasoning: All these calls go to the same page component through the captured $wire and none is #[Async]. Livewire 4 defers an action while a message for the same component is active and fires it on finish (livewire.esm.js coordinateNetworkInteractions: action.defer(); onFinish → action.fire()). So a poll sent before Save all is answered and applied before Save all is even sent, and a poll fired during Save all is sent after it and reads the new state (its stale version simply misses the 'unchanged' shortcut, TranslationCenterPage.php:174-182). Responses cannot be applied out of order.
findings.resolution_ru: Опрос генерации в полёте может перезаписать результат Save all или Discard устаревшим состоянием. Итог: бот ошибся: все вызовы идут в один компонент без #[Async], Livewire 4 откладывает действие, пока идёт запрос того же компонента, и ответы не применяются вне порядка.

findings.claim: A late context() response can open the wrong row, or reopen the drawer after it was dismissed, because openContext has no request token.
findings.reasoning: context() calls are serialised per component by Livewire 4 (a second call is deferred until the first finishes), so two clicks resolve in click order and the last row clicked is the one left open (script.blade.php:863-873). The drawer only exists once a response sets this.context (context.blade.php:17 <template x-if="context">), so it cannot be dismissed before its own request returns; the only 're-open' is the response to a Context click the admin made after the first, which is the row they asked for.
findings.resolution_ru: Поздний ответ context() может открыть не ту строку или снова открыть закрытый drawer. Итог: бот ошибся: Livewire 4 выполняет вызовы context() по очереди, открытой остаётся последняя кликнутая строка; drawer появляется только после ответа, закрыть его раньше нельзя.

findings.claim: Switching language resets an edited background suggestion only in the browser, so the server's suggestion comes back on return or reload.
findings.reasoning: That is the documented behaviour: 'What switching language drops: the volatile drafts only. Background suggestions stay on the server and come back with the language' (script.blade.php:389-390), and the header says typing in a background suggestion makes it a volatile edit and only volatile drafts are lost by leaving or switching (lines 15-23). The design contract scopes server-side discarding to Discard / Discard generated (design-contract.md:738), not to a language switch, which the admin confirms only for the volatile edits (switchText).
findings.resolution_ru: Смена языка сбрасывает отредактированное фоновое предложение только в браузере, с сервера оно вернётся. Итог: бот ошибся, это документированное поведение: при смене языка теряются только volatile черновики, фоновые предложения остаются на сервере, сброс через Discard.

findings.claim: A successful Save all overwrites, via stored(), a newer draft typed into a row while the save was pending.
findings.reasoning: saveAll() sets only generationBusy (script.blade.php:720-737); the fields stay editable because readonly is bound to units[unit].saving || waiting(unit) (row.blade.php:100,121), neither of which saveAll sets. Typing calls edited() (persisted=false) but the server still saves the stored suggestion for that unit, and applySaved() then calls this.stored(item.unit, item.value) (799), replacing the typed text without a warning.
findings.scenario: Admin confirms Save all for 200 suggestions; while the request runs they start correcting one of those rows; when the response lands the correction vanishes and the row shows the AI text as Saved.

findings.claim: Manual Save should send the draft's original value and be rejected when the stored translation changed meanwhile.
findings.reasoning: Last write wins is the documented contract for a manual save: 'A save replaces whatever the language stored. A caller that chose its text from an earlier read — a background AI suggestion ... — saves with handleGuarded() instead' (UpdateProjectTranslationAction.php:39-42). Only machine-chosen text is guarded (translation-engine.md:165-167); an administrator's typed save is intentionally unconditional.
findings.resolution_ru: Ручное сохранение должно отклоняться, если сохранённый перевод тем временем изменился. Итог: бот ошибся: для ручного сохранения документирован last write wins; через handleGuarded() защищается только текст, выбранный машиной, а сохранение администратора безусловно.

findings.claim: The placeholder-chip loop reuses $placeholder, so rows with placeholders show the last token as the field's placeholder text.
findings.reasoning: $placeholder = 'Missing · type a translation or use AI translate' (row.blade.php:26) is overwritten by @foreach ($row['placeholders'] as $placeholder) (50) before the textarea/input use placeholder="{{ $placeholder }}" (95, 115). For any unit with placeholders the empty field shows e.g. ':count' instead of the instruction.
findings.scenario: A missing translation of a string with ':name' shows ':name' greyed out in its empty field, which reads like pre-filled content rather than the 'Missing · type a translation…' hint.

findings.claim: After Refresh adds a model, the combobox keeps its key, so its Alpine maps are stale and searching the new model shows 'No model matches' beside the match.
findings.reasoning: The key is built from period and selected model only (translation-ai.blade.php:35). The combobox's searches/display maps live in x-data (components/admin/ui/combobox.blade.php:67-70) and are not re-evaluated on a morph, while option elements are re-rendered with their own matches() call (233-242). anyShown reads the stale searches map (93-95), so the empty text (269) appears with a visible new option, and display[active] lacks its id for aria-activedescendant.
findings.scenario: A new model is used while the page is open; the admin clicks Refresh and searches for it: the option is listed but the status line says 'No model matches.' and screen readers get no active descendant.

findings.claim: Choosing a model re-keys the combobox, replacing the focused trigger and dropping keyboard focus.
findings.reasoning: pick() returns focus to the trigger (combobox.blade.php:141-156) and the choose handler calls $wire.set('model', …) (translation-ai.blade.php:36); the re-render changes wire:key (md5($selectedModel), line 35), so the element holding focus is replaced and focus falls to <body>. Translation Center handles the same situation explicitly (window.rgAdminTranslationCenterRefocus, script.blade.php:96-100); this screen does not.
findings.scenario: A keyboard user opens the AI model combobox, picks a model with Enter; after the round trip focus is on the document body and they must tab from the top of the page.
findings.reconsidered_because: Livewire gives the focus back to the new trigger.
findings.resolution_ru: Выбор модели пересоздаёт комбобокс Translation AI, и фокус клавиатуры теряется. Итог: оставили как есть, Livewire возвращает фокус новому триггеру.

findings.claim: Tag search should apply the same Unicode case folding on both sides so context-dependent Greek sigma does not miss a tag.
findings.reasoning: Rows carry mb_strtolower(name.slug) (ManageTags.php:282) and the query is lowercased with toLowerCase() (taxonomy/search-script.blade.php:23-28); both apply final-sigma rules, so the only miss is an uppercase Greek prefix ending in Σ matching a medial σ. Tag names here are the English reference (tags.blade.php:26), making the case negligible; not worth a change.
findings.resolution_ru: Поиск тегов должен одинаково применять Unicode case folding, чтобы греческая сигма не мешала. Итог: верно в теории, но обе стороны учитывают конечную сигму, промах возможен только для заглавного греческого префикса на Σ, а имена тегов здесь английские. Не меняем.

findings.claim: The slug warning compares the raw slug field, so clearing it warns that links will break even when the slug made from the name is unchanged.
findings.reasoning: The warning fires on $draftSlug !== $original (drawer.blade.php:15-19). On save a blank slug becomes null (ManageTags.php:139) and UpdateTagAction derives it from the name (UpdateTagAction.php:25 → CreateTagAction::slug), which equals the original whenever the original slug was generated from the unchanged name.
findings.scenario: Admin unlocks the slug of #sunbathing, clears the field (meaning 'make it from the name'); the drawer warns that feed links break, although saving keeps 'sunbathing'.

findings.claim: stop() does not require the confirmation state, so a direct call cancels all remaining actions without the confirmation.
findings.reasoning: stop() resets $confirmingStop and runs StopStudioPlanAction without checking it (StudioPlanActionPlan.php:110-129), while askToStop() is what draws the dialog (99-102). The caller is still an authorised administrator (boot() gate, line 65; the action re-authorises), so this is not an authorization gap, but other confirmations in the same area refuse a call that was not asked (ListStudioPlans::delete 141-145, StudioPlanDiscussionEditor::confirmGenerate 433-440 'never a way around it').
findings.scenario: A replayed or scripted wire call to stop (or a stale button) cancels every pending action of an approved plan for good without the 'Stop the remaining actions?' step.

findings.claim: EditStudioPlan::delete() never checks $confirmingDelete, so the 'asked first' deletion can be invoked directly.
findings.reasoning: delete() clears confirmingDelete and deletes with the editor's lockVersion (EditStudioPlan.php:405-431) whatever askToDelete() set (390-393); the list's delete() refuses without a confirmation in progress (ListStudioPlans.php:141-145). Authorization and the version check still apply, so only the confirmation step can be skipped.
findings.scenario: A direct or replayed delete call from the editor deletes the draft (and releases its photo) without the 'Delete this draft?' dialog.

findings.claim: The action plan should keep polling pending plans while the executor is off.
findings.reasoning: Not polling while the executor is off is the stated design: 'while the executor is on and any of the plan's actions waits, is sent or runs, it alone is read again every few seconds' and 'Nothing moves while the executor is off' (StudioPlanActionPlan.php:33-36, 154-155). With the executor off no action runs, so there is nothing for a poll to follow.
findings.resolution_ru: План действий должен продолжать опрос pending планов при выключенном исполнителе. Итог: бот ошибся: отсутствие опроса при выключенном исполнителе это заявленный дизайн; при выключенном исполнителе ничего не выполняется и следить опросу не за чем.

findings.claim: The executor-off notice should say already-published content stays published and running actions may finish.
findings.reasoning: Copy suggestion for the notice text (studio-plan-action-plan.blade.php:46-49); no behaviour is wrong.
findings.resolution_ru: Уведомление о выключенном исполнителе должно говорить, что опубликованное остаётся, а начатое может завершиться. Итог: это предложение по тексту уведомления, поведение верное.

findings.claim: The plans list hides the not_persona author problem that StudioPlanFormat::author() reports and approval rejects.
findings.reasoning: StudioPlanFormat::author() returns problem 'not_persona' when the author's role is no longer Persona (StudioPlanFormat.php:98-101) and approval preflight rejects it (StudioPlanApprovalProblem::AuthorNotPersona). The row styles only 'deleted' and appends the status only for 'restricted' (row.blade.php:39-41), while the editor (studio-plan/post.blade.php:170) and the votes tables mark 'Not a persona'.
findings.scenario: An author account is turned back into a member; the plans list still shows that author normally, and the admin only learns why the plan can't be approved after opening it.

findings.claim: The stepper buttons send an absolute count rendered into the markup, so quick repeated clicks before the response collapse into one step.
findings.reasoning: Each button carries setVotes(node, way, count±1) computed at render (vote-count.blade.php:8, 21) and the server assigns it as is (StudioPlanDiscussionVotesEditor::setVotes, 327-337). A second click before the re-render is deferred by Livewire and re-sends the same absolute value. The draft count is visible and nothing is written outside the editor, so the effect is a lost click.
findings.scenario: Admin double-clicks + on '5 up votes on C1' and gets 6, not 7.

findings.claim: Restricted users see enabled comment vote buttons that always fail; votingDisabled should include canVote() as PostVoting does.
findings.reasoning: CommentVoting disables only for the author's own comment (CommentVoting.php:78), whereas PostVoting disables when the user may not vote (PostVoting.php:102,109). VoteCommentAction refuses users with ! canVote() (VoteCommentAction.php:41-42), so clicks by a limited/banned user only produce an error message.
findings.scenario: A limited member sees active up/down arrows on every comment; each click returns 'not allowed'.

findings.claim: Moderation-hidden comments still render their score and enabled vote controls.
findings.reasoning: Hidden comments are not drawn with voting: comment-item renders a tombstone with no votes or actions for a removed comment (components/comments/comment-item.blade.php:1-14), and CommentVoting is only mounted inside a visible comment (line 113-117). A component left on screen after a later hide is refused by VoteCommentAction (canReceiveVotes, VoteCommentAction.php:45-46), which is the authoritative check; the score of a comment already shown on the page is not sensitive.
findings.resolution_ru: Скрытые модерацией комментарии показывают счёт и активные кнопки голосования. Итог: бот ошибся: скрытый комментарий рисуется заглушкой без голосов, CommentVoting есть только у видимого; голос за скрытый позже отклонит VoteCommentAction, а показанный счёт не секретен.

findings.claim: The Users table always shows initials and never the stored avatar.
findings.reasoning: Nothing is lost: avatars are untouched; the admin lists consistently draw initials (ListUsers.php:203, ListPosts.php:422, ListComments.php:287, ListReports.php:341/352). Showing photos is a design change, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Таблица Users всегда показывает инициалы, а не сохранённый аватар. Итог: ничего не теряется, аватары не тронуты, а все списки админки последовательно рисуют инициалы. Показ фото это изменение дизайна, а не дефект.

findings.claim: Dismissing the user editor drawer should be blocked while it has unsaved changes.
findings.reasoning: Documented behaviour: 'Cancel, Escape and the scrim close it' and only leaving the page asks (user-editor.blade.php:5-12); the design contract says Escape, the scrim, the close button and Cancel hide a drawer at once and dispatch dismiss (design-contract.md:480-483, 493-496).
findings.resolution_ru: Закрытие drawer редактора пользователя надо блокировать при несохранённых изменениях. Итог: бот ошибся, это документированное поведение: Cancel, Escape и фон закрывают drawer сразу, как требует design-contract.md, а спрашивает только уход со страницы.

findings.claim: After Mark trusted is confirmed in the editor, the trust radio and its baseline still say 'Not trusted', so choosing Not trusted registers no change.
findings.reasoning: UserEditor::confirmSanction() applies the action and notifies the list (UserEditor.php:227-231) but leaves $saved['trust'] and $trust as drawn at mount (105-106, 316-330). save() sends trusted only when $trust differs from $saved['trust'] (144), so after marking trusted, picking 'Not trusted' equals the stale baseline and is sent as null (no change), while the radio shows 'Not trusted' before any edit.
findings.scenario: Admin marks a member trusted from the drawer, realises it was the wrong person and selects 'Not trusted' + Save: the toast says saved, the member stays trusted.

findings.claim: parseFloat accepts a numeric prefix, so '12x' is saved as 12.
findings.reasoning: commit() uses Number.parseFloat (offset-field.blade.php:22) and only rejects NaN/negative (25), so '2h' typed while the unit is min saves 2 minutes. Infinity is harmless (JSON null fails is_numeric server-side), so only the lenient prefix parse matters.
findings.scenario: Admin types '2h' in a field set to minutes expecting two hours; the vote is moved to +2 min without any error.

findings.claim: A rejected setMoment request leaves the typed offset in the field as if saved.
findings.reasoning: commit() only handles success: Promise.resolve($call).then(() => input.value = this.value) (offset-field.blade.php:27); Livewire 4 rejects the promise on a failed request, so the field keeps the unsaved value and the rejection is unhandled.
findings.scenario: The request fails (expired session / network); the offset field shows '+45' while the plan still holds '+30'.

findings.claim: The unit radiogroup lacks arrow-key navigation and roving focus.
findings.reasoning: The units are role=radio buttons in a role=radiogroup with click handlers only (offset-field.blade.php:43-47); every button is a tab stop and arrows do nothing. The design contract requires radiogroups to have only the checked option as a tab stop with arrows/Home/End moving the choice (design-contract.md:427-428), as x-admin.ui.segmented implements (segmented.blade.php:52-55).
findings.scenario: A screen-reader user hears 'radio group', presses Right Arrow and nothing changes.

findings.claim: The priority radiogroup lacks roving focus and arrow-key selection.
findings.reasoning: Priority chips are role=radio buttons calling setPriority on click only (discussion-votes-editor.blade.php:184-189), contrary to the radiogroup keyboard contract (design-contract.md:427-428) that x-admin.ui.segmented implements.
findings.scenario: Keyboard users cannot move between Low/Normal/High with arrows; each chip is a separate tab stop.

findings.claim: The shared avatar partial should use loading=lazy.
findings.reasoning: The images are the avatars of the few Personas in a plan, repeated across rows; the browser fetches each distinct URL once. Negligible gain.
findings.resolution_ru: Общий partial аватара должен использовать loading=lazy. Итог: это аватары нескольких персон плана, повторяющиеся по строкам, и браузер грузит каждый URL один раз. Выигрыш пренебрежимый.

findings.claim: The top-tags sidebar cache is never invalidated and can be stale for five minutes.
findings.reasoning: It is a deliberate 300-second TTL cache (AppServiceProvider.php:185-198), the same as the sidebar categories (147); staleness is bounded and only affects which five tag links show. Wiring invalidation into every post/tag write costs more than it is worth.
findings.resolution_ru: Кэш топ-тегов в сайдбаре не сбрасывается и может устаревать на пять минут. Итог: это намеренный кэш с TTL 300 секунд, как у категорий сайдбара; устаревание ограничено и влияет только на пять ссылок тегов. Сброс при каждой записи стоит дороже пользы.

findings.claim: Tag search loads the whole tag table and filters in PHP on every keystroke.
findings.reasoning: tagChoices() reads id/name of all tags (EditsStudioPlan.php:1148-1163). Tags are an admin-curated, bounded list (ManageTags.php:31 'The list is bounded and already on the page'), so the query is small; moving it to SQL is an optimisation, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Поиск тегов грузит всю таблицу тегов и фильтрует в PHP на каждое нажатие. Итог: верно, но теги это ограниченный список, который ведут администраторы, и запрос маленький; перенос в SQL это оптимизация, а не дефект.

findings.claim: On mobile the selected post renders in both the hidden inline drawer and the mobile overlay, duplicating id='comment-body'.
findings.reasoning: The feed selects a post for the inline split column only on a desktop (feed-page.blade.php:68, window.innerWidth >= 1024) and the mobile overlay loads a post only below the breakpoint and never hears server selections (post-drawer.blade.php:40-48; PostDrawer::getListeners docblock 37-47). selectedPostId is not URL-bound (FeedPage.php:43), so in normal use only one comment form exists; duplication needs a mid-session resize across 1024px.
findings.resolution_ru: На мобильном выбранный пост рендерится и в скрытом drawer, и в оверлее, дублируя id='comment-body'. Итог: бот ошибся: лента выбирает пост для колонки только на десктопе, оверлей работает только на мобильном и не слушает сервер; дубль лишь при resize через 1024px.

findings.claim: Clearing the author on the page leaves the saved author active in the votes editor because followAuthor('') cannot express 'pending no author'.
findings.reasoning: followAuthor() maps '' to null and computes $toBe = $id !== $this->authorId ? $id : null (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:603-604); null already means 'no pending change', so the call returns at 606-608 and the editor keeps authorId as the author (render 777-782), still excluding that Persona from voters and labelling it 'author'.
findings.scenario: Admin clears Night Owl as author (unsaved): the Votes tab still shows 'Night Owl · author' and keeps Night Owl out of the voter pool until the draft is saved/reloaded.
findings.reconsidered_because: the label stays true of the saved plan.
findings.resolution_ru: Пока снятие автора не сохранено, редактор голосов поста показывает сохранённого автора. Итог: оставили как есть, подпись верна для сохранённого плана.

findings.claim: The vote-count steppers and voter-mode control stay enabled when the editor is not writable, producing 'Not saved' with Discard disabled.
findings.reasoning: Most controls carry :disabled="! $editable" (post-votes-editor.blade.php:98,105,283,417), but the voter-mode segmented (84), voterCount stepper (87-95) and up/down steppers (289-290) do not. commit() returns early when ! writable() (StudioPlanPostVotesEditor.php:955-961) while render sets unsaved from the changed settings (776), so the strip says 'Not saved · … or Discard' while Discard is disabled (417), and leaving the step prompts.
findings.scenario: After a conflict, closed or deleted draft, the admin changes the up-vote count: nothing is saved, the editor shows 'Not saved', Discard is greyed out, and Back/Continue ask about a change that can never be saved.

findings.claim: The post-votes editor has no beforeunload warning for an unsaved change.
findings.reasoning: The comment-votes editor warns on unload when $wire.unsaved (studio-plan-discussion-votes-editor.blade.php:28) and the page's own handler counts only the plan draft (studio-plan.blade.php:57); the post-votes editor's root (post-votes-editor.blade.php:44-50) has no such handler, so a change that could not be saved is dropped silently on reload or navigation away (only the step buttons ask, studio-plan.blade.php:47-48).
findings.scenario: Admin sets answer counts that cannot be built yet ('Not saved'), then closes the tab: no browser prompt, the change is gone.

findings.claim: The fixed-height sticky desktop sidebar has no vertical scrolling, so content past the viewport is unreachable.
findings.reasoning: The aside is lg:sticky lg:top-[60px] lg:h-[calc(100vh-60px)] with no overflow-y (app-sidebar.blade.php:1), and its content is unbounded: 4-6 nav items, every active category (AppServiceProvider.php:147-161), top tags and the footer links pushed down by mt-auto (app-sidebar-content.blade.php:1-57). The mobile panel has overflow-y-auto (app.blade.php:292); the desktop one does not.
findings.scenario: On a 1366x768 laptop (≈600px aside) with a handful of categories plus tags, the About/Terms/Privacy/Contact links and the last categories sit below the viewport and stay there while the page scrolls under the sticky aside.

findings.claim: Links opened in a new tab close the overlay sidebar without restoring focus, leaving focus on a hidden link.
findings.reasoning: Every nav link calls hide(false) (sidebar.blade.php:155), skipping focus restoration (hide(), 24-35). That is right for same-tab navigation, but newTab items (target=_blank, 154) keep the current page, where focus stays on a link inside the now-hidden overlay; the header promises focus returns to the opener (lines 4-6).
findings.scenario: On a narrow screen an admin opens the menu and follows a 'new tab' item; back on the admin tab, focus is on an invisible element and Tab continues from inside the hidden sidebar.
findings.reconsidered_because: no navigation item opens in a new tab.
findings.resolution_ru: Ссылка, открытая в новой вкладке, закрывает боковое меню без возврата фокуса. Итог: оставили как есть, ни один пункт меню не открывается в новой вкладке.

findings.claim: Generate tree ignores pending comment-vote edits and can replace the discussion without confirmation.
findings.reasoning: Replacing an existing tree always asks first: generateTree() sets confirmingGenerate when the plan has discussion nodes (StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:405-418) and confirmGenerate() only proceeds from that state (433-444). Without a tree there are no comment votes to lose. The design contract lists exactly what Generate waits for — unsaved post changes or a generation on its way (design-contract.md:1114-1116) — and the comment-vote 'unsaved' state is a change that could not be saved anyway.
findings.resolution_ru: Generate tree игнорирует несохранённые голоса комментариев и может заменить обсуждение без подтверждения. Итог: бот ошибся: замена существующего дерева всегда спрашивает подтверждение, без дерева голосов нет, а несохранённые голоса и так нельзя было сохранить.

findings.claim: Discussion settings stay editable while conflicted and their updates are persisted.
findings.reasoning: The settings (counts, mode, tone) are generation inputs kept only in the session per plan (rememberSettings → session(), StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1607-1621), never written to the plan; the conflict concerns the plan row. Generation itself is refused while not writable (readyToGenerate → writablePlan, 1219-1224), so a conflicted editor cannot persist anything to the plan through them.
findings.resolution_ru: Настройки обсуждения редактируемы при конфликте и сохраняются. Итог: бот ошибся: счётчики, режим и тон это входы генерации, они хранятся только в сессии и в план не пишутся, а саму генерацию при конфликте отклоняет readyToGenerate.

findings.claim: Try again should save unsaved post changes first and then generate, like Generate tree.
findings.reasoning: Try again passes the page's change count to generateTree (discussion-editor.blade.php:220), and the server refuses with 'Save the post first: the discussion is written from the saved title and description.' (readyToGenerate, StudioPlanDiscussionEditor.php:1225-1229). Behaviour is safe and explained; save-then-retry is a convenience.
findings.resolution_ru: Try again должен сначала сохранять изменения поста, как Generate tree. Итог: верно в теории, но сервер отклоняет запрос с понятным 'Save the post first'; поведение безопасное и объяснено, сохранение с повтором было бы лишь удобством.

findings.claim: The comment dialog's offset field can show a cleared or invalid value while Save still saves the previous offset.
findings.reasoning: set() ignores NaN/negative input and returns without touching dialogSeconds (discussion-editor.blade.php:417-423), so after clearing the field or typing 'abc' the input shows that text while Save (452) sends the last valid dialogSeconds; nothing marks the field invalid. The hint keeps describing the old value, which is the only clue.
findings.scenario: Admin clears the time to retype it, gets distracted, clicks Save: the comment keeps its old moment although the field was empty.

findings.claim: An out-of-range page shows 'No people match' and hides pagination instead of clamping to the last page.
findings.reasoning: ListUsers paginates with pageNumber as is (ListUsers.php:163; normalize only enforces >= 1, 226) and the view draws the empty state with no pagination when $rows is empty (users.blade.php:74-104). ListPersonas clamps (ListPersonas.php:137-140).
findings.scenario: Admin is on page 3 of Limited and restores access for the last people on it; the list now says 'No people match' with no pager, although pages 1-2 still hold limited users (same for an old ?page= link).

findings.claim: A persona deleted while the drawer is open makes the next render dereference a null $persona.
findings.reasoning: $persona is null only if the users row no longer exists, and account deletion never removes it: 'Normal account deletion never physically deletes the users row' (docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:149-151). A deleted or demoted persona is still found, so render() passes personaDetails (PersonaEditor.php:107-116) and the gone notice shows (persona-editor.blade.php:38-43).
findings.resolution_ru: Персона, удалённая при открытом drawer, даст null $persona при рендере. Итог: бот ошибся: $persona null, только если строки users нет, а удаление аккаунта её физически не удаляет; удалённая или пониженная персона находится, и показывается уведомление.

findings.claim: For a new persona the 'Keep the current photo' label is wrong after choosing a photo.
findings.reasoning: Button copy only (persona-editor.blade.php:71-73); clearPhoto behaves correctly.
findings.resolution_ru: Для новой персоны подпись 'Keep the current photo' неверна после выбора фото. Итог: это только текст кнопки, clearPhoto работает правильно.

findings.claim: The admin search input should expose aria-expanded.
findings.reasoning: Accessibility polish: the field is not a combobox (no role), result counts are already announced by a polite live region (global-search.blade.php:46-50), and aria-expanded alone on a search input is not the full pattern.
findings.resolution_ru: Поле поиска в админке должно выставлять aria-expanded. Итог: это доработка доступности: поле не combobox, количество результатов уже озвучивает polite live region, а один aria-expanded на поле поиска полного паттерна не даёт.

findings.claim: The mounted theme switchers do not synchronise their selected state when another switcher changes the theme.
findings.reasoning: The layout mounts several ThemeSwitcher instances (app.blade.php:133 dropdown, 231 guest header, 335 mobile nav). setThemePreference updates only its own $preference and dispatches 'theme-preference-changed' (ThemeSwitcher.php:23-42), which no switcher listens to, so the others keep the old aria-pressed/highlight.
findings.scenario: On a desktop the user picks Dark in the user menu, then narrows the window and opens the mobile menu: its switcher still shows System as selected.

findings.claim: The mobile navigation drawer declares aria-modal but does not move, trap or restore focus.
findings.reasoning: The drawer is role=dialog aria-modal=true (app.blade.php:268-279) shown with x-show only; there is no x-trap, initial focus or return to the trigger (36), so Tab walks into the page behind a dialog that tells assistive technology the rest is inert.
findings.scenario: A keyboard user opens the menu with the hamburger, presses Tab and lands on header/page links hidden behind the overlay; Escape closes it but focus is left wherever it was.

findings.claim: The authenticated upload button has no accessible name below the sm breakpoint.
findings.reasoning: The button's only text is <span class="hidden sm:inline"> (app.blade.php:77-84) and x-ui.icon is aria-hidden (components/ui/icon.blade.php:46), so on phones it is an unnamed button; the guest button sets aria-label from uploadCtaLabel() (196).
findings.scenario: A screen-reader user on a phone hears just 'button' for the upload action.

findings.claim: If Livewire's _startUpload request fails, the photo phase never resets and the analysis card stays on 'Uploading photo…'.
findings.reasoning: send() calls $wire.upload with finish() on success/error/cancel (image.blade.php:63-79), but Livewire's UploadManager.startUpload fires $wire.call('_startUpload') with no error path; the error callback runs only on 'upload:errored' or a failed XHR to the signed URL (livewire.esm.js UploadManager makeRequest/markUploadErrored). A failed _startUpload leaves phase 'uploading', so the card (analysis-card.blade.php:28-29) and the image step stay busy until reload.
findings.scenario: The session expired or the server errors on the first upload request: the Image step shows 'Uploading photo…' forever, refuses another photo (busy) and Continue waits.

findings.claim: Repeated Generate clicks while the author change is saving dispatch several save-and-suggest continuations.
findings.reasoning: Extra continuations are harmless: Livewire serialises the saves, a second save with nothing changed goes straight to generateAfterSave (EditStudioPlan.php:194-203), and RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction returns the batch already queued or running instead of starting another (RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction.php:64, 114-124). No duplicate paid request results.
findings.resolution_ru: Повторные клики Generate во время сохранения автора запускают несколько продолжений save-and-suggest. Итог: бот ошибся, лишние продолжения безвредны: Livewire выполняет сохранения по очереди, а RequestStudioPostTextGenerationAction возвращает уже поставленный пакет.

findings.claim: The PR description should fill in the Summary and mark the template checklists not applicable.
findings.reasoning: PR-description check on a review-only PR; not about the code.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR надо заполнить Summary и отметить чек-листы как неприменимые. Итог: это проверка описания служебного review PR, к коду отношения не имеет.

findings.claim: IMPORT_FROM_URL_ENABLED=false does not disable URL imports because nothing reads import.enabled; only the project flag allow_url_imports is checked.
findings.reasoning: `config('import.enabled')` has no reader anywhere in app/ (git log -S finds none ever); ImportFromUrlAction.php:35 and ImportUrlForm.php:80 gate only on the project flag `allow_url_imports`, which defaults to true (ProjectSettingsManager.php:45, pinned by ImportFeatureFlagTest 'default true'). Yet every target template ships IMPORT_FROM_URL_ENABLED=false and environment-contract.json's Import section says 'Off by default, and off is a decision rather than an oversight: the importer fetches a caller-supplied address from the server'. Worse, UploadPostForm::submit (UploadPostForm.php:90-92) downloads the client-settable public `$importedImageUrl` through StoreImportedImageAction with no check of either switch.
findings.scenario: An operator deploys a target with the shipped IMPORT_FROM_URL_ENABLED=false believing server-side URL fetching is off; any signed-in user can still paste a URL (or set importedImageUrl over the Livewire wire) and make the server fetch arbitrary public https/http hosts on ports 80/443. The SSRF guards (public-IP validation + pinned transport) still apply, but the declared kill switch does nothing.

findings.claim: Sentry cache spans and cache breadcrumbs transmit raw cache keys, and the login throttle key contains the email address and client IP.
findings.reasoning: AuthenticateUserAction.php:77-79 builds the throttle key as `Str::lower($email).'|'.$request->ip()` and RateLimiter does not hash it (RateLimiter::cleanRateLimiterKey only htmlentities it; RateLimiter::attempts does `$this->cache->get($key)`). sentry-laravel 4.29 CacheIntegration::handleCacheEventsForTracing sets the span description and `cache.key` data to the raw key, and handleCacheEventsForBreadcrumbs records 'Read: <key>'; config/sentry.php:159 and :221 leave both on (pinned by SentryConfigurationTest:170-178) and there is no before_send/before_breadcrumb scrubber. NightwatchPrivacy.php:93-105 documents exactly this key as the reason Nightwatch uses a cache-key allowlist, but nothing equivalent exists for Sentry, contradicting the runbook's 'no email ... IP address ... is collected' (sentry-observability.md:146-149).
findings.scenario: On staging (SENTRY_TRACES_SAMPLE_RATE=1.0) every login attempt, and on production 10% of them, sends a transaction whose cache.get/cache.put spans carry 'victim@example.com|203.0.113.7' — including failed attempts for arbitrary emails; any error during a login request also carries the same string as a breadcrumb.

findings.claim: Turning allow_guest_viewing off does not require sign-in: the feed, post, share and profile routes, and the feed's user-search results, stay public.
findings.reasoning: allow_guest_viewing is defined (ProjectSettingsManager.php:44) and switched in Project settings with a guarded 'Require sign-in for everyone?' confirmation. ProjectSettingsPage.php:76 describes it as 'Off means every page asks to sign in'. Nothing reads it: grep finds no featureEnabled('allow_guest_viewing') in app/, routes/, middleware or views. The public routes at web.php:24-29 (FeedPage, PostShow, SharePostController, ProfilePage) have no auth gate, and FeedPage::matchedUsers() (FeedPage.php:269-278) returns user results to anyone. docs/admin/project-settings.md:122 says the flag controls whether guests can see the feed, and no test covers guests with it off. The setting is presented as access control but has no effect, the same pattern as the allow_user_uploads bypass triaged as a BUG in batch 15.
findings.scenario: An operator running a closed community turns allow_guest_viewing off and confirms the dialog. A logged-out visitor, or a search-engine crawler, can still open /, /posts/{id}, /u/{username} and search users, so all content stays public.

findings.claim: The post page and post drawer show the author's account name instead of their chosen display name, which can expose a real name the user replaced.
findings.reasoning: docs/profile/profile-2.md:19 says display_name 'Overrides name in public display', and User::getResolvedDisplayNameAttribute (User.php:362-369) implements display_name ?: name ?: username. ProfilePage's header follows that rule. The linked-author branches print $post->user->name instead: link text at post-show.blade.php:65 and post-drawer-content.blade.php:42, avatar name at :57 and :34. Only the else branches use resolved_display_name. Social sign-up fills name with the provider's full name (RegisterSocialUserAction.php:42-49), so name is often a real name. The same raw ->name is used in components/feed/post-card.blade.php:34,41 and components/comments/comment-item.blade.php:26,29,40. Personas work around this by setting name equal to display_name (PersonaPublicPresenceTest.php:24-25).
findings.scenario: A user signs up with Google as 'Ivan Petrov' and sets the display name 'rater42' to stay pseudonymous. Their profile shows 'rater42', but every post page, post drawer, feed card and comment shows 'Ivan Petrov', and the avatar initials match.

findings.claim: The standalone post page mounts the comment thread and comment form even when the show_comments feature flag is off.
findings.reasoning: post-show.blade.php:289-295 renders <livewire:comments.comments-section> unconditionally, while the same view gates only the comment-count button (:144), and the drawer gates its thread (post-drawer-content.blade.php:241) and the card its button (post-card.blade.php:112). CommentsSection, CommentForm and AddCommentAction never read the flag (no featureEnabled/show_comments anywhere under app/Livewire/Comments or app/Actions/Comments). The documented intent is the admin description at app/Filament/Pages/ProjectSettingsPage.php:69: 'Turning this off hides existing comments without deleting them.' FeatureFlagsPublicUiTest only asserts the feed, not posts.show.
findings.scenario: An admin switches show_comments off to hide comment threads; anyone opening /posts/{id} (the canonical URL used by PostUrl, share links and the PostCommented/PostApproved/FollowedAuthorPosted notifications) still sees every existing comment and can post new ones through the form.

findings.claim: The mobile-only overlay's close handler returns early at the desktop breakpoint, so a drawer opened below it leaves the page scroll lock on after a resize, and Escape cannot release it.
findings.reasoning: post-selected adds 'overflow-hidden' to <html> (post-drawer.blade.php:51) when the split view's mobile overlay opens below 1024px. Its request-close-overlay handler starts with 'if (mobileOnly && window.innerWidth >= 1024) return;' (:68), so once the viewport is >= 1024 neither the close button path nor Escape (:89) removes the class, and the host is lg:hidden (:8) so the open panel just disappears. Nothing listens for resize. The lock is released only by clear-selected-post (:82-88), which fires only after a later inline-column selection is closed. Split mode is the default (ProjectSettingsManager.php:41 post_detail_overlay_mode=false).
findings.scenario: On an iPad in portrait (820px) a reader opens a post in the overlay, then rotates to landscape (1180px): the overlay vanishes (lg:hidden) but <html> keeps overflow-hidden, so the feed cannot be scrolled until the reader happens to open and close a post in the desktop column or reloads.

findings.claim: PostFeed's selectedPostId is passed as a non-reactive prop, so selecting or closing a post never updates the selected-card highlight.
findings.reasoning: feed-page.blade.php:119 passes :selected-post-id to PostFeed, whose public $selectedPostId (PostFeed.php:30) has no #[Reactive]; Livewire 4 only pushes changed parent props into a child marked #[Reactive] (vendor SupportReactiveProps), and the child's key (:120) hashes only the filters, so it is never remounted on selection. The card's highlight comes solely from that prop (post-feed.blade.php:38 -> post-card.blade.php:4 variant 'selected-post'). The comment at feed-page.blade.php:66 states the selected card is meant to be marked.
findings.scenario: Clicking a card opens the detail column but the card never gets the selected styling; and if a filter change remounts PostFeed while post A is selected, A is highlighted and stays highlighted after the drawer is closed.

findings.claim: Switching image tabs leaves the client preview out of sync with the server: the URL tab clears the uploaded file server-side but the file tab keeps showing it.
findings.reasoning: The URL tab button runs wire:click="$set('image', null)" (:86) but leaves Alpine previewUrl/fileName and the file input's value untouched; the file-tab preview (:128-130, :145) is driven only by previewUrl/fileName, and the URL tab even shows the file's data: URL as its preview (:160-162). Back on the file tab the preview and file name are shown while UploadPostForm::$image is null, so submit fails the 'image' => required rule (UploadPostForm.php:168-169). Re-picking the same file fires no change event because the input value never changed, so the upload is not re-sent. allow_url_imports is on by default (ProjectSettingsManager.php:45).
findings.scenario: An author picks photo.jpg, clicks the URL tab to look, returns to the file tab: the preview of photo.jpg is still shown, Submit reports 'image field is required', and choosing photo.jpg again in the picker does nothing.

findings.claim: The bell shows only the 10 latest notifications, so older unread ones can't be viewed or marked read, and the badge doesn't reflect the full unread set.
findings.reasoning: Half of the claim is wrong: the badge already counts every unread notification (NotificationBell.php:19-21 `unreadNotifications()->count()`, no limit). The limit to the latest 10 (NotificationBell.php:33-37) is deliberate (docs/design/phase-31-notifications-foundation-review.md: 'Dropdown is limited to latest notifications'). But that limit makes a permanently stuck badge: an unread notification older than the 10 newest is never rendered, so it can't be marked read. No mark-all action, notifications page or pruning exists anywhere in app/ or routes/.
findings.scenario: A post author gets 12 PostCommentedNotification rows and marks the 10 visible ones read. The dropdown still lists those 10 newest, now read, and the badge shows '2' forever with no control that can clear it.

findings.claim: POST /register has no rate limit, so one client can create accounts, and trigger verification mail, without bound.
findings.reasoning: routes/auth.php:21 has no throttle middleware. There are no RateLimiter::for definitions in app/ or bootstrap/, and RegisterUserRequest and RegisterUserAction apply no limit. Each registration fires Registered, which sends a verification mail, and logs in an account that is trusted by default (User::booted sets TRUSTED_LEVEL). Unverified accounts' posts wait for review (CreatePostAction.php:105-107), but per-user limits on votes and comments (ActionRateLimiter) can be multiplied by creating accounts. No docs record a decision to leave registration unthrottled. Other credential routes in the same file use throttle:6,1.
findings.scenario: A script POSTs /register in a loop with generated addresses. It creates thousands of accounts, sends a verification email to each address, and uses the accounts to cast rating and comment votes that each count within their own per-user limit.

findings.claim: The account email can be changed without the current password or confirmation from the old mailbox.
findings.reasoning: ProfileUpdateRequest.php:28-35 validates only format and uniqueness. UpdateUserIdentityAction (lines 17-33) saves the new email at once and only clears email_verified_at. The PATCH /profile route (web.php:71) has no password.confirm middleware, and no notification goes to the old address (grep finds no email-changed mail). The default Breeze behaviour is the same, and no doc records it as a deliberate decision. A stolen session can therefore be turned into a permanent takeover.
findings.scenario: An attacker with a hijacked session changes the email to one they control and then uses forgot-password on the new address. They set a new password, which ends the victim's sessions through the session-generation guard, and the victim cannot recover the account through their own mailbox.

findings.claim: (int) env('REDIS_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER', 90) becomes 0 when the variable is present but blank, as the templates ship it, making reserved jobs immediately re-runnable.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's env() returns '' for `KEY=`, so the cast yields retry_after 0; the staging/production/tits-guru templates and environment-contract.json (value "") ship it blank, although the template header says blank means 'the operator supplies it'. RedisQueue migrates reserved jobs whenever retryAfter is non-null, so with 0 a running job is re-queued at the next pop. Today each target runs a single worker (numprocs=1 in install-bootstrap-services:1109 and rateguru-staging-queue.conf), so no second worker can pick it up concurrently and the impact is currently latent.
findings.scenario: An operator copies the template leaving REDIS_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER blank; once a target runs two or more workers, a translation or media job longer than a second is popped again by the second worker and executes twice.

findings.claim: Blank numeric env values (UPLOAD_IMAGE_*, RATE_LIMIT_*, MEDIA_PURGE_GRACE_DAYS) are cast to 0 instead of falling back to the default.
findings.reasoning: uploads.php:5-16 use max(1,(int) env(...)) so a blank becomes 1 KB/1 px; rate_limits.php:5-21 have no clamp, so max_attempts 0 allows one action per window and decay 0 never accumulates (ActionRateLimiter.php:16-23 via RateLimiter::tooManyAttempts); media.php:81 max(0,...) makes a blank grace period 0 days for the daily media:purge (routes/console.php:16, MediaPurgeCommand.php:65). All of these keys ship explicit values in .env.example and the generated templates (environment-contract.json Upload policy / Rate limits / Filesystem sections), so a blank requires an operator to clear a filled-in value; the contract's own 'Content lifecycle' text even assumes blank means 'the application's own default', which these casts do not honour.
findings.scenario: An operator clears MEDIA_PURGE_GRACE_DAYS= in a host .env; the next daily media:purge force-deletes every soft-deleted, unreferenced asset immediately, eliminating the recovery window. Similarly a blank UPLOAD_IMAGE_MAX_KB rejects every upload over 1 KB.

findings.claim: NIGHTWATCH_REDACT_HEADERS replaces the privacy-critical header list wholesale, and a blank value yields [''] so nothing is redacted.
findings.reasoning: nightwatch.php:125-128 uses raw env() + explode, bypassing the file's own blank-aware $nightwatchString helper (lines 33-41) whose header comment promises blank never 'means something the operator never wrote'; explode(',', '') gives [''], and any partial value drops Authorization/Cookie/X-Forwarded-For. Nightwatch's RequestSensor serialises the full header bag on every sampled request through this list (vendor RequestSensor.php:155). The key is not in any template (environment-contract.json classifies it 'excluded'), and Nightwatch is disabled in all templates, so it takes a deliberate operator edit during an evaluation window.
findings.scenario: During the Nightwatch evaluation an operator adds NIGHTWATCH_REDACT_HEADERS=Referer intending to add one header; session Cookie, X-XSRF-TOKEN and forwarded client IPs are then sent unredacted to Nightwatch for every sampled request.

findings.claim: $nightwatchBool maps any unrecognised value to false, so a typo in NIGHTWATCH_IGNORE_MAIL/NOTIFICATIONS silently turns off a privacy default.
findings.reasoning: nightwatch.php:20 calls filter_var($value, FILTER_VALIDATE_BOOL) without FILTER_NULL_ON_FAILURE, so 'ture' or 'yes ' becomes false instead of the default; the helper exists precisely so a value never means something the operator did not write (lines 5-11). Templates ship 'true' and Nightwatch is disabled in every template, so this needs an operator typo during an evaluation.
findings.scenario: NIGHTWATCH_IGNORE_MAIL=ture on an enabled target makes Nightwatch record mail events including recipient addresses.

findings.claim: $sentryFloat casts non-numeric input such as 'abc' or '0,5' to 0.0, silently dropping all error reports.
findings.reasoning: sentry.php:19-27 only normalises null/'' and then does (float) $value, so a malformed SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE becomes 0.0 and the SDK samples out every error. Templates ship 1.0 and `rateguru:observability:health` prints the effective rate, so this requires an operator typo and is discoverable, but the failure mode (losing all error reporting) is silent at runtime.
findings.scenario: An operator writes SENTRY_SAMPLE_RATE=1,0; after redeploy no backend exception reaches Sentry.

findings.claim: EnsureSessionGenerationIsCurrent is only on the web group, so Filament panel pages never run the session-generation guard.
findings.reasoning: Filament registers panel routes with `$panel->getMiddleware()` (vendor filament routes/web.php:28), not the web group, and AdminPanelProvider.php:156-170 lists neither EnsureSessionGenerationIsCurrent nor EnsureAccountIsNotTombstoned. Practical exposure is small: the generation is bumped only by ClaimAccountWithVerifiedEmailAction (line 117) for an unverified account, which also deletes its database sessions and nulls the password (so AuthenticateSession logs password-holding sessions out), panel access additionally needs an admin/moderator role (User::canAccessPanel), and Livewire update requests go through the web group.
findings.scenario: If a stale-generation session belonged to a panel-eligible account on a non-database session driver, full-page GETs of /admin pages would keep rendering until a Livewire request hit the web stack.

findings.claim: AttachStructuredLogContext runs before the session starts, so the shared log context never includes user_id for session-authenticated requests.
findings.reasoning: bootstrap/app.php:22-25 prepends it to the web group, ahead of EncryptCookies/StartSession and SetLocale, so LogContext::base() (LogContext.php:22-29) sees no authenticated user and the default locale when Log::withContext is set. DomainLogger::build (DomainLogger.php:58), SlowActionLogger and ExceptionContextBuilder call base() again at log time and do get user_id, so only plain Log::* records from web requests lose user_id/locale/theme. LogContextTest uses actingAs and calls base() after the request, so it never exercises the middleware.
findings.scenario: A Log::warning() written directly (not via DomainLogger) during a signed-in user's request carries no user_id and the project-default locale, making it uncorrelatable to the user.

findings.claim: The health command reports 'Sentry events will carry no release' whenever metadata is malformed, even when the release itself is valid and is sent.
findings.reasoning: DeploymentMetadata::fromFile (DeploymentMetadata.php:86-95) deliberately keeps a valid release when only source_sha is bad and returns STATE_MALFORMED; ObservabilityHealthCommand::checkDeploymentIdentity then warns 'Release metadata is {state} — Sentry events will carry no release' purely on state !== 'present', although config/sentry.php:67 does send that release. The half-valid case requires a hand-damaged release.json, since the build pipeline writes both fields.
findings.scenario: A release.json with a valid release and truncated source_sha makes the operator health check claim Sentry has no release while events actually carry it, misdirecting diagnosis.

findings.claim: Sentry HTTP client breadcrumbs (and spans) include the outgoing request query string, which can carry tokens.
findings.reasoning: sentry-laravel HttpClientIntegration::collectUrlData returns ['http.query' => $uri->getQuery()] in legacy data-collection mode (no data_collection option is set in config/sentry.php), for breadcrumbs and spans alike. The app's outgoing requests with arbitrary query strings are user-pasted import URLs via PinnedImportHttpTransport (Http::withOptions); NightwatchPrivacy::redactOutgoingRequest (lines 159-178) strips exactly these because they can be 'presigned-URL credentials, share tokens', but nothing equivalent exists for Sentry. Impact is limited to URLs users deliberately submitted, sent to the project's own error tracker.
findings.scenario: A user imports an S3 presigned image URL; the sampled transaction (or an error breadcrumb) sends X-Amz-Signature/X-Amz-Credential to Sentry.

findings.claim: Hiding the Connected accounts card when providers() is empty also hides its success and error flash messages.
findings.reasoning: edit.blade.php:28 renders the card only when ConnectedAccounts::providers() (ConnectedAccounts.php:30-35) is non-empty. That list contains available providers plus connected ones that were switched off. The status and error messages are rendered only inside partials/connected-accounts.blade.php. Hiding the card when nothing is available and nothing is connected is intended and pinned by SignInProviderSwitchesTest.php:290. However, ConnectedAccountController::destroy returns ConnectedAccountsResponse::success after the last switched-off provider is removed, and on that redirect providers() is empty, so the message is never drawn.
findings.scenario: Both providers are switched off in Project settings and a user has a password and a connected Google account. They click Disconnect Google. The redirect renders /profile#connected-accounts with no card, so the 'disconnected' confirmation never appears.

findings.claim: The Livewire profile form's 'Saved' indicator reads the identity form's session flash. It never appears after its own save, and it appears beside the identity form's 'Saved' after that form submits.
findings.reasoning: EditProfileForm::save() (EditProfileForm.php:41-62) neither flashes nor sets any success state and does not redirect. The Blade view, however, checks session('status') === 'profile-updated' (edit-profile-form.blade.php:87). Only ProfileController::update (ProfileController.php:52) flashes that value, and it does so for the separate name/username/email form, which checks the same key (update-profile-information-form.blade.php:60). Saving the Livewire form therefore shows nothing. After the identity form redirects, both forms on /profile show 'Saved'. No test asserts either indicator.
findings.scenario: A user changes their bio and clicks Save. The bio is saved but the form gives no confirmation, so they cannot tell whether it worked. Later they change their username, and both cards show 'Saved', including the Livewire card that saved nothing.

findings.claim: Save can be submitted while the avatar upload is still running, so the profile saves without the selected avatar.
findings.reasoning: The file input uses wire:model="avatar" (edit-profile-form.blade.php:16), which starts a background upload when a file is chosen. Livewire 4.4.8 disables the form only during the submit request itself (supportDisablingFormsDuringRequest in livewire.js:16158-16190) and does not wait for in-flight uploads. Nothing in the view disables Save with wire:loading/wire:target="avatar". So save() runs with $this->avatar still null, and UpdateUserProfileAction stores the other fields without an avatar. The upload then finishes and sets $avatar, but nothing saves it.
findings.scenario: On a slow connection a user picks a 4 MB avatar and immediately clicks Save. The bio is saved and the old avatar stays. No feedback says the avatar was not applied, because the form has no success indicator either (B-03).

findings.claim: POST confirm-password and PUT password check the current password with no attempt limit, so a session holder can guess it without limit.
findings.reasoning: routes/auth.php:78 (confirm-password) and :80 (PUT password) have no throttle. ConfirmPasswordAction validates the password through the guard with no RateLimiter, and UpdatePasswordRequest uses the 'current_password' rule, so each request answers whether a guess is right. Exploiting this needs an authenticated session, which bounds the impact. The same root cause was already triaged as 01-07 and 02-05 (MINOR low), so this is a duplicate of those.
findings.scenario: An attacker with a stolen session cookie brute-forces the account password through POST /confirm-password. They can then reuse the password on other sites or keep access after the session is revoked.

findings.claim: POST /forgot-password has no per-client throttle. Only the broker's per-email throttle applies.
findings.reasoning: routes/auth.php:31-32 has no middleware. SendPasswordResetLinkAction calls Password::sendResetLink, whose only limit is the per-address 60-second throttle (config/auth.php passwords.users.throttle; pinned by AuthModalPasswordResetTest.php:74). A single client can therefore send one mail per minute to each of any number of addresses. Because the action throws a distinct error for unknown users, the same client can also enumerate accounts without limit.
findings.scenario: A script cycles through a list of addresses. It sends a reset mail to every registered one every 60 seconds and learns which addresses have accounts, with no per-IP cap.

findings.claim: The routes/api.php header comment names a release phase ('Phase 40 only prepares the route file...'), which CLAUDE.md forbids.
findings.reasoning: routes/api.php:11 reads 'Phase 40 only prepares the route file and JSON Resources.' CLAUDE.md forbids phase numbers in comments outside the listed exceptions, and routes/ is not one of them. ReleaseBookkeepingTest only scans the operational surface (workflows, infrastructure/scripts, infrastructure/config, architecture tests), which is why this was not caught. It is a comment-only fix, kept as MINOR for consistency with 11-47.
findings.scenario: No runtime effect. The comment breaks the project convention and will become meaningless as the roadmap changes.

findings.claim: Profile post cards are rendered without preloaded rating state, so each nested RatingVoting loads its distribution and the viewer's vote on its own.
findings.reasoning: The profile posts loop (profile-page.blade.php:148-154) and the saved tab loop pass no rating-voting-state to x-feed.post-card.
