The card's has-preloaded-state is then false (post-card.blade.php:100), and RatingVoting runs its own count and selected-vote queries (RatingVoting.php:109-123) for every post and rating group. PostFeed and SavedPostsPage batch this with RatingVotingStateLoader::forPosts, so the profile page is the one list that does not. The output is correct and only the query count grows.
findings.scenario: A profile page with a full page of posts and two active rating groups runs on the order of 2 x posts x groups extra queries per render instead of three batched ones.

findings.claim: The overlay's window Escape listener fires even while the drawer is closed, sending closeOverlay requests and refocusing the stale returnFocusEl.
findings.reasoning: x-on:keydown.escape.window (:89) dispatches request-close-overlay unconditionally; the handler (:67-76) is skipped only for the mobile-only instance at >= 1024px, so for the global overlay (overlay mode, any width) and for the split view's mobile overlay (< 1024px) every Escape on the page calls $wire.closeOverlay(), dispatches clear-selected-post (also a FeedPage::clearSelectedPost round trip) and calls returnFocusEl?.focus(). returnFocusEl is never cleared after a close, so it still points at the card that opened the last post.
findings.scenario: In overlay mode a user opens and closes post A, scrolls far down and presses Escape to dismiss the header user menu or a card's actions menu: focus is pulled to card A and the page scrolls back to it, plus two needless Livewire requests are sent.

findings.claim: Escape pressed in a dialog nested in the drawer closes the whole post overlay instead of only the topmost dialog.
findings.reasoning: The drawer dispatches request-close-overlay on every window Escape (:89) with no check for a dialog on top. The drawer's own modals (share, fullscreen image, delete confirm: post-drawer-content.blade.php:178-223) are x-ui.modal without close-on-escape (ui/modal.blade.php:9,39), so Escape leaves them untouched but slides the panel out and clears the post; the report dialog (report-modal.blade.php:14) closes together with the drawer. Same root cause as 14-30 (login dialog over the drawer), triaged in an earlier batch.
findings.scenario: A reader opens the post image fullscreen inside the overlay and presses Escape to dismiss it: the whole overlay closes and the selected post is cleared.

findings.claim: The aria-modal post drawer does not trap keyboard focus, so Tab reaches the obscured feed behind it.
findings.reasoning: The aside is role=dialog aria-modal=true (:90-92); on open it only focuses itself (:53) and on close returns focus (:75, :87), but there is no x-trap, so Tab moves past the panel into the sidebar/feed behind the dimmed backdrop (layouts/app.blade.php:349-386). Same class of issue as 16-50 (mobile nav drawer).
findings.scenario: A keyboard user opens a post in the overlay and tabs past the last control: focus lands on feed cards hidden behind the backdrop while assistive technology was told the rest of the page is inert.

findings.claim: wire:keydown.stop on the drawer's footer wrappers swallows Escape, so it neither closes the actions menu nor the overlay while focus is inside them.
findings.reasoning: wire:keydown.stop (no key modifier) becomes x-on:keydown.stop, which calls stopPropagation for every key (Livewire wire-wildcard + Alpine on()). It sits on the follow wrapper (:58), the vote pill (:100), the actions menu (:128) and each rating group (:229), while the menu closes only through a window listener (:13) and the overlay through post-drawer.blade.php:89. Unlike post-card, nothing above these wrappers in the drawer handles keydown, so the stops protect nothing. Same pattern as 14-21 (comment-item).
findings.scenario: A keyboard user opens the drawer's actions menu with Enter and presses Escape with focus on the trigger or a menu item: the menu stays open; with focus on the vote pill, Escape does not close the overlay.

findings.claim: The post-not-found state in the drawer has no close control, so a phone user cannot dismiss the overlay.
findings.reasoning: The only close button (:17-29) lives inside @if($post); the @elseif($postId) branch (:246-250) renders just an error message. The mobile overlay is full width (no clickable backdrop) and phones have no Escape key, so dismissal needs navigating away. PublishedPostDetailsQuery returns null for a post hidden or deleted after the feed rendered, which is when this branch shows.
findings.scenario: A post is moderated away while a phone user still sees its card; tapping it opens a full-screen overlay saying the post was not found, with no way to close it except tapping a header link or reloading.

findings.claim: The drawer's comments button re-runs the feed's selection scroll, jumping the page back to the selected card.
findings.reasoning: The drawer's comment action dispatches post-selected (post-drawer-content.blade.php:110), which FeedPage handles with scrollToSelectedPost (feed-page.blade.php:65, :18-42): on desktop it scrolls the detail column to top and the window to the card before scrollToDetailTarget scrolls to the comments. In overlay mode the same event also re-runs post-drawer.blade.php:52, overwriting returnFocusEl with the in-drawer button, so closing afterwards no longer returns focus to the card.
findings.scenario: In the split view a reader scrolls the feed further down while the sticky detail column shows post A, then clicks the comment count in the column: the page jumps back up to card A and the column flashes to its top before scrolling to the comments.

findings.claim: Selecting a post in the split view waits for the drawer's query and render instead of loading the drawer separately.
findings.reasoning: The intent is lazy loading (wire:lazy at feed-page.blade.php:133/:144, PostDrawer::placeholder() at PostDrawer.php:105, and MobilePostDetailOverlayTest.php:47 even counts the 'wire:lazy' strings), but Livewire 4.4 recognises only the lazy/defer parameters (SupportLazyLoading::mount, HandleComponents::isReservedParam); 'wire:lazy' is passed through as an inert HTML attribute. The column drawer is therefore mounted and rendered inside the selectPost round trip. The same inert attribute appears in post-card, comment-item, post-show and post-drawer-content.
findings.scenario: Every desktop selection blocks on the post detail query and the drawer's nested components before the feed response returns; the placeholder view is never used.

findings.claim: Hidden type=url inputs still take part in native constraint validation, so an invalid value typed before a tab switch silently blocks submit.
findings.reasoning: The form (:6-10) has no novalidate; importedImageUrl (:152-159) and source_url (:234-241) are type="url" and hidden by x-show (display:none) depending on imageTab (:151, :231). Browsers abort submission when the first invalid control is not focusable, showing no message, so wire:submit never runs. The server already validates sourceUrl with 'url' (UploadPostForm.php:177).
findings.scenario: An author types 'example.com' as the source on the file tab, then switches to the URL tab (which hides the source field) and presses Post: nothing happens and no error is shown.

findings.claim: With the following feed and a search both active, an empty result shows the following-feed message instead of the no-results message.
findings.reasoning: post-feed.blade.php:12 checks $followingOnly before filled($search) (:19), so an empty following+search result renders 'No posts from your authors yet / Follow authors to see their posts here.' (lang/en/ui.php:18-19) even when the user follows authors and only the search matched nothing. FeedPage passes both together (feed-page.blade.php:113,118).
findings.scenario: A user who follows several authors searches 'cats' in the Following feed; nothing matches and the page tells them to follow authors rather than that the search found nothing.

findings.claim: An out-of-range ?page shows the 'nothing here' empty state with no pagination links, although earlier pages have items.
findings.reasoning: saved-posts-page.blade.php:4, recently-deleted-posts-page.blade.php:11, profile-page.blade.php:141/:199 and post-feed.blade.php:11 test the current page's collection (isEmpty) and render links() only in the non-empty branch (:23, :64, :159/:216, :49-53). Livewire clamps only page < 1, never to lastPage. In-session paths are mostly covered (RecentlyDeletedPostsPage::restore and ProfilePage::setTab call resetPage; feed filters are full-page links without page), so this needs a stale URL or a list that shrank (unsave, purge, moderation, deleting the last card of the last feed page).
findings.scenario: A user bookmarks /saved-posts?page=3, later unsaves some posts so only two pages remain; opening the bookmark says 'No saved posts yet' and offers no link back to page 1.

findings.claim: Clicking outside the bell does not close the notifications dropdown.
findings.reasoning: The root x-data (notification-bell.blade.php:3-9) closes only on Escape, on the bell toggle and on the close-notification-menu event. It has no @click.outside, while the sibling header user menu (layouts/app.blade.php:94-98) and the locale switcher (components/locale-switcher.blade.php:8) both close on an outside click. On mobile the dropdown is a fixed full-width panel (line 32) that covers content until it is toggled again.
findings.scenario: A user opens the bell on a phone, taps on the page beside it, and the panel stays over the feed until they find the bell again or press Escape.

findings.claim: The bell toggle button doesn't expose its open state through aria-expanded.
findings.reasoning: The button (notification-bell.blade.php:10-15) has only aria-label, while the header user-menu trigger beside it sets aria-haspopup and :aria-expanded (layouts/app.blade.php:104-105). Screen-reader users get no announcement that a popup opened or closed.
findings.scenario: A screen-reader user activates the bell and hears nothing about the panel that opened, so they can't tell whether it is open.

findings.claim: The textarea id `report-message` is hard-coded, so it is duplicated when several ReportModal instances render and the label targets the wrong textarea.
findings.reasoning: The label for= and the textarea id are both the literal 'report-message' (_report-modal-content.blade.php:49,54). ReportModal is mounted per post card, comment, post-show, drawer and profile (post-card.blade.php:160, comment-item.blade.php:72, post-show.blade.php:184, post-drawer-content.blade.php:146, profile-page.blade.php:68). The menu instances are wire:lazy and load once their menu is opened, so after a user opens two report menus the page has duplicate ids, and the second form's label resolves to the first textarea. Impact is limited to accessibility and label clicks; submission is unaffected.
findings.scenario: A user opens the report menu on two feed cards. In the second modal, clicking 'Optional details' does not focus its textarea, and a screen reader announces that textarea without its label.

findings.claim: In the inline variant, the component's own x-data `reportOpen` shadows the caller's state, so Escape does not close the profile report modal.
findings.reasoning: report-modal.blade.php:13-14 always declares a local `reportOpen` (true for inline) and a window Escape handler that sets that local copy. On the profile page the modal wrapper is owned by the caller's x-data `{ reportOpen: false }` (profile-page.blade.php:59) and its x-ui.modal has no close-on-escape (profile-page.blade.php:67; the modal default is closeOnEscape=false, components/ui/modal.blade.php:9). Escape therefore changes only the unused inner flag. The menu variant closes on Escape, because its handler and the modal share one scope.
findings.scenario: A visitor opens 'Report user' on a profile and presses Escape. The dialog stays open, although Escape closes the same report dialog on posts and comments.

findings.claim: canRestore shows Restore for finalized removals, which RestorePostAction always rejects.
findings.reasoning: canRestore() checks only `status === Hidden` (InlinePostModeration.php:55-59), while RestorePostAction refuses `moderation_removed_at !== null` (RestorePostAction.php:35-37), so the two disagree. In practice the component mounts only inside published-post contexts (PublishedPostDetailsQuery::query() uses ->published(); feed cards list published posts). A finalized post reaches it only in a narrow race, and the action guard keeps the state safe. 'Fails for every finalized post' overstates how reachable this is.
findings.scenario: A moderator hides a post from the drawer, an admin finalizes the removal in Filament, and the moderator then clicks the still-visible Restore. The action throws, and in the menu variant nothing is shown (see D-08).

findings.claim: The 1000-character limit on the moderation reason is enforced only by the browser's maxlength.
findings.reasoning: `$reason` has no validation (InlinePostModeration.php:21, normalizedReason() at :104-109), and CreateModerationLogAction stores it into a `text` column with no length check (CreateModerationLogAction.php:26-35; moderation_logs migration: text('reason')). Every Filament moderation path validates `max:REASON_LIMIT` (ListPosts.php:237, ListComments.php:150, ModeratesUsers.php:75), so this entry point is the inconsistent one. Only moderators can call it, which keeps the impact low.
findings.scenario: A moderator, or a script using a moderator session, posts a multi-megabyte reason through the Livewire hide/restore call. It is stored in the audit log and bloats the moderation views that render it.

findings.claim: The menu variant never renders `$error` (or `$success`), so a rejected hide or restore gives the moderator no feedback.
findings.reasoning: runModerationAction catches CannotModeratePostException into $error (InlinePostModeration.php:122-127), but only the panel branch renders $error/$success (blade:92-102). The menu branch (blade:4-64) has no output for either. That menu is the one mounted in the post drawer (post-drawer-content.blade.php:166). The next render does swap Hide and Restore to match the new status, so the state is still visible indirectly.
findings.scenario: Two moderators act on the same post. The second clicks Hide in the drawer menu after the first already hid it. The modal closes, nothing is reported, and the moderator can't tell whether their action did anything.

findings.claim: The reply form stays open under a parent comment that was just deleted or hidden, because refreshComments does not reset replyingTo.
findings.reasoning: deleteComment/hideComment/refreshComments (CommentsSection.php:148-200) clear only the computed caches. The blade renders the form whenever `$replyingTo === $comment->id` (comments-section.blade.php:86), including when that comment now renders as a structural tombstone (Comment::isStructuralTombstone, Comment.php:97). A submit is rejected safely, because AddCommentAction re-reads the parent under lock and requires Visible (AddCommentAction.php:111-124). So the only harm is a stale form that ends in an error.
findings.scenario: A moderator opens Reply on a comment and then hides that comment from its menu. The tombstone still shows an open reply form, and submitting it returns an error.

findings.claim: The role=status live region is inserted only once a message exists, so screen readers may not announce it.
findings.reasoning: The span with role=status is created inside `@if($message)` (follow-button.blade.php:33-35), so the live region is added together with its content. Assistive technology reliably announces changes only to regions already in the accessibility tree. The messages are the outcome of a click: login_required, feature_disabled, cannot_follow_author (FollowButton.php:47-64).
findings.scenario: A guest who uses VoiceOver presses Follow. The 'log in required' message appears on screen but is not announced, so nothing seems to happen.

findings.claim: Saving notification preferences gives no confirmation, and a skipped save reports nothing.
findings.reasoning: save() validates and calls UpdateNotificationPreferencesAction, then sets no state (NotificationPreferencesForm.php:21-33), and the view has no status or error output (notification-preferences-form.blade.php:7-27). The action also returns silently without saving when the locked account can't authenticate (UpdateNotificationPreferencesAction.php:20-22). The neighbouring settings forms show a 'Saved' indicator.
findings.scenario: A user unticks 'notify me about followed authors' and presses Save. Nothing changes on screen, and they can't tell whether the preference was stored.

findings.claim: Saved-post cards in the loop are not keyed, and x-feed.post-card would not forward a wire:key to its root anyway.
findings.reasoning: The loop renders `<x-feed.post-card>` with no key (saved-posts-page.blade.php:12-19). post-card's root `<x-ui.card ...>` (post-card.blade.php:3-16) never forwards $attributes, so the wire:key that profile-page.blade.php passes is dropped too. SavedPostsPage changes its list only by Livewire pagination (WithPagination, SavedPostsPage.php:13-35), so on a page change the cards morph by position, and their Alpine root state (postVoteError, imageOpen, …) can carry over to a different post. The nested Livewire children are keyed (post-card.blade.php:19-23), so server state stays correct.
findings.scenario: A user gets a vote error on the first saved card ('postVoteError' shows), then goes to page 2. The first card of page 2, a different post, can still show that stale error.

findings.claim: The locale select has no accessible name.
findings.reasoning: The <select id="locale"> (user-locale-settings.blade.php:9-18) has no <label for="locale">, aria-label or aria-labelledby. The section heading (line 3) is not programmatically tied to it, so the control is announced only as 'combo box'.
findings.scenario: A screen-reader user tabbing through account settings reaches an unnamed combo box and can't tell it sets the interface language.

findings.claim: After a reload, the guest theme switcher highlights System even when Light or Dark is applied.
findings.reasoning: mount() hard-codes 'system' for guests and for users whose theme_preference is null (ThemeSwitcher.php:17-21). The page itself is themed from localStorage (resources/js/theme-bootstrap.js:7-23) or from the project default via ThemeManager::preferenceForUser (AppServiceProvider.php:97-106, ThemeManager.php:13-27). The highlighted option and aria-pressed (theme-switcher.blade.php:47-51) therefore disagree with the applied theme. The same happens with no localStorage at all when the project default_theme is light or dark. ThemeSwitcherTest pins only the server-side mount value for guests ('system').
findings.scenario: A guest picks Dark and reloads. The page is dark but the System button is highlighted and announced as pressed. Likewise, on a project whose default theme is 'dark', every first-time visitor sees System selected.

findings.claim: An omitted scrollTo defaults to no scrolling, so changing page leaves the viewport where it was.
findings.reasoning: The override sets `$scrollTo = false` when unset (tailwind.blade.php:57-62), whereas upstream Livewire defaults to 'body' (vendor/livewire/livewire/src/Features/SupportPagination/views/tailwind.blade.php:2-4). The commit that added the override (62205605) says 'Disables scrollTo auto-scroll (handled by feed-page Alpine logic)', but feed-page's Alpine scrolls only for post selection (scrollToSelectedPost/scrollToDetailTarget, feed-page.blade.php:18-65), not pagination. resources/js has no pagination scroll either. So none of the paginated lists (feed, saved posts, recently deleted, profile) scroll on a page change.
findings.scenario: On saved posts a user clicks page 2 in the bottom pagination. The new items render, but the viewport stays at the bottom, so the user lands near the end of page 2 and has to scroll up to its first post.

findings.claim: DnsHostResolver silently truncates to 16 answers and trusts the rest, so a mixed public+private answer set beyond the cap is not rejected.
findings.reasoning: DnsHostResolver.php:28 slices to 16 records, and the docs describe exactly that ('bounded to import.dns_max_answers (16 by default) raw records', docs/import/url-import.md:198-204). Records past the cap are never used at all: UrlImportValidator picks and validates an IP only from the returned set and PinnedImportHttpTransport pins the connection to that validated IP, so an unchecked private answer can never be connected to.
findings.resolution_ru: DnsHostResolver обрезает ответ до 16 записей и не отклоняет приватные адреса за пределом. Итог: бот ошибся: обрезка документирована, записи за пределом не используются вовсе, IP берётся и проверяется только из возвращённого набора, к нему и привязано соединение.

findings.claim: The hello@example.com fallback means a missing MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS sends mail from a domain the project does not own.
findings.reasoning: Every deployed target's template declares MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS (environment-contract.json: staging noreply@staging.invalid, production operator-supplied) and verify-environment-contract refuses deploy/configure when a declared key is absent, so the fallback cannot apply on a deployed host; a present-but-blank value makes env() return '' (not the fallback), which fails visibly. The fallback only serves local development, where .env.example sets the same value.
findings.resolution_ru: Fallback hello@example.com без MAIL_FROM_ADDRESS шлёт почту с чужого домена. Итог: бот ошибся: все шаблоны окружения объявляют ключ, verify-environment-contract не пустит деплой без него, пустое значение падает заметно; fallback только для локальной разработки.

findings.claim: The 60s variant_lock TTL can expire during a write; the lease should be extended rather than fixed.
findings.reasoning: MediaVariantWriter::write (MediaVariantWriter.php:64-110) generates and encodes the variant before taking the lock, so the locked section is one putContents plus one updateOrCreate and cleanup — far below 60s. The class already documents and defends the TTL-expiry case: deleteQuietly (lines 132-160) skips deleting any path another MediaVariant row claims.
findings.resolution_ru: TTL 60 секунд у variant_lock может истечь во время записи. Итог: бот ошибся: MediaVariantWriter::write генерирует вариант до блокировки, под ней только запись файла и updateOrCreate, это намного меньше 60 секунд; истечение TTL уже учтено в deleteQuietly.

findings.claim: The profile website link and the post source link put stored URLs into href with no scheme check, so a stored javascript: URL could run script when clicked.
findings.reasoning: Every write path validates these fields with Laravel's 'url' rule: ProfileValidationRules.php:22 (profile_website_url), UploadPostForm.php:177 and StudioPlanValidationRules.php:56 (sourceUrl). The import paths set sourceUrl to a URL already limited to https (config/import.php allowed_schemes). Str::isUrl (vendor Illuminate/Support/Str.php:637-647) needs 'scheme://' from a fixed protocol list that does not contain javascript or vbscript, so 'javascript:alert(1)' and 'javascript://...' both fail. No Filament or other writer sets either column without that rule (grep). Blade {{ }} escaping covers attribute breakout. A stricter 'url:http,https' would be optional hardening against odd schemes such as ftp:// or file://, not a fix for an XSS that exists.
findings.resolution_ru: Ссылки на сайт профиля и источник поста кладут URL в href без проверки схемы. Итог: бот ошибся: все пути записи проверяют правилом url, которое не пускает javascript/vbscript, импорт ограничен https, Blade экранирует; url:http,https был бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: stats, posts, savedPosts and ratingActivity are plain accessors that re-run their queries on every $this-> access in the view.
findings.reasoning: These are Livewire legacy computed properties (getStatsProperty and the others, ProfilePage.php:62-98). Livewire 4.4.8 resolves them through SupportLegacyComputedPropertySyntax::getComputedProperty, which memoizes each value per request with store($target)->find('computedProperties', $property, ...). Repeated $this->stats or $this->posts access in the view therefore runs the query once, which is the same caching #[Computed] gives.
findings.resolution_ru: stats, posts, savedPosts и ratingActivity обычные аксессоры и выполняют запросы при каждом обращении. Итог: бот ошибся: это legacy computed properties, Livewire 4.4.8 кэширует их значение в рамках запроса, так что запрос выполняется один раз, как с #[Computed].

findings.claim: Profile activity loads the votes' posts unconstrained, so votes on unpublished or missing posts can be rendered.
findings.reasoning: UserRatingActivityQuery.php:25 already limits the votes with whereHas('post', status = Published), and soft-deleted posts are excluded by the model scope. Only votes on published posts are returned. The unconstrained with('post') eager load fetches those same posts milliseconds later. The view also handles a missing post with $vote->post->title ?? '—' (profile-page.blade.php:183). The filtering the bot asks for is already done.
findings.resolution_ru: Активность профиля грузит посты голосов без ограничений, могут показаться неопубликованные или удалённые посты. Итог: бот ошибся: запрос уже берёт только голоса за опубликованные посты, мягко удалённые исключены скоупом, вид обрабатывает пропавший пост.

findings.claim: $scrollTo is interpolated into the Alpine expression without JS string encoding.
findings.reasoning: No caller ever passes scrollTo: every `->links()` call (saved-posts-page.blade.php:23, recently-deleted-posts-page.blade.php:64, profile-page.blade.php:159,216, post-feed.blade.php:51) omits it, so $scrollTo is always false and the snippet is the empty string (tailwind.blade.php:57-62). Nothing user-controlled can reach the expression, and the interpolation is the same as upstream Livewire's own view. If D-21 changes the default to 'body', the value is still a constant.
findings.resolution_ru: $scrollTo подставляется в выражение Alpine без JS-экранирования. Итог: бот ошибся: ни один вызов links() не передаёт scrollTo, значение всегда false и фрагмент пустой; пользовательские данные туда не попадают, подстановка та же, что в шаблоне Livewire.

findings.claim: send_default_pii is env-driven, so the no-PII invariant is operator-configurable; hardcode false.
findings.reasoning: The switch is deliberately env-managed: environment-contract.json declares SENTRY_SEND_DEFAULT_PII as a target key with value 'false', every template ships it false, the runbook (sentry-observability.md:351-360) tells operators to set it, and SentryConfigurationTest:120,148 pins false. Flipping it needs a deliberate operator edit plus redeploy; hardcoding would also orphan a contract key and is a policy change, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: send_default_pii берётся из env, надо захардкодить false. Итог: верно в теории, но переключатель намеренно в env: контракт окружения и шаблоны задают false, runbook и SentryConfigurationTest это закрепляют; хардкод это смена политики, а не исправление дефекта.

findings.claim: The import.providers block is dead config that nothing reads.
findings.reasoning: True — no reader of import.providers exists in app/ or tests/; provider selection is ImportProviderDetector plus the adapters in ImportFromUrlAction. The block is not env-driven, so no operator can be misled by toggling it; removing it is cleanup with no behavioural effect.
findings.resolution_ru: Блок import.providers мёртвый, его никто не читает. Итог: верно, но блок не управляется через env, так что оператора он не введёт в заблуждение; удаление это чистка без влияния на поведение.

findings.claim: slow_actions.enabled and redaction.enabled are dead flags that SlowActionLogger and SensitiveDataRedactor ignore, while the health command reports them.
findings.reasoning: Correct that neither SlowActionLogger::measure nor SensitiveDataRedactor::redact reads its flag (only ObservabilityHealthCommand.php:47,56 does). Both are hardcoded `true` and not env-driven, so the health output can only ever say 'enabled', matching runtime; this is dead-config cleanup with no reachable mismatch.
findings.resolution_ru: Флаги slow_actions.enabled и redaction.enabled игнорируются, а health-команда их показывает. Итог: верно, но оба захардкожены в true и не из env, поэтому health всегда пишет 'enabled', что совпадает с реальностью. Это чистка мёртвого конфига без достижимого расхождения.

findings.claim: APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS is split without trimming, so 'key1, key2' breaks the second key.
findings.reasoning: This is Laravel's stock config/app.php line verbatim, and environment-contract.json excludes APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS as a 'laravel-framework-default' the deployed topology does not use. Operators following Laravel's documented comma format are unaffected; trimming is speculative hardening of framework code.
findings.resolution_ru: APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS разбивается без trim, и 'key1, key2' ломает второй ключ. Итог: это строка стокового config/app.php Laravel, а контракт окружения исключает APP_PREVIOUS_KEYS как дефолт фреймворка. Документированный формат работает, trim это спекулятивное усиление.

findings.claim: A configurable reset-token table diverges from PasswordResetToken's hardcoded table, so revocation would miss tokens.
findings.reasoning: PasswordResetToken.php:27 does hardcode password_reset_tokens and is used for revocation (ClaimAccountWithVerifiedEmailAction.php:121, AnonymizeUserAccountAction.php:144). But the env line is the Laravel default, the key is excluded from the environment contract as a framework default, and the migration creates only password_reset_tokens, so setting the variable would break the broker outright before any revocation divergence; purely hypothetical.
findings.resolution_ru: Таблица токенов сброса настраивается, а PasswordResetToken её захардкодил, и отзыв пропустит токены. Итог: строка это дефолт Laravel, ключ вне контракта окружения, миграция создаёт только password_reset_tokens, и смена переменной сразу сломала бы брокер. Чисто гипотетически.

findings.claim: open_graph mime_type, jpeg_quality, minimum_jpeg_quality and max_kilobytes are never read.
findings.reasoning: True — PostOpenGraph.php:111-116 reads only fallback_path, fallback_mime_type, width and height, while the OG variant hardcodes 1200x630, JPEG and quality 82 (MediaVariantSpecificationRegistry.php:21,35). The keys are not env-driven, so this is dead-config cleanup with no runtime effect.
findings.resolution_ru: Ключи open_graph mime_type, jpeg_quality, minimum_jpeg_quality и max_kilobytes нигде не читаются. Итог: верно, OG вариант захардкожен как 1200x630, JPEG, качество 82; ключи не из env, так что это чистка мёртвого конфига без эффекта в рантайме.

findings.claim: A blank SENTRY_ORG_ID becomes org_id 0 rather than unset, contradicting the file's blank-means-unset convention (same for log_flush_threshold).
findings.reasoning: Technically true (sentry.php:78,118 check only === null), but neither key appears in any template (environment-contract.json classifies both 'excluded' vendor defaults), so a blank requires an operator to add the line. org_id only affects continuing traces from other Sentry-instrumented callers, which RateGuru has none of, and log_flush_threshold is inert while enable_logs is false; no realistic effect.
findings.resolution_ru: Пустой SENTRY_ORG_ID становится org_id 0, а не unset (так же log_flush_threshold). Итог: формально так, но этих ключей нет в шаблонах, org_id нужен только для трейсов от других сервисов с Sentry, которых нет, а log_flush_threshold инертен при выключенном enable_logs.

findings.claim: The `$` anchor accepts a trailing newline, so 'staging-main\n' passes the target-ID check.
findings.reasoning: Correct regex semantics, but a dotenv value only contains a trailing newline if an operator writes a double-quoted escaped \n; APP_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET is rendered from the registry target_id. Switching to \z is harmless but has no realistic trigger.
findings.resolution_ru: Якорь $ пропускает завершающий перевод строки, и 'staging-main\n' проходит проверку target ID. Итог: так и есть, но \n в значении dotenv появится, только если оператор сам впишет его в кавычках, а APP_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET берётся из реестра. \z безвреден, но повода нет.

findings.claim: Livewire's default 12 MB temporary-upload rule would cap uploads below UPLOAD_IMAGE_MAX_KB if that were raised above 12288.
findings.reasoning: temporary_file_upload.rules is null, so Livewire's default max:12288 applies; UPLOAD_IMAGE_MAX_KB is 5120 in config default, .env.example and every template, and the 16 MP/256M memory analysis in config/uploads.php argues against large limits. It is a latent coupling only reachable if an operator raises the limit above 12 MB.
findings.resolution_ru: Стандартный лимит Livewire 12 МБ обрежет загрузки, если поднять UPLOAD_IMAGE_MAX_KB выше 12288. Итог: UPLOAD_IMAGE_MAX_KB везде 5120, а анализ памяти в config/uploads.php против больших лимитов; связь скрытая и сработает, только если оператор поднимет лимит выше 12 МБ.

findings.claim: The image URL input has no label, only a placeholder.
findings.reasoning: The input (:152-159) has no id/label association, but per HTML-AAM the placeholder is used as the computed accessible name of a text/url input when no label exists, so it is not nameless; adding an aria-label is accessibility polish.
findings.resolution_ru: Поле URL изображения без label, только с placeholder. Итог: по HTML-AAM placeholder становится доступным именем поля без label, так что оно не безымянное; aria-label это доработка доступности.

findings.claim: The inline moderation child mounts for reporters/deleters who cannot moderate and renders nothing.
findings.reasoning: True: the component is mounted whenever the menu exists (:127, :166-170) and renders an empty wrapper when Gate 'moderate-content' fails (InlinePostModeration.php:31-35). The cost is one small component snapshot per drawer render with no functional effect; a micro-optimisation.
findings.resolution_ru: Дочерний компонент модерации монтируется для тех, кто не может модерировать, и ничего не рисует. Итог: верно, но цена это один маленький снимок компонента на рендер drawer без функционального эффекта; это микрооптимизация.

findings.claim: The menu hide/restore flows should offer an optional reason input instead of logging a null reason.
findings.reasoning: The inline reason is optional by design: the actions take `?string $reason = null` (HidePostAction.php:22, RestorePostAction.php:21), the placeholder reads 'Optional moderation note...' (lang/en/ui.php:177), and tests cover hide/restore without the panel reason. The compact menu leaving it out is a design choice, so this is a feature request rather than a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Скрытие и восстановление из меню должны предлагать необязательную причину вместо null. Итог: причина необязательна по замыслу: действия принимают ?string $reason = null, тесты покрывают сценарий без неё; меню без поля это решение дизайна, так что это запрос на фичу.

findings.claim: The contact form inputs lack the maxlength attributes that match the server limits.
findings.reasoning: SubmitContactMessageRequest.php:15-18 enforces every limit server-side. The view shows each field's error (contact.blade.php:63-65 etc.) and refills the values with old() (lines 59, 76, 94, 112), so an over-length submit loses nothing. Client maxlength would only be UX polish.
findings.resolution_ru: Поля формы контактов без maxlength, совпадающих с серверными лимитами. Итог: SubmitContactMessageRequest проверяет все лимиты на сервере, форма показывает ошибки и заполняет значения через old(), так что ничего не теряется. maxlength на клиенте лишь UX-полировка.

findings.claim: The import URL input has no accessible name, only a placeholder.
findings.reasoning: The observation is accurate (import-url-form.blade.php:5-11), but ImportUrlForm is not mounted in any view, route or layout. A repo-wide search finds it only in its class (app/Livewire/Import/ImportUrlForm.php:82) and in tests/Feature/Livewire/ImportUrlFormTest.php, so no user reaches this markup. Image URL imports go through upload-post-form instead.
findings.resolution_ru: Поле URL импорта без доступного имени, только с placeholder. Итог: наблюдение верное, но ImportUrlForm нигде не смонтирован, на него ссылаются только класс и тест, так что пользователи эту разметку не видят; импорт по URL изображения идёт через upload-post-form.

findings.claim: The import URL field is not inside a form, so pressing Enter does not start the import.
findings.reasoning: This is accurate for the markup (the button at import-url-form.blade.php:12-21 is type=button with wire:click, and there is no <form>). But the ImportUrlForm component is mounted nowhere in the application (only tests reference it), so the behaviour can't be reached.
findings.resolution_ru: Поле URL импорта не внутри form, и Enter не запускает импорт. Итог: для разметки верно, но компонент ImportUrlForm нигде в приложении не смонтирован (на него ссылаются только тесты), так что это поведение недостижимо.

findings.claim: The follow toggle changes its accessible name with its state and also sets aria-pressed, which is redundant.
findings.reasoning: aria-label switches between 'Following' and 'Follow' along with aria-pressed (follow-button.blade.php:11-12, 25-26). The announcement is redundant ('Following, toggle button, pressed') but still correct, and browser tests rely on the aria-pressed state (tests/Browser/FollowBrowserTest.php:38,44). This is a best-practice nit, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: Переключатель подписки меняет доступное имя по состоянию и ещё ставит aria-pressed, это избыточно. Итог: озвучка избыточна, но корректна, а браузерные тесты опираются на aria-pressed. Это придирка к best practice, а не дефект.

findings.claim: Every Restore button has the same generic accessible name.
findings.reasoning: Each button sits in its own <li> with the post title just before it (recently-deleted-posts-page.blade.php:25-58), so its purpose is clear from context. Adding the title to the label is a nice-to-have, not a defect.
findings.resolution_ru: У всех кнопок Restore одинаковое общее доступное имя. Итог: каждая кнопка стоит в своём li сразу после заголовка поста, так что назначение понятно из контекста; добавить заголовок в подпись было бы приятно, но это не дефект.

findings.claim: The PR description should fill in the template's Summary, Verification and review checklists.
findings.reasoning: PR-description check on a review-only PR; not about the code.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR надо заполнить Summary, Verification и чек-листы шаблона. Итог: это проверка описания служебного review PR, к коду отношения не имеет.

findings.claim: post_tag cascades on tag delete while DeleteTagAction's usage check ignores soft-deleted posts, so a restorable post silently loses the tag.
findings.reasoning: DeleteTagAction::handle checks `$locked->posts()->exists()` (DeleteTagAction.php:35); Tag::posts() is a plain belongsToMany to Post, whose SoftDeletingScope hides author-deleted posts, and post_tag.tag_id is cascadeOnDelete (2026_05_14_183853_create_post_tag_table.php:21). The action's own docblock promises 'blocked while any post still references the tag. The pivot is never silently detached', and the sibling DeleteCategoryAction uses posts()->withTrashed()->exists() for exactly this reason. RestoreDeletedPostAction brings the post back assuming child data was never touched. The cascade itself is documented (community-fk-safety.md), the defect is the check.
findings.scenario: An author deletes a post (soft delete, restore window open). The tag page shows the tag with 0 posts (withCount excludes trashed), an admin deletes it, the cascade removes the trashed post's post_tag row, and when the author restores the post it comes back without that tag.

findings.claim: comments has no index on post_id / parent_id / status, so thread reads, counts and reply checks scan the whole table.
findings.reasoning: No migration indexes comments.post_id, parent_id or status (create_comments_table.php:11-20, add_parent_id_to_comments_table.php:15-19; nothing later adds one), and PostgreSQL, the production engine, does not index FK columns automatically. Every thread read and count filters on post_id (CommentListQuery.php:70-73, RefreshesPostCommentsCount.php:24-27, run under the post row lock on every comment write) and renderableTopLevelForPost uses whereHas('replies') on parent_id (CommentListQuery.php:85-101).
findings.scenario: Once the comments table grows, every post page and every comment/reply write (count refresh while holding the post lock) does a sequential scan over all comments, so latency and lock hold time grow with site-wide comment volume rather than per-post volume.

findings.claim: posts.image_asset_id and users.avatar_asset_id are FKs without indexes.
findings.reasoning: Both columns get only a foreign key (add_image_asset_id_to_posts_table.php:12-16, add_avatar_asset_id_to_users_table.php:12-15), which PostgreSQL does not index. They are queried per asset by MediaReferenceChecker (MediaReferenceChecker.php:34-36, 57-59) during release and media:purge, by CreatePostAction::lockStoredPostImage (CreatePostAction.php:216) under a lock, and every media_assets delete must scan both tables for ON DELETE SET NULL.
findings.scenario: The daily media:purge and every reference check run full scans of posts and users per asset; cost grows with the number of posts/users.

findings.claim: posts.category_id has a foreign key but no index.
findings.reasoning: The migration adds only constrained()->restrictOnDelete() (lines 12-15); PostgreSQL and SQLite create no index for it. It is filtered by FeedQuery's category filter (FeedQuery.php:53-60) and ModerationPostsQuery.php:153, counted by ManageCategories withCount('posts') and checked by DeleteCategoryAction's posts()->withTrashed()->exists().
findings.scenario: Category-filtered feeds and the admin category list scan posts as the table grows.

findings.claim: post_tag has no index leading with tag_id.
findings.reasoning: The only index is the composite primary key (post_id, tag_id) (line 22). Lookups from the tag side — ManageTags withCount('posts') (ManageTags.php:267), UploadPostForm withCount, DeleteTagAction's exists — cannot use it on PostgreSQL. The feed's whereHas('tags') correlates on post_id and is served by the PK, so the public feed is not affected.
findings.scenario: The admin tag page and tag deletion scan post_tag once per tag; cost grows with posts x tags.

findings.claim: comments.status defaults to 'published', which is not a CommentStatus value.
findings.reasoning: The column is `string('status')->default('published')` (line 16) and CommentStatus has only visible/hidden (app/Enums/CommentStatus.php); no later migration changes the default. Every current writer sets status explicitly (AddCommentAction.php:131-136, CommentFactory, DemoFillSeeder), so nothing reaches the default today.
findings.scenario: Any future insert that omits status (a raw DB::table insert, a new writer, a manual SQL repair) stores 'published': loading that Comment throws a ValueError from the enum cast and the row is invisible to every Visible query and count.

findings.claim: studio_plans.category_id is nullOnDelete, so deleting a category after approval makes the executor publish the post uncategorized.
findings.reasoning: The FK nulls the plan's category (documented in studio-plans.md:21 and community-fk-safety.md, with the rationale that 'an incomplete Draft may lose a deleted category; checked again on approval'). Nothing re-checks after approval: DeleteCategoryAction only refuses when posts use the category (DeleteCategoryAction.php:55), and ExecuteStudioAction passes `categoryId: $plan->category_id` straight to CreatePostAction (ExecuteStudioAction.php:355). The doc says an approved plan whose category is no longer usable is cancelled (studio-plans.md:1379); a deleted one silently becomes 'no category' instead.
findings.scenario: An admin approves a plan in a new category no post uses yet, then deletes that category before the post action runs; the post is published without the category that was approved, with no failure code.

findings.claim: The admin panel's middleware stack does not run EnsureSessionGenerationIsCurrent, so a stale session survives an account claim there.
findings.reasoning: EnsureSessionGenerationIsCurrent is appended only to the 'web' group (bootstrap/app.php:26-36); the Filament panel has its own stack (AdminPanelProvider.php:156-169) with AuthenticateSession, which Laravel skips when the user has no password (AuthenticateSession.php:47) — and ClaimAccountWithVerifiedEmailAction sets password to null and rotates session_generation (lines 113-121). Livewire update requests carry the 'web' group, so panel actions are covered; full-page GETs to /admin are not. The account must be staff (canAccessPanel, User.php:406-417) with an unverified email, and with the database session driver the claim also deletes its sessions.
findings.scenario: A moderator account registered with an email its creator never confirmed is claimed by the mailbox owner through Google; with a file/redis session driver the creator's open /admin session keeps loading admin pages until it expires.

findings.claim: Default rating groups and options are upserted without a transaction, so a failure leaves a partial configuration.
findings.reasoning: DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder::run upserts each group and then its options with no transaction (lines 20-35), unlike DefaultCategorySeeder, which wraps its loop in DB::transaction and pins that with 'rolls back every default category when one category fails'. This seeder is called from DatabaseSeeder in every environment, but production installs use rateguru:setup, so it runs mainly on fresh/dev/CI databases.
findings.scenario: An option write fails mid-loop (DB error, constraint): group 'type' stays active with fewer active options than its min_options until the seeder is rerun, and the voting UI shows an incomplete question.

findings.claim: Under DatabaseSeeder (WithoutModelEvents) the category writes skip Category's cache invalidation.
findings.reasoning: DatabaseSeeder uses WithoutModelEvents (DatabaseSeeder.php:10), so Category's saved hook that forgets 'sidebar-nav-categories' (Category.php:27) does not fire for DefaultCategorySeeder's updateOrCreate; the sidebar caches categories for 300 s (AppServiceProvider.php:151). ApplyProjectPresetAction forgets the key explicitly for the same kind of bulk write (ApplyProjectPresetAction.php:99).
findings.scenario: db:seed on an installation without a preset renames/reactivates the generic categories, but the navigation keeps showing the old list for up to 5 minutes.

findings.claim: The large demo seeder writes replies to replies, a depth the product does not allow.
findings.reasoning: seedComments picks the 'deep' parents from $level2, which are replies (DemoFillSeeder.php:724-741), creating third-level rows. The product rule is one level of replies (docs/architecture/comment-lifecycle.md:39) and AddCommentAction refuses a parent that has a parent (AddCommentAction.php:85). Those rows are counted in comments_count (lines 744-749) but the thread view never renders them. Dev-only seeder (local/testing guard, line 149).
findings.scenario: After `db:seed --class=DemoFillSeeder`, posts show more comments than a developer can see, and pagination/performance checks run on a comment shape production can never have.

findings.claim: Resolved and ignored demo reports are attributed to the trusted member, who cannot process reports.
findings.reasoning: DemoReportsSeeder.php:26 uses trusted@rateguru.test (role User, DemoUsersSeeder.php:26) as resolved_by for the resolved and ignored fixtures (lines 50, 60); ResolveReportAction/IgnoreReportAction record only the staff actor (ResolveReportAction.php:44, IgnoreReportAction.php:47). The moderator account is seeded earlier in DemoDatabaseSeeder. Dev-only.
findings.scenario: Local moderation screens show a regular member as having resolved reports, a state production cannot produce, so QA of 'resolved by' displays runs on impossible data.

findings.claim: A demo fixture has Carla reporting her own post, which PostPolicy::report forbids.
findings.reasoning: Demo post 03 is authored by carla@rateguru.test (DemoPublishedPostsSeeder.php:88-92) and DemoReportsSeeder.php:45-46 makes Carla its reporter; PostPolicy::report requires the reporter not to be the post owner (PostPolicy.php:67-71). Dev-only.
findings.scenario: The resolved-report fixture is a self-report that no real flow can create, misleading local moderation and report-history checks.

findings.claim: firstOrCreate ignores soft-deleted media assets, so reseeding after a demo image is released fails on the (disk, path) unique index.
findings.reasoning: DemoPostMediaGenerator::create uses MediaAsset::query()->firstOrCreate(['disk','path']) (lines 45-60); MediaAsset uses SoftDeletes, so a trashed asset is not found and the insert violates unique(disk, path) (2026_07_29_100000_create_media_assets_table.php:50). DemoFillSeeder already looks the path up withTrashed for this reason. Dev-only.
findings.scenario: A developer replaces or deletes a demo post's image (the asset is released and soft-deleted); the next `php artisan db:seed` aborts with a unique-constraint error in DemoPublishedPostsSeeder.

findings.claim: sprintf() treats the % in the 'comment:%'/'rating:%' LIKE patterns as directives, so the SQLite table cannot be created.
findings.reasoning: In createSqliteTable (lines 109-131) the format string is the nowdoc, whose only % sequences are the two %s placeholders; TARGET_CHECK and BOUNDS_CHECK are passed as arguments, and sprintf never re-parses substituted arguments. CI runs fresh migrations and rollbacks on SQLite (docs/architecture/database-support.md, 'CI database matrix').
findings.resolution_ru: sprintf() трактует % в LIKE-шаблонах как директивы, и таблица в SQLite не создаётся. Итог: бот ошибся: в строке формата только два %s, TARGET_CHECK и BOUNDS_CHECK идут аргументами, которые sprintf повторно не разбирает; CI гоняет миграции и откаты на SQLite.

findings.claim: The SQLite rebuild silently drops votes whose type is not up/down.
findings.reasoning: The migration runs only on SQLite (line 12). The table it copies is created by 2026_05_26_000004 as enum('up','down'), which Laravel's SQLite grammar compiles to `varchar check ("type" in ('up','down'))`, so the whereIn (line 33) can exclude nothing on any database that runs it now; the only databases that had the earlier string column were local SQLite databases from 2026-05-26, which already ran it. Production is PostgreSQL, where it returns immediately.
findings.resolution_ru: Пересборка в SQLite молча удаляет голоса с типом не up/down. Итог: бот ошибся: миграция работает только на SQLite, а исходная таблица уже создана с CHECK на up/down, так что whereIn ничего не отбрасывает; продакшн на PostgreSQL, там миграция сразу выходит.

findings.claim: enum() does not enforce allowed values on SQLite, so invalid emoji_frequency/engagement can be stored.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's SQLite grammar compiles enum() to `varchar check ("col" in (...))` (SQLiteGrammar::typeEnum), and PostgreSQL likewise gets a CHECK; the migration's comment 'Closed sets, checked by the database on every engine' (line 28) is accurate.
findings.resolution_ru: enum() не проверяет допустимые значения в SQLite, можно сохранить неверные emoji_frequency/engagement. Итог: бот ошибся: грамматика SQLite в Laravel компилирует enum() в varchar с CHECK, в PostgreSQL тоже CHECK, так что комментарий миграции точен.

findings.claim: updateOrCreate drops email_verified_at because it is not in User's #[Fillable], so demo users stay unverified.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's SeedCommand runs every seeder inside Model::unguarded() (vendor/laravel/framework/src/Illuminate/Database/Console/Seeds/SeedCommand.php:88), and $this->seed() in tests goes through the same command, so mass-assignment protection does not apply and email_verified_at is stored.
findings.resolution_ru: updateOrCreate теряет email_verified_at, которого нет в #[Fillable] у User, и демо-пользователи не подтверждены. Итог: бот ошибся: SeedCommand запускает сидеры внутри Model::unguarded(), тесты через $this->seed() идут той же командой, и email_verified_at сохраняется.

findings.claim: Reseeding overwrites stored feature flags (including the Content Studio executor and verified-adults confirmation) with defaults.
findings.reasoning: feature_flags is listed in RESEEDED deliberately, with the docblock 'Reseeded on an existing row that never had a preset applied; everything else a row holds is its own once it exists' (lines 11-27), and DefaultProjectSettingsSeederTest ('preserves administrator edited static pages on subsequent seed runs') pins that identity fields go back to defaults while pages and languages are kept. A row with a preset returns early (line 31); production installs set preset_applied_at through rateguru:setup and the deploy never runs db:seed. The two Content Studio flags reset to false, the safe direction.
findings.resolution_ru: Повторный сид перезаписывает сохранённые feature flags дефолтами. Итог: бот ошибся, так задумано и закреплено тестом: строку без пресета сид обновляет, продакшн ставит пресет через rateguru:setup и db:seed не запускает; флаги Content Studio уходят в безопасный false.

findings.claim: The legacy cleanup archives administrator-customized 'source' groups after a preset is applied.
findings.reasoning: LegacyDefaultRatingConfigurationSynchronizer archives only active groups keyed source/category whose option key set equals exactly the legacy defaults (LegacyDefaultRatingConfigurationSynchronizer.php:12-33); any added or removed option exempts the group. Running it after a preset is pinned by DefaultRatingConfigurationSeederTest 'synchronizes legacy defaults after an installation preset was applied' and 'replaces only known active legacy default groups on an upgraded installation'.
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка legacy архивирует настроенные администратором группы 'source' после пресета. Итог: бот ошибся: архивируются только активные группы source/category с опциями ровно как у legacy дефолтов, любая правка опций их исключает; запуск после пресета закреплён тестами.

findings.claim: Rollback gives social-only users a random hash that hasPassword() treats as a password, so one could disconnect the last provider and lock themselves out.
findings.reasoning: The random unrecoverable hash is the documented intent (comment lines 32-35: password reset stays the only way in). Rolling this migration back requires first rolling back 2026_09_11_100100_create_social_accounts_table, which drops social_accounts, so after the rollback there is no provider to disconnect; and the account can still be recovered through password reset.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат даёт пользователям только с соцвходом случайный хеш, и они могут отвязать последнего провайдера. Итог: бот ошибся: случайный хеш задуман, вход остаётся через сброс пароля; откат требует сначала откатить social_accounts, так что отвязывать уже нечего.

findings.claim: Legacy author-deleted posts with NULL deleted_from_status need a safe restore path instead of a guessed status.
findings.reasoning: RestoreDeletedPostAction already refuses such rows: it requires deleted_from_status to be one of Post::AUTHOR_DELETABLE_STATUSES and otherwise throws becauseDeletionStateIsInvalid, so a NULL row stays unrestored, which is what the finding asks for. Production was first installed in October 2026, after this column existed.
findings.resolution_ru: Старым постам, удалённым автором, с NULL deleted_from_status нужен безопасный путь восстановления. Итог: бот ошибся: RestoreDeletedPostAction уже отказывает таким строкам, как и просит находка; продакшн установлен в октябре 2026, когда колонка уже была.

findings.claim: Variant generation and asset purge can overlap so purge misses a newly written variant.
findings.reasoning: Documented decision in docs/architecture/media.md ('Locking', around lines 718-733): no extra coordination with MediaVariantWriter is needed because MediaVariantGenerator::generateAll() refuses trashed assets and purge requires several days soft-deleted; variant rows go with the asset through the FK cascade, and stray files are handled by the orphan scanner.
findings.resolution_ru: Генерация вариантов и очистка ассета могут пересечься, и очистка пропустит новый вариант. Итог: бот ошибся, это решение из media.md: generateAll() отказывает удалённым ассетам, очистка ждёт несколько дней, строки уходят каскадом FK, а лишние файлы находит сканер сирот.

findings.claim: The rollback needlessly drops and recreates posts_user_id_foreign, opening a window for orphan posts.
findings.reasoning: The FK drop is MariaDB-only (lines 25-29, 38-42) and needed there: InnoDB may silently drop the FK's own index once (user_id, created_at) can serve the constraint, and that index can then not be dropped while the FK exists. The pattern is documented in docs/architecture/community-fk-safety.md ('Why the SQLite/MariaDB branches changed too'). It is a rollback path, not run on deploy.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат зря удаляет и пересоздаёт posts_user_id_foreign, открывая окно для постов-сирот. Итог: бот ошибся: удаление FK только для MariaDB и там нужно из-за поведения InnoDB с индексом FK, это описано в community-fk-safety.md; это путь отката, при деплое он не запускается.

findings.claim: The default seeders check preset_applied_at and create/update outside the settings lock, so a concurrent rateguru:setup or first settings save can race them.
findings.reasoning: True that DefaultProjectSettingsSeeder.php:31-49, DefaultCategorySeeder.php:15 and DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder.php:16 read the guard without ProjectSettingsManager::lockedRow(). The race needs two operator commands at once (db:seed and rateguru:setup) or an admin's first-ever settings save during db:seed; the deploy runs only `migrate --force` (infrastructure/scripts/deploy:1961), production setup is rateguru:setup, and the duplicate-key case is a loud failure that a rerun fixes.
findings.resolution_ru: Сидеры читают preset_applied_at вне блокировки настроек, возможна гонка с rateguru:setup. Итог: верно, но гонке нужны две команды оператора разом или первое сохранение во время db:seed; деплой запускает только migrate, а дубль ключа падает громко и лечится повтором.

findings.claim: Default category and rating seeders overwrite names, order and active/archived state of existing records on reseed.
findings.reasoning: They upsert the generic defaults only when preset_applied_at is null (DefaultCategorySeeder.php:15-31; DefaultRatingConfigurationSeeder.php:16-33, option() resets is_active/archived_at), the same reseed design DefaultProjectSettingsSeeder documents in RESEEDED; docs/admin/project-presets.md:72-73 promise only that an installed preset is not overwritten. Production installs set preset_applied_at via rateguru:setup and no deploy path runs db:seed, so this only touches local/CI databases.
findings.resolution_ru: Сидеры категорий и рейтингов при повторном сиде перезаписывают имена, порядок и статус. Итог: дефолты обновляются только при null preset_applied_at, как в RESEEDED; продакшн ставит пресет через rateguru:setup и db:seed не запускает, задеты лишь локальные и CI базы.

findings.claim: The duplicate-report cleanup does not recompute posts/comments reports_count; a forward repair is needed.
findings.reasoning: The migration (2026-05-19) has already run on every existing database, and production was first installed on 2026-10-17 from an empty schema (infrastructure/ROADMAP.md), so its reports table was empty when it ran; on any new install it is empty too. ReportContentAction recounts reports_count from rows on every report (ReportContentAction.php:239-260), so a stale value would self-correct. A forward repair would target no known data.
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка дублей жалоб не пересчитывает reports_count, нужен ремонт новой миграцией. Итог: миграция уже везде прошла, продакшн ставился с пустой схемы, так что таблица жалоб была пуста; ReportContentAction пересчитывает reports_count при каждой жалобе, ремонтировать нечего.

findings.claim: Deduplication keeps the lowest id regardless of status and deletes later reports' messages/resolution details.
findings.reasoning: Accurate description of lines 16-24, but the migration has already run everywhere and only ever met an empty or near-empty reports table (production installed in October 2026); editing it changes nothing and no data exists to merge.
findings.resolution_ru: Дедупликация оставляет наименьший id независимо от статуса и удаляет сообщения поздних жалоб. Итог: описание верное, но миграция уже везде прошла и видела только пустую или почти пустую таблицу жалоб; правка ничего не изменит, сливать нечего.

findings.claim: The cleanup loads every report into memory and binds all kept ids in one NOT IN, risking memory/parameter limits.
findings.reasoning: True of lines 16-23, but it is an already-applied migration that runs on an empty reports table on any new install; rewriting it to chunk has no effect on any real database.
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка грузит все жалобы в память и передаёт все id в один NOT IN. Итог: верно, но миграция уже применена, а на новой установке идёт по пустой таблице жалоб; переписывать её на чанки бесполезно для любой реальной базы.

findings.claim: whereNotIn($keepIds) deletes reports created after the snapshot was taken.
findings.reasoning: Only relevant while the migration runs against live traffic with existing reports; it has already run everywhere and new installs run it on an empty table.
findings.resolution_ru: whereNotIn($keepIds) удаляет жалобы, созданные после снимка. Итог: это важно только при работе миграции под живым трафиком с жалобами, а она уже везде прошла, и новые установки запускают её на пустой таблице.

findings.claim: The unique index is added without first deduplicating existing (post_id, user_id) votes.
findings.reasoning: post_votes is created by 2026_05_14_183712 and this index added by 2026_05_14_185608 back to back; the migration has run on every existing database and a new install has no votes between them, so dedup logic would never execute.
findings.resolution_ru: Уникальный индекс добавляется без предварительной дедупликации голосов (post_id, user_id). Итог: таблица и индекс создаются миграциями подряд, миграция уже везде прошла, а на новой установке голосов между ними нет, так что дедупликация никогда бы не выполнилась.

findings.claim: needs_review is not backfilled for posts already at the three-report threshold.
findings.reasoning: Already applied everywhere; production was installed in October 2026 with no posts, and a backfill in a new migration would find nothing to flag. ReportContentAction sets the flag when the threshold is reached.
findings.resolution_ru: needs_review не проставлен задним числом для постов, уже набравших три жалобы. Итог: миграция уже применена везде, production поставлен в октябре 2026 без постов, и backfill ничего бы не нашёл; флаг ставит ReportContentAction при достижении порога.

findings.claim: post_votes.type accepts arbitrary values at the database level.
findings.reasoning: All writers use the VoteType enum (VotePostAction, DemoVotesSeeder, DemoFillSeeder); adding a CHECK means a new migration with a table rebuild on SQLite for a raw-write scenario no code path produces.
findings.resolution_ru: post_votes.type на уровне БД принимает любые значения. Итог: все писатели используют enum VoteType (VotePostAction, DemoVotesSeeder, DemoFillSeeder); CHECK потребовал бы новой миграции с пересборкой таблицы на SQLite ради прямой записи, которой нет ни в одном пути кода.

findings.claim: parent_id can point at a node of another plan, so a plan delete could cascade into another plan's discussion.
findings.reasoning: The only writer, SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction::write (SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction.php:128-160, 168-180), sets parent_id from ids it has just written for the same locked plan and looks existing nodes up within studio_plan_id, so a cross-plan parent cannot be created. A composite FK needs a new migration with FK rebuilds on three engines for no reachable failure.
findings.resolution_ru: parent_id может ссылаться на узел другого плана. Итог: единственный писатель SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction::write берёт parent_id только из узлов того же заблокированного плана; составной FK означал бы миграцию с пересборкой FK на трёх движках ради недостижимого сбоя.

findings.claim: parent_action_id is not constrained to the same plan.
findings.reasoning: ApproveStudioPlanAction::written (ApproveStudioPlanAction.php:180-215) sets parent_action_id only from actions it just wrote for the same plan, and ExecuteStudioAction::doneParent rejects a parent of another plan (`$parent->studio_plan_id !== $action->studio_plan_id`). DB-level hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: parent_action_id не ограничен тем же планом. Итог: ApproveStudioPlanAction::written ставит его только из действий того же плана, а ExecuteStudioAction::doneParent отвергает родителя из другого плана; ограничение в БД было бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: target_node_id can reference a node from another plan.
findings.reasoning: RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction derives the target from StudioDiscussionContext::scopeOf($plan, ...) (RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction.php:190, 235-246, 324), i.e. within the plan. Hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: target_node_id может ссылаться на узел другого плана. Итог: RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction берёт цель через StudioDiscussionContext::scopeOf($plan, ...), то есть внутри плана; ограничение в БД было бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: A reply can reference a parent comment on another post.
findings.reasoning: AddCommentAction, the only production writer (Content Studio's executor goes through it), re-reads the parent under lock with where('post_id', $post->id)->whereNull('parent_id') (AddCommentAction.php:85, 118-127). A composite FK is a new migration for a case no writer produces.
findings.resolution_ru: Ответ может ссылаться на родительский комментарий другого поста. Итог: AddCommentAction, единственный писатель в production (исполнитель Content Studio идёт через него), перечитывает родителя под блокировкой с фильтром по post_id; составной FK ради невозможного случая не нужен.

findings.claim: sort_order/offset_seconds have no CHECK bounds.
findings.reasoning: The single writer validates sortOrder/offsetSeconds as min:0 up to LATEST_SORT_ORDER/LATEST_OFFSET_SECONDS (StudioDiscussionValidationRules.php:88-89) before SaveStudioDiscussionTreeAction writes; CHECKs would need a new migration plus a SQLite table rebuild for raw writes only.
findings.resolution_ru: У sort_order и offset_seconds нет CHECK-границ. Итог: единственный писатель проверяет их правилами StudioDiscussionValidationRules (min:0 до LATEST_SORT_ORDER/LATEST_OFFSET_SECONDS); CHECK потребовал бы новой миграции и пересборки таблицы на SQLite только против прямой записи.

findings.claim: max_replies_per_day accepts 51-255 although the app maximum is 50.
findings.reasoning: Writes are validated with between:0,PersonaProfile::MOST_REPLIES_PER_DAY (PersonaValidationRules.php:62); a DB CHECK is hardening against raw writes only.
findings.resolution_ru: max_replies_per_day принимает 51–255, хотя максимум в приложении 50. Итог: запись валидируется правилом between:0,PersonaProfile::MOST_REPLIES_PER_DAY в PersonaValidationRules; CHECK в БД защитил бы только от прямой записи.

findings.claim: The database allows option ranges outside the app's 2..15.
findings.reasoning: The table already enforces min<=max and storage bounds (lines 30-41, 64-66); the business range is validated by the create/update actions. Tightening it needs a new migration and a SQLite rebuild for raw writes only.
findings.resolution_ru: БД допускает диапазоны вариантов вне 2..15. Итог: таблица уже требует min<=max и границ хранения, бизнес-диапазон проверяют действия создания и обновления; ужесточение потребует новой миграции и пересборки на SQLite ради одной прямой записи.

findings.claim: follows accepts self-follow rows.
findings.reasoning: FollowAuthorAction refuses follower == author (FollowAuthorAction.php:35) and is the only writer; DB CHECK is hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: follows допускает подписку на самого себя. Итог: FollowAuthorAction, единственный писатель, отказывает при follower == author; CHECK в БД был бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: provider is unrestricted text although SocialProvider is a closed set.
findings.reasoning: All writers pass the SocialProvider enum (LinkSocialAccountAction); raw writes only.
findings.resolution_ru: provider хранится как произвольный текст, хотя SocialProvider закрытый набор. Итог: все писатели передают enum SocialProvider (LinkSocialAccountAction); проблема возможна только при прямой записи в БД.

findings.claim: tags.name/slug columns are wider than the app's 80/100 limits.
findings.reasoning: A wider column than the validated limit is harmless; preset tag data is repository config. Narrowing would need a new migration.
findings.resolution_ru: Колонки tags.name/slug шире лимитов приложения 80/100. Итог: колонка шире проверяемого лимита безвредна, предустановленные теги лежат в конфиге репозитория, а сужение потребовало бы новой миграции.

findings.claim: trust_level has no 0-255 CHECK on PostgreSQL/SQLite.
findings.reasoning: trust_level is written only from constants (MarkUserTrustedAction::TRUSTED_LEVEL, the User creating hook); hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: У trust_level нет CHECK 0–255 на PostgreSQL/SQLite. Итог: значение пишется только из констант (MarkUserTrustedAction::TRUSTED_LEVEL, хук creating у User); CHECK был бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: Nothing restricts project_settings to the singleton id 1.
findings.reasoning: Every writer goes through id 1 (ProjectSettingsManager::lockedRow, ApplyProjectPresetAction, the seeder); readers use find(1). Hardening only.
findings.resolution_ru: Ничто не ограничивает project_settings единственной строкой id 1. Итог: все писатели работают через id 1 (ProjectSettingsManager::lockedRow, ApplyProjectPresetAction, сидер), читатели используют find(1); ограничение было бы лишь дополнительной защитой.

findings.claim: No (status, moderation_removed_at) index for the moderation purge.
findings.reasoning: The purge (ModerationContentPurgeService.php:40-49) runs once a day, chunked, withoutOverlapping (routes/console.php:33); a scan there is acceptable and the column is null for almost every row.
findings.resolution_ru: Нет индекса (status, moderation_removed_at) для очистки модерации. Итог: очистка в ModerationContentPurgeService идёт раз в день, порциями и с withoutOverlapping; полный проход там приемлем, а колонка почти во всех строках null.

findings.claim: notifications lacks indexes covering read_at / created_at.
findings.reasoning: morphs('notifiable') already indexes (notifiable_type, notifiable_id), which narrows every NotificationBell query to one recipient's rows; that set is small. Standard Laravel schema.
findings.resolution_ru: У notifications нет индексов по read_at/created_at. Итог: morphs('notifiable') уже индексирует (notifiable_type, notifiable_id), и каждый запрос NotificationBell сужается до небольшого набора строк одного получателя; это стандартная схема Laravel.

findings.claim: failed_jobs.failed_at is unindexed although FailedMediaJobReader orders by it.
findings.reasoning: Framework stub table read only by admin diagnostics with a 500-row limit; the table stays small in practice.
findings.resolution_ru: failed_jobs.failed_at без индекса, хотя FailedMediaJobReader сортирует по нему. Итог: это таблица фреймворка, её читает только админская диагностика с лимитом 500 строк, и на практике она остаётся маленькой.

findings.claim: Rollback races a concurrent social signup between the NULL backfill and the NOT NULL change.
findings.reasoning: Rollback-only path; social signups need social_accounts, which the later migration's down() drops first, and a failed ALTER is loud and repeatable.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат может столкнуться с социальной регистрацией между заполнением NULL и переходом на NOT NULL. Итог: это путь только отката; регистрации нужны social_accounts, которые down() более поздней миграции удаляет раньше, а упавший ALTER заметен и повторяем.

findings.claim: Rollback can overwrite a password set between the chunk read and the update.
findings.reasoning: Rollback-only path in a maintenance operation; the window is per-row milliseconds.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат может затереть пароль, заданный между чтением порции и обновлением. Итог: это путь только отката при обслуживании, а окно составляет миллисекунды на строку.

findings.claim: The whole-column read/modify/write can lose a concurrently saved translation.
findings.reasoning: One-off data migration (2026-10-12) that has already run on every database, including the first production release of 2026-10-17; it runs on deploy, and a fresh install has nothing to race.
findings.resolution_ru: Чтение, изменение и запись всей колонки могут потерять параллельно сохранённый перевод. Итог: разовая миграция данных уже прошла на всех базах, включая первый релиз production 2026-10-17; она выполняется при деплое, а на чистой установке гонки не с чем.

findings.claim: The feature_flags data migrations read-modify-write without a row lock.
findings.reasoning: One-off June/July 2026 data migrations already applied everywhere; on a fresh install project_settings has no row yet, so they return early (line 11). Nothing to fix in practice.
findings.resolution_ru: Миграции данных feature_flags делают чтение, изменение и запись без блокировки строки. Итог: это разовые миграции июня-июля 2026, уже применённые везде; на чистой установке строки project_settings ещё нет, и они сразу выходят. На практике чинить нечего.

findings.claim: Rollback writes show_follow_buttons=false instead of restoring the previous state.
findings.reasoning: Rollback of an applied June 2026 migration that nobody will run; the flag is an admin setting that can be switched back.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат пишет show_follow_buttons=false вместо прежнего значения. Итог: это откат применённой в июне 2026 миграции, который никто не будет запускать, а флаг можно переключить обратно в админке.

findings.claim: chunkById over UUIDs misses legacy rows inserted concurrently by old workers.
findings.reasoning: Only during the one deploy that ran it (already applied everywhere); new installs have no legacy notifications.
findings.resolution_ru: chunkById по UUID пропускает legacy-строки, которые параллельно вставляют старые воркеры. Итог: это возможно только в тот единственный деплой, где миграция выполнялась (она уже применена везде); у новых установок legacy-уведомлений нет.

findings.claim: Projects that applied a preset before this column existed get NULL and would be reseeded.
findings.reasoning: The column and the one-time setup command shipped together (commit 78c77dae); only local/staging databases could have used the older admin preset action, staging was recreated after the August FK reset (community-fk-safety.md 'STAGING RESET REQUIRED'), and production was installed in October through rateguru:setup.
findings.resolution_ru: Пресет, применённый до появления колонки, даст NULL и повторный посев. Итог: колонка вышла вместе с разовой командой установки; старый пресет был возможен только на local/staging, staging пересоздан после августовского сброса FK, production поставлен в октябре через rateguru:setup.

findings.claim: Raw DB::statement SQL ignores the connection's table prefix.
findings.reasoning: Every connection in config/database.php hard-codes 'prefix' => '' (lines 39, 58, 78, 96, 111), not read from env, so no deployment can have a prefix without a code change.
findings.resolution_ru: Сырой SQL через DB::statement игнорирует префикс таблиц подключения. Итог: во всех подключениях config/database.php жёстко задан 'prefix' => '' без чтения из env, так что префикс невозможен без изменения кода.

findings.claim: The SQLite rollback recreates comment_votes.type unconstrained.
findings.reasoning: Rollback of a SQLite-only, already-applied migration; not run anywhere in practice.
findings.resolution_ru: Откат на SQLite пересоздаёт comment_votes.type без ограничения. Итог: это откат уже применённой миграции только для SQLite, на практике его нигде не запускают.

findings.claim: DemoFillSeeder should insert each vote batch and recalculate counters in one transaction.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only seeder (local/testing guard); a failed run is simply rerun and the seeder rebuilds its interactions.
findings.resolution_ru: DemoFillSeeder стоит вставлять каждую порцию голосов и пересчитывать счётчики в одной транзакции. Итог: сидер только для разработки (защита local/testing); упавший запуск просто повторяют, и сидер пересобирает свои взаимодействия.

findings.claim: Generated posts are upserted by title, so a local post with the same title can be overwritten.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only seeder; the titles are fixed demo strings documented as rebuilt on rerun (docs/dev/seed-data.md).
findings.resolution_ru: Посты пишутся upsert по заголовку, и локальный пост с тем же заголовком может быть перезаписан. Итог: сидер только для разработки, заголовки это фиксированные демо-строки, и в docs/dev/seed-data.md описано, что они пересоздаются при повторном запуске.

findings.claim: Generated master images are deleted before regeneration, so an interrupted run leaves posts with missing images.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; rerunning the seeder regenerates every image.
findings.resolution_ru: Исходные изображения удаляются перед регенерацией, и прерванный запуск оставит посты без картинок. Итог: только для разработки, повторный запуск сидера заново создаёт все изображения.

findings.claim: Concurrent seeder runs can delete each other's master file.
findings.reasoning: Two simultaneous runs of a local-only seeder are not a supported use.
findings.resolution_ru: Параллельные запуски сидера могут удалить исходный файл друг друга. Итог: два одновременных запуска локального сидера не поддерживаемый сценарий.

findings.claim: The upsert restamps created_at on rerun.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; published_at, which ranking uses, is deterministic per index.
findings.resolution_ru: upsert заново проставляет created_at при повторном запуске. Итог: только для разработки, а published_at, на котором строится ранжирование, детерминирован по индексу.

findings.claim: The fill%@demo.test wildcard can include unrelated local accounts.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; @demo.test addresses are this seeder's own namespace.
findings.resolution_ru: Шаблон fill%@demo.test может захватить посторонние локальные аккаунты. Итог: только для разработки, а адреса @demo.test это собственное пространство имён этого сидера.

findings.claim: The comments recount does not exclude soft-deleted comments.
