findings.reasoning: Technically true of the raw DB::table count (lines 744-749), but every comment the seeder writes is live; only a developer's own soft-deleted comment on a fill post would be counted. Dev-only.
findings.resolution_ru: Пересчёт комментариев не исключает мягко удалённые. Итог: для прямого подсчёта через DB::table это верно, но все комментарии сидера живые, и посчитан был бы только собственный удалённый комментарий разработчика на fill-посте. Только для разработки.

findings.claim: Cleanup deletes votes of generated comments that are then retained because outsiders replied.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only edge case (a local non-fill user replying to generated comments).
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка удаляет голоса сгенерированных комментариев, которые остаются из-за ответов посторонних. Итог: крайний случай только в разработке, когда локальный пользователь не из fill отвечает на сгенерированные комментарии.

findings.claim: Cleanup force-deletes reported generated comments, orphaning reports.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only edge case; the large dataset creates no reports.
findings.resolution_ru: Очистка принудительно удаляет сгенерированные комментарии с жалобами, оставляя жалобы без комментариев. Итог: крайний случай только в разработке, большой набор данных жалоб не создаёт.

findings.claim: The bulk delete can remove tags still attached to posts, cascading the pivot.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; it deletes only the retired demo slugs category-a..d and source-a/b.
findings.resolution_ru: Массовое удаление может снести теги, ещё привязанные к постам, каскадом через pivot. Итог: только для разработки, удаляются лишь выведенные из оборота демо-слаги category-a..d и source-a/b.

findings.claim: Demo comments are added to every published post, not only demo posts.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only seeder whose job is to populate the local feed.
findings.resolution_ru: Демо-комментарии добавляются ко всем опубликованным постам, а не только к демо-постам. Итог: это сидер только для разработки, и его задача как раз наполнить локальную ленту.

findings.claim: Comment body is the upsert identity, so a renamed post gets duplicate demo comments.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; demo post titles are fixed.
findings.resolution_ru: Тело комментария служит ключом upsert, поэтому переименованный пост получит дубли демо-комментариев. Итог: только для разработки, а заголовки демо-постов фиксированы.

findings.claim: Missing tags are detected after the post was written.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; DemoTagsSeeder runs first and a failure is fixed by rerunning.
findings.resolution_ru: Отсутствующие теги обнаруживаются уже после записи поста. Итог: только для разработки; DemoTagsSeeder запускается раньше, а сбой исправляется повторным запуском.

findings.claim: updateOrCreate ignores soft-deleted demo posts, so reseeding creates a duplicate.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; requires soft-deleting a demo post and reseeding without migrate:fresh.
findings.resolution_ru: updateOrCreate не видит мягко удалённые демо-посты, и повторный посев создаёт дубль. Итог: только для разработки, и для этого нужно мягко удалить демо-пост и пересеять без migrate:fresh.

findings.claim: The demo admin/moderator upsert fails if another local account already uses the username.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; the documented workflow is migrate:fresh --seed.
findings.resolution_ru: upsert демо-админа и модератора падает, если имя пользователя уже занято другим локальным аккаунтом. Итог: только для разработки, документированный порядок работы это migrate:fresh --seed.

findings.claim: Vote upserts and recounts are not in one transaction.
findings.reasoning: Dev-only; a failed seed is rerun.
findings.resolution_ru: upsert голосов и пересчёты идут не в одной транзакции. Итог: только для разработки, упавший посев просто запускают повторно.

findings.claim: Nullsafe calls ($user?->delete(), $model?->update(), $request?->validate(), ?->paginate()) are NullsafeMethodCall nodes and bypass rules that only dispatch MethodCall.
findings.reasoning: PHPStan processes every NullsafeMethodCall by building a plain MethodCall twin (attribute virtualNullsafeMethodCall) and walking it with the same rule callbacks on a scope where the receiver is narrowed to non-null (phpstan.phar src/Analyser/ExprHandler/NullsafeMethodCallHandler.php), so Rule<MethodCall> and Rule<CallLike> see `$x?->m()` as a MethodCall with a non-null receiver. The repository already pins this: tests/PHPStan/Fixtures/Controllers/DirectPermissionCheck.php:142 and :147 use `$user?->canCreateContent()` / `$person?->isStaff()` and NoDirectControllerPermissionCheckRuleTest.php:56-63 expects errors on those lines from a Rule<MethodCall>.
findings.resolution_ru: Nullsafe-вызовы вроде $user?->delete() якобы обходят правила на MethodCall. Итог: бот ошибся, PHPStan прогоняет каждый NullsafeMethodCall через те же правила как обычный MethodCall; это уже закреплено фикстурой DirectPermissionCheck.php и NoDirectControllerPermissionCheckRuleTest.

findings.claim: Deletes issued through a User-scoped builder or relation (User::query()->delete(), User::where(...)->delete()) are not rejected by the physical-deletion rule.
findings.reasoning: processInstanceCall only fires when the receiver itself is a User (`ObjectType(User)->isSuperTypeOf(...)->yes()`, line 68), and processStaticCall only knows destroy/forceDestroy (lines 36, 78-80); a Builder<User> or BelongsTo<User> receiver (`$comment->user()->delete()`) therefore passes. The rule's docblock (lines 22-26) states the invariant as 'never a physical users-row delete', while docs/architecture/user-lifecycle.md:176 lists only the four call forms. No app code does this today; FK RESTRICT (docs/architecture/community-fk-safety.md) still refuses deleting users with content, but a content-less account would be physically deleted.
findings.scenario: A scheduled cleanup adds `User::query()->whereNull('email_verified_at')->where('created_at', '<', now()->subDays(30))->delete();` - the non-ignorable guard stays green and unverified accounts are physically removed instead of anonymized.

findings.claim: (Found during triage) The strict `->yes()` receiver checks reject nullable receiver types, so `$request->user()->delete()` and `$this->post->update()` on a `?Post` property escape the rules.
findings.reasoning: Larastan types `$request->user()` / `auth()->user()` as `User|null` (vendor/larastan/larastan/src/ReturnTypes/RequestUserExtension.php:58, TypeCombinator::addNull); `ObjectType(User)->isSuperTypeOf(User|null)` is Maybe, so NoPhysicalUserDeletionRule.php:68 returns no error for the canonical Laravel account-deletion shape `$user = $request->user(); Auth::logout(); $user->delete();` - the very `$user->delete()` the rule and user-lifecycle.md:176 say is banned. EloquentCallInspector.php:24-27 has the same strictness, so a Livewire component with `public ?Post $post` (app/Livewire/Voting/RatingVoting.php:22 declares one) can call `$this->post->update([...])` without NoPresentationModelMutationRule firing, while the nullsafe form is caught (see 19-01). Level 5 does not report calls on possibly-null receivers, and current app code narrows with instanceof/assert first (e.g. VerifyEmailController.php:18-20), so nothing slips through today.
findings.scenario: A contributor ports Breeze's ProfileController::destroy (`$request->user()->delete()`) into a controller; the non-ignorable physical-deletion rule and the presentation-mutation rule both stay green.

findings.claim: The banned method lists omit other physical deletions of users rows: User::truncate(), $user->deleteQuietly(), $user->deleteOrFail().
findings.reasoning: INSTANCE_METHODS is [delete, forceDelete] and STATIC_METHODS is [destroy, forceDestroy] (lines 34-36). Model::deleteQuietly() and deleteOrFail() (framework Eloquent/Model.php:1832, :1844) physically delete a User (User has no SoftDeletes), and `User::truncate()` forwards to the query builder, which on PostgreSQL compiles to `truncate "users" restart identity cascade` (PostgresGrammar.php:727, $cascadeTruncate defaults to true) - emptying every table that references users. None of these appear in app code.
findings.scenario: An Action calls `$user->deleteQuietly()` to avoid observers; CI stays green and the users row is removed (or the request 500s on an FK RESTRICT).

findings.claim: Method names are matched case-sensitively while PHP dispatch is case-insensitive, so `->SAVE()`, `DB::Table()`, `$user->Delete()` bypass the rules.
findings.reasoning: True: every rule uses in_array(..., true) on the written name (EloquentMutationDetector.php:66, RestrictedDatabaseFacadeRule.php:63/75, RestrictedRawQueryRule.php:63, NoPhysicalUserDeletionRule.php:61, NoDirectControllerPermissionCheckRule.php:82). But only a deliberate evasion writes a miscased call, and such a contributor has unlimited other routes ($m = 'delete'; $user->$m(), call_user_func). If wanted, a single `checkFunctionNameCase: true` in phpstan.neon (the parameter exists, default false) makes PHPStan reject every miscased call globally instead of patching five rules.
findings.resolution_ru: Имена методов сравниваются с учётом регистра, и ->SAVE() или DB::Table() обходят правила. Итог: верно, но так пишет только тот, кто намеренно обходит проверку, и у него есть другие пути; при желании это глобально закрывает checkFunctionNameCase: true в phpstan.neon.

findings.claim: The DB facade blocklist omits query-executing methods such as cursor() and selectFromWriteConnection().
findings.reasoning: RESTRICTED_METHODS (lines 24-39) lacks cursor and selectFromWriteConnection (both run SQL on the connection) and also getPdo/getReadPdo (raw PDO access); anything not listed and not 'transaction' returns [] (lines 75-77). docs/architecture/http-and-database-boundaries.md:53-56 says direct SQL execution is rejected and that there are no low-level exceptions. app/ uses only DB::transaction and DB::afterCommit, so this is latent.
findings.scenario: A Service iterates `DB::cursor('select * from users where ...')`; CI stays green although direct SQL is banned.

findings.claim: Only DB::transaction() counts as transaction management; DB::beginTransaction()/commit()/rollBack() pass in presentation classes, Query Objects and Policies.
findings.reasoning: RestrictedDatabaseFacadeRule.php:63 and NoReadOnlyLayerMutationRule.php:76 match only the literal 'transaction', and beginTransaction/commit/rollBack are not in RESTRICTED_METHODS either, so manual transaction control is flagged nowhere. The docs forbid transactions in presentation (http-and-database-boundaries.md:107) and in Query Objects/Policies (:43-45, :105). No current usage in app/.
findings.scenario: A Livewire component wraps two Action calls in DB::beginTransaction()/DB::commit(); CI is green and presentation owns a transaction.

findings.claim: Static calls through a class-string expression ($modelClass::create(), static::getModel()::query()) are never recognised as Eloquent calls.
findings.reasoning: isModelStaticCall returns false unless $node->class is a Name (lines 60-62), so every mutation/query rule ignores `$class::create([...])` with class-string<Model>; NoPhysicalUserDeletionRule.php:80 and RestrictedRawQueryRule.php:132 have the same Name-only guard. No such call exists in app/ today (grep).
findings.scenario: A Filament page persists with `static::getModel()::create($data)` - a presentation-layer write the mutation rule does not see.

findings.claim: Eloquent Collection receivers are not recognised, so `$users->load(...)` / `loadMissing()` in controllers bypass the controller-read rule.
findings.reasoning: NoControllerEloquentQueryRule flags MODEL_READ_METHODS only with hasModelOrQueryReceiver (NoControllerEloquentQueryRule.php:85-86), whose list has no Eloquent\Collection (EloquentCallInspector.php:24), so a collection's load/loadCount/fresh - real queries - pass in a controller, though http-and-database-boundaries.md:39-41 puts relationship loading in Query Objects. The suggested fix is wrong as stated: adding the collection to the shared receiver list would also feed EloquentMutationDetector, whose METHODS contain 'push' (Support\Collection::push), creating false positives in Livewire/Filament. No controller calls load today.
findings.scenario: A controller does `$posts = $query->get(); $posts->load('user');` and CI passes.

findings.claim: METHODS omits persisting calls such as createQuietly, createOrFirst, truncate, insertUsing, incrementEach/decrementEach.
findings.reasoning: The list (lines 18-60) lacks createQuietly (Eloquent/Builder.php:1290), createOrFirst, truncate, insertUsing, insertOrIgnoreUsing, incrementEach/decrementEach, updateOrFail, deleteOrFail, incrementQuietly/decrementQuietly and updateFrom, so these pass both NoPresentationModelMutationRule and NoReadOnlyLayerMutationRule. truncate on PostgreSQL cascades (see 19-04). None occur in presentation, Query Object or Policy code today (grep).
findings.scenario: A Filament page calls `Category::query()->createOrFirst([...])` - a presentation write CI does not flag.

findings.claim: RESTRICTED_METHODS omits common Request input readers (except, post, json, keys, allFiles, filled, missing, cookie...).
findings.reasoning: Any method not in the list returns [] at lines 72-73 even on a Request receiver, and the list (27-45) misses except, post, json, str (alias of the listed string), keys, filled, anyFilled, isNotFilled, missing, exists, hasFile, allFiles, cookie, whenHas/whenFilled/whenMissing and fluent. docs/architecture/http-and-database-boundaries.md:97-99 promises rejection of unvalidated request input regardless of variable name. validated()/safe() stay allowed because safe() returns ValidatedInput, not a Request, so `$request->safe()->except()` is unaffected. No controller uses these readers today.
findings.scenario: A controller passes `$request->except('_token')` or `$request->str('q')` straight to an Action; CI is green although the input never went through the Form Request rules.

findings.claim: Request facade calls such as Request::input('status') are never checked.
findings.reasoning: The rule inspects only ArrayDimFetch, PropertyFetch and MethodCall on a Request-typed receiver (lines 59-78), so a StaticCall on Illuminate\Support\Facades\Request is ignored; so is the more common `request('status')` helper (a FuncCall). `request()->input()` is caught because its receiver is typed Request. Neither form appears in app/Http/Controllers today.
findings.scenario: A controller reads `request('page')` or `Request::input('status')`; CI passes.

findings.claim: Static model pagination such as Post::paginate(15) bypasses the registered-pagination boundary because the rule only dispatches MethodCall.
findings.reasoning: getNodeType() is MethodCall (line 28) and the receiver test is hasQueryReceiver (line 36: Builder/QueryBuilder/Relation only), so `Post::paginate(15)` - the idiom in Laravel's own pagination docs, forwarded via Model::__callStatic - is never examined. HTTP controllers are still covered by NoControllerEloquentQueryRule, but Livewire, Filament, Services, Actions and unregistered Query Objects are not, which is exactly what http-and-database-boundaries.md:122-125 forbids. (The nullsafe half of cubic's claim is invalid, see 19-01.) Every Eloquent paginate call in app/ today is a builder chain inside App\Queries.
findings.scenario: A Livewire list renders `Post::paginate(20)`: no unique final order, rows repeat or vanish between pages under tied sort values, and CI is green.

findings.claim: growthComparedTo() compares per entry rather than per key, so duplicating an existing suppression entry passes the growth guard.
findings.reasoning: indexedEntries() keeps the last entry per key (line 164) and growthComparedTo() checks each current entry alone (130-152): base {K: 2} vs current {K: 2, K: 2} reports nothing although findings() grows. PHPStan honours both entries - once one entry's count is used up the error falls through to the next matching entry (IgnoredErrorHelperResult::process, `$realCount > $ignore['count']`). Unreachable today: there is no phpstan-baseline.neon and CI's base is the empty file created by `|| touch` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:81-87), so every entry is reported as new.
findings.scenario: Once a baseline exists on develop, a PR copies an existing entry to hide new errors of an already-suppressed pattern and the guard passes.

findings.claim: Model instances are missing from the MethodCall receiver list, so `$model->whereRaw(...)` bypasses the raw-query rule.
findings.reasoning: The MethodCall branch accepts only Builder/QueryBuilder/Relation (line 123) while the StaticCall branch accepts Model (line 138); `$post->whereRaw(...)` forwards through Model::__call to a fresh query and is not flagged. Non-idiomatic and absent from app/, so the gap is latent; nullable receivers are a separate gap (19-03).
findings.scenario: A Service writes `(new Post)->whereRaw("title = '$t'")->get()` outside the reviewed allowlist; CI passes.

findings.claim: Static model lock calls like Post::lockForUpdate()->first() are not flagged in Query Objects or Policies.
findings.reasoning: The lock check requires a MethodCall with hasQueryReceiver (lines 45-48), so `Post::lockForUpdate()` (StaticCall on a Model) slips through, against http-and-database-boundaries.md:43-45. The codebase never uses the static form (0 occurrences against 99 builder-chained ->lockForUpdate()), so this is a latent gap.
findings.scenario: A Query Object reads `Post::lockForUpdate()->find($id)`; the read-only-layer rule stays silent.

findings.claim: architecture.neon approves six raw-SQL boundaries that the documented reviewed-boundaries list does not mention.
findings.reasoning: The registry approves 13 classes (architecture.neon:7-119); docs/architecture/http-and-database-boundaries.md:64-77 lists 7 and omits ModerationPostsQuery, ModerationCommentsQuery, ModerationReportsQuery, ModerationUsersQuery, PersonasQuery and MediaAuditIssuesQuery, although lines 82-88 require every new exception to be documented there. Enforcement itself is fine (tests/PHPStan/ArchitectureRegistryTest.php:40-62 checks each entry); only the review contract is stale.
findings.scenario: A reviewer auditing raw SQL against the document misses six approved boundaries, including searches over users.email.

findings.claim: BaselineInventory throws on valid baseline entries without an identifier, breaking baseline-report.php and baseline-guard.php.
findings.reasoning: True that appendEntry() throws when identifier (or count/path) is missing (lines 184-188), and PHPStan's BaselineNeonErrorFormatter omits identifier for identifier-less errors. The failure is closed: both CI steps exit non-zero, and under the documented zero-baseline policy (http-and-database-boundaries.md:136-140) any entry fails the guard anyway; only the error message is less clear.
findings.resolution_ru: BaselineInventory падает на записях baseline без identifier, ломая baseline-report.php и baseline-guard.php. Итог: верно, но сбой закрытый: оба шага CI завершаются с ошибкой, а при политике нулевого baseline любая запись и так валит guard; страдает только понятность сообщения.

findings.claim: The namespace prefix check also matches sibling namespaces such as App\QueriesLegacy, which then get the wrong diagnostic.
findings.reasoning: Such a namespace would get 'unregistered pagination' instead of 'outside boundary' (line 41) - still an error, never a pass, because isRegistered() matches exact class names (60-72) whose namespace ArchitectureRegistryTest.php:126-131 pins to App\Queries\. No such namespace exists; cosmetic.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка префикса namespace захватывает соседние вроде App\QueriesLegacy с неверной диагностикой. Итог: такой namespace получит другое сообщение, но всё равно ошибку, а не пропуск; такого namespace нет, вопрос косметический.

findings.claim: unquote() handles only single-quoted NEON values while PHPStan writes double-quoted escaped strings.
findings.reasoning: PHPStan writes the baseline with Nette Neon (BaselineNeonErrorFormatter, Neon::encode BLOCK); Neon's StringNode::toString emits single-line strings single-quoted with '' doubling and uses double quotes only for strings containing control characters. unquote() therefore strips the quotes PHPStan actually produces; the only artefact is that a doubled '' stays doubled in the JSON report, identically on both sides, so comparisons are unaffected.
findings.resolution_ru: unquote() якобы понимает только одинарные кавычки NEON, а PHPStan пишет двойные. Итог: бот ошибся, PHPStan пишет baseline через Nette Neon, который ставит одинарные кавычки, а двойные только для строк с управляющими символами; удвоенные '' одинаковы на обеих сторонах сравнения.

findings.claim: Terminal reads forwarded from model-instance receivers (e.g. $post->count()) are not flagged in controllers.
findings.reasoning: True that a forwarded terminal call on a model instance returns a non-query type and is not in MODEL_READ_METHODS (lines 84-86), but calling table-wide terminal queries on a model instance is non-idiomatic; the static form (Post::count()) and relation/builder forms are flagged. Speculative.
findings.resolution_ru: Терминальные чтения на экземпляре модели (например $post->count()) в контроллерах не ловятся. Итог: верно, но такой вызов на экземпляре неидиоматичен, а статическая форма Post::count() и формы через связь и builder ловятся; находка умозрительная.

findings.claim: rateguru.controller.eloquentQuery is ignorable, so ignoreErrors entries or generated baselines can suppress controller query violations.
findings.reasoning: docs/architecture/http-and-database-boundaries.md:136-140 states that reintroducing any suppression fails the guard and that rateguru.* identifiers are never suppressible, but only NoPhysicalUserDeletionRule.php:101 and NoDirectControllerPermissionCheckRule.php:75 call ->nonIgnorable(); the other ten rules can be suppressed. The guard cannot compensate: baseline-guard.php:15 reads only phpstan-baseline.neon, so an inline `// @phpstan-ignore rateguru.controller.eloquentQuery`, an ignoreErrors entry in phpstan.neon, or a baseline under another file name passes CI with every counter at zero. No suppression exists in app/ or phpstan.neon today (grep finds only test fixtures).
findings.scenario: A contributor facing a red architecture check adds `// @phpstan-ignore rateguru.presentation.modelMutation` above a Livewire `$post->update()`; CI is green and the suppression report shows 0.

findings.claim: The permission check should report only when the receiver is a User or another authorization type, not any object with a matching method name.
findings.reasoning: Name-only matching for PERMISSION_METHODS is deliberate: the docblock at lines 42-49 explains that only isStaff, which UserRole shares, is receiver-typed, and the fixtures pin both behaviours (DirectPermissionCheck.php:113-118 and :150-154 allow the enum while every other name is flagged). The names are RateGuru capability vocabulary and CI is green, so no unrelated presentation object collides; typing the receiver would lose detection on Authenticatable-typed receivers.
findings.resolution_ru: Проверка прав якобы должна срабатывать только при получателе типа User. Итог: бот ошибся, сопоставление по имени намеренное (описано в docblock, закреплено фикстурами), имена из словаря RateGuru ни с чем не сталкиваются, а типизация потеряла бы срабатывание на Authenticatable.

findings.claim: validate()/validateWithBag() calls through the ValidatesRequests controller trait are not detected.
findings.reasoning: The rule requires a Request receiver (line 41), so `$this->validate($request, [...])` from ValidatesRequests passes. The base controller has no trait (app/Http/Controllers/Controller.php), so today such a call is an undefined-method error; the gap opens only if someone adds the trait, which is a visible change. http-and-database-boundaries.md:13-15 bans inline validate() in controllers.
findings.scenario: A controller adds `use ValidatesRequests;` and `$data = $this->validate($request, [...])`; the inline-validation rule stays silent.

findings.claim: Every Request PropertyFetch is reported, including metadata such as $request->headers, which is a false positive.
findings.reasoning: True (lines 63-64 report any property fetch on a Request), but it is a false positive, not a miss; `$request->header('Accept')` is an unflagged way to read headers, and no controller reads headers today.
findings.resolution_ru: Любое обращение к свойству Request, включая $request->headers, считается ошибкой. Итог: верно, но это ложное срабатывание, а не пропуск; заголовки можно читать через $request->header('Accept'), и сейчас ни один контроллер их не читает.

findings.claim: The tied-row feed test should also assert the descending id tie-breaker in the query orders.
findings.reasoning: This is a test-strength suggestion about tests/Feature/Queries/FeedQueryTest.php, not about the cited rule lines, and the behaviour is already pinned: 'uses post id as the final deterministic feed order' (FeedQueryTest.php:170-183) creates three fully tied rows for newest/top/hot and asserts id-descending order.
findings.resolution_ru: Тест ленты с равными строками должен проверять и порядок по id по убыванию. Итог: это совет к FeedQueryTest.php, а не к правилу, и поведение уже закреплено тестом 'uses post id as the final deterministic feed order' для newest/top/hot.

findings.claim: An empty bindings array passes the 'bindings: required' check even if the SQL interpolates user values.
findings.reasoning: True that line 71 only checks that a second argument exists. A static 'no interpolation' rule is not cheap because an approved call legitimately interpolates a trusted per-engine expression (app/Queries/Translations/TranslationAiUsageQuery.php:162-163), and every approved class is human-reviewed and behaviour-tested via the registry. Cost exceeds value.
findings.resolution_ru: Пустой bindings проходит проверку, даже если SQL подставляет пользовательские значения. Итог: верно, но правило против подстановки дорого (TranslationAiUsageQuery законно подставляет доверенное выражение), а все одобренные классы проверены ревью и тестами; затраты больше пользы.

findings.claim: The line-by-line parser mishandles multi-line NEON messages, so different message patterns can collide.
findings.reasoning: True that a multi-line value (`message: '''`) is read as `'` (lines 43-55 plus unquote), so two multi-line messages in one file and identifier share a key. PHPStan error messages essentially never contain newlines, and with the empty base CI uses every entry is new regardless of key.
findings.resolution_ru: Построчный парсер неверно читает многострочные сообщения NEON, и разные шаблоны могут совпасть по ключу. Итог: верно, но сообщения PHPStan практически не содержат переводов строк, а при пустой базе в CI каждая запись новая независимо от ключа.

findings.claim: A missing, explicitly supplied current-baseline path is silently treated as an empty baseline.
findings.reasoning: fromFile() returns an empty inventory for a missing path (lines 29-31). CI never passes a current path (ci.yml:103-114 relies on the default) and the base file always exists (`|| touch`), so only a manual typo is affected. The larger gap - suppressions that live outside phpstan-baseline.neon - is 19-22.
findings.resolution_ru: Явно указанный, но отсутствующий путь к текущему baseline молча считается пустым. Итог: CI этот путь не передаёт, а базовый файл всегда есть (|| touch), так что затронута лишь ручная опечатка; более крупный пробел с подавлениями вне phpstan-baseline.neon это находка 19-22.

findings.claim: Receiver checks require one supported class to cover the whole type, so unions of supported database types are not recognised.
findings.reasoning: Each class is tested on its own with yes() (lines 24-28, 40-44), so a union like Builder<Post>|HasMany<Post> (from `$cond ? Post::query() : $user->posts()`) is Maybe for every class and escapes the mutation, query and pagination rules. Model unions (Post|Comment) already pass because Model covers both. Rare as a union of builders; the common form of the same strictness - a nullable receiver - is 19-03, which rabbit's proposal (keep rejecting unions with unsupported members, i.e. null) would not fix.
findings.scenario: A Livewire method picks `$q = $own ? $user->posts() : Post::query();` then calls `$q->update([...])`; no rule fires.

findings.claim: --base is declared with an optional value, so `--base` without a value is silently ignored.
findings.reasoning: getopt('base::') yields false for a bare --base and the script falls back to delta 0 (lines 9-17). CI always passes `--base=/tmp/phpstan-base-baseline.neon` (ci.yml:107-108) and the delta is informational; only a manual typo is affected.
findings.resolution_ru: --base объявлен с необязательным значением, и --base без значения молча игнорируется. Итог: CI всегда передаёт --base=/tmp/phpstan-base-baseline.neon, дельта носит информационный характер, затронута лишь ручная опечатка.

findings.claim: The return value of file_put_contents to GITHUB_OUTPUT is not checked.
findings.reasoning: A failed append to the runner-provided GITHUB_OUTPUT file would only blank the summary outputs; the step's JSON still goes to stdout/artifact and the guard is a separate step (ci.yml:112-114). Not worth hardening.
findings.resolution_ru: Результат file_put_contents в GITHUB_OUTPUT не проверяется. Итог: сбой записи лишь обнулит выходы сводки, JSON всё равно уходит в stdout и артефакт, а guard это отдельный шаг; укреплять не стоит.

findings.claim: An empty before group should be rejected instead of producing an empty comparison table.
findings.reasoning: An argument like `,` yields an empty group and the table header reads 'median of 0' with dashes - self-evident to the operator. The script is a manual operator tool; CI only mentions it in a comment (ci.yml:291-292).
findings.resolution_ru: Пустую группу before стоит отвергать, а не строить пустую таблицу сравнения. Итог: таблица с 'median of 0' и прочерками сама всё объясняет оператору; это ручной инструмент, CI упоминает его только в комментарии.

findings.claim: The jobs request stops at per_page=100 and should paginate.
findings.reasoning: The workflows the tool compares have far fewer jobs: ci.yml defines 13 jobs with one 4-leg matrix (about 16 jobs per run), and the jobs endpoint returns one attempt's jobs, so per_page=100 (line 79) always returns the full set.
findings.resolution_ru: Запрос jobs останавливается на per_page=100 и должен листать страницы. Итог: бот ошибся, в ci.yml около 16 jobs на запуск, а endpoint возвращает jobs одной попытки, так что per_page=100 всегда отдаёт полный набор.

findings.claim: Runs with unfinished jobs produce partial timings, or a nonsensical result when no job has finished.
findings.reasoning: Jobs without started_at/completed_at are skipped silently (lines 95-97), so an in-progress run contributes partial job metrics and a wall time that ends at its last finished job; a run with no finished job yields $finished - $queued = -INF - INF, printed through (int) round(-INF). The tool is manual, but its tables go into pull requests as evidence of CI speed.
findings.scenario: The operator includes a still-running run id among five; the medians silently include a truncated wall time.

findings.claim: Repeated step names within a job overwrite each other in the metrics key.
findings.reasoning: No job in .github/workflows/ci.yml has two steps with the same name (checked every job), GitHub's synthetic steps (Set up job, Post ..., Complete job) are unique per job, and matrix legs get distinct job names, so `job > step` (line 108) is unique.
findings.resolution_ru: Одинаковые имена шагов в job перезаписывают друг друга в ключе метрик. Итог: бот ошибся, в ci.yml нет job с двумя одноимёнными шагами, служебные шаги GitHub уникальны в пределах job, а ветки matrix получают разные имена, так что ключ job > step уникален.

findings.claim: A single timing ratio becomes its own baseline, so a lone file's regression can never be reported.
findings.reasoning: True for a leg with exactly one file planned at 2 s or more (lines 61-76), but tests/.pest/shards.json has 109 such files across 4 legs (about 27 per leg), so the case does not occur; the script only writes a job-summary warning and never fails a run (ci.yml:569-582).
findings.resolution_ru: Единственное отношение времени становится собственной базой, и регрессию одиночного файла не заметить. Итог: верно для ветки ровно с одним файлом от 2 с, но в tests/.pest/shards.json таких 109 на 4 ветки, так что случай не возникает; скрипт лишь пишет предупреждение в сводку.

findings.claim: PR description lacks the template sections and docstring coverage is below threshold.
findings.reasoning: PR-description and docstring checks on a review-only PR; not code defects.
findings.resolution_ru: В описании PR нет разделов шаблона, покрытие docstring ниже порога. Итог: это проверки описания и docstring на PR только для ревью, а не дефекты кода.

findings.claim: The default CreatePost action and StudioPlanFactory::status() build Approved plans with no author or approver, and an actor who is not the plan's author - states approval never produces.
findings.reasoning: status() only sets status (StudioPlanFactory.php:61-64), so an 'Approved' plan keeps author, title, approved_by_user_id and approved_at null; StudioActionFactory's default (lines 29-32) pairs it with a fresh persona, while ExecuteStudioAction::publishPost requires status Running, author_user_id === actor and a matching approver (ExecuteStudioAction.php:327-333). The docblock (lines 19-20) wrongly says it is made 'as ApproveStudioPlanAction makes it'. This is a never-made state, but no test passes for the wrong reason: execution tests build plans explicitly or via approvedStudioAction() (tests/Pest.php:14063, StudioExecutorRaceTest.php:40-57), and status(Approved) callers only test 'refuses a non-Draft', which reads status alone.
findings.scenario: A future executor test built on StudioAction::factory()->create() stops with PlanUnavailable - and if it asserts a stop for another reason, passes for the wrong one.

findings.claim: target_type and target_id are coupled, so overriding only target_type leaves target_id pointing at an unrelated Post.
findings.reasoning: Every one of the 38 target_type overrides in tests also sets target_id (grep), so the coupling is never split; per-target states would be a refactor with no present defect.
findings.resolution_ru: target_type и target_id связаны, и переопределение только target_type оставит target_id на чужом Post. Итог: все 38 переопределений target_type в тестах задают и target_id; отдельные состояния под каждую цель были бы рефакторингом без текущего дефекта.

findings.claim: The (int) cast turns a plan without a photo into source_image_asset_id 0 instead of failing.
findings.reasoning: The default plan is made withImage(), so normally the value is real. When a test overrides studio_plan_id with an image-less plan, value('image_asset_id') is null and the cast stores 0; the column is NOT NULL with no foreign key (migration 2026_10_19_110000 lines 22-27), so a row 'about photo 0' is written silently - a state the product never makes, since requests refuse plans without a photo. The same pattern is in StudioPlanTextGenerationFactory.php:29 and StudioPlanDiscussionGenerationFactory.php:45.
findings.scenario: A test of 'an analysis whose photo is no longer the plan's is ignored' built with an image-less plan passes because 0 differs from null, not because the photo was replaced.

findings.claim: Comment, PostVote and Report defaults target a pending post although the product only allows them on published posts.
findings.reasoning: True: PostFactory's default is Pending (PostFactory.php:25), so these are never-made states. But tests that depend on visibility create published posts explicitly (e.g. CommentTombstonePresentationTest.php:20-31; all typed report overrides set their target), CommentPolicy does not read the post's status, and flipping the defaults would add published posts to roughly 300 factory calls and perturb feed and count tests. No wrong-pass found in the visibility tests sampled; cost exceeds value.
findings.resolution_ru: Comment, PostVote и Report по умолчанию ссылаются на pending-пост, хотя продукт допускает их только на опубликованных. Итог: верно, но тесты видимости явно создают опубликованные посты, а смена умолчаний затронет около 300 вызовов фабрик и тесты ленты; затраты больше пользы.

findings.claim: RatingGroupFactory creates an active group with zero options although min_options is 2.
findings.reasoning: Production refuses to create an active group (CreateRatingGroupAction.php:27-29), but in tests the state is transient: the 137 usages attach options right after, and making the default inactive would ripple through all of them.
findings.resolution_ru: RatingGroupFactory создаёт активную группу без вариантов при min_options 2. Итог: production такую группу создать не даёт, а в тестах состояние временное: все 137 использований сразу добавляют варианты, и неактивное умолчание затронуло бы их все.

findings.claim: The default MissingMasterFile issue has no asset, disk or path although production always records them.
findings.reasoning: A never-made state, but tests that read those fields set them (MediaAuditIssuesQueryTest.php:32-33, MediaAuditModelsTest.php:38) and default rows are used only for counting and pagination; per-type payload states would be a refactor.
findings.resolution_ru: Проблема MissingMasterFile по умолчанию без asset, disk и path, хотя production их всегда пишет. Итог: тесты, читающие эти поля, задают их сами, а строки по умолчанию идут только на подсчёт и пагинацию; отдельные состояния по типам были бы рефакторингом.

findings.claim: resolved() attributes the resolution to a regular user, although only moderators and admins process reports.
findings.reasoning: resolved_by is a plain User::factory() (line 42) while ReportPolicy::resolve requires canProcess (ReportPolicy.php:10-12). Current callers (IgnoreReportActionTest.php:52, the retention and purge service tests) need only a non-null resolver, so nothing passes for the wrong reason; it is a never-made state with a one-word fix.
findings.scenario: A future test of report attribution or moderator statistics built on resolved() exercises a resolver the product cannot have.

findings.claim: MediaVariantFactory's default is a JPEG although display variants are WebP, and named() keeps PostFeed640's 640x360 JPEG metadata for every name.
findings.reasoning: The default is 640x360 image/jpeg .jpg (lines 21-28) while MediaVariantSpecificationRegistry.php:31-39 writes every display variant as image/webp (only OpenGraph is JPEG), and named() changes only the name (34-37), so named(PostDetail1920) or Avatar128 keeps 640x360 JPEG. Tests that depend on dimensions or MIME override them (postWithVariants in tests/Pest.php:8582-8586, PostOpenGraphTest.php:88-95), so no wrong-pass was found; it is a never-made state with a single authoritative source to follow.
findings.scenario: A srcset or picture-type test using named() without overrides asserts against dimensions and a MIME type no real variant has.

findings.claim: The default full-discussion generation has no Personas and its parameters omit source_text_fingerprint, so tests cannot exercise the stale-text check.
findings.reasoning: The factory's docblock declares the default a placeholder: 'Its hashes are placeholders: a generation that must fit a plan's context is asked for through RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationAction' (lines 22-26). A row without source_text_fingerprint is a defined state - the model says 'One asked for before the texts were kept with it says nothing' (StudioPlanDiscussionGeneration.php:136-149) - and the tests of the stale-text check add or remove the key explicitly (StudioPlanDiscussionGenerationUiTest.php:710-715, RequestStudioDiscussionGenerationActionTest.php:90, :189).
findings.resolution_ru: Генерация по умолчанию без Personas и без source_text_fingerprint якобы не даёт проверить устаревший текст. Итог: бот ошибся, docblock фабрики объявляет умолчание заглушкой, строка без fingerprint это определённое моделью состояние, а тесты проверки явно добавляют или убирают ключ.

findings.claim: authorDeleted() accepts Hidden and Deleted as source states that author deletion rejects.
findings.reasoning: No test passes Hidden or Deleted (the only explicit argument used is Rejected), and Post re-checks deleted_from_status against AUTHOR_DELETABLE_STATUSES before allowing an author restore (Post.php:141), so the model treats such rows defensively; a factory guard is optional.
findings.resolution_ru: authorDeleted() принимает Hidden и Deleted, которые удаление автором отвергает. Итог: ни один тест их не передаёт (используется только Rejected), а Post перед восстановлением сверяет deleted_from_status с AUTHOR_DELETABLE_STATUSES; защита в фабрике необязательна.

findings.claim: onComment(), forRating() and down() do not reset each other's fields, so combinations build rows studio_plan_votes_target_check rejects.
findings.reasoning: Combining contradictory target states fails loudly at insert on studio_plan_votes_target_check (migration 2026_10_21_100000 lines 83 and 128), and no test combines them.
findings.resolution_ru: onComment(), forRating() и down() не сбрасывают поля друг друга, и комбинации дают строки, которые отвергает studio_plan_votes_target_check. Итог: такая комбинация громко падает при вставке на этом CHECK, и ни один тест их не сочетает.

findings.claim: definition() hashes the analysis alone and skips the author-voice hash used by forPlan() and StudioPostTextContext::sourceHashOf().
findings.reasoning: sourceHashOf() returns the analysis hash unchanged when there is no author (StudioPostTextContext.php:73-77), and the default plan (StudioPlan::factory()->withImage()) has author_user_id null (StudioPlanFactory.php:27), so the default hash is exactly what production stores for that plan; authored plans go through forPlan(), which calls sourceHashOf().
findings.resolution_ru: definition() якобы хэширует только анализ без хэша голоса автора, в отличие от forPlan(). Итог: бот ошибся, sourceHashOf() без автора возвращает хэш анализа как есть, а план по умолчанию без автора, так что хэш совпадает с production; планы с автором идут через forPlan().

findings.claim: The factory stores an incomplete feature-flag set (no allow_url_imports or Content Studio flags).
findings.reasoning: ProjectSettingsManager::current() merges DEFAULTS['feature_flags'] beneath the row's flags (ProjectSettingsManager.php:66-73), and every consumer reads through featureEnabled() (ImportFromUrlAction.php:35, StudioExecutionSwitch.php:28, StudioVerifiedAdults.php:32), so missing keys resolve to the defaults and the factory row behaves exactly like the bootstrap.
findings.resolution_ru: Фабрика хранит неполный набор feature-флагов (нет allow_url_imports и флагов Content Studio). Итог: бот ошибся, ProjectSettingsManager::current() подмешивает DEFAULTS['feature_flags'], а потребители читают через featureEnabled(), так что недостающие ключи берутся по умолчанию.

findings.claim: TagFactory appends a ULID to every tag name and slug instead of a realistic label.
findings.reasoning: Fixture cosmetics; the ULID guarantees unique slugs across many factory calls.
findings.resolution_ru: TagFactory добавляет ULID к имени и slug вместо реалистичной подписи. Итог: это косметика фикстур, а ULID гарантирует уникальные slug при множестве вызовов фабрики.

findings.claim: replyTo() can create a reply-to-reply tree and should reject non-root parents.
findings.reasoning: Tests use replyTo($reply) deliberately to build the invalid reply-to-reply shape the approval preflight must reject (StudioPlanApprovalPreflightTest.php:156-160, 'a reply to a reply' -> discussion_shape_invalid); restricting the helper would remove that fixture route.
findings.resolution_ru: replyTo() позволяет строить ответ на ответ и якобы должна отвергать некорневых родителей. Итог: бот ошибся, тесты намеренно строят через replyTo($reply) недопустимую форму, которую должна отвергнуть предпроверка одобрения (discussion_shape_invalid); ограничение убрало бы эту фикстуру.

findings.claim: withImage() and withAvatar() attach assets whose owner_user_id is null, unlike production.
findings.reasoning: No production code reads media_assets.owner_user_id: it is only written by MediaAssetCreator.php:31 and exposed through a relation (MediaAsset.php:48-50) that nothing calls, and the approval preflight test pins that ownership does not matter ('another administrator's upload' -> no problem). A null owner cannot change any tested outcome.
findings.resolution_ru: withImage() и withAvatar() создают ассеты с owner_user_id null, в отличие от production. Итог: бот ошибся, production-код не читает media_assets.owner_user_id, а тест предпроверки одобрения закрепляет, что владелец не важен; null не меняет ни одного проверяемого результата.

findings.claim: withImage() persists a MediaAsset even when the plan is only made, not created.
findings.reasoning: Laravel's Factory::expandAttributes creates any Factory-valued attribute even for make() (Eloquent/Factories/Factory.php:598-600); StudioPlanFactory's own definition already persists its creator the same way (line 28), and withoutParents() suppresses both. No test calls make() on a StudioPlan factory (grep); the afterCreating style of PostFactory/UserFactory is a consistency point only.
findings.resolution_ru: withImage() сохраняет MediaAsset даже при make() плана. Итог: так Laravel обрабатывает атрибуты-фабрики и при make(), StudioPlanFactory так же сохраняет создателя, а withoutParents() отключает оба; ни один тест не вызывает make() на этой фабрике, вопрос только в единообразии.

threads.claim: This assertion only rejects the selected filename stem, so an error containing `passport.jpg` or another uploader-derived path can still pass. Assert the exact static message to lock in the privacy guarantee.
threads.reply: `couldNotReadUploadedFile()` now takes no arguments and returns fixed text (app/Services/Media/Exceptions/ImageDecodeException.php:16), so nothing uploader-derived can reach the message; the test also asserts no previous exception is chained (tests/Feature/Services/Media/ImageInputTest.php:57). Pinning the exact wording would only couple the test to copy.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил сверять точный статический текст ошибки, а не только имя файла. Итог: отказались, couldNotReadUploadedFile() теперь без аргументов и возвращает фиксированный текст, а тест проверяет отсутствие вложенного исключения; точная формулировка лишь привязала бы тест к тексту.

threads.claim: This test verifies only the configured string, not the isolation level actually used by MySQL or MariaDB. Add an engine-specific integration assertion that opens a transaction and checks the effective isolation level, so a connector/configuration regression cannot pass this test.
threads.reply: `isolation_level` is applied by Laravel's MySqlConnector itself (`SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL`, Connectors/MySqlConnector.php:96-97; MariaDbConnector extends it), so the test pins the setting the framework reads. Querying the server variable would test the framework's connector rather than this change.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил проверять фактический уровень изоляции в MySQL/MariaDB, а не значение конфига. Итог: отказались, isolation_level применяет сам MySqlConnector Laravel через SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL, и запрос к серверу тестировал бы коннектор фреймворка, а не это изменение.

threads.claim: This test cannot construct its span fixture with Sentry 4.34.0 because `Span` requires a `SpanContext`; the test therefore fails before checking transaction redaction. Construct the span with a valid context (or use the SDK's transaction child-span API).
threads.reply: `Span::__construct(?SpanContext $context = null)` takes an optional context in the installed sentry/sentry 4.34.0 (vendor/sentry/sentry/src/Tracing/Span.php:116), so `new Span` at SentryOutgoingRequestPrivacyTest.php:38 constructs fine.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот решил, что тест не соберёт Span без SpanContext в Sentry 4.34.0. Итог: бот ошибся, в установленной sentry/sentry 4.34.0 конструктор Span принимает контекст как необязательный, и new Span в тесте создаётся нормально.

threads.claim: This rejects valid API base URLs whose scheme uses uppercase or mixed case. Normalize the parsed scheme before comparing it so configuration casing does not disable the integration.
threads.reply: This is unchanged behaviour: the check it replaces compared the scheme case-sensitively too (`in_array(..., ['http', 'https'], true)` in the clients), and an uppercase scheme fails closed by leaving the integration unconfigured (ApiBaseUrl.php:21-29). Not worth widening in a security fix.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил нормализовать регистр схемы в базовых URL API. Итог: отказались, поведение не изменилось (прежняя проверка тоже учитывала регистр), а схема в верхнем регистре безопасно оставляет интеграцию ненастроенной; расширять это в исправлении безопасности не стоит.

threads.claim: This test does not exercise the concurrent scenario named in the test. The `tooManyAttempts()` override is unused by the current implementation, so the assertion only verifies that a sequential second `hit()` returns 2; add a deterministic cache barrier or concurrent workers that force both requests to overlap before asserting the limit.
threads.reply: The override is how the race is modelled: it makes `tooManyAttempts()` report the stale count a concurrent request would read, so the previous check-then-hit implementation passes the check and never throws, and this test fails against it (tests/Feature/Support/ActionRateLimiterTest.php:43-52). The new code decides from the atomic `hit()` result alone (ActionRateLimiter.php:20), which is exactly what the test pins.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот счёл, что тест не воспроизводит конкурентный сценарий, а переопределение tooManyAttempts() не используется. Итог: отказались, переопределение и моделирует гонку, отдавая устаревший счётчик, и прежняя реализация тест проваливает; новый код решает только по атомарному hit().

threads.claim: This fix still permits concurrent oversubscription when `CACHE_STORE=file`, which the application explicitly supports and documents. Require an atomic limiter backend such as Redis or database for these keys, or serialize the increment-and-decision with a cross-process lock.
threads.reply: `CACHE_STORE=file` is the local-development default (.env.example:44); deployed targets set the store per target in the Cache / Redis section of infrastructure/config/environment-contract.json:187, where increments are atomic. On the file store this change is no worse than the previous check-then-hit, and mandating a store is outside this PR.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот требовал атомарного хранилища для лимитера, потому что CACHE_STORE=file допускает превышение. Итог: отказались, file это умолчание локальной разработки, развёрнутые окружения задают хранилище с атомарным инкрементом; на file не хуже прежнего, а выбор хранилища вне этого PR.

threads.claim: This privacy setting is ignored by the lower Laravel versions allowed by `composer.json`, so a supported install can still leak query bindings. Raise the framework minimum to the release that introduced `mask_bindings_in_exception_messages` and update the lockfile.
threads.reply: The application installs from composer.lock, which pins laravel/framework v13.40.0, where the option is honoured (Illuminate/Database/Connection.php:871). The real-violation test at tests/Feature/Observability/NightwatchPrivacyTest.php:371 would fail on a framework that ignored it, so the constraint floor changes nothing in practice.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил поднять минимальную версию Laravel ради mask_bindings_in_exception_messages. Итог: отказались, установка идёт из composer.lock с laravel/framework v13.40.0, где опция работает, а тест NightwatchPrivacyTest упал бы на версии, которая её игнорирует.

threads.claim: This dataset does not reproduce an author-deleted post: `delete()` leaves the post `Published` with no `deleted_from_status`, so the regression test never exercises the lifecycle state created by `DeletePostAction`. Use `Post::factory()->authorDeleted()->create()` instead.
threads.reply: The row deliberately keeps status Published so the test proves the relation's SoftDeletes scope alone hides the thread (the reason given in CommentListQuery.php:85). `authorDeleted()` also sets status Deleted (database/factories/PostFactory.php:77-84), which `published()` already excludes, so it would pass without that scope and cover less.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил создавать пост через authorDeleted() вместо delete(). Итог: отказались, статус Published оставлен намеренно, чтобы доказать, что ветку скрывает одна область SoftDeletes; authorDeleted() ставит статус Deleted, который и так исключает published(), и покрывал бы меньше.

threads.claim: This newly added error bypasses the existing `import.errors.feature_disabled` translation and duplicates the message used by the social-post path. Use the shared translation key so non-English admins receive the localized error.
threads.reply: The Studio editor has no translated strings — every `addError()` in EditsStudioPlan.php is an English literal (e.g. :447, :463) — and this message is the same one the editor's social-post import already shows (:710). Switching one string to the public site's translation key would make the editor inconsistent.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил ключ перевода import.errors.feature_disabled вместо литерала. Итог: отказались, в редакторе Studio переводов нет, все addError() в EditsStudioPlan.php это английские литералы, и то же сообщение уже показывает импорт соцпоста; один ключ сделал бы редактор непоследовательным.

threads.claim: This callback does not redact Sentry's standard HTTP breadcrumb `url` field, so a full outgoing URL can still carry presigned query credentials into Sentry. Include `url` in the filtered address keys (and cover the same key in transaction spans).
threads.reply: Sentry records this app's requests through sentry-laravel's HttpClientIntegration (the app uses Laravel's Http client), which sets `url` to scheme, host, port and path only (vendor/sentry/sentry-laravel/src/Sentry/Laravel/Features/HttpClientIntegration.php:104, :167, :188, :241). The full address goes only into `url.full`, which SentryPrivacy.php:22 filters alongside the query and fragment.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил фильтровать и поле url в HTTP-breadcrumb Sentry. Итог: отказались, HttpClientIntegration из sentry-laravel кладёт в url только схему, хост, порт и путь, а полный адрес идёт в url.full, который SentryPrivacy уже фильтрует.

threads.claim: This limits only root rows; the eager-loaded `replies` relation still fetches every visible reply for each selected root. Large reply branches can still produce an unbounded response, so cap or paginate replies as well.
threads.reply: Replies are shown in full under their root by design, and the UI has no reply pagination (CommentListQuery.php:24-33); capping them would hide replies with no way to reach them. This PR bounds the client-controlled number of roots, which is what was unbounded.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил ограничить или пагинировать и подгрузку replies. Итог: отказались, ответы по задумке показываются под корнем целиком, пагинации ответов в UI нет, и ограничение скрыло бы их без доступа; PR ограничивает число корней, которое раньше задавал клиент.

threads.claim: `17-09` duplicates `04-06`: both record the same NotificationBell limit and unread-badge bug. Merge duplicate entries and recalculate the reported finding totals.
threads.reply: The report lists findings per batch, and several cross-batch findings describe the same defect side by side under the PR that fixes it (the hot-score and score-sweep pairs under feed-and-ranking are two more). These two sit under the same fix, so nothing is double-counted as work; recounting every such pair is not worth the churn.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил объединить дублирующиеся 17-09 и 04-06 и пересчитать итоги. Итог: отказались, отчёт перечисляет находки по пакетам, межпакетные дубли одного дефекта стоят рядом под одним исправлением и работу не задваивают; пересчёт всех таких пар не стоит возни.

threads.claim: The guide inaccurately says the resolver and pin use the host exactly as written. `normalizeHost()` lowercases it and strips a trailing dot first; describe the shared normalized host string so the pinning invariant is documented precisely.
threads.reply: The sentence is about decoding: the validator and pin never percent-decode or IDN-convert the host, while libcurl does. Lowercasing and dropping a trailing dot (UrlImportValidator.php:108, :137-138) leave the resolved name the same, so the invariant stated holds.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот счёл, что документация неверно говорит про хост как есть, ведь normalizeHost() его нормализует. Итог: отказались, фраза про декодирование (валидатор и pin не делают percent-decode и IDN, а libcurl делает), а нижний регистр и снятая точка не меняют разрешаемое имя.

threads.claim: This report says the snapshot is tagged `audit-2026-11`, but the PR does not create that tag. Add the tag as part of this change/release, or remove the claim and refer to commit `85553ca2` directly so the next audit has a resolvable baseline.
threads.reply: The tag is already pushed: `refs/tags/audit-2026-11` on origin is an annotated tag pointing at 85553ca2, the commit named on line 3. Tags are not part of a PR diff, so the PR has nothing to add.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот указал, что PR не создаёт тег audit-2026-11, упомянутый в отчёте. Итог: отказались, тег уже запушен в origin как аннотированный и указывает на 85553ca2, а теги в diff PR не входят.

threads.claim: The published scope totals are each one too high. Correct them to 1,218 files and 111,395 lines so the audit’s quantitative scope is reproducible.
threads.reply: The reviewed batches also included `database/.gitignore` (one file, one line) alongside the migrations, seeders and factories, which is exactly the difference from 1,218 / 111,395. The totals count the files that were actually reviewed at 85553ca2.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил уменьшить итоги охвата на единицу, до 1,218 файлов и 111,395 строк. Итог: отказались, в проверенные пакеты входил и database/.gitignore (один файл, одна строка), а итоги считают реально проверенные файлы на 85553ca2.

threads.claim: Log denied post-creation attempts. — When a restricted account submits an imported image, the form returns without recording the authorization denial. Log a security event without including the imported URL so operators can diagnose the failed submission.
threads.reply: Refusing an account that may not post is an expected outcome, not a fault: the early return at app/Livewire/Feed/UploadPostForm.php:93-99 is there to stop the fetch, and it answers as the create path does. Logging sanctioned accounts' attempts would be a separate observability change.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил логировать отказ ограниченному аккаунту при создании поста. Итог: отказались, отказ аккаунту без права публикации это ожидаемый исход, а не сбой; ранний возврат лишь останавливает загрузку, а логирование таких попыток было бы отдельным изменением наблюдаемости.

threads.claim: Bound reply loading separately from root loading. — If a selected root has tens of thousands of visible replies, the first page loads and renders all of them, including their avatar relations. This can consume excessive memory and time despite the root limit. Add bounded reply loading with a way to access the remaining replies.
threads.reply: The reply eager load (app/Queries/Comments/CommentListQuery.php:24-33) is unchanged by this PR, which bounds only the number of roots a client could previously raise without limit. Paging replies within a root would need its own UI control and is outside this fix.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил ограничить подгрузку ответов отдельно от корней. Итог: отказались, этот PR подгрузку ответов не трогал и ограничивает лишь число корней, которое клиент раньше задавал без предела; пагинация ответов требует отдельного элемента UI.

threads.claim: Preserve privacy-safe diagnostics for read failures. — If a storage read fails after validation, the handler reports an `ImageDecodeException` with no underlying cause and displays an invalid-image error. Preserve diagnostic information for unexpected failures without exposing filenames or paths.
threads.reply: Dropping the previous exception is deliberate, as documented at app/Services/Media/Exceptions/ImageDecodeException.php:9-13: the underlying error names the temporary file's path, which can carry the client's file name, and report() logs the whole previous chain. The static message still says which step failed.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил сохранять диагностику причины при ошибке чтения изображения. Итог: отказались, предыдущее исключение отброшено намеренно: в нём путь временного файла с возможным именем файла клиента, а report() логирует всю цепочку; статический текст и так говорит, какой шаг упал.

threads.claim: Make the increment atomic for the file cache. — When two requests share a new key and the limit is one, the file cache can return `1` to both requests. Both then proceed. Use a rate-limit store with atomic increments or synchronize the increment for supported stores.
threads.reply: That is a property of Laravel's file store, whose increment is a read followed by a write (FileStore.php:187-194), so no limiter on it can be atomic. Counting first makes this limiter correct on the stores with an atomic increment (Redis, database); the file store is only the local default in .env.example:44.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил сделать инкремент атомарным для file-кэша. Итог: отказались, инкремент file store в Laravel это чтение и запись, атомарным его не сделать; лимитер корректен на хранилищах с атомарным инкрементом (Redis, database), а file лишь локальное умолчание.

threads.claim: Reset expired windows without retaining the old count. — When the timer expires before its counter, the first request in the new window can be rejected and given a new retry delay. Reset the window atomically with the increment so the stale count does not reject that request.
threads.reply: Laravel writes the timer and the counter a moment apart with the same decay (RateLimiter.php:161-171), so the counter outlives the timer by at most that moment. A request landing exactly there after a window that hit the limit is refused once; restoring the old tooManyAttempts reset would bring back the check-then-hit race this change removes.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил сбрасывать истёкшее окно атомарно с инкрементом. Итог: отказались, счётчик переживает таймер лишь на миг, и попавший туда запрос отклоняется один раз; возврат прежнего сброса через tooManyAttempts вернул бы гонку check-then-hit, которую убирает изменение.

threads.claim: Redact duplicate-entry messages regardless of database locale. — When MariaDB uses French error messages, a duplicate email can reach Nightwatch unredacted because neither expression matches the localized message. Mask unique-constraint messages independently of their wording.
threads.reply: Both drivers report in English unless the server's lc_messages is changed, and nothing in this project changes it. Redacting independently of wording would mean dropping the driver's whole text, losing the column name the redactor keeps on purpose (app/Support/Observability/UniqueViolationValue.php:11-12).
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил маскировать сообщения о дубле независимо от локали БД. Итог: отказались, оба драйвера пишут по-английски, пока lc_messages сервера не изменён, а проект его не меняет; маскировка без учёта текста потеряла бы имя колонки, которое редактор сохраняет намеренно.

threads.claim: Accept other IPv4 loopback addresses. — If a local proxy listens on `127.0.0.2`, this check rejects its URL even though it is loopback. Studio AI reports itself as not configured, and the translation provider rejects its configuration. Accept valid IPv4 loopback addresses without allowing non-loopback HTTP destinations.
threads.reply: No configuration or doc in the repository points an API base URL at another 127/8 address, and the narrow list (app/Support/Urls/ApiBaseUrl.php:13) fails closed: the client reports itself not configured. Widening it is not needed for this fix.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил принимать любые loopback-адреса IPv4 вроде 127.0.0.2. Итог: отказались, ни конфиг, ни документация не указывают на другой адрес 127/8, а узкий список безопасно оставляет клиент ненастроенным; для этого исправления расширение не нужно.

threads.claim: Deduplicate header names without case sensitivity. — If `NIGHTWATCH_REDACT_HEADERS` contains `x-forwarded-for`, Nightwatch redacts that header twice. The serialized value then reports the length of the first redaction marker instead of the original header. Deduplicate header names case-insensitively before passing them to Nightwatch.
threads.reply: No value leaks: the second pass only redacts the first redaction marker (vendor/laravel/nightwatch/src/Concerns/RedactsHeaders.php:28-38), so the only effect is a wrong byte count, and only when the environment repeats a default header in other case. Not worth the extra normalisation.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил убирать дубли заголовков без учёта регистра. Итог: отказались, значение не утекает: второй проход лишь маскирует первый маркер и даёт неверное число байтов, и только при повторе заголовка по умолчанию в другом регистре; лишняя нормализация того не стоит.

threads.claim: Keep the dated audit tag fixed. — After the next audit moves `audit-2026-11`, the tag will identify a later snapshot, although this report associates it with the November audit. Keep the dated tag fixed and use a separate moving tag for the next audit baseline.
threads.reply: The report names the reviewed snapshot by its commit as well (docs/audits/2026-11-app-audit.md:3), so it stays identified after the tag moves, and moving the tag is the process the report describes (:4-5). How the next audit names its baseline is decided then.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил оставить датированный тег неподвижным и завести отдельный подвижный. Итог: отказались, отчёт называет снимок и по коммиту, так что он опознаётся и после переноса тега, а перенос тега это описанный в отчёте процесс; имя базы следующего аудита решат тогда.

threads.claim: Test overlapping increments against the configured cache. — This test makes sequential calls, so it cannot detect duplicate counts from overlapping increments. The configured file cache can produce those counts and admit both requests at a limit of one. Add a concurrent regression test that asserts only one request is admitted.
threads.reply: The test at tests/Feature/Support/ActionRateLimiterTest.php:36-55 reproduces deterministically the interleaving this change fixes. A real concurrent run against the file store would test Laravel's non-atomic FileStore::increment, not this class, and would depend on timing.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил настоящий конкурентный тест инкрементов на file-кэше. Итог: отказались, тест детерминированно воспроизводит исправляемое чередование, а реальный прогон на file store проверял бы неатомарный FileStore::increment Laravel, а не этот класс, и зависел бы от тайминга.

threads.claim: Remove query bindings from Sentry stack frames. — When `zend.exception_ignore_args` is disabled, a failed query can send its bindings to Sentry as stack-frame variables despite the masked message. Prevent Sentry from exporting those arguments.
threads.reply: Sentry only receives frame arguments when PHP keeps them in traces (vendor/sentry/sentry/src/StacktraceBuilder.php:33-34), and the hosts run Ubuntu's production php.ini, where zend.exception_ignore_args is On. That setting covers every exception, not just queries, so it belongs to the hosts' PHP configuration rather than this PR.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил не пускать bindings запросов в кадры стека Sentry. Итог: отказались, Sentry получает аргументы кадров, только если PHP их сохраняет, а на хостах production php.ini Ubuntu с zend.exception_ignore_args On; это настройка PHP хостов для всех исключений, а не этого PR.

threads.claim: Redact URLs in error-event exception values. — If an image host returns a partial error response containing the requested URL, Laravel can report that text in a `RequestException`. The current hooks do not scrub error-event exception values, so query credentials can reach Sentry. Redact those values before sending.
threads.reply: Nothing in app/ raises a RequestException: no HTTP call uses throw(). A failed import fetch becomes ImportFetchException::requestFailed (app/Support/Import/SafeImportHttpClient.php:98), whose URL keeps only scheme, host and path (app/Exceptions/Import/ImportFetchException.php:17-20), and a response body never enters an exception message.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил маскировать URL в значениях исключений Sentry. Итог: отказались, в app/ ничто не бросает RequestException (нет throw()), сбой загрузки становится ImportFetchException::requestFailed с URL только из схемы, хоста и пути, а тело ответа в сообщение не попадает.

threads.claim: Test the effective transaction isolation. — If a MariaDB session remains at REPEATABLE READ, this assertion still passes. Add a two-connection test that reads, commits a change on the peer, and reads again in the original transaction.
threads.reply: Laravel's MySQL/MariaDB connector issues SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL from this key on every connect (MySqlConnector.php:96-97), so the configured value is the session's level. The test checks the part the application owns.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил тест с двумя подключениями на фактическую изоляцию. Итог: отказались, коннектор Laravel для MySQL/MariaDB при каждом подключении выполняет SET SESSION TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL из этого ключа, так что тест проверяет ту часть, за которую отвечает приложение.

threads.claim: The password requirement is decided before the identity action's locked reread, so a concurrent password reset or first-password setup can leave an in-flight profile request authorized to change the email without the newly required password. Recheck the account's password and verify `current_password` inside the same locked transaction that writes the identity, or otherwise make this authorization decision atomic with the write.
threads.reply: The race needs a password to be set or reset within the milliseconds between validation and the write (ProfileUpdateRequest.php:41-51); the same request sent a moment earlier would succeed legitimately under the old state. Moving the password check into the locked write is not worth the restructuring.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил перепроверять пароль внутри заблокированной транзакции записи email. Итог: отказались, гонка требует смены пароля в миллисекунды между валидацией и записью, а тот же запрос чуть раньше законно прошёл бы; перестройка того не стоит.

threads.claim: This check trusts the pre-lock `$user` instance instead of the action result. If an email change commits after request authorization, `VerifyEmailAction::execute` can reject the old hash while `$user` still has the old verified timestamp, causing a stale link to redirect with `?verified=1`; branch on the action’s boolean as well (or refresh the authoritative row).
threads.reply: Nothing is verified wrongly: the hash is checked against the locked row (app/Actions/Auth/VerifyEmailAction.php:34). Only the `?verified=1` hint could be stale, and only if an email change commits within this same request. Branching on the return value would also drop that hint for a repeat click on an already-verified account, where the action returns false (:38).
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил ветвиться по результату VerifyEmailAction, а не по $user до блокировки. Итог: отказались, хэш сверяется с заблокированной строкой, устаревшей может быть лишь подсказка ?verified=1, а ветвление по результату убрало бы её при повторном клике на уже подтверждённом аккаунте.

threads.claim: This loop ignores the first six responses, so the test passes even if the limit is reduced to five or fewer attempts. Assert that each of the first six requests still redirects, then assert the seventh is rate-limited.
threads.reply: The limit itself is the `throttle:6,1` declaration (routes/auth.php:88); the test pins that the seventh guess is refused (tests/Feature/Auth/PasswordUpdateTest.php:88). Asserting each earlier response would only harden the test.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил проверять каждый из первых шести ответов. Итог: отказались, сам лимит это объявление throttle:6,1 в routes/auth.php, тест закрепляет отказ на седьмой попытке, а проверка ранних ответов лишь ужесточила бы тест.

threads.claim: This migration strands reset links issued before deployment for mixed-case addresses: their token rows keep the old uppercase key, while reset requests now submit the lowercased key. Migrate compatible token keys or explicitly revoke these outstanding links.
threads.reply: Only addresses created by the console admin command can be mixed-case (registration and profile updates require lowercase, social sign-in lowercases), and reset links expire after 60 minutes (config/auth.php:99). At worst one such link made in the hour before the deploy has to be requested again.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот указал, что ссылки сброса, выданные до деплоя для адресов в смешанном регистре, перестанут работать. Итог: отказались, такие адреса создаёт только консольная команда админа, ссылки живут 60 минут, и в худшем случае одну ссылку придётся запросить заново.

threads.claim: The migration performs up to two database round trips per mixed-case account, which can make a large production deployment unnecessarily slow. Batch collision detection and updates while retaining the collision rule.
threads.reply: Only accounts created by the console admin command can hold capitals (the docblock at :8-15 explains why), so the per-row queries run for a handful of rows; every other row is skipped in PHP by the `$lower === $row->email` check at :32.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил пакетно проверять коллизии и обновлять строки в миграции. Итог: отказались, заглавные буквы бывают только у аккаунтов из консольной команды админа, запросы идут для горстки строк, а остальные отсеиваются в PHP проверкой $lower === $row->email.

threads.claim: This catch derives the notice from the stale request user, while the action rejects based on a freshly locked user. A concurrent sanction or tombstoning can therefore show the wrong notice, including labeling a deleted account as shadowbanned; carry the locked status through the exception/result and map that value instead. The Livewire catch at `app/Livewire/Profile/EditProfileForm.php:65` needs the same correction.
threads.reply: In that race the stale status is Active, so the fallback key is used, and its text is the generic "Your account has restricted participation." (lang/en/ui.php:78) — true for any sanction, not a shadowban label. A tombstoned account cannot sign in after that one response.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил брать текст уведомления из заблокированного статуса, а не из устаревшего пользователя. Итог: отказались, в такой гонке устаревший статус Active и показывается общий текст об ограничении участия, верный для любой санкции, а не метка shadowban.

threads.claim: This only stamps the session generation; it does not refresh `AuthenticateSession`'s stored password hash, so the current admin session is logged out on its next `/admin` request. Refresh that hash after password updates and signed-in resets as well.
threads.reply: This predates the PR: the panel already ran Filament's AuthenticateSession on develop (AdminPanelProvider.php:160), and a password change already replaced the hash it checks. It only means an administrator signs in to the panel again after changing their password; out of scope here.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил обновлять хэш пароля AuthenticateSession после смены пароля. Итог: отказались, так было и до PR: панель уже использовала AuthenticateSession Filament, а смена пароля уже меняла хэш; админ просто снова входит в панель, это вне рамок PR.

threads.claim: The collision branch leaves one account’s mixed-case email in place while every login and reset request lowercases its address, making that account impossible to authenticate or reset. Quarantine collisions for explicit remediation, or retain an exact-case recovery path until each collision is resolved.
threads.reply: Leaving a collision untouched is the documented choice (migration docblock, lines 14-15): a migration must not merge or overwrite either account. A collision can only come from a console-created mixed-case admin address, and deciding which account keeps it is an operator task.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил карантин коллизий или путь восстановления с точным регистром. Итог: отказались, оставить коллизию нетронутой это задокументированное решение, миграция не должна сливать или перезаписывать аккаунты; коллизия бывает только у консольного адреса админа, и решать её оператору.

threads.claim: Keep throttle keys stable across `APP_KEY` rotation. — If `APP_KEY` changes while a login is locked out, the new key selects a fresh counter and permits five more attempts. Use a separate secret shared across deployments for throttle keys so encryption-key rotation does not reset the limit.
threads.reply: The sign-in counter decays after 60 seconds (RateLimiter::hit's default, app/Actions/Auth/AuthenticateUserAction.php:26), so rotating APP_KEY resets at most one minute's count, once, and only an operator can do it. A separate long-lived secret is not worth that.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил отдельный секрет для ключей throttle, чтобы смена APP_KEY не сбрасывала счётчик. Итог: отказались, счётчик входа и так истекает через 60 секунд, ротация APP_KEY сбрасывает максимум минуту счёта, один раз и только руками оператора; отдельный секрет того не стоит.

threads.claim: Preserve cleanup for duplicate JSON keys. — On MariaDB, a payload such as `{"actor_id":999,"actor_id":12}` can pass the old PHP check for user 12 but fail the new SQL filter. The notification can retain that user’s name. Ensure the filter also includes rows whose last duplicate ID matches.
threads.reply: Notification payloads are only written by Laravel's database channel from PHP arrays (e.g. app/Notifications/PostCommentedNotification.php:37), and json_encode of an array cannot repeat a key. No client-supplied JSON reaches notifications.data, so that payload cannot exist.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предупредил, что JSON с повторяющимся actor_id на MariaDB обойдёт новый SQL-фильтр. Итог: отказались, payload уведомлений пишет только database-канал Laravel из PHP-массивов, а json_encode массива не может повторить ключ; клиентский JSON в notifications.data не попадает.
