threads.claim: Use the reset account’s ID for the redirect. — If two accounts differ only by email case, a signed-in user can reset the other account and receive the `password-set` redirect. Return the reset account’s ID from the action and compare it with the signed-in user’s ID before remembering the session or choosing the redirect.
threads.reply: Two accounts that differ only by case exist only where the lowercase migration left a collision on PostgreSQL, and they share a mailbox. The effect would be the "password set" status on the wrong profile; the signed-in session keeps its own unchanged generation (NewPasswordController.php:44) and the reset account's sessions still end.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил сравнивать id сброшенного аккаунта с текущим пользователем при редиректе. Итог: отказались, аккаунты, различающиеся только регистром, бывают лишь при коллизии миграции на PostgreSQL и делят почтовый ящик; эффект только в статусе password set не на том профиле.

threads.claim: Pass a validated hash to the action. — The controller passes the route hash directly, but `EmailVerificationRequest` has no validation rules. Use a dedicated request to validate the hash and pass its validated value to the action. Retain the existing authorization and locked-email comparison.
threads.reply: The hash is a route parameter of a signed URL; EmailVerificationRequest already authorizes it, and VerifyEmailAction compares it again with hash_equals under the lock (app/Actions/Auth/VerifyEmailAction.php:34). A separate Form Request would add no check.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил отдельный Form Request для валидации hash. Итог: отказались, hash это параметр подписанного URL, EmailVerificationRequest его уже авторизует, а VerifyEmailAction ещё раз сверяет его через hash_equals под блокировкой; отдельный запрос ничего не добавил бы.

threads.claim: Base the redirect on the locked verification outcome. — If an email change commits after authorization, the action rejects the old hash but leaves the request user marked verified. With no intended URL, the controller can then redirect with `?verified=1` for an unverified address. Return an authoritative outcome from the action while preserving success for matching, already-verified addresses.
threads.reply: This needs an already-verified account to change its address at the very moment it clicks an old link. The account is left correctly unverified (VerifyEmailAction.php:34-36); only that one redirect's banner would be wrong.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил строить редирект по результату верификации под блокировкой. Итог: отказались, для этого подтверждённый аккаунт должен сменить адрес ровно в момент клика по старой ссылке; аккаунт при этом верно остаётся неподтверждённым, ошибётся лишь баннер одного редиректа.

threads.claim: Avoid reporting a stale account restriction. — If an account becomes Limited during an update and returns to Active before the redirect, the user sees “Your account has restricted participation.” Report the refused update without asserting a current restriction.
threads.reply: The save was refused under a restriction, and the fallback text ("Your account has restricted participation.", app/Http/Controllers/ProfileController.php:58) was true at that moment. A sanction applied and lifted within one request is too narrow a race to word around.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил не утверждать текущее ограничение, если статус успел вернуться в Active. Итог: отказались, сохранение было отклонено именно при ограничении, и текст был верен в тот момент; санкция, наложенная и снятая в пределах одного запроса, слишком узкая гонка.

threads.claim: Allow unchanged legacy emails through profile validation. — If a mixed-case email remains after a migration collision, the prefilled email fails `lowercase`, so the user cannot save a name-only update. Lowercasing it also fails the uniqueness check. Allow unchanged stored emails without rewriting them, while keeping the checks for email changes.
threads.reply: The `lowercase` rule (app/Http/Requests/ProfileUpdateRequest.php:31) predates this PR, so a mixed-case address already failed it. The migration lowers every such address except a PostgreSQL collision, which makes the case rarer than before, not new.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил пропускать неизменённые legacy email в смешанном регистре при валидации профиля. Итог: отказались, правило lowercase было и до PR, и такие адреса проваливали его раньше; миграция понижает их все, кроме коллизии на PostgreSQL, так что случай стал реже, а не появился.

threads.claim: Use the status that caused the profile update to be rejected. — If a sanction commits during a save, `$user->status` can be stale. The form can then show the shadowban fallback or an older restriction instead of the current notice. Pass the locked status with the exception and use a generic message for unmapped statuses.
threads.reply: A sanction committed during the very save is a narrow race, and the message is still a restriction notice for a refusal that did happen (app/Livewire/Profile/EditProfileForm.php:64-65); the page's notice shows the current status on the next render. Threading the locked status through the exception is not worth it.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил передавать заблокированный статус в исключении для текста отказа. Итог: отказались, санкция ровно во время сохранения это узкая гонка, сообщение всё равно об ограничении при реальном отказе, а следующая отрисовка покажет текущий статус; протаскивать статус не стоит.

threads.claim: Resolve email collisions before enabling normalized lookup. — When accounts differ only by email case, the migration silently leaves one address mixed-case. Login and password reset then select the lowercase account, so the other owner cannot use either path. Detect and resolve these collisions before enabling normalized lookup.
threads.reply: Leaving a collision is deliberate (database/migrations/2026_11_07_100000_lowercase_user_emails.php:14-15, tested in LowercaseUserEmailsMigrationTest.php:26-35): resolving one means choosing which of two accounts keeps the address, an operator's decision rather than a migration's. It can only arise on PostgreSQL, for an address the admin command stored with capitals.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил разрешать коллизии email до включения нормализованного поиска. Итог: отказались, оставить коллизию намеренное решение (задокументировано и покрыто тестом): выбрать, какой аккаунт сохранит адрес, должен оператор, а не миграция; возможно только на PostgreSQL.

threads.claim: Allow for shared-IP registration bursts. — When seven people behind one IP register within a minute, the seventh receives a 429 response. Use a limit that accommodates shared IPs while retaining abuse protection.
threads.reply: Six registrations a minute per client matches the other credential forms here (routes/auth.php:21-25); seven sign-ups from one address within a minute is the burst the limit exists for, and the seventh can retry a minute later.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил поднять лимит регистраций для общих IP. Итог: отказались, шесть регистраций в минуту с клиента совпадают с другими формами учётных данных, семь регистраций с одного адреса за минуту и есть всплеск, ради которого лимит, а седьмой может повторить через минуту.

threads.claim: Show a retry message when profile updates are throttled. — Every profile submission counts toward this limit, including validation failures. After six submissions in a minute, the next save shows a 429 page instead of the form. Return users to the form with a retry message and preserve their non-password input.
threads.reply: Six profile saves a minute is well above normal use, and the limit guards the password check an email change takes (routes/web.php:71-72), with the same 429 the password forms answer. A friendlier throttled response would be a change to every throttled form, not this one.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил при троттлинге профиля возвращать на форму с сообщением вместо страницы 429. Итог: отказались, шесть сохранений в минуту намного выше обычного, лимит защищает проверку пароля при смене email, как и формы пароля; более дружелюбный ответ касался бы всех форм с троттлингом.

threads.claim: Check the refusal and account state. — If the callback creates the account and also flashes an error, this test can still pass. Assert the unavailable message and that no social account was created.
threads.reply: This test is about the card rendering with nothing left to list. That a callback for a provider switched off mid-round-trip connects nothing and says it is unavailable is covered by tests/Feature/Auth/SignInProviderSwitchesTest.php:170-182.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил проверять сообщение о недоступности и отсутствие созданного соцаккаунта. Итог: отказались, этот тест про отрисовку пустой карточки, а то, что callback отключённого провайдера ничего не подключает и сообщает о недоступности, покрыто SignInProviderSwitchesTest.php.

threads.claim: This private `canAdminister()` is now copy-pasted into five policies (CategoryPolicy, MediaDiagnosticsPolicy, RatingGroupPolicy, RatingOptionPolicy, and this one), each with the same docblock. Move the role-plus-lifecycle check onto `User` once, next to `canAccessPanel()`, and have each policy call it so a change to the rule happens in one place.
threads.reply: The PR follows the existing pattern: CategoryPolicy already had this private helper on develop (app/Policies/CategoryPolicy.php:47). Moving it onto User is a refactor outside this fix.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил вынести скопированный в пять политик canAdminister() на User. Итог: отказались, PR следует существующему шаблону (у CategoryPolicy этот приватный помощник уже был на develop), а перенос на User это рефакторинг вне этого исправления.

threads.claim: A purged post still leaves its stale feed card behind: `withTrashed()` finds soft-deleted rows but returns null after retention physically removes the row, and this service reports that case as skipped. Treat a missing post as an idempotent deletion for an authenticated feed action and emit `post-deleted` (including from the drawer’s null branch) so the card is removed.
threads.reply: A post is purged only after the 30-day retention window (config/posts.php:26), so this needs a feed page left open without a reload for longer than that. Treating any unknown id as deleted would also report success for ids that never existed.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил считать отсутствующий пост удалённым и слать post-deleted. Итог: отказались, пост физически удаляется только после 30 дней хранения, то есть лента должна быть открыта без перезагрузки дольше этого, а неизвестный id тогда давал бы успех и для несуществующих.

threads.claim: A post deleted after chunking can make the lock query return `null`, but this unconditional increment still reports it as recalculated. Increment the count only when a locked post was actually processed.
threads.reply: The count only feeds the summary line the command prints (RecalculateHotScoresCommand.php:45); a post purged during the sweep changes no score and miscounting it by one has no effect.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил увеличивать счётчик только для реально обработанного поста. Итог: отказались, счётчик идёт лишь в итоговую строку команды, пост, удалённый во время прохода, никакой оценки не меняет, и ошибка на единицу ни на что не влияет.

threads.claim: The assertion matches `withoutOverlapping(60)` in routes/console.php, but the new comment is garbled. "stops the decay for no longer" should read something like "so a sweep killed midway stops the decay for at most an hour."
threads.reply: The comment is terse but accurate: the overlap lock lasts 60 minutes (routes/console.php:24), so a killed sweep holds the decay up for no longer than that, as routes/console.php:22-23 spells out.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот счёл комментарий про withoutOverlapping(60) искажённым и предложил перефразировать. Итог: отказались, комментарий краткий, но точный: блокировка от наложения длится 60 минут, и убитый проход задерживает затухание не дольше, как и расписано в routes/console.php.

threads.claim: Handle missing post timestamps during score recalculation. — If a post has a null `created_at`, the calculator throws and rolls back comment hides, restores, and deletes. The posts schema permits this value. Provide a safe score fallback for such posts so these actions can complete.
threads.reply: Not changing this. Every write path stores created_at: posts are created through Eloquent, which sets it, and the one raw write (the demo seeder's updateOrInsert) sets it explicitly. The vote path already passes created_at to the same calculator with no fallback, so a post without it is a corrupt row, not a state this code should score: a made-up score would hide the corruption, while a failed write reports it.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил запасную оценку для постов с null created_at. Итог: отказались, все пути записи ставят created_at, а путь голосов передаёт его без запасного значения; пост без него это испорченная строка, выдуманная оценка скрыла бы порчу, а упавшая запись её покажет.

threads.claim: Keep the sweep lock for the full run. — If a large sweep runs past the lock expiry and remains active at a later hourly invocation, another sweep can start. Both runs then perform the per-post transactions, increasing database load. Use a lock that remains held for the full sweep while still recovering after interruption.
threads.reply: Kept as it is, deliberately; routes/console.php says why. The overlap lock lasts an hour so that a scheduler killed mid-sweep stops the decay for an hour, not for the default day. A sweep that outlives the hour and overlaps the next is still correct, because each post is recalculated under its own row lock, and costs only extra load. A sweep taking over an hour would mean far more posts than the site has; the expiry would be revisited then, together with the sweep itself.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил держать блокировку прохода на весь запуск. Итог: оставили намеренно: часовая блокировка нужна, чтобы убитый проход останавливал затухание на час, а не на день; наложение проходов корректно благодаря блокировке строк и стоит лишь нагрузки.

threads.claim: Removing `.env` keys from the inherited OS environment does not stop Laravel from loading `.env` again inside the Pest child. Because `phpunit.xml` defines only a subset of those keys, developer-specific configuration can still re-enter the child; use an isolated child bootstrap/environment and test the actual subprocess.
threads.reply: The variables that pick the database and environment are all set in phpunit.xml (lines 45, 50-56), so once the inherited values are removed (PestVisualScreenshotRunner.php:40) PHPUnit's values apply, and Laravel's later .env load cannot override them because its env repository is immutable (Illuminate/Support/Env.php:89). The rest of .env reaching the child is the same as any `vendor/bin/pest` run.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот считал, что Laravel в дочернем Pest снова загрузит .env и вернёт настройки разработчика. Итог: отказались, переменные выбора БД и окружения заданы в phpunit.xml, и после удаления унаследованных значений .env их не перекроет, так как репозиторий env неизменяемый.

threads.claim: Remove inherited database settings before starting Pest. — If the shell exports `DB_URL` but `.env` omits it, Pest inherits the URL. `RefreshDatabase` can then drop tables in the development database instead of `rateguru_test`. Remove inherited test database settings and `APP_ENV` even when `.env` does not name them.
threads.reply: Not changing this. A variable exported in the shell is the operator's explicit choice, and this repository relies on it: tests are run locally as `DB_DATABASE=rateguru_test php artisan test`, and CI sets DB_* in each job's environment for its PostgreSQL, SQLite and MariaDB runs. Clearing inherited database settings would throw those away. What the child must not inherit is what Artisan itself loaded from .env, which a plain `php artisan test` also removes; that is exactly the set removed here. phpunit.xml also sets DB_URL to empty for the test run.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил удалять унаследованные DB_URL и APP_ENV, даже если их нет в .env. Итог: отказались, экспорт в оболочке это явный выбор оператора, на нём держатся локальный запуск тестов и CI; убирается ровно то, что Artisan загрузил из .env, а phpunit.xml и так обнуляет DB_URL.

threads.claim: The new `catch (Throwable)` in `visitor()` implements this PR's fix for failing visitor lookups, but no test exercises it. Add a case where `auth()->user()` throws and assert the context still has `locale` and `request_id` but no `user_id`.
threads.reply: It is covered by the new test at tests/Feature/Observability/ExceptionContextTest.php:46-72: the guard's `user()` throws, and the reported context still has `request_id` and no `user_id` (:72), which is the `catch` in LogContext::visitor().
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил тест на catch (Throwable) в visitor(). Итог: отказались, это уже покрыто новым тестом ExceptionContextTest.php: guard бросает исключение в user(), а контекст сохраняет request_id и не содержит user_id.

threads.claim: The new visitor middleware is registered only on the `web` group, but the Filament admin panel uses its own explicit middleware stack. Add this middleware to the panel stack after `SetAdminLocale` (and ensure the request-context middleware is included there too), otherwise admin request logs still omit the signed-in user and resolved locale.
threads.reply: The panel's own middleware stack (AdminPanelProvider.php:156-167) has never run the request-id or log-context middleware, on develop either; this PR fixes their order on the web stack. Bringing log context to the panel is a separate change.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил добавить middleware посетителя в стек панели Filament. Итог: отказались, стек панели никогда не запускал middleware request-id и log-context, в том числе на develop; PR исправляет их порядок в web-стеке, а контекст логов для панели это отдельное изменение.

threads.claim: Release the quota when a log write fails. — If the first 31 writes fail, the limiter suppresses later attempts even after the log becomes writable. No attempt or throttling record is stored for that window. Restore failed reservations without discarding successful concurrent counts.
threads.reply: Not changing this. The count also bounds the failure reports: while the security log cannot be written, each attempt reports SecurityLogUnavailableException, and the limiter is what keeps one address to 31 of those a minute. Handing the quota back on a failed write would let a script repeating the call send a report per request for as long as the log is down. What is lost instead is the rest of one minute for one address, right after the log comes back.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил возвращать квоту при неудачной записи лога. Итог: отказались, счётчик заодно ограничивает отчёты SecurityLogUnavailableException до 31 в минуту на адрес, и без него скрипт слал бы отчёт на каждый запрос, пока лог недоступен; теряется лишь остаток минуты.

threads.claim: Make the guest-vote counter atomic across workers. — With `CACHE_STORE=file`, concurrent requests can receive the same count. They can write more than 30 attempt records or more than one throttling record per address in a window. Use an atomic shared counter or serialize its updates.
threads.reply: Not changing this. CACHE_STORE=file is the local development default (.env.example). Deployed targets run one Redis server per host (the environment contract's Cache / Redis section), where RateLimiter::hit increments atomically. On the file store two racing requests can each write one line past the limit, a bound that holds on a developer's machine.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил атомарный счётчик гостевых голосов на случай CACHE_STORE=file. Итог: отказались, file это локальное умолчание, развёрнутые окружения работают с Redis на хосте, где RateLimiter::hit атомарен; на file два параллельных запроса запишут максимум по строке сверх лимита.

threads.claim: This regression test does not cover an HTTP error whose body crosses the cap: the oversized `Content-Length` triggers the separate header-rejection path first. Use a 500 response with no `Content-Length` (or one within the cap) and a body larger than 2048 bytes so the test verifies the `bodyCapExceeded`/`RequestException` mapping added by this change.
threads.reply: The oversized Content-Length does reach the new branch. on_headers throws (PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:99-106), Guzzle rejects with a RequestException that carries the 500, and Laravel rethrows it as its own RequestException, caught at PinnedImportHttpTransport.php:142-148; without that catch the 500 escapes and the test fails. A body-cap abort on a 500 goes through the same catch and the same flag check at line 146.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот счёл, что тест с большим Content-Length не доходит до новой ветки bodyCapExceeded. Итог: бот ошибся, on_headers бросает исключение, и RequestException с 500 ловит новый catch, без которого тест падает; превышение тела на 500 идёт через тот же catch и ту же проверку флага.

threads.claim: This ignores a failed close/flush, so a disk error at close can return an `UploadedFile` for incomplete content and leave the temporary file behind. Check `fclose()` and delete the path before throwing the same import failure.
threads.reply: PHP's plain-file stream hands every fwrite() to the OS and keeps no write buffer for fclose() to flush. A full disk therefore shows up as a failed write in writeAll() (StoreImportedImageAction.php:132-149), and that path already deletes the file (lines 106-113).
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил проверять результат fclose() и удалять файл при ошибке. Итог: отказались, поток обычного файла в PHP сразу отдаёт fwrite() в ОС без буфера, так что полный диск проявится как ошибка записи в writeAll(), а этот путь уже удаляет файл.

threads.claim: The default `array_filter` removes the valid relative image reference `"0"` as falsey before URL resolution. Filter only `null` values instead.
threads.reply: A meta content of exactly "0" is not a realistic image URL. extractMeta() already turns empty content into null (OpenGraphParser.php:66-68), so "0" is the only other value the filter at lines 35-39 drops.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот указал, что array_filter отбрасывает относительную ссылку на изображение "0". Итог: отказались, meta content ровно "0" не реалистичный URL изображения; extractMeta() уже превращает пустое значение в null, и "0" единственное другое значение, которое отбрасывает фильтр.

threads.claim: This test leaves Carbon's global test clock advanced after it finishes, so later tests can observe a falsified `now()` value. Add an `afterEach` hook that calls `Carbon::setTestNow()` to restore real time.
threads.reply: Not needed: Laravel's test case resets the clock after every test. Its tearDown (Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\Concerns\InteractsWithTestCaseLifecycle, lines 163-168) calls Carbon::setTestNow() and CarbonImmutable::setTestNow(), and tests/Feature runs on that test case through tests/Pest.php. That is the same reset the travel() helpers rely on.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот предложил afterEach с Carbon::setTestNow() для сброса часов. Итог: не нужно, tearDown тестового класса Laravel сам сбрасывает Carbon и CarbonImmutable после каждого теста, а tests/Feature работает на нём через tests/Pest.php.

threads.claim: This does not test the claimed “form drawn before the switch” case: both Livewire components mount after `show_comments` is already false. Mount them with comments enabled, update the settings to false, flush `ProjectSettingsManager`, then invoke the actions so this test catches regressions in stale-component enforcement.
threads.reply: CommentForm and CommentsSection have no mount() and check the flag only in submit() and submitReply() (CommentForm.php:22, CommentsSection.php:95). A component mounted after the switch therefore reaches the action in exactly the state of one drawn before it, and without those guards this test creates the comment and the reply and fails.
threads.resolution_ru: Бот счёл, что тест не проверяет форму, отрисованную до переключения флага. Итог: отказались, у CommentForm и CommentsSection нет mount(), флаг проверяется только в submit() и submitReply(), поэтому состояние то же; без этих проверок тест падает.

threads.claim: The action reports success without checking `save()`'s result, so a vetoed User save still makes the form say “Saved.” Capture the result, return `false` on failure, and only synchronize the caller model after a successful save.
threads.reply: Eloquent's save() returns false only when a saving or updating listener cancels it, and nothing listens on User; the only such listener in app/ is StudioPlanVote's (StudioPlanVote.php:64). The write at UpdateNotificationPreferencesAction.php:25-27 either saves or throws, and a throw rolls back before "Saved" is set.
threads.resolution_ru: Действие не проверяет результат save(), и форма пишет «Saved» даже при отменённом сохранении. Итог: save() вернёт false, только если listener отменит запись, а у User таких нет; запись либо проходит, либо бросает исключение с откатом до «Saved».

threads.claim: Turning off `show_saved_posts` while an owner is already on the saved tab leaves `$tab` set to `saved`, but this guard makes `$this->savedPosts` null. Revalidate `$tab` against `getAllowedTabs()` on every render or otherwise reset it to `posts`, so the component does not show a blank hidden-tab area.
threads.reply: This only affects an owner whose page was open on the Saved tab when the feature was switched off. Their next render draws an empty panel and loads nothing (ProfilePage.php:95-97), and a reload puts them back on Posts (ProfilePage.php:46-48). Nothing is exposed.
threads.resolution_ru: После отключения show_saved_posts владелец на вкладке Saved остаётся с $tab = saved и пустой областью. Итог: затронут только владелец с уже открытой вкладкой; он видит пустую панель, после перезагрузки попадает на Posts, ничего не раскрывается.

threads.claim: This check does not hide comments for an already-mounted Livewire child when the setting changes: sorting or loading more sends a request to `CommentsSection` without re-rendering `PostShow`, and the child view still queries and renders comments. Add the feature guard to the child’s render path so switched-off comments stop exposing data on existing pages too.
threads.reply: Only a page drawn while comments were on is affected, and it already shows the thread; load more and re-sort only add public comments to it. What the switch has to stop is a new comment, and submit() and submitReply() refuse that (CommentForm.php:22, CommentsSection.php:95). The next load of the page draws no thread.
threads.resolution_ru: Уже смонтированный CommentsSection продолжает показывать комментарии после отключения настройки. Итог: затронута только страница, открытая при включённых комментариях; load more и сортировка добавляют лишь публичные комментарии, а новый комментарий submit() и submitReply() отклоняют.

threads.claim: `UploadPostForm` does not refuse to open after a pause when it was already rendered. The stale button opens the modal and `resetUploadForm()` has no feature check; only submission is blocked. Either guard the stale-modal path or document only the submission guarantee.
threads.reply: The guarantee the sentence gives is that no member creates a post, even from a page drawn before the pause, and submit() enforces it (UploadPostForm.php:79-82). "Refuses to open" describes mount() (UploadPostForm.php:63), which every fresh page goes through. On an older page the modal opens, but nothing can be submitted from it.
threads.resolution_ru: Документация говорит, что UploadPostForm не открывается после паузы, но старая кнопка открывает модалку. Итог: гарантия в том, что пост не создать, и её даёт submit(); «не открывается» относится к mount() на свежей странице, а со старой модалки отправить ничего нельзя.

threads.claim: `mount()` only runs during the initial component load, so this guard is skipped on subsequent Livewire requests. An already-open saved-post page can still query and return saved posts after the feature is disabled; move the check to `boot()` so it runs on every request.
threads.reply: An open /saved page lists only the viewer's own saves (SavedPostsPage.php:29), so paging through it after the switch exposes nothing to anyone else. The next load is a 404 (SavedPostsPage.php:19-22).
threads.resolution_ru: Проверка в mount() не срабатывает на последующих запросах Livewire, и открытая страница сохранённых продолжает отдавать посты. Итог: открытая /saved показывает только собственные сохранения зрителя, другим ничего не раскрывается; следующая загрузка даёт 404.

threads.claim: This regression test does not verify the deleted account remained unchanged. Assert the persisted notification preference after `save`, otherwise a write followed by a false return can pass unnoticed.
threads.reply: That nothing is written for a deleted account is the action's guarantee, and TerminalUserWriteBarrierTest.php:167-174 already asserts that the persisted preference stays unchanged. This test covers what the form says about it.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не проверяет, что настройка удалённого аккаунта осталась прежней. Итог: это гарантия действия, и TerminalUserWriteBarrierTest уже проверяет сохранённое значение; этот тест покрывает то, что сообщает форма.

threads.claim: This sentence is ungrammatical and obscures the enforcement condition. Start it with “When `allow_guest_viewing` is switched off”.
threads.reply: Wording only. The sentence continues the line before it (project-settings.md:129-131) and states the condition, "switched off".
threads.resolution_ru: Предложение в project-settings.md неграмматично, предложено начать его с «When allow_guest_viewing is switched off». Итог: это только формулировка; предложение продолжает предыдущую строку, и условие «switched off» в нём есть.

threads.claim: This test never renders a static page and bypasses the layout that conditionally mounts `PostDrawer`; enable `post_detail_overlay_mode` and assert the static-page response contains the overlay host.
threads.reply: The guard is in PostDrawer::render itself (app/Livewire/Feed/PostDrawer.php:116-122), so it holds on whichever page mounts the panel; the test drives the component as the layout mounts it, with asOverlay (resources/views/layouts/app.blade.php:388), for a guest and for a signed-in user (tests/Feature/Settings/GuestViewingTest.php:66-78). Rendering a static page would only re-check that the layout mounts the panel, which this change does not touch.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не рендерит статическую страницу и обходит layout, который монтирует PostDrawer. Итог: проверка стоит в самом PostDrawer::render, тест вызывает компонент как layout (asOverlay) для гостя и пользователя; рендер страницы проверил бы лишь монтирование, которое не менялось.

threads.claim: Move saved-post authorization to a policy. — `getSavedPostsProperty` authorizes access with a direct owner check. Delegate that decision to Policy/Gate instead.
threads.reply: Not changing this. The saved tab is only ever the viewer's own list: the query reads the profile user's saves only when the viewer is that user. A policy here would wrap the same identity comparison ProfilePage already makes for the activity tab and the follow button, and there is no saved-posts ability to reuse. Moving the page's identity checks to a policy is a change of its own, not part of honouring the switch.
threads.resolution_ru: Проверку доступа к сохранённым постам в ProfilePage предложено перенести в policy. Итог: не меняем; вкладка показывает только собственный список зрителя, policy обернула бы то же сравнение личности, а перенос проверок страницы в policy это отдельная задача.

threads.claim: Recheck the saved-posts switch on updates. — If an administrator disables saved posts while a user has the page open, pagination can still render more saved posts. Check the switch on subsequent Livewire requests and handle the disabled state in the browser.
threads.reply: The first half is fixed in b2aaa529: SavedPostsPage checks the switch in boot(), on every request, so a page open when saved posts are switched off turns no further page (404, the page's existing answer). A test calls nextPage after switching them off. The second half is not changed: TogglePostSaveAction has no caller in app/. The save button goes through ToggleSavedPostAction, which already throws SavedPostsDisabledException; only a stale-write test still calls the old action.
threads.resolution_ru: SavedPostsPage должен перепроверять переключатель на каждом запросе Livewire. Итог: первая часть исправлена в b2aaa529, проверка в boot() покрыта тестом; вторая не меняется: у TogglePostSaveAction нет вызовов в app/, кнопка идёт через ToggleSavedPostAction.

threads.claim: This test does not simulate recovery despite its name: it stops an initially dispatched action and runs that first job, rather than resending a stale running action. Claim the action, advance past `running_stale_after_seconds`, run the dispatcher, and then execute the resent job.
threads.reply: A recovered action reaches the executor in exactly the state this test builds. The dispatcher resends a left-behind Running action by setting it back to Dispatched (DispatchDueStudioActionsAction.php:89, 167-171), and claim() cancels any Dispatched action of a stopped plan (ExecuteStudioAction.php:278). Going through the dispatcher would test the dispatcher, not this check.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не моделирует восстановление: запускает первую отправку, а не повторную для зависшего действия. Итог: восстановленное действие приходит в executor ровно в таком состоянии, диспетчер возвращает его в Dispatched; прогон через диспетчер тестировал бы диспетчер, а не эту проверку.

threads.claim: This timeout is only below the default 90-second retry window. Because both queue connections allow a lower `*_QUEUE_RETRY_AFTER` via environment configuration, a 60-second deployment can redeliver the job while its 80-second worker is still running and send duplicates. Derive the timeout from the active connection or validate that every configured retry window exceeds it.
threads.reply: The repository ships retry_after 90 s (config/queue.php:43, 71), and its other queued timeouts are set against that same 90 s (config/content_studio.php:38, 71, 98, 145). Lowering it in one environment would shorten every job's window, not only this one's. NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostActionTest.php:95-100 checks this timeout against each connection's configured retry_after.
threads.resolution_ru: Timeout задания 80 с ниже только дефолтного retry_after 90 с, при меньшем значении из env возможны дубли. Итог: репозиторий задаёт retry_after 90 с, остальные таймауты рассчитаны на него же, а NotifyFollowersAboutNewPostActionTest сверяет timeout с retry_after каждого подключения.

threads.claim: This writes `stopped_at` without revalidating the locked plan. A concurrent final action can settle the plan first, so Stop records a stop on a terminal plan; repeated stops can also overwrite the original stop time. Recheck the locked status and preserve an existing timestamp before saving.
threads.reply: stopped_at is read only when an open action of the plan is claimed or postponed (ExecuteStudioAction.php:278, 925). A plan that has already settled has no open actions, so a stop recorded on it changes nothing, and nothing shows the timestamp. The unlocked status read at StopStudioPlanAction.php:54 predates this change.
threads.resolution_ru: StopStudioPlanAction пишет stopped_at без повторной проверки статуса заблокированного плана. Итог: stopped_at читается только при claim или отсрочке открытого действия, у завершённого плана их нет, запись ничего не меняет; чтение статуса без блокировки было и до изменения.

threads.claim: The message only mentions approved plans, but the guard also blocks deletion for running plans. Reword it to cover both states, e.g. 'An approved or running Content Studio plan will publish under this category, so it cannot be deleted.'
threads.reply: A running plan is an approved plan that has started publishing; Running is reached only from Approved (ExecuteStudioAction.php:291-293). The categories page shows its own text for this reason anyway (ManageCategories.php:224-228).
threads.resolution_ru: Сообщение CannotDeleteCategoryException упоминает только approved планы, хотя блокируются и running. Итог: running это approved план, начавший публикацию, в Running попадают только из Approved; страница категорий к тому же показывает свой текст.

threads.claim: When a claimed attempt is replaced before this re-read, the method returns null without logging, unlike the not-claimed path and `CompleteStudioImageAnalysisAction`, which both log `studio.image_analysis.discarded`. Log that case too, and update the `@return` note, which says null means nothing was claimed.
threads.reply: The window is between two consecutive statements (StartStudioImageAnalysisAction.php:23-31 and 46-50), and the outcome is the safe one: no paid request is sent. A log line for it is not worth the change.
threads.resolution_ru: Если захваченную попытку заменили до повторного чтения, метод возвращает null без лога studio.image_analysis.discarded. Итог: окно между двумя соседними операторами, исход безопасный, платный запрос не уходит; строка лога не стоит изменения.

threads.claim: Split follower delivery into resumable jobs. — When delivery needs more than five 80-second attempts, this job fails with followers still unnotified. Each retry rescans earlier followers, so skipped notifications do not guarantee completion. Process bounded batches as separate jobs with retry-safe delivery.
threads.reply: Not changing this here. A retry does resume: each batch of 500 first reads which followers already have the notification and skips them, so a retry spends its 80 s on the followers left, and the per-follower failures are what make the job fail and retry at all. Five attempts with that skip cover far more followers per author than the site has. Splitting delivery into continuation jobs with a persisted position changes how the post's notification is queued and recorded; it belongs with the day an author's following approaches what 80 s delivers, not with this fix.
threads.resolution_ru: Доставку подписчикам предложено разбить на возобновляемые задания. Итог: не меняем; повтор уже продолжает работу, пропуская уведомлённых, пяти попыток хватает с запасом, а continuation-задания с сохранённой позицией нужны, когда подписчиков станет больше, чем укладывается в 80 с.

threads.claim: Recheck analysis completion before saving suggestions. — If an analysis re-run starts during the provider call, the completion action can save and display suggestions from the old description. Check `context->complete` in the completion action too, and update the test that currently expects the batch to succeed.
threads.reply: Not changing this; it is the batch's documented behaviour (CompleteStudioPostTextGenerationAction's docblock, and the test 'a re-run on its way, its result unchanged' since the feature was added). A re-run that is only queued has not changed the description the texts were written from, so their source hash still matches and keeping them is right. If the re-run then writes a different description, the texts stop matching and the suggestions card no longer shows them: it lists only batches whose isFor() matches the current context (StudioPlanTextSuggestionsCard:195). The job refuses to start from an incomplete analysis because it would pay for a call from a description being replaced; at completion the call is already paid and the texts stay valid until the description changes.
threads.resolution_ru: Перед сохранением подсказок предложено перепроверять завершённость анализа. Итог: не меняем, это задокументированное поведение батча; тексты валидны, пока описание не изменилось, а при новом описании карточка подсказок их уже не показывает.

threads.claim: The stale-variant message says every variant is present, but the inspector still offers Regenerate missing variants. Suppress that action when the current inspection reports zero missing variants.
threads.reply: The footer's Regenerate is offered for any asset whose master is on disk, whatever the issue (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:604, asset-inspector.blade.php:87-88). Without force it generates only what is missing (MediaVariantGenerator.php:69), so with every variant present it does nothing.
threads.resolution_ru: Сообщение о stale-варианте говорит, что все варианты есть, но инспектор предлагает Regenerate missing variants. Итог: Regenerate предлагается для любого ассета с мастером на диске, а без force генерирует только недостающее, так что при полном наборе ничего не делает.

threads.claim: These eligibility checks apply only to the inspector; stale issue rows still advertise Release/Purge actions. Gate the row actions with current eligibility or make Inspect the only entry point, so the list does not offer operations that will be rejected later.
threads.reply: The row buttons offer what the audit found, and both actions check again before acting: releaseUnreferenced() leaves a referenced asset alone, and purge() refuses one that is no longer purgeable (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:636-666). Checking eligibility for every row would add per-row reads to a list whose query count the render guard keeps flat.
threads.resolution_ru: Строки списка с устаревшими проблемами всё ещё предлагают Release и Purge. Итог: кнопки отражают результат аудита, а оба действия перепроверяют перед выполнением; проверка для каждой строки добавила бы запросы в список, число запросов которого держит render guard.

threads.claim: The class docblock still says this summary has the same shape as the `media_audit_runs` counter columns and can be persisted directly. `releasedButReferenced` has no column, so update the docblock to note that this field is report-only and is not persisted.
threads.reply: Docblock wording. The new field has its own comment saying that media_audit_runs keeps no column for it (MediaAuditSummary.php:23), and RunMediaAuditJob writes the columns by name (RunMediaAuditJob.php:73-86).
threads.resolution_ru: Docblock MediaAuditSummary говорит, что сводка совпадает с колонками media_audit_runs, хотя у releasedButReferenced колонки нет. Итог: это формулировка docblock; у поля есть свой комментарий об отсутствии колонки, а RunMediaAuditJob пишет колонки по имени.

threads.claim: This test only asserts that `og:image:width` is omitted. Add the matching `og:image:height` check so a regression in the height guard is caught too.
threads.reply: The fix is the nullable constructor (OpenGraphImage.php:14-17): before it, the page threw a TypeError before rendering either tag, and assertOk pins that. The width and height tags have separate guards that predate this PR (post-show.blade.php:19-24).
threads.resolution_ru: Тест проверяет отсутствие только og:image:width, без og:image:height. Итог: исправление в nullable-конструкторе OpenGraphImage, раньше страница падала с TypeError до обоих тегов, и это фиксирует assertOk; отдельные проверки width и height были до этого PR.

threads.claim: The success stub ignores the text it receives, so this test cannot catch a copy of the wrong value. Record the argument in the stub and assert it equals the asset path.
threads.reply: This change is only about when the button says Copied or Copy failed. What it copies, $el.dataset.path from :data-path, is unchanged (asset-inspector.blade.php:66-70).
threads.resolution_ru: Stub успешного копирования игнорирует переданный текст, тест не поймает копирование не того значения. Итог: изменение касается только того, когда кнопка пишет Copied или Copy failed; что копируется ($el.dataset.path), не менялось.

threads.claim: Repeated clicks leave an earlier reset timer running, so the 'Copied' label can disappear before its 1.5s window ends. Store the timer and clear it before scheduling a new reset.
threads.reply: Cosmetic. A second click within 1.5 s can clear the label early, but what it shows is always the result of the latest copy.
threads.resolution_ru: Повторные клики оставляют прежний таймер сброса, и метка Copied может исчезнуть раньше 1.5 с. Итог: косметика; метка может пропасть раньше, но всегда показывает результат последнего копирования.

threads.claim: This test name claims a second click queues nothing, but it only checks that the buttons carry `wire:loading.attr="disabled"`. Either rename it to describe the markup check, or call `regenerate` twice and assert with `Queue::assertPushedTimes(GenerateMediaVariantsJob::class, 1)`.
threads.reply: The guard is the markup (wire:loading.attr="disabled" with the matching wire:target), which is what the test asserts; the name says why it is there. Calling regenerate twice would push two jobs, since the server never deduplicated them (MediaDiagnosticsPage.php:232-245).
threads.resolution_ru: Имя теста обещает, что второй клик ничего не ставит в очередь, а проверяется только разметка wire:loading.attr. Итог: защита и есть разметка, её тест и проверяет, имя объясняет зачем; двойной вызов regenerate поставил бы два задания, сервер их никогда не дедуплицировал.

threads.claim: This method now has two consecutive PHPDoc blocks, so the first description is ignored and the documentation can drift. Merge the null-dimension explanation into one block and remove the duplicate.
threads.reply: Docblock layout only, with no effect on behaviour. The block that applies (MediaVariantSpecification.php:30-34) is the one describing the nullable sizes.
threads.resolution_ru: У метода MediaVariantSpecification два подряд PHPDoc-блока, первый игнорируется. Итог: это только раскладка docblock, на поведение не влияет; действующий блок описывает nullable-размеры.

threads.claim: A failure in `isMissingAnyVariant()` is caught here, but `$processed` is incremented only afterward, so the summary can report `0 of 0` while reporting a failed asset. Count failed check attempts in the processed/attempted total as well.
threads.reply: "Of N candidate media assets" counts the assets found to be missing a variant, and one whose check threw was never found to be a candidate. It is printed by id with its error (GenerateMediaVariantsCommand.php:90), counted in the failure line (line 103), and the command exits FAILURE (line 105).
threads.resolution_ru: Сбой isMissingAnyVariant() не попадает в счётчик processed, сводка может показать «0 of 0» при ошибке. Итог: N считает ассеты с найденным недостающим вариантом, а ассет с исключением кандидатом не стал; он выводится по id с ошибкой, учтён в строке сбоев, команда завершается FAILURE.

threads.claim: Validate disks still used by post images. — After `MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK` changes, existing images can still use the former disk. If its URL is HTTP or uses another host, the verifier can pass while posts emit that URL as `og:image`. Also validate disks used by existing post images and their variants.
threads.reply: Not changing this. The verifier checks this deployment's configuration, and its probe is a synthetic post; it does not read media rows. Pointing MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK elsewhere does not move existing assets, which keep their own disk and its url: that switch is a migration of the assets, and it is where their disks belong to be checked, not in a configuration check that would turn into a scan of every image row.
threads.resolution_ru: Верификатор шаринга предложено расширить на диски существующих изображений постов. Итог: не меняем; он проверяет конфигурацию развёртывания на синтетическом посте, а смена MEDIA_PUBLIC_DISK это миграция ассетов, и проверять их диски нужно там, а не сканом всех строк.

threads.claim: Distinguish inaccessible files from deleted files. — If a directory loses search permission after listing, the existence check can return false for a file that still exists. The scanner then omits the file, so an audit can undercount orphans and a purge can report success without considering it. Distinguish access failures from deletion before skipping.
threads.reply: Not changing this. The storage layer decides 'not found' only through exists(), and Flysystem's fileExists() has no way to tell a missing file from one it cannot reach. What the scanner does with such a file is skip it: it is never a candidate, so a purge never deletes it. That errs on the safe side; it is considered again on the next scan once it can be read. Telling the two apart needs an adapter that reports permission errors, which none here does.
threads.resolution_ru: MediaOrphanScanner не отличает недоступный файл от удалённого. Итог: не меняем; fileExists() во Flysystem эти случаи не различает, сканер такой файл пропускает, purge его не удалит, и он будет рассмотрен при следующем скане; нужен адаптер, сообщающий об ошибках прав.

threads.claim: Check the master dimensions before skipping cover variants. — When a post image has no recorded dimensions, generation skips its OpenGraph variant even if the master is large enough. Regeneration also skips it, so the post uses a fallback image. Read the master dimensions before checking missing and eligible cover variants.
threads.reply: Not changing this. Every asset the application creates records its size from the normalized image (MediaAssetCreator), so a sizeless row only comes from outside that path. Not cropping a cover variant from a source of unknown size is the deliberate choice: the alternative risks an upscaled Open Graph image, and the post's fallback image is the safe outcome. Rows without a size are for a repair that records it, after which the variants generate as usual.
threads.resolution_ru: Для изображения без записанных размеров пропускается OpenGraph-вариант. Итог: не меняем; все ассеты приложения записывают размер через MediaAssetCreator, не резать cover-вариант из источника неизвестного размера это сознательная защита от апскейла, такие строки чинит отдельный repair.

threads.claim: Cover non-not-found storage failures. — If `lastModified()` throws a different `MediaStorageException` and `exists()` returns false, the scanner currently suppresses it. Add a test that expects the original exception, and preserve that failure in the scanner.
threads.reply: Not changing this, for the reason in the thread on the scanner itself: the scanner decides on the file's state, not on the exception's label. FilesystemMediaStorage::lastModified() already rethrows as-is any failure for a file that still exists, and calls it not found only once it is gone; a file that is gone is no orphan candidate, whatever made reading its time fail.
threads.resolution_ru: Нужен тест, что сканер не глушит MediaStorageException, отличные от not-found. Итог: не меняем по той же причине, что в треде о сканере: FilesystemMediaStorage::lastModified() перебрасывает сбой для существующего файла, а исчезнувший файл не кандидат в сироты.

threads.claim: This assertion passes when both measurements are zero, so it does not catch removing the profile’s rating-vote load. Assert the smaller measurement is positive before comparing the two counts.
threads.reply: It is an N+1 guard, and it fails without the change, where each card read its own rating answers. Both counts at zero would mean the profile stopped reading ratings altogether, a broken display rather than a regression this query-count test is meant to catch.
threads.resolution_ru: Проверка проходит, если оба замера равны нулю, и не поймает удаление загрузки голосов рейтинга. Итог: это защита от N+1, и без изменения она падает; два нуля означали бы, что профиль вообще перестал читать рейтинги, это сломанный вывод, а не то, что ловит этот тест.

threads.claim: `comments.user_id` is read by the moderation profile page (`UserModerationProfileQuery::history()`) and checked on every user delete, but it is not in `INDEXES`. Add `comments_user_id_index` for it, or document why it is excluded.
threads.reply: This migration covers the indexes the audit found missing on the feed's and the thread's read paths. comments.user_id is RESTRICT because accounts become tombstones and are never deleted (community-fk-safety.md:34, 51), and the moderation history is an admin page about one user. Out of scope here.
threads.resolution_ru: В миграции нет индекса для comments.user_id, который читает страница модерации и проверяет удаление пользователя. Итог: вне рамок; миграция покрывает индексы на путях чтения ленты и треда, аккаунты не удаляются, а становятся tombstone, история модерации это админ-страница одного пользователя.

threads.claim: This unscoped listener causes every save button on a feed page to receive each save event and issue a no-op network request for unrelated posts. Scope the event name by `postId` (for example, `saved-post-changed.{postId}`) and dispatch that scoped name.
threads.reply: Livewire sends the listener calls for one dispatch in a single request, and a button for another post does no I/O in syncSavedState() (SavePostButton.php:87-94). PostVoting's post-voted listener has the same shape (PostVoting.php:106-113). Scoping the event would save a little payload, not a query.
threads.resolution_ru: Неограниченный listener заставляет все кнопки сохранения на ленте слать запрос на каждое событие. Итог: Livewire отправляет вызовы listener одного dispatch одним запросом, кнопка чужого поста не делает I/O в syncSavedState(); сужение события сэкономит немного payload, но не запрос.

threads.claim: `up()` skips the required `(post_id, parent_id)` index on MySQL and MariaDB. Their separate foreign keys only create single-column supporting indexes, so comment-thread queries still lack the composite index; create this composite index on those engines and remove it in `down()` while continuing to skip redundant single-column foreign-key indexes.
threads.reply: PostgreSQL is what the audit measured and what production runs. MariaDB is a migrations-only compatibility job in CI (.github/workflows/ci.yml:637-649), and there each foreign key already has its own index; the post_id one serves the thread's reads.
threads.resolution_ru: На MySQL и MariaDB up() пропускает составной индекс (post_id, parent_id). Итог: аудит мерил PostgreSQL, и он же в продакшене; MariaDB в CI только проверяет миграции, и там у каждого внешнего ключа свой индекс, индекс post_id обслуживает чтения треда.

threads.claim: The feed now queries `post_saves` even when `show_saved_posts` is disabled and no save button is rendered. Skip saved-state loading when the feature is off, while still loading vote state.
threads.reply: That is one indexed query per page (PostCardViewerState.php:40), and only for a signed-in viewer (SavedPostState.php:17-19 returns early for a guest). Not worth a feature check in the shared loader.
threads.resolution_ru: Лента запрашивает post_saves даже при выключенном show_saved_posts. Итог: это один индексированный запрос на страницу и только для вошедшего пользователя, ради него не стоит добавлять проверку фичи в общий загрузчик.

threads.claim: `comment-voted` is still dispatched after every successful vote, but this change removes its only runtime listener and no other listener exists. Remove the no-op dispatch (and update its assertion) to avoid unnecessary event work.
threads.reply: An event with no listener costs nothing measurable, and comment-voted stays available as a hook (CommentVotingTest.php:28 asserts it). Removing it is unrelated cleanup.
threads.resolution_ru: Событие comment-voted отправляется, хотя единственный listener удалён. Итог: событие без listener ничего заметного не стоит и остаётся как точка расширения, CommentVotingTest его проверяет; удаление это посторонняя чистка.

threads.claim: This test verifies trimming affects the minimum-length validation, but not that valid padded reasons are stored without surrounding whitespace. Add a valid padded reason case and assert the created `ModerationLog` contains the trimmed value.
threads.reply: The test covers what this change adds: the three-character minimum is checked on the trimmed reason. Storing a reason without its edges predates this PR and is pinned in CreateModerationLogActionTest.php:54-67, which every sanction's log goes through (CreateModerationLogAction.php:26).
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не проверяет, что валидная причина с пробелами сохраняется обрезанной. Итог: тест покрывает то, что добавляет изменение, минимум в три символа на обрезанной причине; обрезка при сохранении была раньше и закреплена в CreateModerationLogActionTest.

threads.claim: This test does not verify the behavior named in the test: trimming a valid reason before storage. Add a valid padded reason case and assert the resulting `ModerationLog` reason is trimmed; keep this one-character case separately if the minimum-length edge is also required.
threads.reply: The test's name is about the minimum ('holds a hiding reason to its minimum as it is stored', ReportResourceActionsTest.php:189), and it asserts that: ' a ' is refused with `min` and the post stays Published. Storing the reason without its edges predates this PR and is covered by CreateModerationLogActionTest.php:54-67.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не проверяет обрезку валидной причины перед сохранением. Итог: имя теста про минимальную длину, и он это проверяет: ' a ' отклоняется по min, пост остаётся Published; обрезка при сохранении была до PR и покрыта CreateModerationLogActionTest.

threads.claim: `strip` still accepts invisible-only combining marks such as U+034F and U+FE0F. The comment action then persists them because its empty check sees a non-empty string, so include the relevant default-ignorable marks in this edge set and add regression cases.
threads.reply: Not changing this here. Stripping default-ignorables at the edges would also remove the U+FE0F that ends emoji such as "\u2764\uFE0F" at the end of a comment, altering what was typed. The PR targets paste artefacts (no-break space, zero-width space, BOM; AddCommentActionTest.php:276-278), and a body built only of combining or variation marks is deliberate input from an open-ended set that no edge strip can close.
threads.resolution_ru: InvisibleEdges::strip пропускает невидимые знаки вроде U+034F и U+FE0F. Итог: не меняем здесь; их срезание по краям убрало бы U+FE0F в конце эмодзи, PR нацелен на артефакты вставки, а текст из одних combining или variation знаков это намеренный ввод из открытого множества.

threads.claim: This stale-target path refreshes only the comments component and returns without emitting the deletion event. On feed pages, `PostFeed` therefore keeps showing the deleted comment in the post’s cached count; dispatch the appropriate change event, or use a shared refresh event, before returning.
threads.reply: The deletion happened elsewhere, so the feed card's count was already stale before the click, as it is for any change made in another tab or by another reader (PostFeed follows only this page's own events, app/Livewire/Feed/PostFeed.php:41-43). This path now redraws the thread instead of answering 404; keeping the feed's counts live is outside this fix.
threads.resolution_ru: CommentsSection на устаревшей цели обновляет только себя, без события удаления, и PostFeed показывает старый счётчик. Итог: удаление было в другом месте, счётчик уже устарел, как при правке из другой вкладки; путь теперь перерисовывает тред вместо 404, живые счётчики ленты вне фикса.

threads.claim: Report a stale hide as unavailable. — If another moderator already hid the comment, the action returns normally. This path emits `comment-hidden` without a change and can clear an open reply draft, but shows no unavailable toast. Have the action report whether it changed the comment, then handle a no-op before dispatching the event.
threads.reply: Not changing this. HideCommentAction is idempotent on purpose: a comment another moderator hid meanwhile is already in the state this moderator asked for, so telling them it is unavailable would say their action failed when its outcome holds. The thread refreshing without it and the reply form under it closing are right too: a hidden comment cannot be replied to, so that draft could never be sent. A comment that is gone (deleted) is still told as unavailable, as before.
threads.resolution_ru: Скрытие комментария, уже скрытого другим модератором, предложено сообщать как недоступное. Итог: не меняем; HideCommentAction идемпотентен намеренно, нужный результат достигнут; обновление треда и закрытие формы ответа верны, а удалённый комментарий по-прежнему сообщается как недоступный.

threads.claim: A forced preset with an empty tag list deletes tags even when author-deleted posts still reference them, and the pivot cascade permanently removes those associations. Preserve tags referenced by `withTrashed()` posts when pruning, matching `DeleteTagAction`'s safeguard.
threads.reply: With --force this is the documented behaviour: the option exists to 'replace an existing setup or configure a project with content' (SetupProjectPresetCommand.php:18) and the prompt says it replaces the tags (line 73). A forced list already removed tags used by live posts (ApplyProjectPresetAction.php:222), so protecting only author-deleted posts would make --force inconsistent rather than safe.
threads.resolution_ru: Принудительный пресет с пустым списком тегов удаляет теги, на которые ссылаются удалённые автором посты. Итог: с --force это документированная замена тегов; он уже удалял теги живых постов, так что защита только удалённых автором сделала бы --force непоследовательным, а не безопасным.

threads.claim: This test only asserts `assertOk()`, so it does not check the behavior its name promises. Assert the resolved filter property too (for example `assertSet('status', 'all')` for `ListUsers`), so a regression that keeps the array as a filter fails.
threads.reply: The fixed defect was an error page from an array-to-string conversion, and assertOk() fails on exactly that. normalize() replaces the array with the default (ListUsers.php:230), and keeping the array would reach the (string) casts in getViewData and fail the same assertion.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест проверяет только assertOk() и не проверяет итоговое значение фильтра. Итог: исправлялась страница ошибки от преобразования массива в строку, assertOk() ловит именно её; normalize() заменяет массив дефолтом, а оставленный массив дошёл бы до (string) и уронил тот же assert.

threads.claim: The docblock says this returns the first page for a page 'past any list', but it only applies to numbers above `ListPageNumber::MOST` (100,000). Correct the comment to describe that cap. Note that `?page=100001` now shows page 1, not the last page as the PR describes for out-of-range pages.
threads.reply: 'Past any list' is how ListPageNumber defines its cap ('Far beyond any list in the panel', ListPageNumber.php:14), and the PR states the rule as 1 to 100,000, else the first page. ?page=100001 opening page 1 is that documented rule; the last-page clamp applies to pages within range that a list no longer reaches.
threads.resolution_ru: Docblock говорит «past any list», хотя первая страница отдаётся только выше ListPageNumber::MOST, и ?page=100001 даёт страницу 1. Итог: так ListPageNumber определяет свой предел, PR задаёт правило «от 1 до 100 000, иначе первая»; clamp на последнюю страницу относится к страницам в диапазоне.

threads.claim: For an option that is already archived and stored as active, this guard blocks every drawer save, and the error says it 'was archived meanwhile'. The Active toggle is disabled in that state, so the admin cannot clear it. Unarchive the option first, or make the message name the actual state.
threads.reply: An archived option is stored inactive by ArchiveRatingOptionAction.php:36, so archived-and-active only arises from the race this guard closes. Such a row is recoverable: the drawer says to unarchive it from the options table (EditRatingGroup.php:499), and UnarchiveRatingOptionAction.php:38 clears archived_at and is_active together, after which the drawer saves normally.
threads.resolution_ru: Для архивной, но активной опции guard блокирует любое сохранение в drawer с сообщением «archived meanwhile». Итог: ArchiveRatingOptionAction делает архивную опцию неактивной, такое состояние даёт только закрытая гонка; drawer предлагает разархивировать, после чего сохранение работает.

threads.claim: The error for an out-of-range `--older-than` does not say the valid range. Use the same message as the sibling purge commands so users see the 0 to 36500 bound.
threads.reply: The message names the refused value and the run fails (MediaPurgeCommand.php:237), so this is wording consistency only; it can be aligned with the siblings when the command is next touched.
threads.resolution_ru: Ошибка о --older-than вне диапазона не называет допустимые границы. Итог: сообщение называет отклонённое значение и запуск падает, так что это только единообразие формулировок; выровняем с соседними командами, когда будем трогать команду.

threads.claim: The data update makes these rows visible but does not recount their posts. `posts.comments_count` will stay stale for affected posts until the next comment write on each post. Recount the affected posts in this migration, or note the manual recount as a deploy step.
threads.reply: Every writer sets the status explicitly (AddCommentAction.php:136, DemoFillSeeder.php:695, CommentFactory.php:22), and a 'published' row could not even be read back, so the update is a defensive no-op on real data. If such a row existed, the counter is recomputed from scratch on that post's next comment write (RefreshesPostCommentsCount.php:22-30).
threads.resolution_ru: Миграция делает строки видимыми, но не пересчитывает posts.comments_count. Итог: все писатели задают статус явно, а строку с 'published' нельзя даже прочитать, так что update это защитный no-op; если такая строка есть, счётчик пересчитается при следующей записи комментария.

threads.claim: This guard is redundant. An empty `--post=` already fails the `ctype_digit` check below with the same message, and Symfony rejects a bare value-required `--post` before `handle()` runs. Delete the block; the existing check already refuses an empty id.
threads.reply: `{--post=}` declares an optional value in Laravel's signature parser (Illuminate/Console/Parser.php:110), so a bare `--post` reaches handle() as null and previously fell through to the full purge (PostsPurgeCommand.php:173-175). The guard is what refuses it; PostsPurgeCommandTest.php:63 covers that case.
threads.resolution_ru: Проверку пустого --post назвали избыточной. Итог: {--post=} в Laravel это необязательное значение, голый --post приходит в handle() как null и раньше проваливался в полный purge; именно эта проверка его отклоняет, случай покрыт PostsPurgeCommandTest.

threads.claim: This out-of-range fallback is copy-pasted into about nine admin pages, and this copy adds a `total() > 0` guard that the Personas and Studio pages lack. Move the logic into one helper next to `ListPageNumber`, such as a paginator-aware method, and call it from each page so the empty-list behaviour is the same everywhere.
threads.reply: A refactor beyond this PR's scope. The guard makes no visible difference: with no rows lastPage() is 1, so the unguarded copies (such as the existing ListPersonas.php:138-139) and the guarded ones both show the empty state.
threads.resolution_ru: Fallback для страницы вне диапазона скопирован примерно в девять админ-страниц, предложено вынести его в общий helper. Итог: рефакторинг вне рамок PR; guard total() > 0 видимой разницы не даёт, при пустом списке lastPage() равен 1 и обе версии показывают пустое состояние.

threads.claim: “Unsigned digit string of one” is incomplete and omits the accepted range; describe it as a digit string representing a value in range.
threads.reply: Docblock wording only: 'an integer from 0 to MAX_DAYS, or unsigned digit string of one' (RetentionDays.php:8-9) already carries the range. It may be reworded together with the MAX_DAYS comment.
threads.resolution_ru: Формулировка docblock RetentionDays неполная и не называет диапазон. Итог: только формулировка, диапазон от 0 до MAX_DAYS в docblock уже указан; можно переписать вместе с комментарием к MAX_DAYS.

threads.claim: Handle invalid grace values in media diagnostics. — If `MEDIA_PURGE_GRACE_DAYS` exceeds 36500, opening an asset inspector or confirming a purge can fail with an uncaught exception. Show a configuration error and disable both purge entry points until the value is corrected. Keep the service validation in place.
threads.reply: Not changing this. A grace above 36500 days is a value no deployment means: the templates ship a few days, and the bound exists so a saturated value refuses the purge rather than wrapping the cutoff round to now. Refusing loudly is the intent wherever the grace is read, the diagnostics page included; its error is reported, names the setting, and goes once the value is corrected. A separate disabled state on two entry points would be UI for a misconfiguration the refusal already makes plain.
threads.resolution_ru: При MEDIA_PURGE_GRACE_DAYS больше 36500 инспектор и purge падают с исключением, предложено показывать ошибку конфигурации и отключать purge. Итог: не меняем; такое значение никто не задаёт, громкий отказ задуман везде, ошибка называет настройку и уходит после исправления.

threads.claim: Allow valid pages above 100000. — If a posts list contains more than 2.5 million rows, its pagination controls offer pages that this helper maps to page 1. Allow those valid pages while retaining protection against oversized offsets.
threads.reply: Not changing this. 100000 pages of 25 rows is 2.5 million rows in one admin list, far past anything this panel lists; the bound is what keeps a forged page number from reaching the database as an enormous offset. A list approaching that size needs keyset pagination, not a higher cap, and that is the change to make then.
threads.resolution_ru: ListPageNumber отправляет страницы выше 100000 на первую, хотя в списке может быть больше 2,5 млн строк. Итог: не меняем; таких списков в панели нет, а предел не пускает подделанный номер страницы в БД как огромный offset; для таких объёмов нужна keyset-пагинация.

threads.claim: Keep the audit running when grace validation fails. — If the configured grace exceeds 36500 days, an unreferenced soft-deleted asset makes `media:audit` abort before reporting missing files, orphans, and failed jobs. Preserve purge validation, but let the audit report independent checks and mark grace-dependent classification as unavailable.
threads.reply: Not changing this, for the reason given on the purge command: an out-of-range grace is a configuration error, and the audit run fails with it, recorded as a failed run and reported, rather than reporting a partial picture as if it were complete. Correcting the value lets the next run report everything.
threads.resolution_ru: При неверном grace media:audit прерывается и не сообщает результаты независимых проверок. Итог: не меняем по той же причине, что для команды purge: это ошибка конфигурации, прогон записывается как неуспешный, а не выдаёт частичную картину за полную; исправленное значение вернёт полный отчёт.

threads.claim: Keep rollback from restoring an invalid comment default. — After rollback, an insert without `status` stores `published`. Reading that status through `Comment` then throws because `CommentStatus` has no `published` case. Keep the rollback default compatible with the cast.
threads.reply: Not changing this. A down() restores the schema the migration found, and that was the 'published' default; the rows it converted stay visible (the comment in down() says so, and a test now checks it). Every write path sets a comment's status explicitly, so the old default only ever reached rows written straight to the table, which is what up() repaired.
threads.resolution_ru: Откат миграции возвращает дефолт 'published', которого нет в CommentStatus. Итог: не меняем; down() восстанавливает найденную схему, конвертированные строки остаются видимыми, и это проверяет тест; все пути записи задают статус явно, старый дефолт получали только строки, записанные напрямую.

threads.claim: This regression test does not cover a username changed after the editor read the account, even though username is part of the stale-state comparison. Add a username case so a future save cannot silently overwrite that concurrent change without failing tests.
threads.reply: The username is part of the same comparison (UpdateUserAccountAction.php:127) that the existing name, address and role rows exercise (UpdateUserAccountActionTest.php:153-171). Another row would add coverage of the same conjunction, not of a different behaviour.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест не покрывает username, изменённый после того, как редактор прочитал аккаунт. Итог: username входит в то же сравнение, что уже проверяют строки с именем, адресом и ролью; ещё одна строка покрыла бы ту же конъюнкцию, а не новое поведение.

threads.claim: This assertion does not reject the misleading success toast that this race test is meant to prevent, so a future implementation could dispatch both error and `Comment #… hidden` messages while the test still passes. Also assert that the success toast is not dispatched.
threads.reply: A hide that went through would already fail this test: it asserts the error toast and that no HideComment log was written (ReportResourceActionsTest.php:150-153). The comment list's twin checks the absent success toast as well (CommentResourceActionsTest.php:92); mirroring it here would be a nicety, not a missing check.
threads.resolution_ru: Тест гонки не проверяет отсутствие ложного success-тоста. Итог: прошедшее скрытие и так провалит тест, он проверяет error-тост и отсутствие лога HideComment; двойник в CommentResourceActionsTest проверяет и тост, повторить его здесь было бы удобством, а не недостающей проверкой.

threads.claim: This assertion does not verify that Google was omitted from persisted settings: `toMatchArray` accepts extra keys, while the manager check passes for both a missing Google key and `google => true`. Use an exact array assertion so a save that writes the stale Google value cannot pass.
threads.reply: This test checks the effective providers after a switch-off. Not writing an untouched provider back over someone else's value is asserted in ProjectSettingsPageTest.php:74-103, where Google stays off after a stale tab saves.
threads.resolution_ru: toMatchArray допускает лишние ключи, поэтому тест не докажет, что Google не записан в настройки. Итог: этот тест проверяет действующих провайдеров после отключения; что нетронутый провайдер не перезаписывается, проверяет ProjectSettingsPageTest, где Google остаётся выключенным.

threads.claim: Trimming before this diff can turn an untouched whitespace-padded field into a stale write. If another administrator updates that field after the page opens, this editor sends the trimmed old value and overwrites the newer value; compare equivalent normalized snapshots deliberately or compute the change set before normalization.
threads.reply: Only the identity and label texts are trimmed (ProjectSettingsPage.php:279-281), and they are only ever stored by this page, already trimmed, or by presets from config. A padded stored value does not arise, so an untouched field compares equal and is not written.
threads.resolution_ru: Обрезка до сравнения может превратить нетронутое поле с пробелами в устаревшую запись. Итог: обрезаются только тексты identity и label, а хранит их только эта страница, уже обрезанными, или пресеты из config; значения с пробелами не возникают, нетронутое поле не пишется.

threads.claim: `change()` decides whether to validate the catalog from the cached settings value before locking the row. A concurrent update can make that decision stale, allowing an incomplete locale to be newly offered or rejecting a locale already offered; derive the current offered state after `lockedRow()` and validate against it.
threads.reply: The list change is applied to the locked row (UpdateProjectLocaleSettingsAction.php:99-106), which keeps another administrator's change. The catalog pre-check reads state from the same request, so it can only misjudge a language with a broken catalog that someone else toggles within that request; not worth inspecting catalogs under the settings lock.
threads.resolution_ru: change() решает о проверке каталога по кешированным настройкам до блокировки строки. Итог: изменение списка применяется к заблокированной строке и сохраняет чужие правки; предпроверка ошибётся лишь для языка со сломанным каталогом, переключённого в тот же момент, это не стоит проверки под блокировкой.

threads.claim: Detect password changes before replacing the password. — If the owner resets their password after the drawer opens, the stale-edit check still passes. The administrator’s save can then replace the new password without a warning. Capture a credential revision when the drawer opens and check it when saving a replacement password.
threads.reply: Not changing this. Setting a password is a deliberate replacement by the administrator, whatever the account's password was: unlike the name or address, there is nothing of the owner's to merge, and a reset meanwhile is not an edit this save could undo. The owner's sessions end on the change either way. A credential revision in the drawer would bring the password state into an admin form for no outcome a stale check could improve.
threads.resolution_ru: Сохранение администратором может заменить пароль, который владелец сменил после открытия drawer. Итог: не меняем; установка пароля это намеренная замена, сливать с данными владельца нечего, его сессии завершаются в любом случае, а ревизия учётных данных в форме ничего бы не улучшила.

threads.claim: Compare normalized text against a normalized baseline. — If a stored tagline has surrounding whitespace, an unchanged draft is treated as edited. A later save can overwrite another administrator’s tagline. Normalize both values before comparison and add a concurrent-save test with a padded baseline.
threads.reply: Not changing this; it was raised on the first review round too. Only the identity and label texts are trimmed, and they are stored only by this page, already trimmed, or by presets from config, which carry no padding. A padded stored tagline does not arise, so an unchanged draft compares equal.
threads.resolution_ru: Нормализованный текст предложено сравнивать с нормализованным baseline, иначе tagline с пробелами считается изменённым. Итог: не меняем, это уже поднималось в первом раунде; обрезаются только тексты identity и label, хранятся они уже обрезанными, так что tagline с пробелами не возникает.

threads.claim: This sentence incorrectly implies that dry-run purges lock report rows, although dry runs intentionally use an unlocked read. Qualify the locking guarantee as applying only to non-dry-run purges so operators do not infer race protection from a dry-run result.
